# BADAN Master Product Blueprint — v2.0 (Execution-Grade Super-Blueprint)

**BADAN بدن — The Body's Own Ledger**
Product master plan · technical architecture spec · implementation decomposition map · repo planning guide · agent orchestration guide · phased execution plan — in one document.

- **Document status:** v2.0 execution-grade super-blueprint (supersedes v1.0; v1 remains the strategic record)
- **Date:** July 2026
- **Lineage:** v1 was synthesized from (a) the "Health Analysis Apps: A Developer's Deep Report" market/technical analysis and (b) a frame-by-frame analysis of a ~6-minute Bevel screen recording (July 2026 build). v2 preserves every v1 decision and expands each section into implementation-grade specification, then adds twenty new execution sections (§47–§66) covering repository design, platform architectures, subsystem implementation plans, testing/CI/CD/migrations/observability, and the agent-orchestration capstone.
- **Scope guardrail (unchanged):** wellness and personal health tracking, interpretation, logging, reporting, and user-controlled data workflows. No diagnosis, no treatment claims, no surveillance features. All clinical-adjacent capability is future potential, explicitly labeled and compliance-gated.

## 1. Executive framing

### 1.1 What BADAN is

BADAN (بدن — Arabic for "body") is a **personal health repository and interpretation layer**: a single place where every health signal a person can practically collect — wearable biometrics, sleep, workouts, nutrition, glucose, cycle data, symptoms, medications, body composition, lab biomarkers, subjective mood and energy — is ingested, normalized, stored with provenance, interpreted in plain language, and returned to the user in whatever form they want: a one-line morning summary, a trend chart, a narrative PDF, or a raw CSV.

BADAN is simultaneously two products sharing one data model:

1. **For the casual user:** an app that requires *near-zero interaction* to be useful. Connect a data source once, glance at one screen each morning, read one honest sentence about your body. Never forced to log anything, never punished for passivity, never confronted with a wall of numbers.
2. **For the power user:** the most inspectable, exportable, longitudinally deep consumer health platform on the market. Every score decomposable to its inputs. Every input traceable to its source sample. Every dataset exportable in machine-readable form. Every algorithm documented in-app.

This dual nature is the core product thesis, and in v2 it is also an engineering thesis: the "two altitudes" ship as **rendering profiles stored in the `customization_profiles` table**, evaluated by the shared KMP core (`core-registry`, `core-scoring`), so casual and power modes are provably the same data path. The market evidence stands: casual users pay for interpretation, not raw data; power users churn exactly when interpretation is opaque, unexportable, or contradicts lived experience. Both problems have one solution — **an interpretation layer built on radical data transparency** — and this document specifies it down to module, file, table, event, and test.

### 1.2 Why now — the strategic window

Step counters and dashboards are commoditized; the frontier is *connected health intelligence* — fusing wearables, nutrition, clinical data, and AI coaching. Bevel leads that direction today, but six simultaneous gaps remain open, and no leader has closed them together. v2 binds each gap to the repo assets that close it:

| # | Documented gap | Who fails | BADAN's answer | Closing repo assets |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Genuine device agnosticism | WHOOP (own hardware), Oura (ring), Bevel (Apple Watch–primary, iOS only) | All wearables as equal citizens; iOS + Android parity from day one | `adapters/port-health/` + `port-health-ios/` + `port-health-android/`; parity matrix in `docs/` (§12) |
| 2 | Female physiology as a covariate | WHOOP (documented luteal-phase false alarms), Bevel (cycle as bolt-on) | Cycle phase modeled inside every baseline and score | `core-baseline` covariate contexts; `cycle.phase` in `contracts/metrics/registry/` (§10.13, E-14) |
| 3 | Private, on-device AI | All (cloud-first AI) | Tiered AI with an explicit "nothing leaves the phone" mode | `core-insight` local path; `backend/services/ai-gateway/` only for opted-in tiers (§23.4, E-21) |
| 4 | Raw data export / user API | WHOOP ❌, Oura ❌, Bevel ❌ | CSV/JSON/PDF/SQLite export as a *free, first-class* feature + personal API | `core-export`, `contracts/export/schema/v1/`, `contracts/api/personal-api-openapi.yaml` (E-09, E-22) |
| 5 | Non-punitive pricing | WHOOP ($30/mo resentment), Bevel (core interpretation paywalled) | Repository never paywalled; premium is depth-of-interpretation | Entitlement checks confined to UI layer (Law 1 mechanism, §2.1.1); pricing anchors $59.99/yr, $7.99/mo, 14-day trial |
| 6 | Cold-start honesty | Bevel: locked rings, particle-scrambled numbers, "Calibrating," empty states dominate the first session | Something real immediately: historical backfill + provisional values with confidence flags | E-02.3 backfill; `QualityFlags.provisional` rendered end-to-end (§27, §37) |

### 1.3 What BADAN is not

- Not a medical device, a diagnostic tool, or a treatment recommender. Wording guardrails are engineered, not editorial: `contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml` feeds the `core-phrasing` linter that gates every insight template and content article in CI (§23.9, §28).
- Not a hardware company. BADAN never privileges its own sensor because it has none; `SourceConnection` treats every source symmetrically.
- Not a Bevel clone. Bevel is the coverage floor (v1 §6.1 observations remain the parity checklist); BADAN diverges structurally on export, Android, offline-first ownership, meds/symptoms/conditions as first-class citizens, and Arabic/RTL at launch.
- Not a social network first. Community arrives Phase 3 (E-23), additive, never load-bearing.

### 1.4 The one-paragraph pitch

> Your body produces data all day. Today that data is scattered across a watch app, a ring app, a food app, a pharmacy bag, and a lab PDF — each fragment interpreted by a different company, none of it truly yours. BADAN gathers all of it into one private repository you actually own, explains it in one honest sentence a day (or a 40-page report, if that's who you are), works in your language, on your platform, with your devices — and lets you take every byte with you, forever.

### 1.6 The twelve delivery tracks

Numbered inventory; missions are one line, full charters and dependency matrices live in §66.

1. **TRACK-CONTRACTS** — author and freeze every spec under `contracts/` (metric registry, event taxonomies, export schemas, sync protocol, APIs, phrasing guardrails) before dependent code starts; changes thereafter require ADR + version bump.
2. **TRACK-CORE-DATA** — build the KMP data spine: `core-model`, `core-registry`, `core-db`, `core-ingest`, `core-sync`, `core-export`, `core-search`.
3. **TRACK-CORE-INTEL** — build the interpretation spine: `core-baseline`, `core-scoring`, `core-insight`, `core-phrasing`, `core-notify`, `core-flags`, `core-analytics`.
4. **TRACK-IOS-SHELL** — ship the SwiftUI app shell: `BadanApp.swift`, `AppRouter.swift`, DI, `DesignSystem/` tokens and components.
5. **TRACK-IOS-FEATURES** — implement every `ios/BadanApp/Features/<FeatureName>/` screen against §16A specs.
6. **TRACK-AND-SHELL** — ship the Compose shell: `net.badan.app` navigation, `designsystem/`, `platform/` glue.
7. **TRACK-AND-FEATURES** — implement every `net.badan.app.features.<feature>` screen against §16B specs at iOS parity.
8. **TRACK-ADAPTERS** — implement `HealthStorePort` + platform actuals (HealthKit, Health Connect) and the utility ports (`CryptoPort`, `ClockPort`, `PushPort`, locale/files).
9. **TRACK-BACKEND** — stand up `backend/services/` (identity, sync, integrations, fooddata, ai-gateway, contentcms, push, billing, telemetry) and `backend/infra/` IaC.
10. **TRACK-AMBIENT** — widgets, watch apps, complications/tiles, Live Activities, Shortcuts/Intents on both platforms.
11. **TRACK-CONTENT** — education articles, insight template corpus, EN/AR localization, store listings, in-app glossary; everything under `content/`.
12. **TRACK-QA-RELEASE** — fixtures and golden files in `core-testing/`, conformance suites, perf budgets, accessibility/RTL audits, release trains, store submissions.

### 1.8 Success criteria for this blueprint

A product and engineering organization should be able to use this document to:

- staff and sequence 36 months of work across the 12 tracks with explicit blocking edges (§40–42, §66);
- freeze the canonical contracts before the first screen ships (TRACK-CONTRACTS exit criteria in §47+);
- pass privacy review in EU, GCC, and US wellness contexts (§28–29);
- meet or exceed Bevel's observed feature surface — v1 §6.1 remains the parity checklist, re-verified per release by TRACK-QA-RELEASE;
- and resolve, repeatedly and explicitly, the central tension — **broad + deep + calm** — with a named mechanism each time it appears (progressive disclosure, presets, phrasing engine, notification budgets).

## 2. Product philosophy

### 2.1 The seven laws as enforcement mechanisms

Each law is a decision-arbiter (lower number wins in conflict) and, in v2, an **enforced invariant**: each carries (a) an architectural consequence, (b) enforcing module(s) and the CI check, (c) a testable acceptance criterion, (d) a violation example code review must reject.

#### 2.1.1 Law 1 — The repository is sacred; the interpretation is a service

Raw samples, logs, and provenance are the permanent, free, exportable core; scores, insights, and AI narratives are a monetizable layer on top. Bevel padlocks the Nutrition Score ring and particle-scrambles Biological Age; BADAN may gate *derived intelligence*, never *ingested data or manual logs*.

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** storage and export are physically separated from entitlements. Entitlement checks live **only in the UI layer** (feature ViewModels and screen composition); no core module can even see subscription state.
- **(b) Enforcement:** dependency-graph rule `deps.raw-data-firewall`: Gradle modules `:core:core-db`, `:core:core-export`, `:core:core-ingest`, `:core:core-model` MUST NOT declare a dependency on `:core:core-flags` (which carries entitlement evaluation) or any billing artifact. Enforced by `tooling/ci/deps-guard` (module-graph allowlist, CI-blocking) plus a Konsist test in `core-testing` asserting no import of `FeatureFlagService` inside those modules.
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** fixture `fixture_expired_subscription` — with entitlement state `expired`, `ExportEngine.buildBundle()` produces a byte-identical export to the `active` state for all raw tables (`samples`, `event_records`, `sessions`, `medication_regimens`, `adherence_events`); only `derived_values`/`insights` presence may differ per plan definition.
- **(d) Review must reject:** an `ExportEngine` change that injects `FeatureFlagService` to "skip premium columns"; a delete-account flow that requires an active subscription to run the pre-deletion export.

#### 2.1.2 Law 2 — Honesty over reassurance, but kindness over alarm

The #1 churn driver is "the algorithm disagrees with how I feel." The answer is *explained* numbers with *confidence*, not softer numbers. Every score ships with top contributing inputs, a confidence/quality indicator, a "why am I seeing this" affordance, and non-alarmist phrasing. During calibration BADAN says "I'm still learning your baseline — this number will wobble for ~2 more weeks."

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** confidence is a type-level requirement — `DerivedValue` in `core-model` carries non-nullable `QualityFlags` (incl. `provisional`, `confidence`, `algorithmVersion`); `ScoringEngine` cannot emit a score without input attribution captured for the Score Anatomy sheet.
- **(b) Enforcement:** `core-phrasing/PhrasingLinter` compiled against `contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml` (banned lexicon: "warning", "danger", "failed", diagnosis verbs; required patterns: confidence qualifier when `provisional=true`). CI job `tooling/ci/phrasing-lint` runs over all insight templates in `content/` and all string catalogs; CI-blocking.
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** golden test in `core-testing/golden/`: for a `fixture_calibrating_user` (day 5 of history), every rendered score surface (Today, detail, widget, export narrative) includes the provisional marker; zero guardrail-lexicon hits across the template corpus.
- **(d) Review must reject:** an insight template asserting "Your recovery is poor" for a user inside the calibration window; any score UI that renders a bare number with no path to its inputs in ≤2 taps.

#### 2.1.3 Law 3 — Zero-effort utility; opt-in depth

A user who does nothing but grant permissions must receive daily value indefinitely. Logging multiplies value but is never a precondition. Bevel's "Log 776 kcal to unlock today's Nutrition score" is the named anti-pattern.

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** every feature is specified twice — a passive variant fed by ambient data and an active variant enriched by logs. The §16 screen-spec template makes `empty`/`no-data` states mandatory fields; `GetTodayOverviewQuery` must return a renderable payload from wearable data alone.
- **(b) Enforcement:** UI state contract — iOS `LoadState.empty(EmptyReason)` and Android `XxxUiState.Empty` variants are required by the sealed-interface pattern; §62 suite `suite_smoke_casual` drives every top-level screen with `fixture_rania_wearable_only` (zero logs) and fails if any screen shows a lock, a demand-to-log, or a dead end instead of ambient value or a self-hidden module.
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** with `fixture_rania_wearable_only`, the Nutrition surface renders active-energy context and an invitation (never a gate); modules with no data self-hide (no persistent `0g/0g/0g` rows).
- **(d) Review must reject:** any screen whose loaded state branches on "has the user logged today"; a score whose unlock condition is a manual-logging threshold.

#### 2.1.4 Law 4 — One data model, two altitudes

Casual and power modes are *renderings*, not forks. The same canonical record powers the one-ring glance and the 90-day rolling-delta table.

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** there is exactly one database (`core-db` SQLDelight schemas); depth is a presentation profile persisted in `customization_profiles` and interpreted by view-facing queries — never a second store, never duplicated precision.
- **(b) Enforcement:** presets defined once in `contracts/presets/presets.yaml` (ADR-gated contract addition) and loaded by `core-registry`; schema review rule in `tooling/ci/schema-guard` rejects any new table whose columns duplicate an existing metric at different granularity; snapshot test renders Today in `preset_casual` and `preset_power` from the *same* fixture and asserts identical underlying `DerivedValue` ids.
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** switching preset at runtime requires zero recomputation — verified by asserting no `ScoresRecomputed` domain event fires on preset change.
- **(d) Review must reject:** a "power mode" feature that stores its own aggregates in a new table instead of reading `derived_values`; casual-mode rounding applied at write time rather than render time.

#### 2.1.5 Law 5 — Provenance or it didn't happen

Every stored value carries source device, source app, ingestion path, timestamps, timezone, algorithm version (derived values), and quality flags. This makes dedup tractable (§34), exports trustworthy (§20), and "why does my sleep differ from my ring app?" answerable in-product. Bevel's Data Sources screen is matched and extended to per-*sample* lineage.

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** `Provenance` is a non-nullable field of `Sample`, `IntervalRecord`, `Session`, `EventRecord`, and `DerivedValue` in `core-model`; the corresponding columns are `NOT NULL` in every `.sq` schema; `NormalizationPipeline` rejects (to a quarantine table, not silently) any inbound record lacking source identity.
- **(b) Enforcement:** `core-ingest` conformance suite (E-03.2, ≥40 real-world dedup fixtures, CI-blocking); export schema `contracts/export/schema/v1/` marks provenance columns as `required`, so schema snapshot tests fail if an export drops them.
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** for any sample visible in the Raw Data Explorer, a lineage sheet resolves device, app, ingestion path, and dedup decision in ≤2 taps; every exported row round-trips its `algorithm_version` for derived values.
- **(d) Review must reject:** a demo/seed script inserting samples with `source = "unknown"`; a new derived metric writer that omits `algorithmVersion`.

#### 2.1.6 Law 6 — The body is one system; the app must feel like one app

The most damning power-user critique of Bevel: fragmentation. Cross-pillar links are mandatory: sleep detail references last night's late meal; recovery references yesterday's strain and cycle phase; the Timeline interleaves all event types on one axis.

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** cross-pillar communication runs through the internal domain-event bus typed by `contracts/events/domain-events.yaml` (`IngestBatchCompleted`, `ScoresRecomputed`, `InsightGenerated`…); `core-insight/InsightEngine` subscribes across families by design, and every feature registers its events into the unified Timeline projection.
- **(b) Enforcement:** contract rule — a new feature PR must add its event types to `domain-events.yaml` and a Timeline renderer registration, checked by `tooling/ci/timeline-coverage` (compares registered event kinds against the `event_records.kind` enum); §62 suite `suite_connective_tissue` asserts the three canonical cross-links (sleep↔meal, recovery↔strain, recovery↔cycle-phase when enabled).
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** with `fixture_late_meal_short_sleep`, the sleep detail screen renders the late-meal reference card sourced from `MealEntry` via the Timeline projection — no direct feature-to-feature import.
- **(d) Review must reject:** feature module A importing feature module B's repository directly; a new loggable type that never appears on the Timeline.

#### 2.1.7 Law 7 — Built for the world, not for one platform or one language

iOS + Android at feature parity; full RTL and Arabic at launch; metric/imperial and mmol/L vs mg/dL both first-class; regional food databases; Ramadan-aware "schedule context" and prayer-time-quiet windows expressed as neutral, generic mechanisms.

- **(a) Architectural consequence:** all logic that could diverge lives in the KMP core; platform code is shells + adapters. Units and locale formatting are core concerns (`core-model` value classes render via `port-locale`), so charts and exports localize identically.
- **(b) Enforcement:** CI gates — string-extraction lint (no hardcoded user-facing strings on either platform), RTL snapshot suite `suite_rtl_l10n` (§62) over the top 20 screens, and a release gate that blocks shipping a feature flagged `ff_*` on one platform unless `docs/runbooks/parity-exceptions.md` documents the fallback with an ADR reference.
- **(c) Acceptance criterion:** `fixture_kenji_locale_matrix` renders the same `DerivedValue` in 6 locales (incl. AR RTL, mmol/L and mg/dL) with correct digits, direction, week-start, and identical values in the corresponding export.
- **(d) Review must reject:** an iOS-only nutrition write-back merged without a documented Health Connect equivalent or fallback; a chart component that mirrors its time axis in RTL (time axes remain LTR per §25.9).

### 2.2 Emotional register — operationalized

BADAN must be **not boring, not sterile, not intimidating, not clinical**. In v2 the register is carried by named systems, not taste:

- **Warm-serious.** Bevel's scenic hero art is the single best emotional device observed; BADAN adopts the principle as the generative "inner landscape" component (§25.4), a `DesignSystem/` deliverable (`BadanHeroCanvas` on iOS, `HeroCanvas` composable on Android) whose palette is driven by daily state tokens.
- **Confident, plain language.** Bevel's coaching altitude ("Your Resting HRV (25.4 ms) is near its average of 31.4 ms") is standardized as the Narrative Voice: templates in `content/`, rendered by `core-phrasing/PhrasingEngine` with tone policies (`neutral`, `gentle`, `direct`) selected in settings and enforced by `PhrasingLinter`.
- **Delight in the details, never in the way.** Ring-fill micro-animations, haptic ticks on chart scrubbing, opt-in streak celebrations — specified as interaction tokens in §26; explicitly banned by guardrails: confetti storms, shame mechanics, red badges for missed logs (lint rule `guardrails.yaml#punitive_ui`).

### 2.3 The trust ladder — each rung a shipped system

| Rung | Trust claim | Owning system (path) | Verification surface |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Accuracy — data matches source apps | `core-ingest/DedupEngine` + decision journal | Reconciliation UI (§37); dedup conformance suite (E-03.2) |
| 2 | Interpretation — scores match lived experience or explain why | `core-scoring` input attribution + `StatusInterval` contexts (§10.13) | Score Anatomy sheet; confidence bands |
| 3 | Privacy — visible, revocable, local-first | consent center + `consent_records` table; local-only mode (§28.5) | Network-transparency page; telemetry opt-out (§36.2) |
| 4 | Ownership — export everything, delete everything, verifiably | `core-export` + Export Center (§20) | Manifest + generated data dictionary in `docs/data-dictionary/` |
| 5 | Longevity — repository outlives devices and subscriptions | `core-sync` E2E sync (§34); open formats in `contracts/export/schema/v1/` | Cross-platform restore drill (E-24); import connectors (§13.9) |

### 2.4 What we copy, improve, and reject from Bevel — philosophy level

| Dimension | Copy | Improve | Reject |
|---|---|---|---|
| Interpretive tone | Plain-language coaching sentences with real numbers | Add confidence + "why" affordance to every one | Overclaiming certainty during calibration |
| Progressive disclosure | Detail-sheet template (value → status vs personal range → chart → trends table → resources → definition) | Make it universal across *all* metric types incl. labs, meds, symptoms | Burying core value behind Pro locks on the first screen |
| Contextual status | Activity Status (Active/Sick/Injured/On A Break) propagated to trends | Richer taxonomy (travel, fasting, med change, cycle phase) feeding scoring covariates | Context as a manual-only afterthought |
| Data controls | Calculations settings (HRV/RHR methods, source windows), Data Sources with hide/merge | Per-metric algorithm docs and per-sample lineage | Hiding algorithm behavior entirely |
| Visual system | Dark-first, pillar accents, band-charts with personal ranges | Full light theme, accessibility palettes, RTL mirroring | Single-theme lock-in; decorative charts without axes |
| Monetization | Free trial, yearly discount | Repository-free / intelligence-paid split | Locking the day-one hero number (particle-scramble) — BADAN teases with *a real limited version*, never obfuscation |

AR equivalents; every Law 2/2.2 rule has a machine-checkable entry |

| WP-07-01 | Narrative Voice tone-policy spec + 30 seed coaching templates EN/AR | `content/en/`, `content/ar/`, `core/core-phrasing/` | WP-08-01 | WP-08-02 | All templates pass `phrasing-lint`; AR templates reviewed by native speaker; tone switch changes rendering without template forks |

## 3. User archetypes

Twenty archetypes, carried in full from v1 and compressed to operational form. They are *design test fixtures*: every §16 screen must pass "would archetype X understand this / would archetype Y respect this?" Each archetype now names its default preset (defined in `contracts/presets/presets.yaml`), 2–3 acceptance-test fixtures (shipped in `core-testing/fixtures/`), and its analytics segment (`user_segment` enum in `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` — computed on-device from behavior shape only; never from health values; never sent when telemetry is opted out; cycle-module enablement is never encoded in any segment).

### 3.1 Rania — the passive casual user
- 34, PM, Apple Watch "because it came with the phone plan"; opens BADAN 3–5 mornings/week for <30s; never logs, customizes, or exports.
- **Value prop:** the One True Sentence + three glanceable rings; auto-everything; empty modules self-hide (anti-Bevel: no persistent 0g macros row).
- **Danger:** intimidation walls, guilt mechanics, paywall resentment.
- **Preset:** `preset_casual` (Health Monitor collapsed to 3 tiles; nutrition hidden until first data).
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_rania_wearable_only` (60d Watch data, zero logs), `fixture_rania_gap_week` (7-day wear gap — no shame copy), `fixture_rania_day_one` (first-launch, backfill running).
- **Segment:** `seg_glance`.

### 3.2 Omar — the lightly engaged wellness user
- 41, gym twice weekly; opens daily, one detail screen/week, logs food in bursts.
- **Value prop:** weekly digest with one actionable theme; forgiving streaks (freezes); self-configured nudges.
- **Danger:** notification noise; five scores that don't cohere.
- **Preset:** `preset_casual_plus` (weekly report enabled).
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_omar_burst_logger` (2 weeks of food logs then none — no regression nagging), `fixture_omar_notification_budget` (throttling per §24.8).
- **Segment:** `seg_light`.

### 3.3 Ayesha — the Apple Watch heavy user
- 29, closes rings religiously, sleeps with the Watch; checks after every workout; cares about HR zones, HRR, VO₂ Max trend.
- **Value prop:** full HealthKit depth, workout segments, post-workout HRR, watch app + complications; Bevel-style calculation-method controls documented in-line.
- **Danger:** unexplained discrepancies vs Apple's numbers — lineage must be visible.
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_ayesha_hk_full` (all §12 ✅ types populated), `fixture_ayesha_apple_disagreement` (BADAN RHR ≠ Apple RHR; lineage sheet explains method).
- **Segment:** `seg_ecosystem`.

### 3.4 Tariq — the Android / Health Connect user
- 37, Galaxy Watch 7 + Pixel; burned twice by iOS-only apps; tests export and permission granularity in hour one.
- **Value prop:** Health Connect first-class; every iOS read/write has a mapped equivalent or documented fallback (§12 matrix); Wear OS tile + complications.
- **Danger:** silent feature gaps; OEM battery managers killing background sync (§37.6).
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced` (often self-upgrades to `preset_power`).
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_tariq_hc_parity` (drives the §12 matrix), `fixture_tariq_oem_battery_kill` (sync recovery after process death), `fixture_tariq_first_hour_export` (export within 60 min of install).
- **Segment:** `seg_ecosystem`.

### 3.5 Dmitri — the quantified-self enthusiast
- 33, engineer; Oura + Garmin + smart scale + spreadsheets since 2019; audits dedup decisions, files precise bugs, evangelizes if respected.
- **Value prop:** the repository itself — raw sample explorer, per-sample provenance, CSV/JSON/SQLite export, personal API token, historical archive import.
- **Danger:** any opaque number, any export that omits fields, any "we know better" resistance.
- **Preset:** `preset_power`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_dmitri_multisource` (Oura+Garmin+scale overlap — dedup journal populated), `fixture_dmitri_archive_import` (Apple Health ZIP, multi-year), `fixture_dmitri_export_roundtrip` (export → re-import → byte-level field parity).
- **Segment:** `seg_analyst`.

### 3.6 Lena — the hybrid athlete
- 27, CrossFit + 10k; Garmin Forerunner + chest strap; 2 workouts/day peaks; plans deloads.
- **Value prop:** Bevel-grade cardio load (acute:chronic, Detraining→Overtraining statuses, Target Strain band) *plus* an honest muscular-load channel so strength days aren't "rest."
- **Danger:** cardio-only load models erasing her strength work.
- **Preset:** `preset_power_fitness`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_lena_dual_channel` (strength day must not read as rest), `fixture_lena_double_session` (two workouts/day load math).
- **Segment:** `seg_athlete`.

### 3.7 Yusuf — the strength trainee
- 24, 5 gym sessions/week; wants progressive-overload evidence: e1RM trends, volume per muscle group, plateaus.
- **Value prop:** full resistance logging (exercise DB, sets×reps×weight×RPE, templates), Strength Progression, muscular radar; ≤3 taps per set.
- **Danger:** cardio-centric scores calling leg day "nothing"; clunky logging.
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced_strength`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_yusuf_set_logging_speed` (UI test: 3-tap set entry), `fixture_yusuf_e1rm_progression` (12-week golden math), `fixture_yusuf_leg_day_recovery` (muscular channel labeled heuristic).
- **Segment:** `seg_athlete`.

### 3.8 Ingrid — the endurance user
- 45, marathoner; Garmin Fenix; trains by plan; cares about periodization, sleep-as-recovery, race readiness.
- **Value prop:** ACWR-grounded cardio load, VO₂ Max trajectory, Cardio Focus distribution, HRR trend; context tags (heat, altitude, illness) as covariates.
- **Danger:** double-counted workouts (Garmin + Watch); naive load models ignoring context.
- **Preset:** `preset_power`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_ingrid_garmin_watch_dupe` (dedup keeps one workout, journal explains), `fixture_ingrid_context_covariates` (heat-tagged week doesn't poison baseline).
- **Segment:** `seg_athlete`.

### 3.9 Faisal — the longevity-focused biohacker
- 38, Attia/Huberman follower; quarterly blood panels; sauna, zone 2, supplements; cares about ApoB, hs-CRP, HbA1c, VO₂ Max.
- **Value prop:** Biology pillar — 390+ biomarker catalog, manual + PDF lab entry, biological-age model *with visible inputs and weights* (anti-particle-scramble), longevity preset dashboard.
- **Danger:** pseudo-precision (bio-age to two decimals, no CI); clinical-claim wording.
- **Preset:** `preset_power_longevity`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_faisal_lab_history` (8 quarterly panels, reference ranges), `fixture_faisal_bioage_explain` (free band + decomposition access rules), `fixture_faisal_pdf_import` (lab PDF parsed on-device).
- **Segment:** `seg_analyst`.

### 3.10 Mariam — the cycle-aware user
- 31, Oura wearer; her old app "panicked every luteal phase" (the documented WHOOP failure).
- **Value prop:** cycle phase as a covariate **inside every baseline** — temperature, HRV, RHR, sleep, recovery vs phase-conditioned norms; passive inference where quality permits; complete opt-out with data-locality guarantees.
- **Danger:** false "sickness" flags in luteal phase; reproductive-data privacy anxiety (§28.7: strictest storage class, on-device by default, excluded from cloud AI by default).
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced` (cycle module on).
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_mariam_luteal_no_alarm` (luteal temp/HRV shift produces no illness flag), `fixture_mariam_module_off` (opt-out hides all cycle UI and stops inference), `fixture_mariam_phase_bands` (band chart shifts with phase).
- **Segment:** `seg_engaged` (module state never encoded).

### 3.11 Salim — the chronic symptom tracker
- 52, IBS + migraines managed with his GP; paper diary today.
- **Value prop:** first-class symptom logging (custom symptoms, severity, duration, triggers), honest symptom↔metric correlations ("7 of 9 migraines followed <6h sleep — association, not cause"), physician-visit PDF.
- **Danger:** vocabulary chaos (canonical dictionary + synonyms, §21.6); causation overclaim.
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced_logging`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_salim_symptom_synonyms` (five spellings merge to one canonical id), `fixture_salim_migraine_correlation` (min-n gating + association phrasing), `fixture_salim_physician_pdf` (report golden file).
- **Segment:** `seg_logger`.

### 3.12 Huda — the medication-heavy user
- 60, six daily medications on three schedules; caregiver daughter helps set up.
- **Value prop:** medication repository, gentle adherence (skip-with-reason, no red X's), regimen-change markers as annotations on every metric chart, zero dosing advice.
- **Danger:** anything resembling medical advice; alarm fatigue; tiny tap targets.
- **Preset:** `preset_casual_large_type` (accessibility type scale, simplified Today).
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_huda_regimen_annotations` (med change renders as vertical line on any chart), `fixture_huda_skip_with_reason` (adherence record without shame copy), `fixture_huda_large_type_layout` (no truncation at max Dynamic Type).
- **Segment:** `seg_logger`.

### 3.13 Karim — the recovery-focused user
- 35, post-ACL surgery, cleared for progressive loading; psychologically fragile period.
- **Value prop:** Injured status with recovery-context mode — strain targets suppressed/re-based, progress framing ("4th consecutive week of rising step counts"), pain logging tied to activity.
- **Danger:** "Overtraining risk!"/"Detraining!" shouted at someone medically required to rest — the exact Bevel wording failure the status-aware `core-phrasing` engine prevents (§23.9).
- **Preset:** `preset_casual`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_karim_injured_phrasing` (Injured status swaps every load-status string), `fixture_karim_milestone_framing` (rising-trend copy under suppressed targets).
- **Segment:** `seg_glance`.

### 3.14 Noor — the sleep optimization user
- 28, shift-adjacent job; poor sleep is her #1 complaint; drawn by exactly Bevel's sleep depth.
- **Value prop:** full sleep suite — stages, latency, continuity, HR dip, respiratory rate, temp deviation, Sleep Bank ledger, wind-down clock, weekly distribution strip, social-jetlag metric (beyond Bevel).
- **Danger:** orthosomnia — mitigated by "gentle sleep mode" (hide nightly scores, weekly trends only; deliberate anti-Bevel option).
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced_sleep`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_noor_sleep_bank_ledger` (debt/surplus golden math), `fixture_noor_gentle_mode` (nightly scores hidden everywhere incl. widgets), `fixture_noor_shift_schedule` (irregular schedule doesn't trigger "inconsistency" scolding).
- **Segment:** `seg_engaged`.

### 3.15 Diego — the nutrition/macro-focused user
- 30, recomposition goal; weighs food; MyFitnessPal refugee (ads, database distrust).
- **Value prop:** four logging pathways (photo AI, natural language, barcode, search) + verified regional databases, recipes, g/% toggle, Net Energy view, food-quality score with a visible rubric, portion-uncertainty flags on AI estimates.
- **Danger:** database garbage; AI hallucinating portions; score opacity.
- **Preset:** `preset_power_nutrition`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_diego_10s_repeat_log` (repeat meal logged in ≤10s), `fixture_diego_ai_portion_uncertainty` (photo estimate carries uncertainty flag into totals), `fixture_diego_writeback_toggles` (macros/micros/water/caffeine/alcohol write-back switches honored).
- **Segment:** `seg_logger`.

### 3.16 Aziza — the CGM-aware lifestyle tracker
- 44, prediabetic per her doctor; wears a Libre/Lingo-class sensor in focus periods; explicitly not seeking treatment advice.
- **Value prop:** CGM ingestion, glucose day-strip with meal/activity/sleep overlays, derived trio (fasting/average/variability), post-meal response cards — wellness-framed, never dosing.
- **Danger:** anything reading as medical management; mmol/L vs mg/dL confusion anywhere incl. exports.
- **Preset:** `preset_balanced`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_aziza_meal_response` (2h response card, order-independent meal/CGM arrival), `fixture_aziza_unit_override` (mmol/L↔mg/dL correct in UI, thresholds, exports), `fixture_aziza_compression_low` (artifact flagged, not alarmed).
- **Segment:** `seg_logger`.

### 3.17 Sven — the privacy-maximalist user
- 39, security engineer; refuses cloud health apps; found BADAN via local-first positioning.
- **Value prop:** Local-Only Mode (§28.5) — no account, all processing on-device, on-device AI tier only, encrypted local backups, network-transparency page (local-only: nothing sent).
- **Danger:** dark patterns pushing account creation; silent telemetry.
- **Preset:** `preset_power_local`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_sven_zero_network` (instrumented run asserts zero non-user-initiated egress in local-only mode), `fixture_sven_no_account_paths` (all P1 features reachable without identity), `fixture_sven_telemetry_optout` (no analytics events emitted, verified at `core-analytics` boundary).
- **Segment:** none — telemetry opt-out means no segment is ever computed or sent.

### 3.18 Priya — the export-focused data nerd
- 36, epidemiology PhD; wants her n-of-1 in Jupyter; stable schemas above all.
- **Value prop:** schema-versioned JSON/CSV/Parquet/SQLite exports + published data dictionary, filtered exports, scheduled recurring exports, read-only personal API with token scopes, derived-vs-raw separation with algorithm version stamps.
- **Danger:** schema churn without versioning; exports silently dropping provenance.
- **Preset:** `preset_power`.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_priya_schema_snapshot` (export validates against `contracts/export/schema/v1/`), `fixture_priya_scheduled_export` (monthly ZIP job fires and resumes after reboot), `fixture_priya_api_scopes` (token with sleep-only scope cannot read nutrition).
- **Segment:** `seg_analyst`.

### 3.19 The Haddad family — caregiver / partner-sharing scenario
- Adult son (48) loosely supporting his father (74) who tracks meds + BP cuff readings.
- **Value prop (Phase 4, consent-first):** *outbound sharing only* — owner shares selected summaries with a named recipient; revocable, visibly logged; no silent monitoring.
- **Danger:** surveillance patterns; elder-consent ambiguity. Ship late, design with a consent researcher.
- **Preset:** `preset_casual_large_type` (father); recipient view is read-only summaries.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_haddad_share_scope` (recipient sees only shared summaries), `fixture_haddad_revocation` (revoke removes access and logs it in `consent_records`).
- **Segment:** `seg_glance` (owner); recipient generates no segment.

### 3.20 Kenji — the international / multilingual user
- 33, Japanese national in Dubai; phone in Japanese, work in English; foods across three cuisines.
- **Value prop:** EN + AR at launch (full RTL), JA/ES/FR/DE/UR/HI in year one; per-metric unit override; regional food DBs (GCC, Levantine, South Asian, East Asian); dates, week-start, number formats honored everywhere *including charts and exports*; AI narrative in UI language.
- **Danger:** half-localized UI (translated labels, English insights); RTL-broken charts.
- **Preset:** any.
- **Fixtures:** `fixture_kenji_locale_matrix` (shared with Law 7 acceptance), `fixture_kenji_multicuisine_food` (three regional DBs resolve in one day's log), `fixture_kenji_narrative_language` (insight language follows UI language, not data language).
- **Segment:** any (locale is an event property, not a segment).

## 4. Jobs to be done

Seventeen jobs, carried from v1, each now with: acceptance-of-done, mechanism, **measurable success metric** (exact event math against `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml`), **owning module(s)**, and **delivering epics** (E-01…E-24, v1 §42 ids). Any feature that cannot cite a job is cut; any job without a metric cannot claim to be done.

### 4.1 Awareness jobs

**J1. "When I wake up, I want to know how my body is doing, so I can shape my day without thinking hard."**
- Done when: <10 seconds from open (or widget glance) to a trusted answer. Casual: sentence + rings; Power: same + tappable input attribution.
- Mechanism: Today hero (three-score glance + One True Sentence) via `GetTodayOverviewQuery`; morning widget; watch complication.
- **Metric:** p50 time-to-answer < 10s, measured as `today_viewed` → `app_backgrounded` event delta on morning sessions (05:00–11:00 local) with no further navigation; ≥60% of DAU sessions are satisfied-glance sessions by P1+3mo.
- **Owners:** `core-scoring`, `core-phrasing`, `Features/Today/` (both platforms), `BadanWidgets/`/`android/widgets/`.
- **Epics:** E-04, E-05, E-07, E-10.

**J2. "When something feels off, I want to check whether my data agrees, so I can decide whether to rest, push, or see someone."**
- Done when: today's vitals vs *their* normal bands in one screen, deviations flagged calmly; "consider consulting a professional if this persists" appears only under strict §23.9 rules.
- Mechanism: Health Monitor grid (RR/RHR/HRV/SpO₂/Temp/Sleep range pills) + "unusual today" digest.
- **Metric:** `health_monitor_viewed` sessions where ≥1 tile shows `deviation` resolve to `metric_detail_viewed` within the session ≥40% (users trust the flag enough to inspect); zero guardrail-lint violations in shipped deviation copy.
- **Owners:** `core-baseline`, `core-phrasing`, `Features/HealthMonitor/`.
- **Epics:** E-04, E-05, E-07.

**J3. "When my score surprises me, I want to know exactly why, so I keep trusting the system."**
- Done when: every score answers "why" in ≤2 taps with named inputs and contributions. The single most important anti-churn job.
- Mechanism: universal Score Anatomy sheet (§22.5) fed by `ScoringEngine` attribution capture.
- **Metric:** `score_anatomy_opened` / `metric_detail_viewed` ratio ≥15%; D30 retention of users with ≥3 `score_anatomy_opened` events exceeds cohort baseline by ≥20% (trust proxy tracked in §36 dashboards).
- **Owners:** `core-scoring` (attribution), `Features/MetricDetail/`.
- **Epics:** E-04.3, E-05.3.

### 4.2 Optimization jobs

**J4. "When I train, I want to know if my load is productive, so I progress without burning out."**
- Mechanism: Cardio Load (acute/chronic + statuses), Target Strain band, muscular load channel; casual sees a status word, power sees the ACWR-style curve and Below/Within/Above tables.
- **Metric:** among `seg_athlete`, `fitness_tab_viewed` weekly frequency ≥3; load-status false-alarm reports (in-app feedback `insight_feedback_submitted{verdict=disagree}`) <5% of load insights.
- **Owners:** `core-scoring` (load calculators), `Features/Fitness/`.
- **Epics:** E-04.4, E-11.

**J5. "When I change a habit, I want evidence it's working, so I keep or drop it."**
- Mechanism: Experiments (§22.8) — tag a date range, get honest before/after with confidence caveats. Bevel has nothing like this.
- **Metric:** ≥25% of `experiment_created` reach `experiment_concluded` (28-day completion); every conclusion card carries a confidence qualifier (lint-enforced).
- **Owners:** `core-insight` (experiment evaluator), `Features/Experiments/`.
- **Epics:** E-19.

**J6. "When I plan sleep, I want a realistic target for tonight, so I can pay down debt."**
- Mechanism: Sleep Bank ledger + wind-down/target-bedtime clock + "tonight's need" figure.
- **Metric:** users with bedtime reminders on hit target bedtime ±30min on ≥50% of nights (computed on-device; only the ratio band is reported as an enum property, never times).
- **Owners:** `core-scoring` (sleep-need calculator), `core-notify`, `Features/Sleep/`.
- **Epics:** E-04.2, E-05, E-10.

**J7. "When I eat, I want to know what this meal does to *me*, so I choose better next time."**
- Mechanism: meal response cards (glucose if CGM present; else next-morning recovery/sleep correlates with honest weak-signal framing).
- **Metric:** `meal_response_viewed` / `meal_logged` ≥30% for CGM users; repeat-meal improvement loop measured as `meal_logged{method=repeat}` share rising month-over-month.
- **Owners:** `core-insight` (response binder), `Features/Nutrition/`, `Features/Glucose/`.
- **Epics:** E-12, E-13.

### 4.3 Record-keeping jobs

**J8. "When I experience symptoms, I want to capture them in seconds, so my record is complete when I need it."**
- Mechanism: 2-tap recents, severity slider, voice log via Shortcuts/assistant.
- **Metric:** p50 `log_hub_opened` → `symptom_logged` < 8s for recents path; symptom loggers' 8-week logging persistence ≥40%.
- **Owners:** `core-db` (`event_records`), `Features/LogHub/`, `BadanIntents/`.
- **Epics:** E-06.3, E-16.

**J9. "When I take medications, I want a truthful adherence record without being nagged, so I can review it with my doctor."**
- Mechanism: med schedules, skip-with-reason, quiet reminders, physician PDF.
- **Metric:** reminder interaction rate (taken/skip-with-reason vs ignored) ≥70%; notification-driven disable rate for med reminders <5%/month (budget health per §24.8).
- **Owners:** `core-notify`, `core-db` (`medication_regimens`, `adherence_events`), `Features/Medications/`.
- **Epics:** E-06.4, E-09 (PDF), E-10.

**J10. "When I get lab results, I want them in the same place as everything else, so trends across years are visible."**
- Mechanism: Biology pillar — manual entry, on-device PDF parsing first, reference ranges, 390+ biomarker catalog parity.
- **Metric:** `lab_result_added` users adding a second panel within 6 months ≥50%; PDF-parse success rate ≥85% on the lab-format corpus in `core-testing/fixtures/`.
- **Owners:** `core-registry` (biomarker catalog), `Features/Biology/`, on-device parser in `core-ingest`.
- **Epics:** E-01, E-06, E-20 (bio-age consumes).

**J11. "When I see a doctor, I want a clean summary of relevant history, so the visit is productive."**
- Mechanism: Report Composer — date-range + topic-filtered narrative PDF (§20.6).
- **Metric:** `report_generated{template=physician}` completion rate ≥90% once started; qualitative loop: report-sharers' 6-month retention vs cohort +15%.
- **Owners:** `core-export` (PDF-data), `core-phrasing` (narrative), `Features/Reports/`.
- **Epics:** E-09, E-18.

### 4.4 Ownership jobs

**J12. "When I invest years of data, I want certainty I can take it all with me, so I never feel locked in."**
- Mechanism: Export Center, personal API, scheduled exports, account-deletion with verifiable data package first.
- **Metric:** `export_completed` success rate ≥99% (failures alerting via `backend/services/telemetry/`); 100% of account deletions offered and able to produce a final export; export freshness (data cut ≤24h old) on scheduled jobs.
- **Owners:** `core-export`, `contracts/export/schema/v1/`, `Features/ExportCenter/`.
- **Epics:** E-09, E-22.

**J13. "When I switch phone platforms, I want my history intact, so the repository outlives my hardware."**
- Mechanism: cross-platform E2E sync (§34) + import connectors for the other platform's stores.
- **Metric:** cross-platform restore drill (E-24, quarterly): 100% row-count and checksum parity across `samples`/`sessions`/`event_records` after iOS↔Android migration on the reference dataset.
- **Owners:** `core-sync`, `backend/services/sync/`, import connectors (E-15).
- **Epics:** E-15, E-22, E-24.

**J14. "When I grant access to my health data, I want to see and revoke exactly what's used, so I stay in control."**
- Mechanism: Permission dashboard — per-type status, last-read timestamps, in-app revocation guidance (§28.3); `PermissionRevoked` domain event triggers pipeline cleanup.
- **Metric:** 100% of granted types show a last-read timestamp; revocation honored in <1 sync cycle (no reads of revoked types thereafter — asserted by adapter tests).
- **Owners:** `adapters/port-health*/` (capability descriptors), `Features/Privacy/`, `consent_records`.
- **Epics:** E-02.5, E-08.

### 4.5 Understanding jobs

**J15. "When I see a metric I don't know, I want a plain explanation right there, so I learn without leaving."**
- Mechanism: universal (i) definition footers at Bevel's specificity bar (e.g., wrist-temperature sampling cadence and 1–2 °C core offset), glossary, "explain this chart" AI action.
- **Metric:** every registry metric has EN+AR definition content (CI check: `tooling/ci/registry-content-coverage` fails on gaps); `definition_expanded` events present across ≥60% of metric detail types monthly (breadth of curiosity, not depth of any one user).
- **Owners:** `contracts/metrics/registry/` (definition fields), `content/`, `Features/MetricDetail/`.
- **Epics:** E-01, E-17 (education library).

**J16. "When I've used the app for a year, I want to see the story of my year, so the accumulation feels meaningful."**
- Mechanism: Year in Body annual report (§22.9); monthly retrospectives.
- **Metric:** `year_in_body_viewed` reach ≥35% of eligible (365d+) users; share-card generation (`share_card_created`) from it ≥10% of viewers.
- **Owners:** `core-insight` (retrospective composer), `Features/Reports/`.
- **Epics:** E-18.

**J17. "When two metrics might be related, I want the app to check honestly, so I don't invent patterns."**
- Mechanism: Correlation Lab — multiple-comparison honesty, minimum-n gating, "association ≠ cause" framing baked into every output (§22.7).
- **Metric:** 100% of correlation outputs pass the min-n gate and carry association framing (lint + unit tests); `correlation_run` users' insight-disagreement rate below app average (honesty pays).
- **Owners:** `core-insight` (correlation evaluator + phrasing rules), `Features/CorrelationLab/`.
- **Epics:** E-19.

## 5. Product positioning

### 5.1 Category definition

BADAN positions in the most underserved category: **the device-agnostic health interpretation layer** — the platform wins not by capturing device data first, but by being where the user wants to understand all their data — sharpened with the ownership axis: *interpretation layer + personal repository*.

**Positioning statement:**
> For people who collect health data across any device or app, BADAN is the private health repository and interpreter that turns every signal into honest, personal understanding — unlike hardware-locked platforms (WHOOP, Oura), single-ecosystem apps (Bevel: Apple-first, iOS-only), and dashboards that show data without meaning (platform health apps), BADAN works with everything, explains everything, and lets you keep everything.

### 5.2 The four positioning pillars

1. **Yours.** Repository free forever; export total; deletion real; local-only mode exists. (Attacks: WHOOP/Oura/Bevel all ❌ on export.) Proof surfaces: Export Center (§20), Law 1 firewall (§2.1.1).
2. **Everything.** All practical devices, both platforms, wearable + manual + lab + subjective in one model. (Attacks: hardware lock-in and iOS-onlyness.) Proof: §12 capability matrix, `adapters/`.
3. **Honest.** Explainable scores, confidence levels, calibration transparency, context-aware phrasing. (Attacks: the #1 churn driver.) Proof: Score Anatomy (§22.5), `QualityFlags` end-to-end.
4. **Human.** One warm sentence a day if that's all you want; your language, your units, your culture's food. (Attacks: sterile-clinical UX, Anglo-centric assumptions.) Proof: Narrative Voice (§23.8), AR/RTL launch (§25.9).

Every marketing claim must map to one pillar and cite its proof surface; TRACK-CONTENT maintains the claims register at `docs/runbooks/claims-register.md` — a claim without a shipped proof surface cannot appear in store copy (this is also the App Store review defense).

### 5.3 Naming, brand, and voice

- **BADAN بدن** — short, pronounceable in English and Arabic, means "body." The Arabic form is a first-class brand element: logo lockup supports both scripts; app display name localized per store locale.
- Voice: second-person, concrete, calm. Never "Warning!" — "Worth a look." Never "You failed your goal" — "Short of your target; here's what got in the way." These are guardrail entries, not style suggestions (`contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml`).
- Tagline candidates: "Know your body." / "اعرف بدنك" ; "Every signal. One story." ; "Your body's ledger." Final selection is WP-content work with AR-first review (the AR tagline is not a translation afterthought).

### 5.4 Competitive frame (summary; full benchmark in §6)

| Axis | WHOOP | Oura | Bevel | Apple Health / Google | **BADAN target** |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hardware required | Yes | Yes | No (BYO wearable) | No | No |
| Platforms | iOS/Android | iOS/Android | **iOS only** | One each | iOS + Android parity |
| Interpretation depth | High (recovery) | High (sleep) | High (broadest) | Low | ≥ Bevel breadth, higher explainability |
| Nutrition | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ strong | Partial | ✅ + regional DBs |
| Labs/records | ❌ | Partial | ✅ (3.0) | Partial (US) | ✅ manual+PDF now, FHIR-aware later |
| Meds/symptoms/conditions | ❌ | ❌ | Partial (Journal/habits) | Partial | ✅ first-class |
| Cycle as covariate | ❌ (documented failures) | ✅ | Module | Partial | ✅ inside all baselines |
| Export/API | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | Raw only | ✅ flagship |
| Community | ✅ | Partial | ❌ | ❌ | Phase 3, opt-in |
| Free tier durability | ❌ ($30/mo) | ❌ (sub) | Limited | Free | Repository free forever |
| On-device AI mode | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | N/A | ✅ tiered |
| RTL/Arabic | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | OS-level only | ✅ launch |

### 5.5 Go-to-market wedges (ranked)

1. **The export wedge:** "the health app you can leave" paradoxically retains best; target r/QuantifiedSelf, r/Biohackers, spreadsheet-keepers (Dmitri/Priya) as vocal early adopters. Launch asset: public data dictionary on the web (generated from `docs/data-dictionary/`).
2. **The Android wedge:** Bevel's entire feature class is absent on Android; Health Connect users (Tariq) have no equivalent. First-mover among interpretation-layer apps on Android. Launch asset: the §12 parity matrix published as a comparison page.
3. **The regional wedge:** Arabic-first (GCC + MENA): zero localized competitors at this depth; App Store featuring potential; the brand itself signals it. Launch asset: full AR store listing + AR narrative demo video.
4. **The trust wedge:** cycle-aware scoring + privacy-maximalist mode as public commitments, each answering a documented, quotable competitor failure. Launch asset: "what BADAN sends and when" transparency page mirrored in-app (§28.5).

### 5.6 What BADAN does *not* compete on

- Sensor accuracy — no sensor; BADAN is an honest broker of others' accuracy, including surfacing their disagreement (lineage sheets).
- Medical care delivery — no diagnosis, treatment, or telehealth in scope; enforced by phrasing guardrails and §29 architecture, not just policy.
- Social-fitness gamification depth — Strava's job; interoperate, don't replicate.

### 5.7 Store-listing requirements checklist

Owned by TRACK-CONTENT (copy/assets) + TRACK-QA-RELEASE (submission); source artifacts under `content/en/store/` and `content/ar/store/`; submission runbook at `docs/runbooks/store-submission.md`.

**Apple App Store**
1. App name/subtitle EN + AR; localized keywords; AR metadata reviewed by native speaker (no machine-translation submission).
2. `NSHealthShareUsageDescription` / `NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription` strings that name concrete uses ("read sleep and heart data to compute your personal baselines") — vague strings are a rejection risk.
3. App Privacy nutrition labels consistent with `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` (no health values collected; telemetry opt-out documented) and with the in-app transparency page — the three must agree.
4. HealthKit entitlement + review notes: wellness framing, no diagnosis/treatment claims anywhere in metadata or screenshots (guardrail lint runs on store copy too).
5. Account-optional justification (Guideline 5.1.1): local-only mode means no forced registration; delete-account flow reachable in-app.
6. IAP configuration: $59.99/yr, $7.99/mo, 14-day trial; paywall screenshots show real limited versions, never obfuscated values (Law 1 marketing corollary).
7. Screenshot sets: EN LTR + AR RTL (RTL screenshots are mirrored chrome with LTR time axes — must match the real app); dark + light.
8. Age rating questionnaire (health/wellness, no medical); export-compliance declaration for E2E encryption (standard exemption documentation filed).
9. watchOS/widget assets; App Clips not in scope P1.

**Google Play**
1. Listing EN + AR (title/short/full description); RTL screenshot set; Wear OS listing assets.
2. Health Connect permissions declaration form: every requested permission mapped to a visible feature (the §12 matrix is the source of truth); background-read justification prepared.
3. Data safety form consistent with the same single source as Apple's labels (`docs/runbooks/data-safety-mapping.md` maps taxonomy → both stores' forms).
4. Health apps policy declaration: wellness category, no medical functionality claims.
5. Play Billing products mirroring IAP anchors; trial configuration parity.
6. Target API level current per Play policy at each release; `android/wear/` bundle included.
7. Pre-launch report pass with fixture account (no locked/empty first-run surfaces — the anti-Bevel cold start is also a store-review asset).

**Both stores — release-gate checks (§62 `suite_store_compliance`):** guardrail lint over all store copy; label/data-safety consistency check; screenshot freshness check against current UI (hash of screen fixtures).

### 5.9 Competitive-watch operating procedure

Positioning decays if the competitive frame goes stale. Standing procedure, owned by product lead, executed with TRACK-CONTENT:

- **Cadence and scope:** monthly release-notes sweep of Bevel, WHOOP, Oura, Apple Health, Health Connect (App Store/Play listings, changelogs, developer-doc diffs for HealthKit/Health Connect types); quarterly deep teardown of Bevel (screen recording, same frame-by-frame method as v1's input) rotating with one adjacent app per quarter.
- **Outputs (exact paths):** monthly note `docs/competitive/YYYY-MM-sweep.md` (delta list only — what changed, which BADAN section it touches); quarterly `docs/competitive/YYYY-QQ-bevel-teardown.md` updating the parity checklist (`docs/runbooks/bevel-parity-checklist.md`, WP-01-03).
- **Trigger rules:** a competitor shipping export/API, Android support, or Arabic localization is a **positioning incident** — product lead files an ADR within 2 weeks revising §5.5 wedge ranking; a new Bevel surface not in the parity checklist opens a backlog item tagged to the owning epic.
- **Platform watch:** WWDC/Google I/O health announcements reviewed within 1 week; new HealthKit/Health Connect data types get a §12 matrix row and an `adapters/port-health/` capability-descriptor decision (support/fallback/defer) before the next release train.

## 6. Competitive benchmark against Bevel and adjacent apps

This section converts the screen recording and report into a precise, executable benchmark: what Bevel demonstrably ships (observed, §6.1 — the parity floor, preserved in full), what it implies, where it excels (§6.2), where it simplifies (§6.3), and — new in v2 — a numbered **Bevel Parity Checklist** (§6.4) in which every observed capability is bound to a BADAN target behavior, an owning module (canonical monorepo path per §47), a phase, and a parity-verification test idea. QA and build agents verify against §6.4; nothing in it may be weakened without an ADR in `docs/adr/`.

### 6.1 Bevel's observed structure (from the recording) — the parity floor

**Top-level shell.** Three tabs in a floating pill dock — **Home, Fitness, Biology** — plus a persistent circular **"+" FAB** (global logging). The dock collapses to a single contextual circle + FAB on scroll. Settings is a modal (X-close) reached from the avatar, not a tab.

**Home tab (observed order):** date-pager header (calendar picker with per-day score rings; share icon; avatar) → Activity Status pill (Active/Sick/Injured/On A Break, with retroactive apply) + weather/location pill → triple-ring hero (Strain % amber, Recovery % lime, Sleep % indigo) → COACHING sentence card → rotating promo card slot → Stress card (Highest/Lowest/Average + semicircular gauge "30 Low") → Energy bar (body-battery style, 46%) → Nutrition teaser (Today's foods, locked score ring, 0g macros, blood glucose row) → **Health Monitor** grid (RR/RHR/HRV/SpO₂/Temp/Sleep tiles with vertical range-pill gauges and Normal/Higher/Lower chips) → Timeline (typed events, e.g., "Primary sleep… score 67") → **Edit Home** + **View All Categories** buttons.

**Pillar detail pages (Strain/Recovery/Sleep):** scenic hero art + ring → two key stat cards (e.g., Resting HRV 25.4 ms / Resting HR 83.5 bpm with baseline-deviation badges) → coaching paragraph → Timeline events → **Trends list** (each metric: value, status chip vs personal normal band, band-chart sparkline, chevron drill-in). Sleep adds: wind-down/target-bedtime 24-hour clock dial, Sleep Bank (surplus/deficit ledger), weekly sleep-distribution heat strip, sleep/wake time normality, Time to Fall Asleep.

**Universal metric detail sheet (the strongest single pattern observed):** big value + date → status vs *personal* normal range (e.g., "Above normal, 74.0–82.2 bpm") → horizontally scrollable metric-switcher chips → band chart with dotted personal average → period control (30D/3M/6M/1Y + calendar + paging chevrons) → **Trends Analysis table** (3/7/14/30/90-day rolling deltas with mini sparklines and directional coloring; "based on 7-day rolling averages") → Resources (education cards) → plain-language definition footer with genuinely specific physiology notes.

**Fitness tab:** "Last 30 days" header → dual mini-month activity heatmap calendar (1/2/3+ activity legend) → Activity Summary (current-vs-prior comparison chart, activity-type filter chips, metric picker) → Strain Performance (deviation-% vs target, ±10% band, tri-color line, Below/Within/Above breakdown table, 30D→1Y) → Cardio section: Cardio Load (acute/chronic envelope, statuses Calibrating/Detraining/Maintaining/Peaking), Cardio Focus (Low Aerobic/High Aerobic/Anaerobic stacked bars + breakdown), HRR → Strength section: muscle-group radar with metric switcher (Total Volume/Workout Frequency/Muscular Load; Chest/Arms/Back/Core/Legs/Shoulders), Strength Progression, Workout Templates ("Strength Builder") → per-tab **edit-layout mode** (remove badges, drag grips, Add card, Reset to default).

**Biology tab:** starfield aesthetic → Biological Age semicircular tick dial (value Pro-locked via particle scramble; "18+" eligibility; chronological-age anchor on dial) → Other Biomarkers curated list (Weight, HRV Baselines, RHR Baselines, Body Fat %, Lean Body Mass, VO₂ Max — with status words like Poor/High/Decreasing and mini trend thumbnails; "Edit" curation) → **full Biomarkers registry**: alphabetical, ~390+ entries spanning wearable-derived (VO₂ Max, RHR baselines) and blood-panel biomarkers (ApoB, AST, BUN, cortisol, DHEA-S, eGFR, HbA1c, hs-CRP, homocysteine, IgA, insulin, IGF-1, magnesium, MCH/MCHC/MCV/MPV, mercury, RDW, SHBG, sodium, free testosterone, uric acid, VLDL, B12, vitamin D, WBC…), each with status • value • sparkline or "No data" skeleton, A–Z index rail, bottom search.

**Nutrition detail:** "Log 776 kcal to unlock today's Nutrition score" gate → My Foods (favorites/recipes/foods) → Goals (calorie bar + fat/carb/protein rings) → Nutritional Details (g/% toggle, dot-matrix macros) → Net Energy (diverging burned-vs-consumed bar, −2,342 kcal "Deficit") → Food Quality Contributors → Blood glucose chart (3.9/7.8 mmol/L threshold lines, gear for settings) → Timeline (+ add) → Trends (Nutrition Score, Macro Balance).

**All Categories:** searchable, pillar-grouped registry of every metric card (incl. Morning Fasting Glucose, Average Glucose, Glucose Variability) — the full-catalog browser behind the curated Home.

**Settings tree (observed):** Bevel Pro / Manage Subscription (Free-vs-Pro entitlement checklist) · referral + Rewards (30-day guest pass) · Account · Appearance (three app-icon families incl. seasonal specials) · Notifications (Daily Summary, Activity completed, Target bedtime reminder, Target strain reached, Food processed, Glucose processed) · **Customization hub** (Goals; Units; Heart Rate Zones editor — Max-HR method, 6 zones with %/bpm; **Calculations** — HRV method Bevel-RMSSD-from-raw-beats vs Apple Health field, HRV/RHR/SpO₂/RR sampling window "Entire sleep," temperature method Wrist, calories display, merge-manual-sleep toggle; Data Loading Window "sync >1 year"; Social Sharing; module visibility switches with live preview mockups for Nutrition/Cycle/Strength Builder/Journal/Biology, each warning "hiding X disables all related features and UI") · Shortcuts (Apple Shortcuts: "Sleep alarm + sleep focus") · Language · **Data** (Data Sources: per-metric source counts → device-level lists with dates → hide sources; Resync Health; Restore from backend; Manage CGM; iCloud Sync status/last-sync) · Resources (What's new; Getting started 4-page story incl. a Recovery explainer teaching interpretation + calculation; Knowledge base → help site) · Request a feature / Report a bug / Rate.

**Monetization observed:** $99.99/yr (framed "Save 44%," $8.33/mo) vs $14.99/mo; 7-day trial with "No payment due now" and a trial-end-reminder promise screen; Pro gates: Bevel Intelligence (check-ins, meal planning, training plans, custom analysis), Biological Age, Health Records import, Nutrition score; rotating in-feed promo cards; referral guest passes.

**Bevel Intelligence V2 (observed via What's-New):** persistent-memory coach; proactive check-ins; web search + chart generation + "custom data analysis" on user data; photo/describe food logging; training plans; "Ask Bevel anything" composer.

### 6.2 What Bevel does well (adopt the principle)

1. **The universal metric-detail template** — one learnable grammar for every metric. BADAN adopts and extends it to labs, meds, symptoms (§16.5 S-56; template engineering in §8.4).
2. **Personal normal bands everywhere** — status is always relative to *you* ("Above normal 74.0–82.2 bpm"), not population cutoffs. Correct default; BADAN adds cohort context only as an explicit optional overlay (§22.6). Computed by `core/core-baseline/BaselineEngine`.
3. **Rolling-delta Trends Analysis table** (3/7/14/30/90d) — compact longitudinal literacy. Adopt verbatim as a pattern; computed once in `core/core-scoring/` (`RollingDeltaCalculator`), rendered identically by both design systems.
4. **Calculation-method transparency** — user-selectable HRV/RHR derivation with plain-language explainers. Rare, excellent; adopt and go further (per-metric algorithm pages, §27.5, content in `content/education/`).
5. **Context statuses** (Active/Sick/Injured/On A Break) with retroactive application propagated to trends — adopt, extend taxonomy, and make it feed scoring covariates (§10.13; `StatusInterval` in `core/core-model/`).
6. **Module visibility switches with live previews** — users can turn whole pillars off (Cycle disabled in the recording). Perfect chaos-control instrument; adopt as the backbone of BADAN's customization (§19.2, persisted in `customization_profiles`).
7. **Data Sources management** — per-metric source inventories, hide-source, resync, restore. Adopt; extend to per-sample lineage and priority ordering UI (`core/core-ingest/` + S-58/S-60).
8. **Empty states that teach** ("No workouts — Start using Strength Builder by creating a workout template") and skeletons that show *shape* of future value.
9. **Scenic emotional art** on pillar pages; **app-icon personalization**; story-style Getting Started explaining both *interpretation* and *calculation* of each pillar.
10. **Education woven in-line:** Resources cards + definition footers of genuine specificity (temperature sampling cadence, wrist-vs-core offset). Sourced from `contracts/metrics/registry/*.yaml` `definition` fields so footers can never drift from the ontology.

### 6.3 What Bevel simplifies or omits (BADAN's openings)

| Observation | Implication | BADAN response |
|---|---|---|
| iOS only; Apple Watch primary; Garmin + CGMs as the only direct integrations | Android market abandoned; multi-device users partially served | Dual-platform parity; broker + direct integrations (§13) |
| No export anywhere (Social Sharing ≠ data export) | Power users' top unmet demand (report: Medium-High frequency) | Export Center as flagship free feature (`core/core-export/`) |
| No medications, limited symptoms (Journal/habits module; "Track Habits & Symptoms" is a paywall bullet) | Chronic/med-heavy users unserved | Meds/symptoms/conditions as first-class pillar (§21) |
| Nutrition score gated by kcal-logging threshold and Pro | Passive users see locks and zeros | Passive-value nutrition surface; scores unlock by data presence, not payment for basics |
| Bio Age paywalled via obfuscation on day one, 18+ | Teasing without value; trust cost | Free coarse Bio-Age band with explanation; paid = full model + decomposition |
| New-user experience dominated by "No data / Calibrating" | Cold-start trust gap (report: calibration complaints) | Historical backfill on connect (multi-year import; 30-day instant baseline; §11.7) |
| Single Max-HR zone method | Athletes want LTHR/HRR%/per-sport zones | Multi-method zone editor (§19.6) |
| Community absent | Report: Bevel's biggest gap vs WHOOP | Phase-3 opt-in circles (§38.6) |
| One language, LTR only | MENA + global users unserved | i18n/RTL at launch |
| Fragmentation critique (report) despite good pieces | Pillars don't reference each other much | Connective-tissue systems: unified Timeline, cross-pillar insight cards, Correlation Lab (§8.5) |
| AI is cloud-bound | Privacy-sensitive users excluded | Tiered AI with on-device mode (§23.4) |

### 6.5 Adjacent benchmarks (report-sourced)

- **WHOOP:** best-in-class cohesive narrative + community/trophies; worst-in-class pricing resentment and female-physiology failures. Lesson: cohesion and community matter; hardware-tied subscriptions and unexplained scores burn trust.
- **Oura:** best sleep-staging credibility (79% PSG agreement) and calm brand; ring-locked, limited export. Lesson: algorithmic credibility can be a brand pillar — BADAN earns it via transparency rather than proprietary sensors.
- **Gentler Streak / Athlytic / Training Today (Apple-ecosystem interpreters):** prove demand for HealthKit interpretation; all iOS-only, none repository-grade. Lesson: the interpretation-layer category is validated; nobody has claimed the cross-platform repository position.
- **Longevity One / Rejuve:** bio-age depth (PhenoAge-style blood models; NHANES-trained hallmarks) and local-compute privacy marketing. Lesson: bio-age needs scientific framing + explainability; privacy claims are retention drivers when verifiable.
- **MyFitnessPal (nutrition incumbent):** database breadth with quality distrust + ad fatigue. Lesson: verified-entry quality signaling beats raw entry count.
- **Apple Health / Google's stack:** the free default repositories — but raw, uninterpreted, single-platform each. They are BADAN's *substrate and rival simultaneously*; BADAN must always answer "why not just Apple Health?" with interpretation, cross-platform history, logging depth, and export coherence.

### 6.6 Benchmark verdict

Bevel is the correct benchmark for **breadth of interpreted metrics** and **quality of progressive disclosure**; nobody else combines four pillars + biomarkers + AI at its level. But it is structurally beatable on: platform reach, ownership/export, meds/symptoms, cold-start honesty, cycle-as-covariate depth, community, localization, and privacy architecture. BADAN's mandate: **match the template quality, beat the structure.** The checklist above is the contractual form of "match"; §7 is the contractual form of "beat."

## 7. Principles for surpassing Bevel

Twelve operating principles, each phrased as "Bevel does X → BADAN does X′." New in v2: each principle carries an **enforcing mechanism** (a module, CI check, or review gate — never "culture"), an **owning track**, and a **violation-smell list** used in design/code review. A principle without an enforcement mechanism is a poster; these are gates.

### 7.1 The twelve principles, enforced

**P1. Match the metric floor before adding novelty.** Every metric visible in the recording (§10 ontology) exists in BADAN's model by end of Phase 2. New metric classes (social jetlag, mobility, experiments) come after the floor, not instead of it.
- *Enforced by:* PB-tracker dashboard (WP-24-03) as the Phase-2 exit gate; registry coverage CI (WP-01-04) in `core/core-registry/`.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CONTRACTS.
- *Violation smells:* a novel metric PR lands while a PB item is red · roadmap review shows Phase-2 scope with parity items deferred "to P3" without ADR · a §6.1-named biomarker missing from `contracts/metrics/registry/`.

**P2. Interpret everything, gate only synthesis.** Free tier interprets every individual metric (status vs personal band + definition + trend); paid gates *cross-metric synthesis* (deep AI analysis, long-horizon reports, experiments engine). A free user is never left with a naked number.
- *Enforced by:* static gate-map test (PB-77): every key in `core/core-flags/EntitlementConfig` must declare `gates: synthesis|ambient|volume`, and CI rejects keys tagged `repository` or `per_metric_interpretation`; paywall review gate in `docs/runbooks/review-gates.md`.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CORE-INTEL (config), TRACK-QA-RELEASE (gate test).
- *Violation smells:* an entitlement check imported inside `core-db` or a repository class · designs showing lock icons on single-metric surfaces · "free tier shows blurred value" in any spec.

**P3. Every score is a glass box.** Score Anatomy: inputs, qualitative weights, data quality, algorithm version, "what would move this."
- *Enforced by:* type system — `DerivedValue` in `core/core-model/` has non-optional `anatomy: ScoreAnatomy` and `algorithmVersion`; `core-testing` conformance test fails any calculator emitting empty anatomy (PB-31).
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CORE-INTEL.
- *Violation smells:* a calculator PR with `anatomy = ScoreAnatomy.EMPTY` "temporarily" · UI spec with a score card lacking a "why" affordance · anatomy inputs that don't sum to a coherent explanation in the fixture golden.

**P4. The cold start must feel warm.** On first connect: backfill history, compute provisional baselines from it, label them "provisional" honestly with confidence + countdown — never "Calibrating 100%" walls.
- *Enforced by:* E-02.3 acceptance (resumable multi-year backfill); `BaselineEngine` emits `confidence: Provisional|Settling|Established` consumed by mandatory `ProvisionalBadge` component; first-session integration test asserts ≥2 real personal facts rendered from a 90-day fixture store (S-12).
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CORE-DATA + TRACK-ADAPTERS.
- *Violation smells:* any surface stringly-typed "Calibrating" without a value · backfill behind a settings toggle defaulting off · provisional values rendered without the badge component.

**P5. Presence-based UI, not placeholder-based UI.** Modules with no possible data self-collapse into a single "what you could add" browser entry instead of rows of 0g and "No data" walls.
- *Enforced by:* `ModulePresenceRule` evaluated in `GetTodayOverviewQuery` (data presence → module visibility); UI tests asserting zero-value strings absent for no-data fixtures (PB-10); design-review checklist item "show me this screen for Rania."
- *Owning track:* TRACK-IOS-FEATURES + TRACK-AND-FEATURES.
- *Violation smells:* "0 g / 0 g / 0 g" in any snapshot · more than one empty-state module visible on default Today · empty modules that render skeletons indefinitely instead of collapsing.

**P6. Two platforms, one soul.** No feature ships iOS-first by more than one release train. Platform delights may differ; data capability may not.
- *Enforced by:* **parity CI suite in `core-testing`** — the fixture DB is run through both apps and the diff of rendered values must be empty (WP-24-02); release checklist in `tooling/ci/release/` blocks a train if a feature flag is enabled on one platform ≥2 trains.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-QA-RELEASE.
- *Violation smells:* `if (platform == iOS)` branches inside `core/` modules · a `ff_*` flag with per-platform values older than one train · Android screen specs marked "TBD, mirror iOS."

**P7. Context is a covariate, not a caption.** Statuses (sick/travel/cycle-phase/meds-change/fasting) enter baseline computation and phrasing selection, not just chart annotations.
- *Enforced by:* `BaselineEngine` API requires a `CovariateContext` parameter (no context-free overload exists); `PhrasingEngine` template selection keyed on active statuses; conformance test PB-36 (Injured never yields "Detraining").
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CORE-INTEL.
- *Violation smells:* a new score computed from raw baselines bypassing `CovariateContext` · luteal-phase fixture flagging "unusual temperature" · status shown on chart but absent from the same metric's status computation.

**P8. Logging is always ≤3 interactions for the repeat case.** Food re-log, symptom re-log, med taken, workout from template: 2–3 taps or one voice/Shortcut invocation.
- *Enforced by:* UI interaction-count tests in both apps' test suites (tap-count assertions on recents flows, PB-41/PB-51); log-hub perf budget (<300 ms open) in `tooling/ci/perf/`.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-IOS-FEATURES + TRACK-AND-FEATURES.
- *Violation smells:* a confirmation dialog added to a repeat flow · recents row demoted below the fold in S-70 · any log flow requiring text entry for a repeat.

**P9. Export is a feature, not a settings row.** A designed Export Center with previews, templates, scheduling — in the Body destination, marketed on the store page.
- *Enforced by:* navigation contract — `body/export` is a first-class route in `AppRouter` (§8.5 route table); export schema snapshot tests against `contracts/export/schema/v1/` block silent field drops; store-listing checklist in TRACK-QA-RELEASE launch gate.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CORE-DATA (`core-export`).
- *Violation smells:* export reachable only via Settings · an export format missing provenance columns · schema change merged without version bump in `contracts/export/`.

**P10. Depth reveals; it never greets.** Default surfaces match Bevel's density ceiling (Home ≈ 6–8 modules); every additional layer is one intentional gesture away. Power Mode is a rendering preference, not a separate app.
- *Enforced by:* `PresentationPolicy` (§8.7) is the single density authority — components read policy, never a raw "isPower" boolean; lint rule bans `depth ==` comparisons outside the policy resolver; default-preset snapshot caps module count.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-IOS-SHELL + TRACK-AND-SHELL.
- *Violation smells:* a feature adding a module to Casual default without preset review · duplicate "advanced" screens instead of policy-modulated ones · navigation topology that differs by depth setting.

**P11. Localize the whole experience.** Language, script direction, units, food culture, week start, quiet hours, education examples — and the AI narrative too.
- *Enforced by:* l10n CI: pseudo-locale + AR snapshot matrix on all design-system components; `PhrasingEngine` generation tests run EN and AR fixtures with identical assertion sets (E-07 parity criterion); registry schema requires localized names/definitions (PB-30); RTL audit in E-24.
- *Owning track:* TRACK-CONTENT.
- *Violation smells:* hardcoded strings found by lint · AR screenshots reviewed only at release · charts whose chrome fails to mirror (or whose time axis wrongly mirrors) in RTL snapshots.

**P12. Trust artifacts ship with features.** Every launch includes its explanation page, data-dictionary entries, privacy note, and failure-mode behavior.
- *Enforced by:* Definition-of-Done template in `docs/runbooks/dod.md` with four named artifacts; `tooling/schema-dictionary-gen/` fails the build if a shipped table/column lacks dictionary text; release gate checks education content exists for new registry metrics (PB-29 link-integrity).
- *Owning track:* TRACK-QA-RELEASE + TRACK-CONTENT.
- *Violation smells:* a feature flag flipped on with dictionary TODOs · "docs to follow next sprint" in a launch review · a new derived value with no algorithm page.
