## 13. Device ecosystem compatibility strategy

v1 §13 defined tiering + per-ecosystem notes; here each integration gets an **implementation card** and the import connectors get parsing specs. Tiering (v1 §13.1) unchanged: Tier 1 launch (Apple Watch, Wear OS/Pixel/Galaxy via HC, phone-only, smart scales, BP cuffs), Tier 2 P2 (Garmin/Oura/Fitbit/Polar/Suunto/Coros/CGMs/Whoop), Tier 3 P3 (Withings direct, Eight Sleep, more rings, trainers). Architecture rule: new device classes attach as new source adapters without schema surgery (§10/§30).

### 13.1 Integration implementation cards

Each card: auth flow · data endpoints/webhooks · sync cadence · dedup interaction · module home · rollout flag · test strategy. All vendor adapters implement `VendorApiAdapter` (§11.1); backend homes under `backend/services/integrations/<vendor>/`.

**Garmin (Tier 2, direct)**
- Auth: OAuth2 (Garmin Connect). Endpoints: Health API pull + Ping/webhook notifications; workout FIT files for laps/power. Cadence: webhook-driven, poll fallback hourly. Dedup: `WorkoutOverlapRule` — Garmin-direct wins workouts over HK/HC companion writes (v1 §13.2). Module home: `backend/services/integrations/garmin/`. Flag: `ff_integration_garmin`. Test: Garmin sandbox + recorded FIT fixtures in `core-testing/fixtures/garmin/`.

**Oura (Tier 2, direct)**
- Auth: OAuth2 (Oura API v2). Endpoints: daily sleep/readiness/activity, heartrate, temperature; polling (no push). Cadence: poll every 2–4h. Dedup: if Oura app already writes to store, `SourceDetection` (§13.2) prefers store path to avoid double-ingestion; else direct. Module home: `backend/services/integrations/oura/`. Flag: `ff_integration_oura`. Test: Oura sandbox tokens + JSON fixtures.

**Dexcom (Tier 2, CGM direct)**
- Auth: OAuth2 (Dexcom partner). Endpoints: EGV pull (near-real-time), device/calibration. Cadence: poll 5–15 min during active session. Dedup: `GlucosePointDedupRule` prefers HK/HC store point if present; artifact classifier flags compression lows. Module home: `backend/services/integrations/dexcom/`. Flag: `ff_integration_dexcom`. Test: sandbox EGV stream fixtures; wellness-framing lint (no dosing UI).

**Fitbit (Tier 2, direct)**
- Auth: OAuth2 (Fitbit Web API). Endpoints: steps/sleep/HR intraday, subscription webhooks. Cadence: webhook + daily backfill. Dedup: standard family rules; watch Google-platform migration risk. Module home: `backend/services/integrations/fitbit/`. Flag: `ff_integration_fitbit`. Test: Fitbit sandbox + fixtures.

**Whoop (Tier 2, optional)**
- Auth: OAuth2 (availability permitting; else broker). Endpoints: recovery/strain/sleep/cycles. Cadence: webhook. Dedup: treat recovery/strain as vendor-native, do not blend into BADAN scores (provenance-separate). Module home: `backend/services/integrations/whoop/`. Flag: `ff_integration_whoop`. Test: fixtures; adapter optional-load gated by flag.

**Broker / Terra-class (Tier 2 breadth)**
- Auth: one OAuth per device via broker UI. Endpoints: normalized webhook + backfill for 500+ devices; multiplexes `sourceId`. Cadence: webhook. Dedup: normalized (lowest-common) data flagged lower richness; direct adapters override for top sources. Module home: `backend/services/integrations/broker/`. Flag: `ff_integration_broker`. Test: broker sandbox + contract tests per privacy posture (data-residency, no secondary use, exit path — v1 §13.3).

**Withings / Polar / Suunto / Coros (Tier 2–3)**
- Withings: store writes now, direct later (scales/BP/mats). Polar/Suunto/Coros: broker-first (long-tail economics, v1 §13.2). Flags: `ff_integration_withings`, `ff_integration_polar`, etc. Test: fixtures per vendor.

### 13.2 Companion-vs-bridge detection

Setup wizard starts with **detection** (`core-ingest/vendor/SourceDetection.kt`): read available sources from the store, recognize signatures (e.g., Oura app writes), and only offer direct/broker OAuth when store data is absent or shallow (v1 §13.4). Avoids double-ingestion and minimizes OAuth friction.

### 13.3 Import-connector specs

`ArchiveImporter` impls (§11.1). All stream to bounded memory and tag an `ImportBatch` (idempotent, one-tap undo).

**Apple Health ZIP (`AppleHealthZipImporter`)**
- Format: ZIP containing `export.xml` (+ `export_cda.xml`, workout GPX). Parsing: **streaming SAX/pull parser** over `export.xml` — never DOM-load (files reach hundreds of MB). Emit `RawArchiveEntry` per `<Record>`/`<Workout>` element; flush on element close. Entity mapping table:

| XML element / `type` attr | Ontology target | Canonical entity |
|---|---|---|
| `<Record type="HKQuantityTypeIdentifierHeartRate">` | `vitals.hr` | Sample |
| `<Record type="...StepCount">` | `activity.steps` | IntervalRecord |
| `<Record type="...HeartRateVariabilitySDNN">` | `vitals.hrv_sdnn` | Sample |
| `<Record type="...AppleSleepingWristTemperature">` | `temp.wrist_deviation` | Sample→derived |
| `<Category type="...SleepAnalysis">` | `sleep.*` | SleepSession |
| `<Workout workoutActivityType=...>` | `workout.*` | WorkoutSession |
| `<Record type="...DietaryEnergyConsumed">` | `nutrition.energy_in` | EventRecord |
| `<Record type="...BloodGlucose">` | `glucose.*` | Sample |

  Dedup: `ImportOverlapRule` suppresses records matching live-synced data (deterministic id/hash). Module home: `core-ingest/import/AppleHealthZipImporter.kt`. Flag: `ff_import_apple_zip`. Test: fixture ZIPs (small + large synthetic) in `core-testing/fixtures/import/`.

**Google Takeout / Fit (`GoogleTakeoutImporter`)** — JSON/CSV per data type; map Fit data types to ontology; same batch/dedup rules. Flag `ff_import_takeout`.

**Garmin/Oura/Fitbit archives** — vendor export JSON/CSV; per-vendor entity mapping tables; flags `ff_import_garmin`, etc.

**CSV mapper (`CsvMappingImporter`) — column-mapping UI contract**
- User uploads arbitrary CSV; importer `probe()` returns detected columns + sample rows. UI presents a mapping form (`Features/Import/CsvMappingScreen`): each source column → (ontology metric id | timestamp | unit | ignore). Contract: `ColumnMapping(sourceCol, ontologyId?, role, unit?)[]`; unit-guard validates value ranges against metric physiologic bounds before import; timezone column optional (default device tz). Preview shows first N mapped rows with flagged out-of-bounds values. Module home: `core-ingest/import/CsvMappingImporter.kt` + iOS/Android `Features/Import/`. Flag: `ff_import_csv`. Test: malformed-CSV fixtures, unit-mismatch fixtures, bounds-violation fixtures.

### 13.4 Source-priority defaults (per family, user-overridable)

Seeds `core-ingest/dedup/SourcePriorityTable.kt`; user overrides stored in `customization_profiles` (v1 §11.4). Default ranking (high→low) per family:

| Family | Default priority order | Override note |
|---|---|---|
| workouts | Garmin-direct > vendor FIT > platform session > manual | direct wins richness (laps/power) |
| sleep | dedicated ring/watch > phone > manual | ranked source owns session boundary |
| steps/energy | dedicated wearable > phone > 3rd-party app > manual | overlap-suppressed |
| HR/HRV | dedicated wearable > phone > manual | method (rMSSD/SDNN) per user setting |
| glucose | store point > vendor API > fingerstick | fingerstick distinct class |
| weight/BP/labs | manual > device | deliberate human authority |

### 13.5 Auth-health monitoring

Vendor tokens expire and ToS churn (v1 §11.2 risks). `backend/services/integrations/AuthHealthMonitor` tracks per-`SourceConnection`: token expiry, refresh failures, webhook silence, rate-limit hits. On degradation → `SourceConnection` marked `needs_reauth` → in-app banner with re-auth CTA (never silent data staleness). Broker contract requires a connection-inventory export so users can re-auth direct if BADAN switches brokers (v1 §13.3 exit path).

### 13.6 CGM strategy (wellness framing locked)

Paths (v1 §13.5): store reads preferred → vendor APIs where gaps → manual fingerstick always. Gated to wellness: day-strip, meal responses, variability, user-set band thresholds (defaults 3.9–7.8 mmol/L, editable, unit-localized). Non-features: dosing calculators, hypo/hyper safety alarms (OS/vendor own safety; BADAN states this in CGM onboarding). Home: `core-scoring/glucose/*` + `backend/services/integrations/dexcom|libre/`.

### 13.7 New-device-class attach checklist (extensibility contract)

Per architecture rule (v1 §13.1), a new device class attaches without schema surgery. Checklist for adding an adapter:

1. Implement `VendorApiAdapter` (or reuse broker `sourceId`) in `core-ingest/vendor/` / `backend/services/integrations/<vendor>/`.
2. Add source signature to `SourceDetection` (§13.2) so companion-vs-bridge detection works.
3. Map vendor types → existing ontology metric ids via `PlatformTypeMap`/adapter `entityMapping()` — extend registry only if a genuinely new metric (then §10 YAML seed + ADR).
4. Insert into `SourcePriorityTable` (§13.4) with a sensible default rank.
5. Add per-family dedup interaction (usually an existing rule; new rule only if a new overlap shape).
6. Gate behind `ff_integration_<vendor>` flag; add sandbox creds + fixtures to `core-testing/fixtures/<vendor>/`.
7. Register in `AuthHealthMonitor` (§13.5).

No table migration, no scoring change — the ontology and pipeline absorb the new source.

### 13.8 Test-strategy summary (all integrations)

Every adapter ships: (a) recorded-fixture replay tests (JSON/FIT) in `core-testing/fixtures/`, (b) idempotency test (webhook+poll+backfill overlap → no dupes), (c) dedup-interaction test against the relevant rule fixtures, (d) privacy/framing lint (CGM: no dosing UI; broker: data-residency + no-secondary-use contract test), (e) auth-refresh failure → `needs_reauth` banner test. CI-blocking; new integrations cannot merge without all five.

## 14. Information architecture

### 14.1 Top-level IA (five destinations + one global action)

```
Today | Journey | Body | Log (+) | Coach       (Profile/Settings via avatar, modal stack)
```

- **Today** — L1 daily contract + curated modules (Bevel Home parity, presence-based defaults per v1 P5).
- **Journey** — time axis: unified Timeline, calendar (day rings → month → year heat), digests/reports, experiments.
- **Body** — repository axis: pillar cards, All-Metrics browser, Raw Data Explorer, Export Center, Data Sources.
- **Log (+)** — global logging hub (center-elevated FAB-in-bar): food, water/caffeine/alcohol, workout, symptom, med, mood, measurement, note, status.
- **Coach** — interpretation axis: narratives, insight feed, check-ins, Ask-BADAN, education library.
- The depth dial (v1 §8.6) changes destination *contents*, never the destination set. All five tabs exist for every user from first launch; casual presets render fewer modules inside each.

### 14.2 IA principles (carried from v1, now enforceable)

1. Time, body, and action are orthogonal axes; no screen mixes them in one list. Enforced by the route registry (§14.3): every route belongs to exactly one destination graph.
2. Every entity has one canonical home + unlimited contextual appearances. Enforced by the entity→surface map (§14.4): contextual appearances render read-projections from named queries; only the canonical home offers edit/delete.
3. Search reaches everything from anywhere — `core-search/SearchIndexer` (FTS5) feeds a global search sheet reachable by pull-down on Today and a search icon on Body/Coach (§35 owns the query grammar).
4. Settings is a modal stack (X-close, Bevel parity) — configuration is not a destination; `route_settings` presents `fullScreenCover` (iOS) / dialog-destination graph (Android).
5. Paywall surfaces live inside the features they upgrade (`route_membership?context=<feature>`); no navigation edge exists from tab roots directly to the paywall.
6. The avatar (top-trailing on every tab root) is the single entry to the Settings modal stack — one `AvatarButton` component (`DesignSystem/components/AvatarButton.swift`, `designsystem/components/AvatarButton.kt`) rendering sync-state and local-only badges, so account/privacy status is glanceable app-wide without a fifth-plus destination.

### 14.3 Route registry (canonical, frozen in `contracts/navigation/routes.yaml`)

The registry below is the single source of truth for navigation. `contracts/navigation/routes.yaml` declares each route id, param types, and deep-link pattern; `tooling/scripts/gen-routes.ts` generates `ios/BadanApp/App/Route.swift` (enum `Route: Hashable, Codable`) and `android/.../navigation/Routes.kt` (`@Serializable` route objects), so the two platforms cannot drift. Deep-link scheme: `badan://`; universal/app links mirror as `https://badan.net/a/<same path>`.

| Route id | Destination | Params | Deep-link URL | iOS `NavigationPath` entry | Android NavHost route |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| `route_today_edit` | Today (sheet) | — | `badan://today/edit` | `Route.todayEdit` (sheet) | `today_edit` (bottom sheet dest) |
| `route_calendar` | Today (sheet) | `month?: YearMonth` | `badan://calendar?month=2026-07` | `Route.calendar(month:)` | `calendar?month={month}` |

| `route_digest/{digestId}` | Journey | `digestId` (`2026-W27`, `2026-06`) | `badan://journey/digest/2026-W27` | `Route.digest(id:)` | `digest/{digestId}` |

Registry rules: (a) params are typed in `routes.yaml`; (b) unknown params are dropped, never crash; (c) unknown routes fall back to `route_today` with analytics `deeplink_unresolved`; (d) adding a route requires an ADR-free minor bump of `routes.yaml` + regenerated code on both platforms in the same PR (CI check `tooling/ci/routes-drift-check`).

**Param types (declared once in `routes.yaml`, generated as value types on both platforms):**

| Param type | Wire form | Kotlin / Swift type | Validation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DayKey` | ISO-8601 local date `2026-07-10` | `DayKey` (core-model value class) / `DayKey` struct | must parse; future dates clamp to today |
| `YearMonth` | `2026-07` | `YearMonthKey` | 2000–2100 range |
| `Period` | `7d\|30d\|3m\|6m\|1y\|all` | `Period` enum | enum else dropped |
| `MetricId` | dot-namespaced `vitals.hrv_rmssd` | `MetricId` value class | must exist in `MetricRegistry` else fallback to `route_all_metrics?query=<raw>` |
| `PillarId` | `sleep\|recovery\|strain\|fitness\|nutrition\|glucose\|cycle\|biology\|meds\|symptoms` | `PillarId` enum | enum; inactive module → pillar renders module-off education state |
| `Uuid` | RFC 4122 | `Uuid` | parse else dropped |
| `EventKind[]` | comma list `meds,symptoms` | `Set<EventKind>` | unknown members dropped individually |
| `FeatureKey` | analytics-safe enum (`bio_age`, `scheduled_export`…) | `FeatureKey` enum | required on `route_membership` (paywall must know its context) |
| `OnboardingStage` | lowercase stage name | `OnboardingStage` | only while onboarding incomplete |

### 14.4 Entity→surface map (upgraded with read paths)

Every contextual appearance names the exact query (`core` use case) and repository it reads. Queries live in `core-db`/feature use-case layer; all return cold Flows over SQLDelight so surfaces update reactively.

| Entity | Canonical home (route) | Also appears in | Read path (query → repository) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sleep session | `route_timeline` | Sleep pillar, Today hero, Coach narrative, metric details | `GetTimelineQuery(filters)` → `SessionRepository`; hero via `GetTodayOverviewQuery(date)` → `DerivedValueRepository` |
| Score (any) | `route_pillar/{id}` hero | Today rings, calendar rings, digests, All-Metrics, export | `GetTodayOverviewQuery` / `GetCalendarMonthQuery(month)` → `DerivedValueRepository` (rows `derived_values` filtered `metric_id IN (…score)`) |
| Metric series | `route_metric_detail/{metricId}` | pillar trends lists, All-Metrics rows, widgets | `GetMetricDetailQuery(metricId, period, date)` → `SampleRepository` + `BaselineRepository` (bands) |
| Food entry | `route_timeline` | Nutrition pillar, meal-response cards, Coach | `GetTimelineQuery(kinds=[MEAL])` → `EventRecordRepository`; day totals via `GetNutritionDayQuery(date)` |
| Medication schedule | `route_meds_hub` | Today due strip, Timeline taken-events, chart annotations | `GetMedsDueQuery(date)` → `MedicationRepository` (`medication_regimens` ⋈ `adherence_events`); annotations via `GetAnnotationsQuery(metricId, range)` |
| Symptom event | `route_timeline` | Symptoms hub, correlations, reports | `GetTimelineQuery(kinds=[SYMPTOM])` → `EventRecordRepository`; per-symptom via `GetSymptomHistoryQuery(symptomId)` |
| Lab result | `route_pillar/biology` | Timeline, biomarker detail, reports | `GetBiomarkerQuery(metricId)` → `LabResultRepository`; timeline via `GetTimelineQuery(kinds=[LAB])` |
| Status interval | `route_timeline` | every chart annotation layer, scoring covariates | `GetActiveStatusesQuery(date)` / `GetAnnotationsQuery` → `StatusIntervalRepository` |
| Insight | `route_coach` feed | Today top card, digests, metric detail "insights about this" | `GetInsightFeedQuery(scope)` → `InsightRepository` (`insights` table; scope = day/metric/digest) |
| Experiment | `route_experiment/{id}` | Timeline span markers, Coach mentions | `GetExperimentQuery(id)` / `ListExperimentsQuery()` → `ExperimentRepository` |
| Customization profile | `route_today_edit` / Settings | Today layout, pillar layouts, presets, widgets | `CustomizationProfileRepository.observe(profileKey)` (`customization_profiles`) |
| Source connection | `route_data_sources` | S-02 sync sheet, onboarding S-15, lineage sheets | `GetSourceHealthQuery()` → `SourceConnectionRepository` (`source_connections`) |

### 14.5 Destination content inventory (what each tab root owns at L2)

| Destination | Root screen | Owned L2 surfaces | Sheets it may present | Never contains |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Today | S-20 | pillar pushes (contextual entry), metric detail pushes | S-21 edit, S-22 calendar, log hub, sync status, search, Score Anatomy | settings, export, raw data (linked, not homed) |
| Journey | S-30 | S-31 Timeline, S-32 digests, S-33 annual, S-34/35 experiments | calendar picker, share sheets | metric browsing (Body's job), logging forms |
| Body | S-40 (§16.5, sibling) | pillars, All-Metrics, biomarkers, raw explorer, sources, export, meds/symptoms/conditions | lineage, Score Anatomy, export scope pickers | narratives/chat (Coach's job) |
| Log (+) | S-70 hub (sheet) | all S-7x flows | photo/barcode capture, portion pickers | any read-only analytics surface |
| Coach | S-90 (§16.7, sibling) | chat, insight detail, check-in config, education | guardrail notices, feedback sheets | raw tables, export |
| Settings (modal) | S-100 (§16.8, sibling) | consent, privacy, membership, modules, data controls | OS-settings hand-offs | health data rendering (only counts/status) |

### 14.6 IA invariants under the depth dial

- Casual preset caps Today at 5 modules and collapses pillar trends behind "See trends" — implemented as `PresentationPolicy` fields (`maxTodayModules`, `trendsCollapsed`) consumed by renderers, never as separate routes (v1 §18.5).
- Power surfaces (`route_raw_explorer`, `route_experiments`, `route_lineage`) are reachable from every altitude via explicit links; they are never ambient on casual presets.
- RTL: destination order in the tab bar is mirrored automatically (leading→trailing semantics); route ids and deep links are locale-invariant.

## 15. Navigation model

### 15.1 Topology as implementation

Root = 5-tab shell with per-tab push stacks, preserved across tab switches; sheets for quick-looks/pickers/logging; full-screen modals for onboarding, settings stack, report composer, paywall (feature-context only). Universal gestures: edge-swipe back (iOS) / predictive back (Android), pull-to-refresh → visible sync stages (Bevel "Syncing…/Sync Complete" toast adopted), long-press any card → context menu (pin/hide/reorder/explain/export-this).

```
AppRoot
├── OnboardingModal (gate: OnboardingStage ≠ COMPLETE)   route_onboarding/{stage}
└── TabShell (S-01)
    ├── Today stack      route_today → [route_pillar/* → route_metric_detail/* → route_score_anatomy(sheet)]
    │     sheets: route_today_edit · route_calendar · route_log_hub · route_sync_status · search
    ├── Journey stack    route_journey → [route_timeline | route_digest/* | route_year_report/* | route_experiments → route_experiment/*]
    ├── (Log)            action, not a stack → route_log_hub sheet → S-7x flows
    ├── Body stack       route_body → [route_pillar/* | route_all_metrics | route_raw_explorer → route_lineage(sheet)
    │                                  | route_data_sources | route_export_center | meds/symptoms/conditions]
    ├── Coach stack      route_coach → [route_chat | route_insight/* | route_checkin_config | route_education]
    └── Modals (any tab) route_settings(stack) · route_membership · report composer
```

**Back behavior matrix (identical semantics, platform idioms):**

| Context | iOS | Android | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pushed screen | edge-swipe / back button | predictive back | pop one |
| Sheet | swipe-down | back gesture | dismiss sheet, keep stack |
| Full-screen modal | X only (settings/onboarding); back allowed on paywall | back = X where X allowed | never silently discards a dirty form (confirm-discard) |
| Tab root, re-tap tab | `popToRoot` | `popBackStack(startDestination)` | scroll-to-top on second re-tap |
| Cross-tab deep link | tab switch + push | tab switch + navigate | back returns within target tab's stack, then to previously selected tab root (single hop, no history replay) |

**Pull-to-refresh sync toast grammar** (shared component `SyncStagesToast` — `DesignSystem/components/SyncStagesToast.swift`, `designsystem/components/SyncStagesToast.kt`): three staged labels driven by `core-ingest` pipeline events — "Syncing…" (`IngestBatchStarted`) → "Processing…" (raw landed, normalization running) → "Up to date · 8:03" (`IngestBatchCompleted`, shows processed-through time). Failure renders "Couldn't sync — tap for details" → S-02. The toast never blocks input and auto-dismisses at 2.5 s; identical grammar on every refreshable surface so sync literacy is learned once.

### 15.2 iOS: TabView + NavigationStack per tab + `AppRouter`

Files: `ios/BadanApp/App/BadanApp.swift` (entry, DI), `App/AppRouter.swift`, `App/Route.swift` (generated), `App/DeepLinkParser.swift`, `App/SheetCoordinator.swift`, `App/RestorationStore.swift`.

```swift
// ios/BadanApp/App/AppRouter.swift — responsibilities sketch
@Observable final class AppRouter {
    enum Tab: String, CaseIterable { case today, journey, body, coach } // Log is an action, not a tab
    var selectedTab: Tab = .today
    var paths: [Tab: NavigationPath] = [:]          // one stack per tab, Codable for restoration
    var activeSheet: SheetRoute?                    // .logHub, .calendar, .scoreAnatomy, .syncStatus, .lineage
    var activeModal: ModalRoute?                    // .onboarding(stage), .settings(section), .membership(ctx), .reportComposer

    func push(_ route: Route)                       // appends to paths[selectedTab]
    func present(sheet: SheetRoute)                 // enforces §15.4 rules (one sheet at a time; queued)
    func present(modal: ModalRoute)
    func handle(deepLink url: URL) -> Bool          // DeepLinkParser.parse → route → tab select + push/present
    func popToRoot(_ tab: Tab)                      // re-tap tab bar item behavior
    func encodeRestorationState() -> Data           // paths + tab + sheet, persisted via RestorationStore
    func restore(from data: Data)                   // validates routes still resolvable (registry check)
}
```

Rules: `AppRouter` is the only object that mutates navigation state; ViewModels emit `NavigationEvent`s consumed by screens which call the router (screens stay dumb, VMs testable without SwiftUI). Log tab item intercepts selection and presents `SheetRoute.logHub` instead of switching tabs (long-press = recents radial, S-01). Onboarding gate: `BadanApp.swift` reads `GetOnboardingStateQuery`; any stage ≠ `.complete` renders the onboarding modal before the TabView and `handle(deepLink:)` queues non-onboarding links until completion.

### 15.3 Android: single-activity NavHost with nested graphs

Files under `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/navigation/`:

```
navigation/
├── BadanNavHost.kt          # single NavHost in MainActivity; Scaffold w/ NavigationBar + center Log FAB
├── Routes.kt                # generated @Serializable route objects (type-safe navigation)
├── DeepLinkHandler.kt       # intent-filter entry; parses badan:// + https://badan.net/a/*
├── NavigationEvents.kt      # VM → UI one-shot nav event channel contract
├── RestorationKeys.kt       # rememberSaveable/SavedStateHandle key constants
└── graphs/
    ├── TodayNavGraph.kt     # today, today_edit, calendar + pushes (metric, anatomy)
    ├── JourneyNavGraph.kt   # journey, timeline, digest, year_report, experiments
    ├── BodyNavGraph.kt      # body, pillars, all_metrics, raw_explorer, sources, export, meds, symptoms
    ├── CoachNavGraph.kt     # coach, chat, insight, checkin_config, education
    ├── LogNavGraph.kt       # log_hub + all log flows (bottom-sheet / dialog destinations)
    ├── OnboardingNavGraph.kt# onboarding/{stage}, gated before main graphs
    └── SettingsNavGraph.kt  # settings stack incl. consent, privacy, membership
```

Each tab graph is a nested `navigation(startDestination=…)` block so tab back-stacks save/restore independently (`saveState = true`, `restoreState = true` on `NavigationBar` item clicks — the Compose equivalent of per-tab NavigationStack). `route_metric_detail` and `route_score_anatomy` are declared once at NavHost level (cross-graph destinations) so any tab can push them without duplicating the composable. Predictive back enabled (`android:enableOnBackInvokedCallback`).

### 15.4 Sheet/modal presentation rules

| Surface class | Contents | iOS mechanism | Android mechanism | Dismissal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Quick-look sheet | metric quick-look, Score Anatomy, calendar, sync status, lineage | `.sheet` w/ detents `[.medium,.large]`; drag up → full push (`push(route)` replaces sheet) | `ModalBottomSheet` (M3), expand → navigate to full destination | swipe-down; never blocks tab bar taps (dismiss-then-navigate) |
| Logging flow | log hub + all S-7x flows | `.sheet` `.large` detent, keyboard-safe | bottom-sheet destination in `LogNavGraph` | confirm-discard alert iff dirty form |
| Picker | period calendar, options, unit pickers | `.sheet` `.medium` | `ModalBottomSheet` | tap-outside allowed (stateless) |
| Full-screen modal | onboarding, Settings stack, report composer, paywall | `.fullScreenCover` w/ X-close | `dialog`/nested graph w/ `DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth=false)` or activity-scoped destination | explicit X only (Bevel parity); paywall additionally hardware-back-dismissable |
| Rule | max one sheet at a time; a second `present(sheet:)` queues behind dismissal (`SheetCoordinator`); sheets never present modals; modals may present sheets | | | |

### 15.5 State restoration keys

| Key (both platforms, `RestorationKeys`) | Payload | Written by |
|---|---|---|
| `nav.selected_tab` | Tab raw value | AppRouter / NavHost listener |
| `nav.path.<tab>` | Codable `[Route]` / rememberSaveable NavBackStackEntry ids | AppRouter.encodeRestorationState / Compose saved state |
| `nav.active_sheet` | SheetRoute? | SheetCoordinator |
| `today.selected_date` | DayKey | TodayViewModel (`SavedStateHandle["today.selected_date"]` / `@SceneStorage`) |
| `timeline.scroll_anchor` | first-visible event id + offset | TimelineViewModel |
| `metric.period.<metricId>` | Period (per-chart override, remembered — v1 §19.2) | PeriodSelector via `CustomizationProfileRepository` |
| `onboarding.stage` | OnboardingStage (persisted, not just restored — §16.2.0) | OnboardingStateRepository |
| `journey.segment` / `timeline.filters` | segment enum / `Set<EventKind>` | JourneyViewModel / TimelineViewModel via `CustomizationProfileRepository` |
| `log.draft.<kind>` | dirty logging-form drafts (crash-safe logging — a food entry survives process death) | each S-7x flow VM |

Budget: Today renders from local cache <400 ms cold (v1 §15.4); restoration must not add a blocking read — restoration state is read synchronously from a small key-value store (`core-db` table `customization_profiles`, key prefix `restore.`), while data queries stream in.

### 15.6 Date-navigation grammar as a component pair

One system everywhere (v1 §15.2): header **DatePagerHeader** for day-anchored screens; **PeriodSelector** for every chart. Shared value types in `core/core-model`: `DayKey`, `Period` (`P7D, P30D, P3M, P6M, P1Y, ALL`), `DateWindow(start, endExclusive)`.

**`PeriodSelector` component spec** — iOS `ios/BadanApp/DesignSystem/components/PeriodSelector.swift`; Android `android/.../designsystem/components/PeriodSelector.kt`.

| Aspect | Contract |
|---|---|
| Inputs | `supported: [Period]` (metric-family-driven; labs omit `P7D`), `selected: Period`, `anchor: DateWindow`, `availability: DateWindow` (first…last data), `showCalendarButton: Bool`, `pagingEnabled: Bool` |
| Outputs (events) | `onPeriodChanged(Period)`, `onPageBackward()` / `onPageForward()` (chevrons; disabled at `availability` edges), `onCalendarRequested()` (host presents `route_calendar` picker sheet), `onWindowChanged(DateWindow)` (derived; the only event chart data queries listen to) |
| Behavior | segmented control `7D|30D|3M|6M|1Y|All` + calendar icon + paging chevrons; selection persists per metric via `metric.period.<metricId>` restoration key; haptic tick on page |
| Accessibility | segmented items are adjustable trait / `Role.Tab`; chevrons labeled "Previous period"/"Next period" with resolved dates in the a11y value |
| RTL | chevron *icons* mirror; time semantics do not — "previous period" always moves earlier; chart time axes stay LTR (v1 §25.9), selector chrome mirrors |

**`DatePagerHeader`** (Today, pillar day views): inputs `selected: DayKey`, `todayKey`, `ringSummaryProvider` (calendar sheet minis); events `onDayChanged(DayKey)`, `onCalendarRequested()`, `onSnapToToday()`. Swipe-anywhere-on-header pages days; title tap opens S-22.

### 15.7 Deep-link handling module + test list

iOS: `App/DeepLinkParser.swift` (pure function `parse(URL) -> Route?`, table-driven from generated registry) + `AppRouter.handle`. Android: `navigation/DeepLinkHandler.kt` + manifest intent filters for `badan://` and `https://badan.net/a/`. Both route through the same generated registry, so a link mints identically on both platforms. Notification payloads carry `route` + params, never free-form screens (v1 §15.3: every notification deep-links to its exact evidence).

Test list (`core-testing/conformance/deeplinks/` fixtures + platform UI tests):

1. DL-T1: every row of §14.3 parses to its route with typed params (table-driven, both platforms).
2. DL-T2: unknown host/path → `route_today` + `deeplink_unresolved` analytics event; no crash.
3. DL-T3: malformed param (`date=banana`) → route resolves with param dropped.
4. DL-T4: link received while onboarding stage ≠ COMPLETE → queued, executed after completion (except `route_onboarding/*`).
5. DL-T5: link to paywalled feature for free user → destination renders its paywalled state in-place (never redirects to bare paywall).
6. DL-T6: cold-start link ≤1 render of Today before target appears (no flash of wrong tab > 1 frame budget).
7. DL-T7: widget/notification round-trip — `today_viewed(source=widget)` attribution recorded.
8. DL-T8: universal link `https://badan.net/a/metric/vitals.rhr` equals `badan://metric/vitals.rhr`.

### 15.8 Cold-start sequence (budget: Today interactive <400 ms, v1 §15.4)

1. **0 ms** — process start; DI graph builds lazily (no engine construction on main thread; `core-ingest`/`core-baseline` factories deferred).
2. **~40 ms** — synchronous small reads: `onboarding.stage`, `restore.*` keys, active locale/theme (single `customization_profiles` batch query, SQLCipher connection warm from `core-db` pool).
3. **~60 ms** — shell renders: tab bar + restored tab + layout-shaped Today skeleton (layout spec read is part of the batch above, so skeleton shape is correct, not generic).
4. **≤400 ms** — `GetTodayOverviewQuery` first emission from cache; hero + narrative paint; modules stream in independently (each module Flow paints as it arrives — no all-or-nothing join).
5. **background** — deep link (if launch intent) resolves after step 3; sync delta kicked via `ResyncCommand(background=true)`; UI updates non-jarringly (diffed lists, no full-screen spinner ever on root surfaces).
6. **failure path** — DB migration pending: step 2 detects schema version mismatch → lightweight migration screen (progress + never-lose-data copy) before shell; measured in `app_coldstart_completed(duration_bucket, migrated)`.

Template per conventions §5. Common abbreviations: **DD** = data dependencies, **VM** = ViewModel responsibilities, **AE** = analytics events (from `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml`; properties never carry health values), **A11y** = accessibility, **RTL** = RTL/l10n notes. Cross-cutting states (v1 §16.9) apply everywhere; each spec lists only the states with screen-specific behavior. iOS paths under `ios/BadanApp/`, Android under `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/`.

**Part A screen index:**

| ID | Name | Route | Epic |
|---|---|---|---|
| S-01 | App shell / tab bar | (host) | E-05 |
| S-02 | Global sync status sheet | `route_sync_status` | E-05/E-02 |
| S-10…S-17 | Onboarding: Welcome, Platform connect, Backfill+first insight, Tuning, Notifications, Source wizard, Sync choice, Stories | `route_onboarding/{stage}` | E-05/E-02 |
| S-20 | Today root (flagship) | `route_today` | E-05.2 |
| S-21 | Edit Today | `route_today_edit` | E-05.2 |
| S-22 | Calendar sheet | `route_calendar` | E-05.4 |

### 16.1 Shell & system screens

**S-01 App shell / tab bar**
- **Purpose:** orientation + global log action; hosts the five destinations and the offline/sync affordances.
- **Archetypes:** all 20 (the one surface every archetype shares).
- **DD:** `GetSyncStatusQuery()` → `SourceConnectionRepository` (offline chip, per-tab syncing shimmer); `GetOnboardingStateQuery()` (gate); `GetLogRecentsQuery(limit=4)` → `EventRecordRepository` (long-press radial); badge counts none (no red badges — v1 anti-feature #4 adjacent).
- **States:** normal; offline (subtle cloud-slash chip on trailing edge of tab bar; tap → S-02); syncing (shimmer on active tab icon only); onboarding-gate (shell not yet shown).
- **Actions:** primary — tab selection, Log tap (presents S-70 hub). Secondary — Log long-press → recents radial (last 4 log kinds, one-tap re-open); re-tap current tab → popToRoot; offline chip → S-02.
- **Subcomponents:** `BadanTabBar` (labeled icons, collapse-to-slim on scroll — Bevel dock behavior without losing labels), `LogFabButton` (center-elevated), `OfflineChip`, `SyncShimmerModifier`, `RecentsRadialMenu`.
- **VM:** `ShellViewModel` — merges sync status + connectivity into `ShellUiState(offline: Bool, syncingTabs: Set<Tab>)`; exposes `logRecents: [LogKind]`; no navigation logic (router owns it).
- **iOS:** `App/BadanApp.swift`, `App/AppRouter.swift`, `Features/Shell/ShellViewModel.swift`, `DesignSystem/components/BadanTabBar.swift`, `LogFabButton.swift`.
- **Android:** `navigation/BadanNavHost.kt`, `features/shell/ShellViewModel.kt`, `designsystem/components/BadanTabBar.kt`, `LogFabButton.kt`.
- **Navigation:** hosts all tab graphs; Log intercepts to `route_log_hub`; offline chip → `route_sync_status`.
- **AE:** `tab_selected(tab)`, `log_hub_opened(source=fab|radial)`, `offline_chip_tapped`.
- **Tests:** (1) tab switch preserves per-tab stack; (2) Log tap never switches tabs; (3) offline chip appears within 2 s of connectivity loss and never blocks taps; (4) long-press radial shows the user's actual last 4 log kinds; (5) re-tap tab pops to root.
- **A11y:** tab items ≥48 dp targets; radial menu has a non-gesture fallback (context menu list); shimmer excluded from Reduce Motion.
- **RTL:** tab order mirrors; Log stays center; chip moves to mirrored trailing edge.

**S-02 Global sync status sheet**
- **Purpose:** trust in freshness — answers "is what I'm seeing current?" with per-source truth.
- **Archetypes:** Tariq (background-sync anxiety), Dmitri, Ayesha; everyone during incidents.
- **DD:** `GetSourceHealthQuery()` → `SourceConnectionRepository` (per-source: last raw sync, auth state); `GetPipelineStatusQuery()` → `core-ingest` (pending queue depth, last processed batch) — the two stages rendered separately ("Received 8:02 · Processed 8:03") to kill the "synced vs processed" confusion risk; background-permission state from `port-health` capability descriptor.
- **States:** all-healthy; degraded (per-row warning: auth expired → fix path deep-link, background-read denied → "foreground-refresh mode" explainer per v1 §12.6); offline (queue shown, "will sync when online"); syncing (live row progress).
- **Actions:** primary — Resync (per-source + all, Bevel parity). Secondary — open `route_data_sources`; open OS settings deep-link for revoked permissions.
- **Subcomponents:** `SourceHealthRow` (icon, name, two-stage timestamps, status chip), `PipelineQueueCard`, `ResyncButton` (debounced, shows progress inline).
- **VM:** `SyncStatusViewModel` — `SyncStatusUiState.Loaded(sources: List<SourceHealthUi>, queue: QueueUi, backgroundMode: BackgroundMode)`; triggers `ResyncCommand(sourceId?)`.
- **iOS:** `Features/SyncStatus/SyncStatusSheet.swift`, `SyncStatusViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/syncstatus/SyncStatusSheet.kt`, `SyncStatusViewModel.kt`, `SyncStatusUiState.kt`.
- **Navigation:** sheet from offline chip, pull-to-refresh long-state, and Data Sources; `route_sync_status`.
- **AE:** `sync_sheet_viewed(source)`, `resync_requested(scope=one|all)`, `permission_fix_opened(kind)`.
- **Tests:** (1) received/processed timestamps differ correctly under a delayed-pipeline fixture; (2) resync debounce (double-tap = one job); (3) auth-expired row deep-links to correct re-auth flow; (4) offline shows queued-item count matching `sync_oplog`.
- **A11y:** status conveyed by icon+text, never color alone. **RTL:** timestamps localized; two-stage layout mirrors.

### 16.2 Onboarding & setup wizards

#### 16.2.0 Resumability state machine + permission bundles (governs S-10…S-17)

```kotlin
// core/core-model/src/commonMain/kotlin/net/badan/model/OnboardingStage.kt
enum class OnboardingStage {          // persisted enum — the resumability contract
    WELCOME,            // S-10
    PLATFORM_CONNECT,   // S-11
    BACKFILL,           // S-12 (may complete in background)
    FIRST_INSIGHT,      // S-12 second phase
    TUNING,             // S-13
    NOTIFICATIONS_OPTIN,// S-14
    SOURCE_WIZARD,      // S-15
    SYNC_CHOICE,        // S-16
    STORIES,            // S-17 (skippable)
    COMPLETE
}
```

Rules: (1) persisted after **every** transition via `OnboardingStateRepository.set(stage)` → `customization_profiles(profile_key='onboarding.stage')`; cold start resumes at the persisted stage (kill the app at S-13, reopen at S-13). (2) Monotonic forward; back navigation within onboarding edits answers but never regresses the persisted stage below the furthest reached. (3) `BACKFILL` is non-blocking: user may advance while `core-ingest` backfill continues; `BackfillProgress` is observable from any later stage and from S-02 post-onboarding. (4) Stages `TUNING`→`STORIES` are individually skippable; skip records `onboarding_stage_skipped(stage)` and advances. (5) Deep links (except `route_onboarding/*`) queue until `COMPLETE` (§15.7 DL-T4). (6) Settings exposes "Replay setup" which re-enters at `SOURCE_WIZARD` or `STORIES` without resetting `COMPLETE`.

**Stage transition table (the QA matrix for resumability):**

| Stage | Screen | Advance trigger | Skippable | Persisted artifacts on exit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WELCOME | S-10 | Continue | no | locale (`port-locale`), `onboarding.stage` |
| PLATFORM_CONNECT | S-11 | any grant outcome (incl. full denial) | via "continue without connecting" | `consent_records` rows, granted-type set |
| BACKFILL | S-12 | Continue (backfill keeps running) | effectively (Continue always enabled) | backfill job handle (resumable), imported rows |
| FIRST_INSIGHT | S-12 (phase 2) | facts rendered or Continue | yes | `insights` rows (kind=`first_fact`) |
| TUNING | S-13 | 3 answers or Skip | yes → Essential defaults | `today_layout`, `depth_dial`, `modules.active` profiles |
| NOTIFICATIONS_OPTIN | S-14 | grant/deny/Not-now | yes | notification budget config (`core-notify`) |
| SOURCE_WIZARD | S-15 | Looks right / connections done | yes | `source_connections` rows, background-mode flag |
| SYNC_CHOICE | S-16 | mode chosen or Later (=local) | yes → LOCAL_ONLY | sync mode, analytics consent, account (if created) |
| STORIES | S-17 | Done or Skip all | yes | `stories.seen`, `onboarding.stage=COMPLETE` |

**Permission bundles** (`adapters/port-health/PermissionBundle`, staged per v1 §12.6):

| Bundle | Contents | Trigger | Denial fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CORE` | sleep, HR, HRV, RHR, steps/activity, workouts | S-11 primary CTA | manual-mode explainer + re-request path; shell proceeds (manual-mode Today hero) |
| `BACKGROUND` | HK background delivery / HC background-read + battery-optimization exemption | S-15 (after first value) | "foreground-refresh mode" banner contract (v1 §12.6) |
| `NOTIFICATIONS` | OS notification permission | S-14, only after first insight shown | in-app inbox only; morning narrative appears on Today instead |
| `NUTRITION` / `GLUCOSE` / `CYCLE` / `BODY` / `MEDICATIONS_IOS` | family read(+write) sets | module opt-in at S-13, or first feature use post-onboarding | module renders denied-state education per v1 §12.6 matrix |

Every request screen states value + denial consequence before the OS sheet (never a blank prompt). All bundle requests emit `permission_bundle_requested(bundle)` / `…_granted` / `…_denied` (bundle enum only — never which health types a user actually has).

**S-10 Welcome**
- **Purpose:** value promise + language selection; first trust signal (RTL flips live).
- **Archetypes:** all; Kenji and Arabic-first users decisively.
- **DD:** none (static content from `content/l10n/`); `SetLocaleCommand(locale)` → `port-locale`.
- **States:** default only; no network required (local-first path — no account wall).
- **Actions:** primary — Continue. Secondary — language selector (EN/AR at launch); "Restore from backup" link (→ restore flow, §34 owner).
- **Subcomponents:** `BrandLockup` (bilingual BADAN بدن), `LanguagePicker`, `ValuePromiseCarousel` (3 static cards: gather/explain/own).
- **VM:** `WelcomeViewModel` — applies locale immediately (activity/scene recreate), advances stage.
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/WelcomeScreen.swift`, `OnboardingCoordinatorViewModel.swift` (shared across S-10…S-17). **Android:** `features/onboarding/WelcomeScreen.kt`, `OnboardingViewModel.kt`, `OnboardingUiState.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/welcome`; entry point when stage=WELCOME.
- **AE:** `onboarding_started`, `language_selected(lang)` (fires before analytics consent? No — event buffered locally, flushed only after consent at S-16; rule applies to all onboarding events).
- **Tests:** (1) AR selection flips layout direction within the same session, no restart artifacts; (2) kill+relaunch resumes at WELCOME with chosen language; (3) no network calls observed in local-only path (traffic assertion test).
- **A11y:** carousel auto-advance off under Reduce Motion; all text Dynamic Type XL-safe. **RTL:** the flagship RTL proof screen — audit fixture for §25.9.

**S-11 Platform connect**
- **Purpose:** request the `CORE` bundle with plain-language value + explicit denial consequences.
- **Archetypes:** all with a platform store; Sven reads this screen skeptically — copy must promise on-device processing.
- **DD:** `port-health` capability descriptor (which types exist on this OS version); `RequestPermissionsCommand(PermissionBundle.CORE)`.
- **States:** pre-request; requesting (OS sheet up); granted (✓ per family, auto-advance); partially-granted (family checklist with granted/denied marks + "you can add these later"); denied-all (manual-mode explainer + "continue without connecting" + re-request path).
- **Actions:** primary — Connect Health Data. Secondary — "What will BADAN read?" expandable type list; Skip (→ manual mode).
- **Subcomponents:** `PermissionValueCard` (per family: icon, one-line value, denial consequence), `GrantChecklist`, `ManualModeExplainer`.
- **VM:** `PlatformConnectViewModel` — maps `PermissionResult` (per-type) into family-level UI; writes granted set to `consent_records`; advances stage on any outcome (denial never dead-ends).
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/PlatformConnectScreen.swift` + `Platform/HealthKitPermissionRequester.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/PlatformConnectScreen.kt` + `platform/HealthConnectPermissionRequester.kt` (handles HC-not-installed → Play Store deep-link state).
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/platform_connect`.
- **AE:** `permission_bundle_requested(bundle=core)`, `permission_bundle_granted/denied(bundle=core, partial: Bool)`.
- **Tests:** (1) partial grant renders correct per-family checklist (fixture: sleep granted, HR denied); (2) HC missing on Android 10–13 → install path, resumable; (3) denial → manual mode reachable and stage advances; (4) consent rows written match grants exactly.
- **A11y:** OS sheet is system-owned; pre-screen readable by screen reader in one pass (heading order). **RTL:** checklist marks mirror.

**S-12 Backfill & first insight**
- **Purpose:** the calibration-gap killer (v1 P4): import history with live counts, then render 2–3 provisional personal facts in the very first session.
- **Archetypes:** all granted users; Dmitri watches the counts; Rania just needs it to feel alive.
- **DD:** `StartBackfillCommand(window=maxPermitted)` → `core-ingest` backfill orchestrator; `GetBackfillProgressQuery()` (per-family counts: "Reading 214 nights of sleep…"); `GetFirstFactsQuery()` → `core-baseline` provisional facts generator (runs once ≥30 days of any family land; emits `FirstFact(metricId, phrasedText, confidence)` through `core-phrasing`).
- **States:** running (live counters, cancellable to background); first-facts-ready (fact cards animate in, provisional badges); sparse-history (<30 days total: honest "I'll learn your baseline over ~2 weeks" + what-works-now list); no-permission (skipped here entirely — stage machine routes past it); error (partial import: keep what landed, retry affordance).
- **Actions:** primary — Continue (enabled immediately; backfill keeps running in background — rule 3 of §16.2.0). Secondary — pause backfill (battery courtesy); "how is this computed?" → mini-explainer.
- **Subcomponents:** `BackfillProgressList` (per-family row: icon, count-up number, done check), `FirstFactCard` (fact + provisional badge + confidence phrase), `SparseHistoryNotice`.
- **VM:** `BackfillViewModel` — subscribes to progress Flow, throttles UI updates to 4 Hz; requests first facts when threshold event `IngestBatchCompleted` carries `backfillPhase=initial`; persists facts to `insights` (kind=first_fact) so Today can re-show them day one.
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/BackfillScreen.swift`, `BackfillViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/BackfillScreen.kt`, `BackfillViewModel.kt` (+ WorkManager job already owned by `core-ingest` glue in `platform/`).
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/backfill`; auto-advances stage BACKFILL→FIRST_INSIGHT when facts render or user continues.
- **AE:** `backfill_started(window_bucket)`, `backfill_completed(duration_bucket, families_count)`, `first_insight_shown(facts_count)` — counts bucketed, no values.
- **Tests:** (1) 5-year fixture archive → counts monotonically increase, UI stays 60 fps (perf test); (2) kill mid-backfill → resumes, no duplicate samples (dedup conformance tie-in E-03.2); (3) sparse fixture (7 days) → sparse state, no fake facts; (4) facts respect phrasing guardrails (`PhrasingLinter` pass); (5) Continue during running backfill → S-13 while ingest proceeds (assert background continuation).
- **A11y:** counters announced politely (no per-tick announcements); facts readable as complete sentences. **RTL:** count-up numerals localized (Arabic-Indic digits per locale setting).

**S-13 Three-question tuning**
- **Purpose:** map goal focus, depth appetite, and module opt-ins to a starter preset — 3 questions max, all skippable.
- **Archetypes:** everyone; determines Rania's Casual vs Dmitri's Power start.
- **DD:** `ApplyPresetCommand(presetId, moduleKeys)` → writes `customization_profiles('today_layout')`, `('depth_dial')`, `('modules.active')`; module opt-ins may trigger permission bundles (`NUTRITION`/`CYCLE`/`GLUCOSE`/`MEDICATIONS_IOS`) per §16.2.0 table.
- **States:** Q1 goal (feel better / train smarter / track health issues / understand everything) → preset map (Essential/Athlete/Recovery-or-Logging/Analyst per v1 §19.3); Q2 depth (keep it simple / show me depth); Q3 modules (nutrition, cycle, meds+symptoms, glucose, biology — presence-based hints: "we noticed glucose data" pre-checks a module); skipped (sane defaults: Essential + presence-based modules).
- **Actions:** primary — per-question select → auto-advance. Secondary — Skip all; back to previous question (edits answer, stage unchanged).
- **Subcomponents:** `TuningQuestionPager`, `GoalOptionCard`, `ModuleTogglesGrid` (with one-line consequence per module: "adds a Cycle pillar; strictest privacy class").
- **VM:** `TuningViewModel` — accumulates `TuningAnswers`, resolves `PresetId` via pure function `resolvePreset(answers)` (unit-tested mapping), issues `ApplyPresetCommand` once at completion (atomic — no half-applied presets).
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/TuningScreen.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/TuningScreen.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/tuning`.
- **AE:** `onboarding_tuning_completed(preset, depth, modules_count)`, `onboarding_stage_skipped(stage=tuning)`.
- **Tests:** (1) every answer combination resolves to a defined preset (exhaustive table test); (2) module opt-in fires exactly its bundle request, not before; (3) skip yields Essential + presence-based modules (fixture with glucose data pre-checks glucose); (4) back-edit then complete applies final answers only.
- **A11y:** cards are buttons with full labels; auto-advance announced. **RTL:** option grids mirror.

**S-14 Notifications opt-in**
- **Purpose:** request notification permission *after* first value, with the concrete default set (morning narrative + weekly digest only — the notification floor, v1 §17.2).
- **Archetypes:** all; Omar's noise-fear is the design target.
- **DD:** `RequestPermissionsCommand(PermissionBundle.NOTIFICATIONS)`; preview content from `core-notify` templates (example morning narrative rendered with the user's actual first fact when available — a real preview, not lorem).
- **States:** pre-request (two example cards + "that's all, everything else is opt-in"); granted (confirm + link to notification matrix in Settings); denied (in-app inbox explainer; no re-nag — re-request only from Settings).
- **Actions:** primary — Enable these two. Secondary — Not now (equal visual weight — no dark pattern).
- **Subcomponents:** `NotificationPreviewCard` ×2, `FloorPromiseNote`.
- **VM:** `NotificationsOptinViewModel` — records outcome to `core-notify` budget config; never blocks advance.
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/NotificationsOptinScreen.swift` + `Platform/NotificationPermissionRequester.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/NotificationsOptinScreen.kt` (POST_NOTIFICATIONS, API 33+ path + pre-33 no-op).
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/notifications_optin`.
- **AE:** `permission_bundle_requested/granted/denied(bundle=notifications)`, `notifications_optin_shown`.
- **Tests:** (1) preview uses real first fact when present, template sample otherwise; (2) denied → no OS re-prompt attempts anywhere in app for 30 days (budget rule test); (3) "Not now" and "Enable" have equal-weight styling (snapshot).
- **A11y:** previews read as example content ("Example:") to screen readers. **RTL:** preview cards render AR narrative when locale=ar.

**S-15 Device/source wizard**
- **Purpose:** detection-first source setup (v1 §13.4): recognize what already writes to the store; offer direct/broker connect only for gaps; request `BACKGROUND` bundle.
- **Archetypes:** Tariq (OEM battery flows), Ingrid (Garmin), Aziza (CGM), Dmitri (everything).
- **DD:** `DetectSourcesQuery()` → `core-ingest/SourceSignatureDetector` (reads store sample source signatures, e.g., Oura app writes); `GetConnectorCatalogQuery()` (direct/broker connectors, Phase-gated by `ff_integrations_broker`); `RequestPermissionsCommand(PermissionBundle.BACKGROUND)`; per-source setup guides from `content/guides/` (e.g., `samsung-health-hc-toggle` with screenshots).
- **States:** detected (recognized sources listed with ✓ + last-write time); gaps (suggest connectors: "Garmin detected via files only — connect directly for training depth"); background-denied ("foreground-refresh mode" banner contract); OEM-battery step (Android: allowlist walkthrough per manufacturer, from `content/guides/oem-battery/<vendor>`); empty (no sources: phone-sensors-only path + connector catalog).
- **Actions:** primary — Looks right, continue. Secondary — connect a source (OAuth/broker flow), open setup guide, request background permission.
- **Subcomponents:** `DetectedSourceRow` (✓, name, signature, last write), `ConnectorSuggestionCard`, `BatteryOptimizationWalkthrough` (Android only), `BackgroundPermissionCard`.
- **VM:** `SourceWizardViewModel` — merges detection results + catalog; writes accepted sources to `source_connections`; tracks per-vendor guide completion.
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/SourceWizardScreen.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/SourceWizardScreen.kt`, `platform/BatteryOptimizationHelper.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/source_wizard`; also re-enterable post-onboarding from `route_data_sources`.
- **AE:** `source_detected(vendor_family, count)`, `source_connected(method=store|direct|broker)`, `permission_bundle_requested(bundle=background)`, `battery_guide_completed(vendor_family)`.
- **Tests:** (1) Oura-signature fixture → detected row, no OAuth push; (2) background denial → foreground-mode banner appears on Today thereafter; (3) Samsung guide flow resumable mid-way; (4) empty state offers phone-only path that reaches COMPLETE.
- **A11y:** guide screenshots carry alt text; walkthrough steps numbered for screen readers. **RTL:** guide content mirrored variants shipped in `content/guides/ar/`.

**S-16 Account/sync choice (optional)**
- **Purpose:** explicit local-only vs E2E-encrypted-sync decision with a tradeoffs table; freely deferrable.
- **Archetypes:** Sven (local-only is first-class), Priya, multi-device users.
- **DD:** `SetSyncModeCommand(mode: LOCAL_ONLY | E2E_SYNC)` → `core-sync` config + `consent_records`; account creation via `backend/services/identity` only if sync chosen; analytics consent toggle here (buffered onboarding events flushed or discarded accordingly).
- **States:** choice (two cards + tradeoffs table: backup, multi-device, "what leaves the device"); deferring (Later = local-only until changed); creating-account (email/passkey flow); error (account creation fails → stays local, retry later — never blocks COMPLETE).
- **Actions:** primary — Choose Local-only / Choose Sync. Secondary — Later; "what leaves the device?" → privacy explainer (pre-render of S-102 content).
- **Subcomponents:** `SyncChoiceCard` ×2, `TradeoffsTable`, `AnalyticsConsentRow` (default off in local-only).
- **VM:** `SyncChoiceViewModel` — persists mode; ensures local-only leaves zero network traffic (assertion hook for tests).
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/SyncChoiceScreen.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/SyncChoiceScreen.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/sync_choice`.
- **AE:** `sync_mode_chosen(mode|deferred)`, `analytics_consent_set(enabled)` (this event itself only sent when enabled).
- **Tests:** (1) local-only → network-traffic assertion passes across a full session; (2) Later = LOCAL_ONLY persisted; (3) account failure does not block stage COMPLETE; (4) buffered events discarded when consent off.
- **A11y:** tradeoffs table linearized for screen readers. **RTL:** table mirrors.

**S-17 Getting-started stories**
- **Purpose:** 4–6 page story-format explainers per pillar (Bevel parity: interpretation + how-calculated per page); re-openable forever from Coach library.
- **Archetypes:** Omar, Noor, anyone new to recovery scores.
- **DD:** `GetStoryQuery(storyId)` → `content/stories/<pillar>/` via `ContentRepository`; completion flags to `customization_profiles('stories.seen')`.
- **States:** story pages (swipe/tap progress); all-seen; skipped.
- **Actions:** primary — page through / Done. Secondary — Skip all (→ COMPLETE); "open later in Coach" hint on skip.
- **Subcomponents:** `StoryPager` (progress segments), `StoryPage` (art + interpretation + calculation blocks), `SkipAffordance`.
- **VM:** `StoriesViewModel` — page tracking; marks stage COMPLETE at exit (this is the terminal stage transition).
- **iOS:** `Features/Onboarding/StoriesScreen.swift`. **Android:** `features/onboarding/StoriesScreen.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_onboarding/stories`; re-entry `route_education?article=story_<pillar>`.
- **AE:** `story_viewed(pillar, pages_completed)`, `onboarding_completed(duration_bucket, path=full|skipped)`.
- **Tests:** (1) exit here sets COMPLETE and unqueues deferred deep links (DL-T4 pair); (2) stories reachable later from Coach; (3) Reduce Motion disables auto-advance.
- **A11y:** stories fully readable without gestures (next buttons). **RTL:** pager direction mirrors; progress segments mirror.

### 16.3 Today (L1)

**S-20 Today root — the flagship**
- **Purpose:** the daily contract (v1 §8.2): in <10 s — how I slept, how ready I am, anything unusual, one thing worth doing. Everything else is curated modules.
- **Archetypes:** all 20; sized for Rania, deepened for Dmitri via `PresentationPolicy` density (v1 §18.5).
- **DD (all reactive Flows):** `GetTodayOverviewQuery(date)` → `DerivedValueRepository` + `BaselineRepository` (three scores + drivers + provisional flags); `GetNarrativeQuery(date)` → `InsightRepository` (One True Sentence + why-evidence links); `GetActiveStatusesQuery(date)` → `StatusIntervalRepository` + weather chip via `port-locale`; `GetHealthMonitorQuery(date)` (6 vitals tiles vs personal bands); `GetMedsDueQuery(date)` → `MedicationRepository`; `GetNutritionDayQuery(date)`; `GetTimelinePreviewQuery(date, limit=3)`; layout from `CustomizationProfileRepository.observe('today_layout')`; staleness from `GetSourceHealthQuery()` (>36 h rule).
- **Module composition system:** modules are plugins resolved from a registry against the persisted layout —

```kotlin
// android/.../features/today/modules/TodayModule.kt   (iOS mirror: Features/Today/modules/TodayModule.swift protocol)
interface TodayModule {
    val id: TodayModuleId                                  // HERO, NARRATIVE, HEALTH_MONITOR, MEDS_DUE, STRESS_ENERGY,
                                                           // NUTRITION_SNAPSHOT, TIMELINE_PREVIEW, WEEKLY_PROGRESS, GLUCOSE_STRIP, CYCLE_CHIP…
    val presenceRule: PresenceRule                         // ALWAYS | IF_DATA(metricFamily) | IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(key)  — empty-state suppression (P5)
    fun content(date: DayKey): Flow<TodayModuleUi>         // each module owns its query; VM merges
    @Composable fun Render(ui: TodayModuleUi, policy: PresentationPolicy, onEvent: (TodayEvent) -> Unit)
}
object TodayModuleRegistry {                               // features/today/modules/TodayModuleRegistry.kt
    val all: List<TodayModule>
    fun resolve(layout: LayoutSpec, presence: PresenceFacts): List<TodayModule>  // ordered, presence-filtered, capped by policy.maxTodayModules
}
```

  Edit-Today (S-21) writes `LayoutSpec` (ordered module ids + size variants) via `SaveTodayLayoutCommand` → `customization_profiles('today_layout', payload_json)`, replicated through `sync_oplog`; `TodayViewModel` observes the profile and re-resolves — reorder is therefore a pure data change, no navigation or process restart. Preset application (`ApplyPresetCommand`) writes a whole new `LayoutSpec` after diff preview (v1 §19.3).

  **Module inventory (launch set; adding one = new registry entry + gallery card, zero Today-screen changes):**

| `TodayModuleId` | Presence rule | Content query | Default in presets (Ess / Ath / Rec / Lon / Ana) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HERO` | ALWAYS (manual-mode variant when CORE denied) | `GetTodayOverviewQuery` | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ (non-removable, pinned first) |
| `NARRATIVE` | ALWAYS | `GetNarrativeQuery` | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ (non-removable, pinned second) |
| `HEALTH_MONITOR` | IF_DATA(vitals) | `GetHealthMonitorQuery` | 3-tile / 6-tile / 6-tile / 6-tile / 6-tile-dense |
| `MEDS_DUE` | IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(meds) | `GetMedsDueQuery` | auto when regimens exist (all presets; safety lint on removal) |
| `STRESS_ENERGY` | IF_DATA(vitals.hr_daytime) | `GetStressEnergyQuery` | ✗ / ✓ / ✓ / ✗ / ✓ |
| `NUTRITION_SNAPSHOT` | IF_DATA(nutrition) ∨ IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(nutrition) | `GetNutritionDayQuery` | presence / presence / ✗ / presence / ✓ |
| `GLUCOSE_STRIP` | IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(glucose) ∧ IF_DATA(glucose) | `GetGlucoseDayQuery` | presence-based all presets |
| `CYCLE_CHIP` | IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(cycle) | `GetCyclePhaseQuery` | presence-based; strictest privacy class rendering |
| `TIMELINE_PREVIEW` | IF_DATA(any events today) | `GetTimelinePreviewQuery(limit=3)` | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| `WEEKLY_PROGRESS` | ALWAYS after 7 days tenure | `GetWeeklyProgressQuery` | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / ✓ / compact |
| `TRAINING_TODAY` | IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(strength) ∨ IF_DATA(workouts) | `GetTrainingTodayQuery` | ✗ / ✓ / target-suppressed / ✗ / ✓ |
| `BIOLOGY_WATCHLIST` | IF_MODULE_ACTIVE(biology) ∧ IF_DATA(labs) | `GetBiomarkerWatchlistQuery` | ✗ / ✗ / ✗ / ✓ / ✓ |
- **UiState — Kotlin (android `features/today/TodayUiState.kt`):**

```kotlin
sealed interface TodayUiState {
    data object Loading : TodayUiState                        // skeletons mirror persisted layout shape
    data class Loaded(
        val date: DayKey,
        val isToday: Boolean,                                 // false ⇒ read-only past mode (from S-22)
        val contextStrip: ContextStripUi,                     // statuses + weather chip
        val hero: HeroUi,                                     // Rings(sleep, readiness, strain, drivers) | ManualMode(checkInPrompt, steps)
        val narrative: NarrativeUi?,                          // sentence, whyAvailable, evidenceRoute
        val modules: List<TodayModuleUi>,                     // ordered per customization_profiles
        val provisional: ProvisionalUi?,                      // calibration badge + daysRemaining
        val staleness: StalenessBannerUi?,                    // >36h "data paused" + fix route
        val offline: Boolean,
    ) : TodayUiState
    data class Empty(val reason: EmptyReason) : TodayUiState   // NO_SOURCES → education hero
    data class Denied(val kind: PermissionKind) : TodayUiState // all-denied → value restatement + fix path
    data class Error(val error: AppError) : TodayUiState
}
```

- **UiState — SwiftUI @Observable equivalent (`Features/Today/TodayViewModel.swift`):**

```swift
@Observable final class TodayViewModel {
    enum State {
        case loading
        case loaded(TodayContent)
        case empty(EmptyReason)
        case denied(PermissionKind)
        case error(AppError)
    }
    private(set) var state: State = .loading
    var selectedDate: DayKey                                   // @SceneStorage-backed via RestorationStore
    func onAppear() ; func refresh() async                     // pull-to-refresh → sync stages toast
    func select(date: DayKey) ; func snapToToday()
    func handle(_ event: TodayEvent)                           // module taps → NavigationEvent to AppRouter
}
struct TodayContent {                                          // mirrors Kotlin Loaded field-for-field
    let date: DayKey; let isToday: Bool
    let contextStrip: ContextStripUi; let hero: HeroUi
    let narrative: NarrativeUi?; let modules: [TodayModuleUi]
    let provisional: ProvisionalUi?; let staleness: StalenessBannerUi?; let offline: Bool
}
```

- **States:** loading (layout-shaped skeletons, no spinner); first-run (provisional badges + first facts from S-12 re-surfaced); no-wearable (manual-mode hero: subjective check-in + phone steps); all-denied (education hero + fix path); stale >36 h (gentle "data paused" banner → S-02); past-date read-only (edit affordances hidden, "Back to today" chip); offline (cached banner; logging still works).
- **Actions:** primary — glance; tap ring → `route_pillar/<id>`; tap narrative "why →" → evidence (insight detail/anatomy). Secondary — Edit layout (S-21); date pager/calendar (S-22); long-press module → context menu (pin/hide/reorder/explain); pull-down → search sheet; pull-to-refresh → sync.
- **Subcomponents:** `DatePagerHeader` (§15.6), `ContextStrip` (status pills + weather chip, Bevel parity), `TripleRingHero` (distinct-from-Apple-rings semantics; one-word driver under each ring — v1 §17.2), `NarrativeCard` (One True Sentence + why), `HealthMonitorGrid` (6 `VitalsTile`s with vertical range pills + Normal/Higher/Lower chips), `MedsDueStrip`, `StressEnergyCard`, `NutritionSnapshotCard` (presence-based; never 0g/0g/0g), `TimelinePreviewList`, `WeeklyProgressChip`, `ProvisionalBadge`, `StalenessBanner`.
- **VM responsibilities:** combine module Flows with layout Flow (`combine(layout, presence, moduleContents)`); debounce recompositions; map `TodayEvent` → `NavigationEvent`; own pull-to-refresh orchestration (`ResyncCommand` + staged toast); record impression analytics once per date per session; enforce policy caps.
- **Event contract (`features/today/TodayEvent.kt`, mirrored as Swift enum):**

```kotlin
sealed interface TodayEvent {
    data class RingTapped(val pillar: PillarId) : TodayEvent            // → route_pillar
    data object WhyTapped : TodayEvent                                   // → narrative evidence route
    data class TileTapped(val metricId: MetricId) : TodayEvent           // → route_metric_detail
    data class ModuleAction(val id: TodayModuleId, val action: ModuleAction) : TodayEvent // PIN, HIDE, EXPLAIN, REORDER
    data class MedAction(val regimenId: Uuid, val action: TakeOrSkip) : TodayEvent        // inline take/skip, no navigation
    data class DateChanged(val date: DayKey) : TodayEvent
    data object EditRequested : TodayEvent ; data object CalendarRequested : TodayEvent
    data object RefreshRequested : TodayEvent ; data object StalenessFixRequested : TodayEvent // → route_sync_status
}
```
- **iOS files:** `Features/Today/TodayScreen.swift`, `TodayViewModel.swift`, `modules/TodayModule.swift`, `modules/TodayModuleRegistry.swift`, `components/TripleRingHero.swift`, `components/HealthMonitorGrid.swift`, `components/NarrativeCard.swift`, `components/ContextStrip.swift`.
- **Android files:** `features/today/TodayScreen.kt`, `TodayViewModel.kt`, `TodayUiState.kt`, `modules/TodayModule.kt`, `modules/TodayModuleRegistry.kt`, `components/TripleRingHero.kt`, `components/HealthMonitorGrid.kt`, `components/NarrativeCard.kt`, `components/ContextStrip.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_today` (tab root; `date?` param for widget/notification deep links); presents S-21 (sheet), S-22 (sheet); pushes pillars/metric details.
- **AE:** `today_viewed(source=organic|widget|notification, is_today)`, `today_module_tapped(module_id)`, `narrative_why_tapped`, `today_refreshed(result)`, `staleness_banner_shown`.
- **Tests:** (1) cold-start render <400 ms from cache with 5-module layout (perf harness, both platforms); (2) layout change in `customization_profiles` reorders modules without recreation (state preserved in untouched modules); (3) presence rules: wearable-only fixture hides nutrition module, shows no zeros; (4) >36 h stale fixture shows banner exactly once, links S-02; (5) manual-mode hero renders when CORE denied but app proceeds; (6) past-date mode hides edit/log affordances.
- **A11y:** rings expose value+driver as one label ("Readiness 62, short sleep"); grid tiles are buttons; narrative is the first element after the header in reading order (the contract in one swipe); all badges text-bearing.
- **RTL:** module order and ring order mirror; ring *progress direction* stays clockwise (convention); Arabic narrative from `core-phrasing` AR templates, never machine-flipped English.

**S-21 Edit Today (layout editor)**
- **Purpose:** Bevel Edit-Home parity+: drag/remove/add/reset + preset switcher + per-module size.

**S-22 Calendar sheet**
- **Purpose:** month grid with per-day tri-ring minis (Bevel parity) + year heat-map zoom (BADAN addition); the time portal from Today.
- **Archetypes:** Omar ("how was my week"), Ingrid (training blocks), all.
- **DD:** `GetCalendarMonthQuery(month)` → `DerivedValueRepository` (per-day score triple, batched single query per month); `GetCalendarYearQuery(year)` (heat values = readiness composite, precomputed in `derived_values` metric `recovery.score` day rows); availability window from `SampleRepository.firstSampleDate()`.
- **States:** month (default, current month, minis render progressively); year heat (pinch-out or segmented toggle); pre-history months (disabled cells before first data); loading (skeleton grid); legend sheet ((i) explains ring semantics + heat scale).
