### 16.4 Journey (time layer)

**S-30 Journey root**
- **Purpose:** container for the time axis — segmented: Timeline | Calendar | Reports | Experiments.
- **Archetypes:** Salim (record), Priya (review), Omar (digests).
- **DD:** segment persistence `customization_profiles('journey.segment')`; badge dots: unread digest from `GetDigestQuery(latest)`, running experiment count from `ListExperimentsQuery(state=RUNNING)`.
- **States:** per-segment (delegated); default segment = Timeline; deep link may select segment (`route_journey?segment=reports`).
- **Actions:** segment switch; search icon → global search scoped to events.
- **Subcomponents:** `JourneySegmentedBar`, hosted segment screens (S-31, S-22-embedded calendar, S-32/33 list, S-34).
- **VM:** `JourneyViewModel` — segment state + badges only; segments own their VMs.
- **iOS:** `Features/Journey/JourneyScreen.swift`, `JourneyViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/journey/JourneyScreen.kt`, `JourneyViewModel.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_journey` (tab root).
- **AE:** `journey_viewed(segment)`, `journey_segment_changed(segment)`.
- **Tests:** (1) segment persists across restarts; (2) deep-link segment selection; (3) unread digest dot clears on view.
- **A11y:** segments as tabs with selected state. **RTL:** segment order mirrors.

**S-31 Unified Timeline**
- **Purpose:** the anti-fragmentation spine (v1 §8.5): one chronological stream of all typed events, day-grouped, filterable, infinite back-scroll.
- **Archetypes:** Salim, Huda, Dmitri; casuals reach it via Today's Timeline preview.
- **DD:** `GetTimelineQuery(filters: Set<EventKind>, before: Instant, limit=50)` → `EventRecordRepository` + `SessionRepository` (paged union query in `core-db/queries/timeline.sq`; kinds: SLEEP, WORKOUT, MEAL, MED_TAKEN, SYMPTOM, NOTE, STATUS, LAB, SYNC); filter persistence `customization_profiles('timeline.filters')`.
- **States:** loaded (day headers + rows); filtered-empty ("no meds events in this range" + clear-filters); end-of-history (first-data marker card: "Your record begins here — March 2021"); loading-page (bottom skeleton rows); offline (full function — local data).
- **Actions:** primary — tap row → native detail (each kind's canonical route). Secondary — filter chips (multi-select); jump-to-date (calendar sheet); power: multi-select → bulk tag/delete (manual entries only) or "send to Correlation Lab" (`route` owned by §16.5+ writer / §22).
- **Subcomponents:** `TimelineDayHeader` (date + day-score micro-rings), `TimelineRow` (icon + title + key value + score/severity badge + time — the row grammar), `EventFilterChips`, `BulkSelectBar`, `HistoryStartCard`.
- **VM:** `TimelineViewModel` — paging state machine (key = `before` cursor); filter set; scroll-anchor restoration (`timeline.scroll_anchor`); bulk-selection mode with kind-aware capability checks (auto-ingested rows not deletable — provenance law).
- **iOS:** `Features/Journey/Timeline/TimelineScreen.swift`, `TimelineViewModel.swift`, `components/TimelineRow.swift`. **Android:** `features/journey/timeline/TimelineScreen.kt`, `TimelineViewModel.kt`, `TimelineUiState.kt`, `components/TimelineRow.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_timeline` (segment of `route_journey`; direct deep link with filter param — used by cross-pillar links).
- **AE:** `timeline_viewed`, `timeline_filter_applied(kinds_count)`, `timeline_event_opened(kind)`, `timeline_bulk_action(action, count_bucket)`.
- **Tests:** (1) 10k-event fixture scrolls at 60 fps with stable paging (no gaps/dupes across page boundaries — cursor property test); (2) filter chips compose (meds+symptoms only); (3) bulk delete blocked for ingested rows, allowed for manual; (4) scroll anchor survives process death; (5) row tap routes to each kind's canonical detail (table test over kinds).
- **A11y:** rows are single a11y elements with composed labels; day headers are section headings; filter state announced. **RTL:** row grammar mirrors (icon leading→trailing); times localized; badge position mirrors.

**S-32 Digest viewer (weekly/monthly)**
- **Purpose:** narrative + key charts + "what changed" table + next-period focus; the Omar surface.
- **Archetypes:** Omar, Rania (when a notification lands), Noor.
- **DD:** `GetDigestQuery(digestId)` → `InsightRepository` (digest = persisted composition: narrative blocks, chart specs, change table rows — generated by `core-insight` digest job, §22.9); verbosity setting `customization_profiles('digest.verbosity')`.
- **States:** loaded; generating (digest job not yet complete for period: honest "being prepared" + partial data); paywalled-depth (free: standard digest; Pro: deep variant — explained in-place, never obfuscated); past-archive list.
- **Actions:** primary — read; tap any chart/claim → underlying metric detail (every claim deep-links its evidence). Secondary — share-card (privacy-safe image, §38 owner), export PDF (`route_export_center?template=digest`), verbosity control.
- **Subcomponents:** `DigestNarrativeBlock`, `DigestChartCard` (renders chart spec via design-system chart kit), `WhatChangedTable` (metric, delta, direction — rolling-delta grammar), `NextFocusCard`, `DigestArchiveList`.
- **VM:** `DigestViewModel` — loads digest doc; resolves chart specs to queries lazily; share-card generation via `port-files`.
- **iOS:** `Features/Journey/Digest/DigestScreen.swift`, `DigestViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/journey/digest/DigestScreen.kt`, `DigestViewModel.kt`, `DigestUiState.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_digest/{digestId}` (from Journey segment, notification deep link, Today weekly chip).
- **AE:** `digest_viewed(kind=weekly|monthly, source)`, `digest_claim_opened`, `digest_shared(format)`, `digest_verbosity_changed(level)`.
- **Tests:** (1) every narrative claim in fixture digest has a resolvable evidence route (linter-style test); (2) generating state when job pending; (3) verbosity change re-renders without refetch; (4) share-card contains no values beyond user-approved template (privacy snapshot test).
- **A11y:** narrative first in reading order; tables linearized. **RTL:** AR digests generated natively by `core-phrasing`; charts keep LTR time axes with mirrored chrome.

**S-33 Year in Body (annual report)**
- **Purpose:** story-format annual report (v1 §22.9) — the accumulation-payoff surface (J16).
- **Archetypes:** everyone at year-end; Faisal and Priya deeply.
- **DD:** `GetAnnualReportQuery(year)` → `InsightRepository` (persisted composition from the annual job); eligibility: ≥90 days of data in year, else "partial year" variant.
- **States:** story mode (full-screen pages: totals, records, turning points, honest misses); partial-year; not-ready (before generation date, with countdown); archive (prior years).
- **Actions:** page through; share individual pages (privacy-reviewed templates); export full PDF; jump from any page to underlying metric detail.
- **Subcomponents:** `AnnualStoryPager`, `AnnualStatPage`, `AnnualRecordCard`, `ShareControls`.
- **VM:** `YearReportViewModel` — page state; per-page share rendering.
- **iOS:** `Features/Journey/YearReport/YearReportScreen.swift`, `YearReportViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/journey/yearreport/YearReportScreen.kt`, `YearReportViewModel.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_year_report/{year}` (Journey Reports segment; seasonal Today card).
- **AE:** `annual_report_viewed(year_offset)`, `annual_page_shared(page_kind)`.
- **Tests:** (1) partial-year fixture renders variant without fake totals; (2) share pages pass privacy snapshot; (3) archive lists exactly years meeting eligibility.
- **A11y:** story pages readable via buttons; stats have text equivalents. **RTL:** full mirror; AR typography reviewed (display sizes).

**S-34 Experiments list**
- **Purpose:** J5 home — define and track habit experiments with honest before/after comparison.
- **Archetypes:** Dmitri, Noor, Diego; casual entry via Coach suggestions.
- **DD:** `ListExperimentsQuery()` → `ExperimentRepository` (states DRAFT/RUNNING/ANALYZING/CONCLUDED); `CreateExperimentCommand(variable, window, hypothesis, targetMetricIds)`.
- **States:** list (running cards with day-progress, concluded with verdict chips); empty (explainer + 3 template experiments: earlier caffeine cutoff, consistent bedtime, alcohol-free block); create sheet (variable picker from loggable dictionaries + metric picker from registry).
- **Actions:** primary — open experiment; New experiment. Secondary — duplicate template; archive concluded.
- **Subcomponents:** `ExperimentCard` (variable, window, progress/verdict chip), `ExperimentTemplateRow`, `CreateExperimentSheet`.
- **VM:** `ExperimentsViewModel` — list + create validation (min window 7 days; max 3 concurrent — honesty guardrail from §22.8).
- **iOS:** `Features/Journey/Experiments/ExperimentsScreen.swift`, `ExperimentsViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/journey/experiments/ExperimentsScreen.kt`, `ExperimentsViewModel.kt`, `ExperimentsUiState.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_experiments` (Journey segment); create sheet inline.
- **AE:** `experiment_created(variable_kind, from_template)`, `experiments_viewed`.
- **Tests:** (1) concurrent-limit enforced with explanatory copy; (2) template creates prefilled draft; (3) create validation rejects <7-day window.
- **A11y:** progress conveyed as text ("day 6 of 14"). **RTL:** cards mirror.

**S-35 Experiment detail**
- **Purpose:** tracked comparison (before vs during) with confidence caveats and an honest verdict vocabulary ("suggestive," "no clear change").
- **Archetypes:** as S-34; Salim for symptom-linked experiments.
- **DD:** `GetExperimentQuery(id)` → `ExperimentRepository` + `GetExperimentComparisonQuery(id)` → `core-baseline` comparison calculator (per target metric: before-window vs during-window distributions, min-n gates, covariate warnings — e.g., "cycle phase differs across windows"); verdict text via `core-phrasing` honesty vocabulary templates.
- **States:** running (progress + interim "too early to say" — no interim verdicts before min-n); analyzing; concluded (verdict card + per-metric comparison rows); confounded (covariate warning banner: travel/sick status overlapped window); insufficient-data verdict.
- **Actions:** primary — read comparison; End early (with consequence note). Secondary — extend window; annotate; share to Coach ("ask about this experiment"); repeat experiment.
- **Subcomponents:** `VerdictCard` (vocabulary-constrained), `ComparisonRow` (metric, before→during, delta with CI phrase, mini distribution strips), `CovariateWarningBanner`, `ExperimentTimelineStrip` (window on a date axis with status overlays).
- **VM:** `ExperimentDetailViewModel` — comparison Flow; end/extend commands; guards verdict rendering behind min-n (never shows a naked p-value; phrases via linter-approved templates).
- **iOS:** `Features/Journey/Experiments/ExperimentDetailScreen.swift`, `ExperimentDetailViewModel.swift`. **Android:** `features/journey/experiments/ExperimentDetailScreen.kt`, `ExperimentDetailViewModel.kt`, `ExperimentDetailUiState.kt`.
- **Navigation:** `route_experiment/{experimentId}` (from S-34, Coach insight cards, timeline span markers).
- **AE:** `experiment_viewed(state)`, `experiment_concluded(verdict_class, duration_bucket)`, `experiment_extended`.
- **Tests:** (1) min-n fixture below threshold → "too early," no verdict; (2) overlapping Sick status → confounded banner; (3) verdict strings all pass `PhrasingLinter` (no causal claims); (4) end-early recomputes with shortened window and says so; (5) comparison math golden-file test against `core-testing/golden/experiments/`.
- **A11y:** verdict + caveat read as one statement; distribution strips have text summaries. **RTL:** comparison arrows mirror; date strip keeps LTR time axis with mirrored chrome.

### 16.5 Body screens (repository layer)

The Body tab is the repository made navigable: pillar dashboards → metric details → raw samples → export. Every screen in this subsection renders from local SQLDelight reads via `XxxQuery` use cases (see §47+ for module layout, §30 for entity rationale). No screen here may block on network; sync deltas arrive via repository `Flow`s. All screens satisfy the §16.9 state contract and are wrapped in the shared `StatefulContainer` (spec in §16.9).

**S-40 Body root (`BodyRootScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** single "your body's data" front door — active pillar cards, repository tools, inactive-module discovery. Unifies what Bevel splits across Fitness + Biology + All Categories.
- **Archetypes:** all; layout is presence-based so Rania sees 3 cards, Dmitri sees 10 + tools row.
- **Data:** `GetActivePillarsQuery()` (module activation from `customization_profiles`), `GetPillarSummariesQuery(date)` (one headline stat + sparkline per pillar, backed by `DerivedValueRepository.latestPerPillar()`), `SourceConnectionRepository.healthSummary()` (badge on Data Sources row).
- **States:** loading (pillar-card skeletons, fixed 2-col grid shape); empty impossible (Sleep/Recovery/Strain always present); denied (pillar cards render with "connect data" footers, not blanks); offline (cached, no banner — fully local); provisional (calibration badge on affected pillar cards).
- **Actions:** primary — tap pillar card → S-41…S-54; secondary — "Add more" collapsed row (inactive modules with live-preview activation, Bevel visibility-switch parity), tools rows → S-55/S-58/S-60/S-61.
- **Subcomponents:** `PillarCard` (icon, headline value, status word, 7d sparkline), `AddModulesRow`, `RepositoryToolsList` (All Metrics / Raw Data / Data Sources / Export).
- **ViewModel:** `BodyRootViewModel` — combines the three queries into `BodyRootUiState.Loaded(pillars, inactive, tools)`; listens to `ScoresRecomputed` domain event to refresh summaries.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Body/BodyRootScreen.swift`, `BodyRootViewModel.swift`, `components/PillarCard.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/body/BodyRootScreen.kt`, `BodyRootViewModel.kt`, `BodyRootUiState.kt`.
- **Nav:** tab root `body`; deep link `badan://body`.
- **Analytics:** `body_root_viewed`, `module_activation_started {module}`.
- **Tests:** (1) inactive module hidden from grid, present in Add-more row; (2) activating Cycle inserts card without restart; (3) pillar summary updates on `ScoresRecomputed`; (4) denied HealthKit → cards render with connect footers, zero crashes.
- **A11y:** pillar cards are single accessible elements ("Sleep, 7 hours 12 minutes, in your normal range"); grid reflows at XXL type to 1-col.
- **RTL:** grid mirrors; sparklines keep LTR time axis (§25.9 rule).

**S-41 Sleep pillar (`SleepPillarScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** L2 sleep dashboard per the pillar grammar (§8.3): hero → stats → narrative → tools → trends.
- **Archetypes:** Noor (primary), Rania (top third only), Dmitri (trends + drill-ins).
- **Data:** `GetPillarOverviewQuery("sleep", date)`; `SleepSessionRepository.forDate(date)` (stages, latency, continuity); `GetMetricSeriesQuery("sleep.bank_balance", P30D)` (Sleep Bank ledger); `GetSleepPlanQuery()` (wind-down/target-bedtime dial); `GetTrendRowsQuery(pillar="sleep")` (score, time asleep, REM, deep, HR dip, bank, sleep/wake times, latency, continuity — Bevel floor + continuity/social-jetlag); narrative via `GetNarrativeQuery(scope=Pillar("sleep"), date)`.
- **States:** loading; no-data-today ("no sleep recorded last night" + yesterday context + manual-add path); denied (sleep permission fix path); provisional (bank + score badged during calibration); offline (full function); gentle-mode (score hidden, weekly trend shown — anti-orthosomnia policy from §17.3).
- **Actions:** primary — tap trend row → S-56; tap ring → S-57 anatomy. Secondary — edit bedtime targets (dial), add manual sleep, toggle hypnogram (power).
- **Subcomponents:** `PillarHero` (ring + inner-landscape art), `StatCardRow`, `NarrativeCard`, `BedtimeClockDial` (24h dial, Bevel parity), `SleepBankCard` (surplus/deficit ledger area chart), `StageBars`, `TrendsList` (shared), `WeeklyDistributionStrip`.
- **ViewModel:** `SleepPillarViewModel` — merges 5 queries; exposes `SleepPillarUiState`; handles gentle-mode policy from `PresentationPolicy`.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Sleep/SleepPillarScreen.swift`, `SleepPillarViewModel.swift`, `components/BedtimeClockDial.swift`, `components/SleepBankCard.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/sleep/SleepPillarScreen.kt`, `SleepPillarViewModel.kt`, `SleepPillarUiState.kt`, `components/BedtimeClockDial.kt`.
- **Nav:** `body/sleep`; deep link `badan://pillar/sleep?date=YYYY-MM-DD`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"sleep"}`, `bedtime_target_changed`, `trend_row_opened {metric_family}`.
- **Tests:** (1) missing night renders no-data variant, not zeros; (2) gentle mode hides score everywhere on this screen incl. hero; (3) bank ledger matches `sleep.bank_balance` series golden fixture; (4) dial edit persists and reschedules wind-down notification via `NotificationDecisionEngine`.
- **A11y:** dial has slider-semantics alternative (+/− 15 min buttons); hypnogram has data-table alternative.
- **RTL:** dial numerals localized; clock remains clockwise (universal convention); trends chevrons mirrored.

**S-42 Recovery pillar (`RecoveryPillarScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** readiness dashboard with the BADAN-signature input-anatomy strip (why the number is what it is, on the pillar page itself).
- **Archetypes:** Ayesha, Mariam (cycle-aware bands), Karim (status-conditioned phrasing).
- **Data:** `GetPillarOverviewQuery("recovery", date)`; `GetScoreAnatomyQuery("recovery.score", date)` (input pulls for the mini-strip); `GetMetricSeriesQuery` for HRV/RHR stat cards with `BaselineRepository.bandFor(metricId, date)` deviation badges; `GetTrendRowsQuery(pillar="recovery")` (recovery, HRV, RHR, RR, SpO₂, temp — Bevel floor); `CyclePhaseQuery(date)` when module active (band annotation note).
- **States:** loading; provisional (calibration countdown "baseline ready in ~9 days"); denied; no-data-today (shows last-known + staleness note); status-conditioned (Sick/Injured intervals swap coaching template family — the Karim safeguard §23.9).
- **Actions:** primary — trend row → S-56; anatomy strip → S-57. Secondary — set status (→ S-83), toggle cycle overlay.
- **Subcomponents:** `PillarHero`, `DeviationStatCard` (value + badge "−14% vs baseline"), `InputAnatomyStrip` (mini contribution bars), `NarrativeCard`, `TrendsList`, `CycleBandNote`.
- **ViewModel:** `RecoveryPillarViewModel`; recomputes on `ScoresRecomputed`; passes `StatusInterval` context to phrasing selection.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Recovery/RecoveryPillarScreen.swift` + ViewModel + `components/InputAnatomyStrip.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/recovery/…` (same triple + component).
- **Nav:** `body/recovery`; `badan://pillar/recovery`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"recovery"}`, `anatomy_opened {score:"recovery"}`.
- **Tests:** (1) Sick status suppresses performance-critique phrasing (template-family assertion); (2) cycle-enabled user sees phase-conditioned band note, disabled user never does; (3) anatomy strip sums match `GetScoreAnatomyQuery` snapshot; (4) provisional badge shows exact remaining-days from `Baseline.coverage`.
- **A11y:** deviation badges read direction + magnitude in words ("14 percent below your baseline").
- **RTL:** contribution bars mirror (origin right); numerals per locale.

**S-43 Strain pillar (`StrainPillarScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** today's effort: strain ring, zone durations, activity list, target band.
- **Archetypes:** Lena, Ingrid, Omar (status word only).
- **Data:** `GetPillarOverviewQuery("strain", date)`; `GetZoneDurationsQuery(date)` (Zone 0–5 bar, Bevel floor); `WorkoutSessionRepository.forDate(date)`; `GetMetricSeriesQuery("strain.score", P30D)` with target band from `GetStrainTargetQuery()`.
- **States:** loading; empty (rest day — framed neutrally "recovery day", never "you did nothing"; muscular-load note if strength logged); denied (workout permission path); provisional.
- **Actions:** trend/activity rows → S-56 / workout detail; add workout (→ S-76); target band gear → strain goal setting.
- **Subcomponents:** `PillarHero`, `ZoneDurationBar`, `ActivityRowList`, `TargetStrainBandChart`, `NarrativeCard`.
- **ViewModel:** `StrainPillarViewModel`.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Strain/…` / `features/strain/…` per convention.
- **Nav:** `body/strain`; `badan://pillar/strain`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"strain"}`.
- **Tests:** (1) strength-only day contributes muscular channel, not zero strain; (2) zone bar durations sum to tracked active time fixture; (3) rest-day phrasing passes linter category `non-punitive`.
- **A11y/RTL:** zone bar has per-zone value labels on focus; band chart mirrors chrome only.

**S-44 Fitness pillar (`FitnessPillarScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** longitudinal training analysis — the Bevel Fitness tab, absorbed as a Body pillar with editable layout.
- **Archetypes:** Lena, Yusuf, Ingrid.
- **Data:** `GetActivityHeatmapQuery(P30D)`; `GetActivitySummaryQuery(period, typeFilter)` (current-vs-prior comparison); `GetMetricSeriesQuery("strain.performance_deviation", period)` (±10% band + Below/Within/Above breakdown table — Bevel parity); `GetCardioLoadQuery(period)` (acute/chronic envelope + status machine Calibrating/Detraining/Maintaining/Peaking/Overreaching); `GetCardioFocusQuery(period)` (Low Aerobic/High Aerobic/Anaerobic stacks); `GetMetricSeriesQuery("vitals.hrr_1min", period)`; `GetMuscleRadarQuery(metric=Volume|Frequency|Load, period)`; `GetStrengthProgressionQuery(exerciseId?)`; `WorkoutTemplateRepository.list()`.
- **States:** loading; empty-teaching per card (Bevel parity: "No workouts — create a template to start", each card owns its empty copy); provisional (Cardio Load shows Calibrating status, not fake numbers); status-conditioned (Injured status suppresses Detraining label → "training paused" neutral phrasing).
- **Actions:** card drill-ins → S-56 (each fitness metric is a registry instance); Edit layout (drag/remove/add/reset, Bevel per-tab edit parity); template row → S-77 flow.
- **Subcomponents:** `ActivityHeatCalendar` (dual mini-month), `ComparisonCard`, `StrainPerformanceCard` (+ `BreakdownTable`), `CardioLoadCard` (envelope chart + status chip), `CardioFocusCard`, `MuscleRadarCard` (metric switcher chips), `StrengthProgressionList`, `TemplateGallery`, `PillarLayoutEditor` (shared with Today's editor).
- **ViewModel:** `FitnessPillarViewModel` — card list driven by `customization_profiles.fitness_layout`; per-card independent `LoadState` so one slow query never blanks the page.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Fitness/FitnessPillarScreen.swift`, `FitnessPillarViewModel.swift`, `components/MuscleRadarCard.swift`, `components/CardioLoadCard.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/fitness/…` mirrors.
- **Nav:** `body/fitness`; `badan://pillar/fitness`; card anchors `badan://pillar/fitness#cardio_load`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"fitness"}`, `fitness_layout_edited`, `radar_metric_switched {metric}`.
- **Tests:** (1) Injured status never renders "Detraining"; (2) radar switcher preserves period; (3) layout edit round-trips through profile export/import; (4) per-card isolation: template query failure leaves other cards Loaded.
- **A11y:** radar has table alternative (muscle group × value); heatmap cells expose date + activity count.
- **RTL:** radar labels localized around the polygon; heatmap week orientation follows locale week-start.

**S-45 Nutrition pillar (`NutritionPillarScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** presence-based nutrition dashboard — shows whatever exists, invites the rest (anti-pattern guard vs Bevel's "log 776 kcal to unlock" gate, Law 3).
- **Archetypes:** Diego (full), Rania (module hidden until first log/source), Aziza (glucose module inline).
- **Data:** `GetDailyPlateQuery(date)` (kcal + macro rings, g/% toggle); `MyFoodsQuery()` (favorites/recipes/recents); `GetNutritionGoalsQuery()`; `GetMicronutrientMatrixQuery(date|P7D)` (dot-grid); `GetNetEnergyQuery(date)` (diverging consumed-vs-burned bar); `MealEntryRepository.forDate(date)` (meal timeline); `GetTrendRowsQuery(pillar="nutrition")` (nutrition score + visible-rubric link, macro balance); `GetGlucoseDayQuery(date)` when CGM present (thresholds via gear — Bevel 3.9/7.8 mmol/L defaults, editable).
- **States:** loading; **passive state** (no logs: energy-out context + single "log first meal" invite — never a 0g/0g/0g row); provisional (nutrition score needs N logged days; shows "score unlocks by data presence" copy, free-tier honest); paywalled (only depth layers — e.g., quality-score history — with real limited version visible, never scrambled); offline (logging fully functional).
- **Actions:** + on meal timeline → S-71; rings toggle g/%; glucose gear → threshold editor; rubric link → algorithm page (§27.5).
- **Subcomponents:** `PlateSummaryCard`, `MacroRings`, `MyFoodsRow`, `GoalsCard`, `MicronutrientDotMatrix`, `NetEnergyBar`, `MealTimeline`, `GlucoseStripCard`.
- **ViewModel:** `NutritionPillarViewModel`; observes `MealEntryRepository.changes()` for instant post-log refresh.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Nutrition/NutritionPillarScreen.swift` + ViewModel + `components/MicronutrientDotMatrix.swift`, `components/NetEnergyBar.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/nutrition/…` mirrors.
- **Nav:** `body/nutrition`; `badan://pillar/nutrition`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"nutrition"}`, `macro_view_toggled {mode}`, `glucose_thresholds_changed`.
- **Tests:** (1) zero-log day renders passive variant (assert no "0 g" strings); (2) meal logged offline appears in timeline <1 s; (3) unit profile mmol/L↔mg/dL renders correctly in strip + thresholds; (4) micronutrient matrix matches platform-standard set fixture.
- **A11y:** dot matrix has per-nutrient list alternative; rings labeled with grams and % both.
- **RTL:** diverging bar mirrors (consumed side flips); Arabic food names render in list primary position.

**S-46 Glucose pillar (`GlucosePillarScreen`)** *(module-gated)*
- **Purpose:** CGM day-view + derived trio + meal-response library; wellness-framed always.
- **Archetypes:** Aziza.
- **Data:** `GetGlucoseDayQuery(date)` (5-min series + gap segments); `GetOverlayEventsQuery(date, types=[meal,workout,sleep])`; `GetMetricSeriesQuery` for `glucose.morning_fasting`, `glucose.avg`, `glucose.variability`; `GetMealResponsesQuery(period)` (response cards: Δpeak, time-to-baseline); `SensorSessionRepository.current()` (session status, warm-up, gaps).
- **States:** loading; no-sensor (education + connect paths); sensor-gap honesty (compression-low artifacts flagged, gaps drawn as gaps — never interpolated silently, §37); provisional (derived trio needs calibration threshold days); denied.
- **Actions:** tap response card → meal detail; threshold gear; scrub day strip (haptic ticks).
- **Subcomponents:** `GlucoseDayStrip` (threshold lines + overlay markers), `DerivedTrioCards`, `MealResponseLibrary`, `SensorStatusCard`.
- **ViewModel:** `GlucosePillarViewModel`.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Glucose/…` / `features/glucose/…`.
- **Nav:** `body/glucose`; `badan://pillar/glucose`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"glucose"}`, `meal_response_opened`.
- **Tests:** (1) artifact-flagged lows excluded from variability calc (golden fixture); (2) gap rendering never interpolates; (3) unit override respected in every number incl. response cards; (4) zero dosing/diagnosis strings pass phrasing linter.
- **A11y:** day strip scrub announces time + value; threshold crossings listed textually.
- **RTL:** strip time axis LTR; card chrome mirrored.

**S-47 Cycle pillar (`CyclePillarScreen`)** *(module-gated, sensitive class)*
- **Purpose:** phase wheel + phase-conditioned expectations; the covariate made visible.
- **Archetypes:** Mariam.
- **Data:** `CyclePhaseQuery(date)` (phase, day, prediction confidence); `GetPhaseExpectationsQuery()` ("HRV typically dips ~8% for you in luteal" — from phase-conditioned baselines); `CycleLogRepository.recent()`; `GetMetricSeriesQuery("cycle.length", P1Y)`.
- **States:** loading; insufficient-history (wheel shows logged days, no predictions, honest confidence); module-off (unreachable — nav guard); provisional.
- **Actions:** log period/flow/symptoms strip (→ S-78 pre-filtered); toggle phase overlay for other charts (writes chart-annotation default); privacy link → S-101 sensitive-class section.
- **Subcomponents:** `PhaseWheel` (confidence-shaded prediction arc), `ExpectationsCard`, `CycleLogStrip`, `HistoryRows`.
- **ViewModel:** `CyclePillarViewModel`; all reads via sensitive-class storage path (§28.7), never included in cloud AI context by default.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Cycle/…` / `features/cycle/…`.
- **Nav:** `body/cycle`; `badan://pillar/cycle` (link suppressed from share-cards).
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"cycle"}` — no phase/day properties ever (analytics rule §3 conventions).
- **Tests:** (1) cycle data absent from cloud-AI context payload fixture; (2) prediction arc hidden under min-history; (3) module disable removes all cycle UI incl. overlays elsewhere; (4) export requires sensitive-class confirmation toggle.
- **A11y:** wheel has linear list alternative (phase, day range, confidence).
- **RTL:** wheel labels localized; rotation direction unchanged.

**S-48 Biology pillar (`BiologyPillarScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** long-horizon biology home: curated biomarkers, Bio Age (honest free tier), lab timeline, result entry. Bevel parity minus the particle-scramble tease (Law 1 / §2.4).
- **Archetypes:** Faisal (primary), Priya (export-adjacent), Huda (labs from checkups).
- **Data:** `GetCuratedBiomarkersQuery()` (user-curated list, default: weight, HRV baseline, RHR baseline, body fat %, lean mass, VO₂ Max — Bevel's observed default set) each row = status word + value + sparkline via `GetMetricSeriesQuery(biomarkerId, P1Y)`; `GetBioAgeQuery()` → `BioAgeResult(band, drivers[], fullModel?)` where `fullModel` is entitlement-gated; `LabResultRepository.timeline(period)`; `GetBiomarkerCoverageQuery()` (how many of 390+ have data — fuels the registry link copy "12 of 390 tracked").
- **States:** loading; empty (no labs yet: education card "3 ways to add results" — manual, PDF import, connected sources); Bio Age states: `Ineligible(under18)`, `InsufficientInputs(missing[])`, `FreeBand(band, topDrivers)`, `Full(value, ci, decomposition)` — free band is a *real* coarse output with named drivers, never obfuscated; paywalled (Full model card shows band + "unlock full model + decomposition" with honest ✓/✗ delta); provisional (drivers based on <60d data badged).
- **Actions:** primary — biomarker row → S-56 (lab-family chart resolution); Bio Age card → decomposition (Pro) or explainer (free); "Add result" CTA → S-81 lab-entry variant / PDF import flow. Secondary — Edit curation (add/remove/reorder from registry, Bevel parity), full registry link → S-49.
- **Subcomponents:** `BioAgeCard` (tick-dial with chronological-age anchor — Bevel dial adopted; free renders band segment, Pro renders needle + CI), `CuratedBiomarkerList` (+ `EditCurationSheet`), `LabTimelineStrip` (panel dates as nodes), `AddResultCTA`, `CoverageChip`.
- **ViewModel:** `BiologyPillarViewModel` — merges 4 queries; entitlement from `FeatureFlagService.entitlement("bioage_full")`; emits `BiologyUiState.Loaded(bioAge: BioAgeCardState, curated, timeline, coverage)`.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Biology/BiologyPillarScreen.swift`, `BiologyPillarViewModel.swift`, `components/BioAgeCard.swift`, `components/CuratedBiomarkerList.swift`, `components/LabTimelineStrip.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/biology/BiologyPillarScreen.kt`, `BiologyPillarViewModel.kt`, `BiologyUiState.kt`, `components/BioAgeCard.kt`.
- **Nav:** `body/biology`; deep links `badan://pillar/biology`, `badan://bioage`.
- **Analytics:** `pillar_viewed {pillar:"biology"}`, `bioage_card_viewed {tier: free_band|full|ineligible}`, `biomarker_curation_edited`, `lab_entry_started {method: manual|pdf}`.
- **Tests:** (1) free tier renders real band + ≥2 named drivers (no scramble assets exist in repo); (2) under-18 profile hides Bio Age entirely; (3) curation edit persists + syncs; (4) single-lab-result biomarker rows show value + reference range, no fake sparkline; (5) paywall card passes §16.9 paywalled contract (explains free vs Pro concretely).

- **RTL:** dial ticks unchanged; A-Z concepts localized (Arabic collation in curated list per locale).

**S-50 Medications hub (`MedicationsHubScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** medication repository + non-punitive adherence overview; states its own boundary ("BADAN records, never advises on dosing").

- **Actions:** primary — regimen row → S-51; take/skip from due strip (→ S-79 inline). Secondary — add medication (wizard: name via localized ingredient list + free-form, strength, form, route, schedule incl. PRN/cycling/taper), retire medication, reminders settings link.
- **Subcomponents:** `DueStrip`, `RegimenCard` (next-due countdown, schedule summary), `AdherenceWeekStrip`, `BoundaryFooter` (the no-advice statement), `AddMedicationWizard`.

**S-51 Medication detail (`MedicationDetailScreen`)** — *priority depth*

**S-52 Symptoms hub (`SymptomsHubScreen`)** / **S-53 Symptom detail (`SymptomDetailScreen`)**

**S-56 Universal metric detail (`MetricDetailScreen`)** — *priority depth; the ~300-instance template*
- **Purpose:** one learnable grammar for every metric (Bevel's strongest observed pattern, §6.2, extended to labs/meds/symptoms per §8.4). Instantiated by `metricId` from the registry — there is exactly one implementation; adding a metric never adds a screen.
- **Archetypes:** all; casual sees header + status + chart; power sees everything default-open.
- **Data:** `MetricRegistry.definition(metricId)` (name, unit variants, chart family, education refs, decimals, sensitivity class); `GetMetricSeriesQuery(metricId, period)`; `BaselineRepository.bandFor(metricId, date)` (personal normal band + status word); `GetRollingDeltasQuery(metricId, windows=[3,7,14,30,90])` (Trends Analysis table, "based on 7-day rolling averages" — Bevel parity); `GetAnnotationsQuery(metricId, period)` (statuses, regimen changes, cycle phases, experiments — toggleable layers); `GetScoreAnatomyQuery(metricId, date)` when metric is a composite; `GetRelatedInsightsQuery(metricId)`; `GetEducationCardsQuery(metricId)` (Resources section + definition footer from content CMS); `GetSiblingMetricsQuery(metricId)` (horizontally scrollable metric-switcher chips, Bevel parity).
- **Component breakdown (top→bottom):**
  1. `MetricHeader` — big value + unit + date, delta-vs-baseline badge, provenance chip (tap → S-59 for the underlying sample(s)).
  2. `StatusBand` — status word vs personal range ("Above normal · 74.0–82.2 bpm", Bevel parity); cycle-conditioned band note when applicable; provisional badge with countdown.
  3. `MetricSwitcherChips` — sibling metrics in the same family, horizontal scroll.
  4. `ChartArea` — chart type resolved per metric family (table below), personal-average dotted line, band shading, `AnnotationLayer` (toggle chip row: Statuses / Meds / Cycle / Experiments — power default on, casual default off), scrub with haptic ticks + value callout.
  5. `PeriodSelector` — `7D | 30D | 3M | 6M | 1Y | All` + calendar icon + paging chevrons (§15.2 single grammar).
  6. `TrendsTable` — 3/7/14/30/90-day rolling deltas, mini sparklines, directional coloring, effect-size "meaningful change" flag (§22.4).
  7. `AnatomySection` — for composites: input contribution bars + "open full anatomy" → S-57; for raw metrics: source/method note ("HRV: RMSSD from raw beats, entire-sleep window — change in Calculations").
  8. `ResourcesSection` — education cards.
  9. `DefinitionFooter` — plain-language physiology note at Bevel's observed specificity bar (e.g., wrist-temp sampling cadence + core offset).
  10. `ActionsBar` — pin · export-this-slice (→ S-61 pre-scoped) · ask Coach about this (→ S-91 seeded) · set goal (where goalable).
- **Chart-type resolution (registry `chart_family` field):**

| Metric family | Chart | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| vitals.* (HRV, RHR, RR, SpO₂, temp) | band-line | personal band + dotted average |
| sleep stages, cardio focus | stacked bars | per-day composition |
| sleep.bank_balance | ledger area | zero-line surplus/deficit |
| nutrition.net_energy | diverging bar | consumed vs burned |
| symptoms.* | event-frequency | dots/bars per episode, severity color |
| meds.adherence_rate | adherence strip | calendar strip, non-punitive palette |
| biology.* (labs) | point-with-reference-range | sparse points; single point = value + range, **no fake trend line** |
| glucose day view | continuous strip | gaps rendered as gaps |
| scores (recovery/sleep/strain) | band-line + ring header | anatomy section active |

- **States:** loading (skeleton mirrors final layout incl. chart shape); no-data (education + concrete how-to-get-data paths per source capability map); single-point (labs rule above); denied-source (permission fix path naming the OS toggle); provisional (badge + wobble copy, Law 2); offline (cached series + banner-free); paywalled (only depth layers — e.g., >1Y horizons or anatomy weights per packaging §39 — with the free rendering fully honest); error (retry + support id).
- **ViewModel responsibilities:** resolve definition → dispatch queries → fold into state; own period + annotation-toggle persistence (per-chart override remembered, §19.2); debounce scrub reads; emit analytics.

```kotlin
// android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/metricdetail/MetricDetailUiState.kt
sealed interface MetricDetailUiState {
    data object Loading : MetricDetailUiState

    data class Loaded(
        val definition: MetricDefinition,            // from MetricRegistry
        val headline: HeadlineValue,                 // value, unit, date, deltaVsBaseline, provenanceChip
        val statusBand: StatusBand?,                 // status word + personal range + conditioning note
        val siblings: List<MetricChipRef>,
        val chart: ChartSpec,                        // family, series, band, annotations, scrubState
        val period: Period,                          // P7D, P30D, P3M, P6M, P1Y, ALL
        val annotationLayers: Set<AnnotationLayer>,  // STATUSES, MEDS, CYCLE, EXPERIMENTS
        val trendsTable: List<RollingDeltaRow>,      // 3/7/14/30/90d + meaningfulChange flag
        val anatomy: AnatomySection,                 // None | Composite(inputs) | RawMethodNote(text)
        val resources: List<EducationCardRef>,
        val definitionFooter: LocalizedText,
        val quality: QualityFlags,
        val isProvisional: Boolean,
        val gate: DepthGate,                         // None | ProLayer(feature, freeAlternativeShown)
    ) : MetricDetailUiState

    data class Empty(val reason: EmptyReason, val feedPaths: List<FeedPath>) : MetricDetailUiState
    data class SinglePoint(val value: HeadlineValue, val referenceRange: Range?) : MetricDetailUiState
    data class Denied(val permission: PermissionKind, val fixPath: OsSettingsRoute) : MetricDetailUiState
    data class Error(val error: AppError) : MetricDetailUiState
}
```

```swift
// ios/BadanApp/Features/MetricDetail/MetricDetailViewModel.swift
enum MetricDetailUiState {
    case loading
    case loaded(Loaded)
    case empty(reason: EmptyReason, feedPaths: [FeedPath])
    case singlePoint(value: HeadlineValue, referenceRange: Range?)
    case denied(permission: PermissionKind, fixPath: OsSettingsRoute)
    case error(AppError)

    struct Loaded {
        let definition: MetricDefinition
        let headline: HeadlineValue
        let statusBand: StatusBand?
        let siblings: [MetricChipRef]
        let chart: ChartSpec
        let period: Period
        let annotationLayers: Set<AnnotationLayer>
        let trendsTable: [RollingDeltaRow]
        let anatomy: AnatomySection
        let resources: [EducationCardRef]
        let definitionFooter: LocalizedText
        let quality: QualityFlags
        let isProvisional: Bool
        let gate: DepthGate
    }
}

@Observable final class MetricDetailViewModel { /* mirrors Android responsibilities via shared KMP queries */ }
```

- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/metricdetail/MetricDetailScreen.kt`, `MetricDetailViewModel.kt`, `MetricDetailUiState.kt`, `components/` (same nine, `.kt`).
- **Nav:** sheet-first (quick look) with swipe-up to full push (§15.1); route `metric/{metricId}?date=&period=`; deep link `badan://metric/{metricId}?date=…` — the target of every widget/notification metric citation.
- **Analytics:** `metric_detail_viewed {metric_family, entry_point, depth_mode}`, `metric_period_changed {period}`, `annotation_layer_toggled {layer, on}`, `metric_pinned`, `export_slice_started {metric_family}` — never metric values.
- **Tests:** (1) chart-family conformance: every registry entry resolves to a renderer (CI test iterates all ~300 ids, zero fallbacks-to-line); (2) single lab point renders no trend line; (3) period control state survives process death; (4) annotation toggle default differs by depth policy and per-chart override persists; (5) denied state names the exact OS settings path per platform; (6) paywalled >1Y horizon shows real 1Y data + honest gate copy (no obfuscation assets).

**S-57 Score Anatomy sheet (`ScoreAnatomySheet`)**
- **Purpose:** the anti-churn "why" surface (J3): inputs, weights, quality, versioning.
- **Archetypes:** all (casual gets words, power gets numbers — same sheet, policy-rendered).
- **Data:** `GetScoreAnatomyQuery(scoreId, date)` → stored per-day input snapshot (§22.5): inputs with direction/weight/contribution, data-quality row, algorithm version; `GetAlgorithmChangelogQuery(scoreId)`; perceived-gap history ("you often feel better than this score after short-but-deep sleep").
- **States:** loading; provisional (weights shown with calibration caveat); error; no-anatomy (raw metrics route to method note instead — guard at call site).
- **Actions:** input row → that metric's S-56; "what would move this" bullets; "ask Coach about this" → S-91 seeded; changelog link; "doesn't match how I feel" → perceived-gap log (§18.4).
- **Subcomponents:** `ContributionBarList`, `QualityRow`, `VersionFooter`, `PerceivedGapNote`, `MoveThisList`.
- **ViewModel:** `ScoreAnatomyViewModel`.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/MetricDetail/ScoreAnatomySheet.swift` / `features/metricdetail/ScoreAnatomySheet.kt` (+ VM).
- **Nav:** sheet over any score context; `badan://anatomy/{scoreId}?date=…`.
- **Analytics:** `anatomy_opened {score, entry_point}`, `perceived_gap_logged {score}`.

**S-61 Export Center (`ExportCenterScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** the flagship trust feature's cockpit (§20): format cards, scope pickers, templates, history, schedules.
- **Archetypes:** Priya, Dmitri, Sven (local-only delivery), Salim/Huda (physician PDF), any deletion flow (export-first offer S-104).
- **Data:** `GetExportFormatsQuery()` (CSV/JSON/SQLite/PDF/Archive; Parquet behind `ff_export_parquet`; per-format size estimate via `ExportEngine.estimate(spec)`); `GetExportTemplatesQuery()` ("Physician visit", "Full archive", "Sleep study self-report", "Training block", "Custom"); `ExportJobRepository.history()` (past artifacts: spec summary, size, checksum, expiry); `GetScheduledExportsQuery()` (Pro, `ff_export_scheduled`); scope pickers backed by `MetricRegistry` (metric/collection/pillar/all), date presets, `SourceConnectionRepository` (include/exclude + include-suppressed toggle), unit profile, display language.
- **Job state machine (`core-export/ExportJob.kt`):**

```kotlin
sealed interface ExportJobState {
    data class Draft(val spec: ExportJobSpec) : ExportJobState            // scope being edited
    data object Queued : ExportJobState                                    // persisted to export_jobs
    data class Preparing(val resolvedRowCounts: Map<MetricId, Long>) : ExportJobState
    data class Generating(val progress: Float, val currentMetric: MetricId?) : ExportJobState
    data class Packaging(val checksumsDone: Int, val total: Int) : ExportJobState // manifest + dictionary + zip
    data class Ready(val artifact: ExportArtifact) : ExportJobState        // share sheet / save target
    data class Delivered(val destination: DeliveryTarget) : ExportJobState // Files/Drive/iCloud/share
    data class Failed(val error: ExportError, val retryable: Boolean, val partialArtifact: ExportArtifact?) : ExportJobState
    data object Cancelled : ExportJobState
    data object Expired : ExportJobState                                   // artifact cleaned up post-retention
}
// Legal transitions: Draft→Queued→Preparing→Generating→Packaging→Ready→Delivered|Expired;
// any active state →Failed|Cancelled; Failed(retryable)→Queued. Scheduled exports are cron
// specs in scheduled_exports that spawn Queued instances; jobs survive process death (WorkManager /
// BGProcessingTask resume from last completed metric file).
```

- **States (screen):** loading; empty history (first-export invitation with template shortcuts); job-running (progress card with per-metric progress, cancellable; Live Activity / ongoing notification for large jobs §24.3); job-failed (error + retry + partial-artifact salvage offer); paywalled (scheduled exports + Parquet only; one-off exports of everything are **free forever** — Law 1, positioning pillar 1); offline (generation fully local; cloud delivery targets queue until online); sensitive-class gate (cycle data inclusion requires extra confirmation toggle §20.9).
- **Actions:** primary — pick template or build custom spec → `ExportEngine.enqueue(ExportJobSpec)`. Secondary — re-run past job ("same spec, new range"); share/save artifact; verify checksum; manage schedules; open data dictionary.
- **Subcomponents:** `FormatCardRow` (size estimates), `ScopePicker` (4-step: metrics/date/sources/options), `TemplateGallery`, `JobProgressCard`, `ExportHistoryList` (checksum + "verify" affordance), `SchedulesSection`, `SensitiveClassGate`.
- **ViewModel:** `ExportCenterViewModel` — spec builder state machine (Draft editing); observes `ExportJobRepository.activeJobs()`; fires `ExportCompleted` system notification through decision engine (transactional class).
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Export/ExportCenterScreen.swift`, `ExportCenterViewModel.swift`, `components/ScopePicker.swift`, `components/JobProgressCard.swift`, `components/FormatCardRow.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/export/ExportCenterScreen.kt`, `ExportCenterViewModel.kt`, `ExportUiState.kt`, `components/` mirrors.
- **Nav:** `body/export`; deep links `badan://export`, `badan://export?template=physician&scope=regimen:{id}` (from S-51), `badan://export?scope=slice:{metricId}:{range}` (from S-58/S-56).
- **Analytics:** `export_started {format, scope_kind, template}`, `export_completed {format, duration_bucket, size_bucket}`, `export_failed {error_class, retryable}`, `export_scheduled {cadence}` — never metric contents.
- **Tests:** (1) job resumes after process kill from last completed metric file; (2) manifest row counts match emitted rows (truncation detectability §20.5); (3) cancelled job cleans temp files; (4) cycle data excluded unless sensitive gate toggled, verified in artifact fixture; (5) free tier can export full archive with zero entitlement checks in the raw path (architectural test: storage layer has no entitlement import); (6) checksum verify detects a corrupted artifact fixture.
- **A11y:** progress announced at 25% increments; scope picker steps are headings.
- **RTL:** step order mirrors; exported display columns honor chosen language while ids stay stable (§19.6).

### 16.6 Log flows (the + hub)

All log flows share contracts from §21.1: repeat case ≤3 interactions, retro-logging via backdate picker on every flow, full offline function (writes queue to `sync_oplog`), every entry editable/deletable with audit trail, write-back toggles honored (§11.5). Every flow opens as a sheet from the Log tab-FAB, dismisses to the invoking context, and emits its domain event (`MealLogged`, `SymptomLogged`, …) so hosting screens refresh reactively. Shared components: `BackdatePicker`, `SaveBar` (save + save-and-add-another), `OfflineQueueBadge`.

**S-70 Log hub (`LogHubScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** global logging front door; opens <300 ms; one-handed reach grid.
- **Archetypes:** all logging users; Rania never needs it (Law 3).
- **Data:** `GetLogRecentsQuery(limit=4)` (per-user recents row — most-used log types + most-recent entities: "Log Metformin", "Coffee 250ml"); static grid of enabled log types (module-gated: no food tile when Nutrition hidden).
- **States:** default; long-press Log tab = recents radial shortcut (S-01 parity, skips this screen).
- **Actions:** tile → S-71…S-83; recents chips → prefilled flows.
- **Subcomponents:** `RecentsRow`, `LogTypeGrid`.
- **ViewModel:** `LogHubViewModel` (recents ranked by frequency×recency).
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Log/LogHubScreen.swift` / `features/log/LogHubScreen.kt`.
- **Nav:** `log`; `badan://log`; per-type deep links `badan://log/{food|water|workout|symptom|med|mood|measurement|note|status}`.
- **Analytics:** `log_hub_opened {source: tab|longpress|deeplink}`, `log_type_selected {type}`.
- **Tests:** (1) cold-open <300 ms perf test; (2) module-hidden types absent; (3) recents chip prefills correct entity.
- **A11y:** grid tiles ≥48 dp, labeled with type + hint.
- **RTL:** grid mirrors; recents scroll direction flips.

**S-71 Food search/entry (`FoodLogScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** search-first food logging with all four Bevel-parity pathways reachable from one screen: search field (verified-first ranking, regional DBs), barcode button, photo button, describe field (§21.2).
- **Archetypes:** Diego (primary), Kenji (regional DBs), Omar (occasional).
- **Data:** `SearchFoodQuery(text, locale)` → ranked `FoodItem`s (verified badge, brand, per-100g/serving); `MyFoodsQuery()` (favorites/recents/meals tabs — "my usual breakfast" one-tap); `GetPortionUnitsQuery(foodId)` (density-aware conversions); `GetMealSlotSuggestionQuery(time)` (meal assignment default by time-of-day).
- **States:** search-empty (recents + favorites fill the void — never blank); no-results (create-custom-food path + describe suggestion); offline (local DB subset + custom foods work; remote DB results marked unavailable); provisional (AI-parsed items carry ± portion ranges, §21.2 quality honesty).
- **Actions:** primary — select item → portion stepper (unit picker + quick fractions) → meal assignment → save (`LogMealCommand(items, mealType, time, method)`). Secondary — star favorite; barcode → S-73; photo → S-72; describe (free text/voice → `ParseFoodTextCommand` — fast model for simple, capable for complex); quick-calories fallback (kcal-only honest low-detail entry); recipe → S-74.
- **Subcomponents:** `FoodSearchBar` (with barcode/photo/describe affordances), `VerifiedResultRow`, `MyFoodsTabs`, `PortionStepper` (unit-guarded), `MealSlotPicker`, `SaveBar`.
- **ViewModel:** `FoodLogViewModel` — debounced search (150 ms), draft `MealEntry` accumulation (multi-item meals), method stamped into provenance (`method: search|barcode|photo_ai|describe|favorite`).
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/FoodLog/FoodLogScreen.swift`, `FoodLogViewModel.swift`, `components/PortionStepper.swift`, `components/MyFoodsTabs.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/foodlog/FoodLogScreen.kt`, `FoodLogViewModel.kt`, `FoodLogUiState.kt`, `components/` mirrors.
- **Nav:** `log/food`; `badan://log/food?meal=breakfast`; entry from S-45 meal timeline +.
- **Analytics:** `meal_logged {method, item_count, meal_type, is_retro}` — never food names/kcal.
- **Tests:** (1) repeat log of favorite ≤3 interactions (UI test counts taps); (2) verified entries rank above unverified same-name; (3) offline log queues and syncs with correct timestamps; (4) Arabic search matches Arabic + transliterated names; (5) quick-calories entry flagged low-detail in data model.

- **RTL:** full mirror; numerals localized; mixed-script food names bidi-isolated.

**S-72 Photo-AI review (`PhotoAiReviewScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** the correction-loop UX for photo-detected meals: confirm, correct, teach. Corrections are the personal-alias flywheel (§21.2).
- **Archetypes:** Diego, Omar (lowest-friction pathway).
- **Data:** `ParseFoodPhotoCommand(imageRef)` → `PhotoParseResult(items: [CandidateItem(foodMatch, confidence, portionEstimate ± range, bbox)])` via ai-gateway (cloud Tier 1, on-device fallback for simple items later — §23.4); `FoodAliasRepository.matches(candidates)` (personal aliases pre-applied and badged "your usual").
- **Correction loop UX:** each candidate renders as a card: photo crop + name + confidence chip (High/Med/Low, color + word) + portion slider (± range visualized as slider track shading). Tap name → inline search to replace (S-71 search embedded); swipe to remove; "add missed item" appends manual search. **Every correction (replace/rename/portion-change) is written on save via `FoodAliasRepository.upsert(PersonalAlias(userLabel|visualSignature, resolvedFoodId, portionDefault))` — local-only storage, applied at next parse before display, improving future parses without any cloud training (§23.5).**
- **States:** parsing (photo + shimmer over detected regions, cancellable); low-confidence-all ("not sure — want to describe it instead?" pivot); parse-failed (offline or model error: keep photo attached, offer search/describe path, photo retained for retry); partial (some items resolved, others unmatched → search chips).
- **Actions:** primary — confirm all → `LogMealCommand` (method=`photo_ai`, per-item confidence stored). Secondary — correct any card; retake; switch to describe.
- **Subcomponents:** `CandidateItemCard` (confidence chip + portion slider), `PhotoCropHeader`, `AliasBadge`, `AddMissedItemChip`, `SaveBar`.
- **ViewModel:** `PhotoAiReviewViewModel` — holds `PhotoParseResult` draft; diffs saved state vs parse to compute alias writes; emits `photo_ai_corrected` analytics per correction type.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/FoodLog/PhotoAiReviewScreen.swift`, `PhotoAiReviewViewModel.swift`, `components/CandidateItemCard.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/foodlog/PhotoAiReviewScreen.kt`, `PhotoAiReviewViewModel.kt`, `PhotoAiUiState.kt`, `components/CandidateItemCard.kt`.
- **Nav:** pushed from S-71 photo affordance; `badan://log/food/photo`.
- **Analytics:** `photo_ai_reviewed {item_count, corrections_count, all_confirmed}`, `photo_ai_corrected {kind: replace|portion|remove|add}`, `food_alias_created` — no food identities.
- **Tests:** (1) correction produces alias row and next parse of same label pre-resolves (round-trip test with fake ai-gateway); (2) parse failure retains photo + pivots gracefully; (3) portion ± range persisted onto `MealEntry.confidence`; (4) aliases never leave device (network payload fixture assert); (5) feature-flag `ff_nutrition_photo_ai` off hides photo affordance everywhere.
- **A11y:** candidate cards fully labeled ("Detected: flatbread, medium confidence, portion 80 grams, adjustable"); photo regions get descriptions.
- **RTL:** cards mirror; slider direction flips with value semantics preserved.

**S-77 Strength logger (`StrengthSessionScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** the Strength Builder parity+ session runner (§21.3): template start → per-set logging → finish summary → write-back. Must beat "clunky logging >3 taps per set" (Yusuf's danger).
- **Archetypes:** Yusuf (primary), Lena.
- **Data:** `WorkoutTemplateRepository.list()/byId(id)`; `ExerciseRepository.search(muscleGroupFilter)` (canonical + custom, muscle-group mapped); `GetLastSessionSetsQuery(exerciseId)` (pre-fills weight/reps from last time — the ≤3-interaction repeat case); `GetPlateMathQuery(targetWeight, barType, availablePlates)`; session persistence in `strength_sessions` draft table (crash-safe).
- **Session state machine (`features/strength/StrengthSessionMachine.kt`, shared logic in `core-model`):**

```kotlin
sealed interface StrengthSessionState {
    data object Idle : StrengthSessionState                       // template gallery / empty start
    data class TemplateSelected(val template: WorkoutTemplate) : StrengthSessionState
    data class Active(
        val exerciseIndex: Int,
        val phase: SetPhase,                                      // Entering | Resting(remaining) | Reviewing
        val loggedSets: List<LoggedSet>,                          // weight, reps, rpe?, isWarmup
        val supersetGroup: SupersetGroup?,                        // rotates exercises within group
    ) : StrengthSessionState
    data class Swapping(val fromExerciseId: ExerciseId) : StrengthSessionState  // mid-session swap (Bevel Live-Sync parity)
    data class Paused(val since: Instant) : StrengthSessionState  // app background / interruption
    data class Finished(val summary: SessionSummary) : StrengthSessionState     // volume, e1RM changes, PRs
    data class WriteBackPending(val summary: SessionSummary) : StrengthSessionState // HK/HC workout write queued
    data object Completed : StrengthSessionState
    data class Abandoned(val recoverable: Boolean) : StrengthSessionState       // crash-restore offer on relaunch
}
// Transitions: Idle→TemplateSelected→Active; Active⇄Swapping; Active⇄Paused (auto on background);
// Active(Resting) auto-advances on timer or tap; Active→Finished (explicit finish or all sets done);
// Finished→WriteBackPending→Completed; any→Abandoned(recoverable=true) on crash, draft restored on next launch.
```

- **Per-set interaction contract:** weight/reps steppers pre-filled from last session → one tap "log set" starts rest timer (haptic at end; timer runs in Live Activity / ongoing notification when backgrounded). RPE optional chip row. Plate-math popover on weight long-press. Superset grouping rotates the entry card automatically.
- **States (screen):** loading; empty templates (Bevel-parity teaching empty: "create a template to start"); active (the runner); resting (countdown prominent, next-set preview); interrupted-restore banner; finished summary (volume by muscle group, e1RM deltas, PR badges — celebratory only if user opted into celebrations §2.2); write-back failed (retry queue, session data safe).
- **Actions:** primary — log set. Secondary — swap exercise, add set/exercise, edit past set, skip rest, finish early, discard (double-confirm).
- **Subcomponents:** `SetEntryCard` (steppers + RPE chips), `RestTimerBar`, `PlateMathPopover`, `SupersetIndicator`, `SessionSummarySheet`, `TemplateGallery`, `ExerciseSwapSheet`.
- **ViewModel:** `StrengthSessionViewModel` — owns the state machine; persists every transition to draft table (crash-safety invariant: no logged set may ever be lost); on finish emits `WorkoutSessionAssembled` → strain muscular channel + write-back per toggles.
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Strength/StrengthSessionScreen.swift`, `StrengthSessionViewModel.swift`, `components/SetEntryCard.swift`, `components/RestTimerBar.swift`, `components/PlateMathPopover.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/strength/StrengthSessionScreen.kt`, `StrengthSessionViewModel.kt`, `StrengthSessionUiState.kt`, `StrengthSessionMachine.kt`, `components/` mirrors.
- **Nav:** `log/strength` + `body/fitness/templates/{id}/start`; `badan://log/strength?template={id}`; watch companion (Phase 2) mirrors Active state via connectivity session.
- **Analytics:** `strength_session_started {from_template}`, `strength_set_logged {has_rpe, in_superset}` (batched), `strength_session_completed {duration_bucket, set_count_bucket, had_swap}`, `strength_session_abandoned {recovered}` — never weights.
- **Tests:** (1) process-death mid-set restores exact machine state incl. rest timer remainder; (2) repeat set = ≤2 taps (pre-fill assert); (3) superset rotation order fixture; (4) e1RM summary matches `core-scoring` golden; (5) write-back failure never blocks Completed locally; (6) plate math correct for kg/lb bars + micro-plates.
- **A11y:** steppers with large targets + adjustable actions; rest timer announces at 10 s remaining; full session operable via switch control.
- **RTL:** steppers mirror; plate-math diagram mirrors labels only; numerals localized.

**S-78 Symptom log (`SymptomLogSheet`)**
- **Purpose:** ≤10 s capture: recents chips → severity + duration + optional depth (§21.4).
- **Archetypes:** Salim (primary), Mariam, Karim.
- **Data:** `SymptomRepository.recents(limit=8)` (2-tap re-log); `SearchSymptomDictionaryQuery(text, locale)` (~200 canonical, localized, fuzzy: "did you mean 'light-headed' (used 4×)?"); body-map regions; trigger-tag suggestions (`GetTriggerTagsQuery()`: foods, stress, weather, meds change, custom).
- **States:** default (recents-first); dictionary-miss (create custom, fuzzy-guard prompt); ongoing-episode (open episodes offer "update" vs "new").
- **Actions:** chip → severity slider (3-level casual / 0–10 power per policy) → save; expand for duration/onset/ongoing flag, body-map, triggers, note + photo attachment (wellness-framed).
- **Subcomponents:** `RecentsChips`, `SeveritySlider` (policy-variant), `BodyMapPicker` (optional), `TriggerTagRow`, `AttachmentRow`, `SaveBar`.
- **ViewModel:** `SymptomLogViewModel` — recurrence linking (`episodeId` continuity), fuzzy-dedup at entry.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Symptoms/SymptomLogSheet.swift` / `features/symptoms/SymptomLogSheet.kt`.
- **Nav:** `log/symptom`; `badan://log/symptom?symptom={id}` (widget/watch recents).
- **Analytics:** `symptom_logged {method: recent|search|custom, severity_scale, has_triggers, is_retro}` — never symptom identity.
- **Tests:** (1) recent re-log = 2 interactions; (2) fuzzy prompt prevents duplicate vocabulary (fixture: "lightheaded"/"light-headed"); (3) casual policy shows 3-level scale, power 0–10, stored normalized; (4) photo attachment respects local-only storage class.
- **A11y:** severity slider with named levels; body map has list alternative.
- **RTL:** slider mirrors with value semantics; body-map labels localized.

**S-79 Medication taken/skip (`MedActionSheet`)**
- **Purpose:** the due-list action surface: one-tap take-all, per-med take/skip-with-reason (§21.5, non-punitive).
- **Archetypes:** Huda (large-type default).
- **Data:** `MedicationRepository.dueToday()` (grouped by time slot: morning/noon/evening/night + PRN row); `GetSkipReasonsQuery()` (enum chips: forgot, side effects, ran out, doctor's advice, other).
- **States:** all-taken (calm completed state); overdue (neutral "still due" — never red alarm); empty (no meds → hub setup path).
- **Actions:** take (per med / take-all per slot); skip → reason chips (optional note); undo window; retro-log via backdate.
- **Subcomponents:** `DueSlotGroup`, `TakeAllButton`, `SkipReasonChips`, `PrnRow`.
- **ViewModel:** `MedActionViewModel` — writes `AdherenceEvent(taken|late|skipped+reason)`; reschedules escalation through decision engine.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Medications/MedActionSheet.swift` / `features/medications/MedActionSheet.kt`.
- **Nav:** `log/med`; `badan://meds/due` (reminder deep link — lands here); watch take-from-wrist parity (§24.4).
- **Analytics:** `med_action_logged {action, has_reason, surface}`.
- **Tests:** (1) take-all creates one event per regimen with slot timestamp; (2) skip reason stored, adherence math counts it distinctly from missed; (3) undo removes event + restores due state; (4) watch action syncs conflict-free with phone action (dedup by slot+regimen).
- **A11y:** ≥48 dp targets; slot groups are headings; VoiceOver-first ordering (med name → dose → action).
- **RTL:** dose numerals shaped; slot order follows locale day convention.

**S-80 Mood/energy check-in (`MoodCheckinSheet`)**
- **Purpose:** 5-second subjective capture: two sliders + optional word chips (§21.7).
- **Data:** `GetCheckinDefaultsQuery()` (slider start = last value); word-chip vocabulary (localized).
- **States:** default; already-logged-today (edit mode, not duplicate).
- **Actions:** drag two sliders → save (auto-save on dismiss with confirmation haptic); optional chips.
- **Files:** `Features/Subjective/MoodCheckinSheet.swift` / `features/subjective/MoodCheckinSheet.kt`; nav `badan://log/mood`.
- **Analytics:** `mood_checkin_logged {has_words, surface}` — never values.
- **Tests:** (1) end-to-end ≤5 s scripted UI test; (2) values feed perceived-vs-scored gap metric (§21.8).
- **A11y:** sliders as adjustable with named anchors ("drained…energized").
- **RTL:** sliders mirror; chips wrap RTL.

**S-81 Measurement entry (`MeasurementEntrySheet`)**
- **Purpose:** unit-guarded manual entry: weight, BP, temp, waist, body fat %, lab result (Biology variant with reference-range fields + panel-date).
- **Data:** `GetMeasurementTypesQuery()` (registry-driven, unit variants per locale + per-metric override); lab variant: `GetBiomarkerEntrySpecQuery(biomarkerId)` (expected unit, plausible range guard).
- **States:** default; implausible-value guard (soft warning "260 kg — keep or fix?", never silent rejection); lab PDF-import handoff (`ff_biology_pdf_import`).
- **Actions:** type picker → unit-guarded keypad → backdate → save (write-back per toggles).
- **Subcomponents:** `UnitGuardedKeypad` (unit label always visible, locale decimal separator), `PlausibilityHint`, `ReferenceRangeFields` (lab variant).
- **ViewModel:** `MeasurementEntryViewModel`.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Log/MeasurementEntrySheet.swift` / `features/log/MeasurementEntrySheet.kt`.
- **Nav:** `log/measurement`; `badan://log/measurement?metric={id}` (S-48 Add-result arrives here with biomarker preset).
- **Analytics:** `measurement_logged {metric_family, is_retro, method: manual|pdf}`.
- **Tests:** (1) mmol/L vs mg/dL entry stores canonical unit + user unit; (2) plausibility guard thresholds from registry; (3) BP compound entry (sys/dia) validates ordering.
- **A11y:** keypad buttons labeled with unit context.
- **RTL:** keypad LTR digits, mirrored chrome; Arabic decimal separator honored.

**S-82 Note/journal (`NoteEntrySheet`)**
- **Purpose:** free text + tags + attachment, linked to day; feeds search + correlations via tags.
- **Data:** `GetTagSuggestionsQuery(prefix)`; drafts autosaved.
- **Actions:** write → tag → attach → save; link-to-entity (from context menus elsewhere: "add note to this workout").
- **Files:** `Features/Subjective/NoteEntrySheet.swift` / `features/subjective/NoteEntrySheet.kt`; nav `badan://log/note`.
- **Analytics:** `note_logged {has_tags, has_attachment, linked_entity_kind}`.
- **Tests:** (1) note appears in Timeline + FTS index ≤1 s; (2) attachments stay in local storage class.
- **A11y/RTL:** standard text editing; full bidi support in the editor.

**S-83 Status setter (`StatusSetterSheet`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** Bevel Activity-Status parity sheet, extended taxonomy (§10.13): the covariate control that keeps scores honest (Sick/Injured/Travel/Fasting/On-a-Break/Med-change…).
- **Archetypes:** Karim (Injured), Mariam, Ingrid (travel/heat), anyone via auto-suggestion confirm.
- **Data:** `GetStatusTaxonomyQuery()` (statuses with icons + one-line effect descriptions: "Sick — recovery expectations relax; performance critique pauses"); `StatusIntervalRepository.active()`; `GetStatusSuggestionsQuery()` (auto-suggested: travel via timezone shift, sick via prolonged multi-vital deviation — one-tap confirm, always optional §17.2).
- **States:** default (current statuses on top); retroactive-apply note ("applies to trends from the start date — recalculation runs once you save", Bevel parity); overlapping-statuses allowed (Sick + Travel), conflict rules from taxonomy.
- **Actions:** primary — select status → date-range picker (start today default; open-ended toggle) → save (`SetStatusIntervalCommand(status, range)` → `StatusIntervalSet` event → conditioned-baseline recompute §22.2 + phrasing engine context §23.9). Secondary — end active status; edit past interval; view "how statuses affect your scores" explainer.
- **Subcomponents:** `StatusOptionRow` (icon + effect description), `DateRangePicker` (retroactive-capable), `ActiveStatusChips`, `RecomputeNote`.
- **ViewModel:** `StatusSetterViewModel` — save triggers visible recompute note on affected surfaces (§18.4: never silent).
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Status/StatusSetterSheet.swift`, `StatusSetterViewModel.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/status/StatusSetterSheet.kt`, `StatusSetterViewModel.kt`, `StatusUiState.kt`.
- **Nav:** `log/status`; `badan://log/status?suggest=travel` (auto-suggestion notifications land here pre-selected); also from Today context strip.
- **Analytics:** `status_set {status, is_retroactive, source: manual|suggestion}`, `status_suggestion_dismissed {status}`.
- **Tests:** (1) retroactive Sick interval re-conditions baselines for the window (golden recompute); (2) Injured suppresses Detraining phrasing end-to-end (S-44 assertion); (3) overlapping statuses both annotate charts; (4) suggestion confirm is one tap from notification; (5) recompute note appears on Recovery pillar after save.
- **A11y:** status rows announce effect description; date picker fully labeled.
- **RTL:** date-range picker mirrors; Hijri-calendar display option honored where locale requests (Gregorian canonical storage).

### 16.7 Coach (interpretation layer)

**S-90 Coach root (`CoachRootScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** interpretation's home address (vs Bevel burying Intelligence in promos): expanded narrative, insight feed, check-ins, Ask entry.
- **Archetypes:** Omar (digest consumer), Rania (narrative only), Faisal (deep-dive questions).
- **Data:** `GetNarrativeQuery(scope=Day, date, verbosity)` (deterministic engine + LLM smoothing §23.3); `GetInsightFeedQuery(page)` (cards with evidence links, 👍/👎, "why am I seeing this" §23.10); `GetCheckinsQuery()` (configured cadence strip); `GetSuggestedQuestionsQuery()` (seeded Ask chips).
- **States:** loading; AI-off (deterministic templates render un-smoothed — §23.5 clean removal; Ask hidden, narrative remains); offline (cached narrative + insights; Ask disabled with honest copy); insight-feed-empty (calibration copy + education cards); provisional (narrative carries calibration framing, Law 2).
- **Actions:** insight card → evidence (deep link to cited metric/date); 👍/👎 (trains template weights §23.7); "why" → trigger + evidence + template id (power); Ask field → S-91; check-in card → conversation thread.
- **Subcomponents:** `NarrativeCard` (expandable), `InsightCard` (evidence footer), `CheckinStrip`, `AskField`, `FeedbackButtons`.
- **ViewModel:** `CoachRootViewModel` — feed pagination; feedback writes to `insights` table; respects topic-snoozes.
- **iOS/Android:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Coach/CoachRootScreen.swift` / `android/…/features/coach/CoachRootScreen.kt` (+ VM/UiState).
- **Nav:** tab root `coach`; `badan://coach`; insight deep links `badan://insight/{id}`.
- **Analytics:** `coach_viewed`, `insight_feedback {direction, template_id}`, `insight_evidence_opened`.
- **Tests:** (1) AI-off mode renders zero LLM-path calls (network fixture); (2) 👎 twice on a template family suppresses it per cooldown rules; (3) every insight card's evidence link resolves (no dead links CI sweep); (4) narrative language matches UI language incl. AR generation-not-translation.
- **A11y:** insight cards are single elements with actions menu; narrative readable at B1 level (linter-enforced for casual policy).
- **RTL:** full mirror; AR narrative typography per §25.9.

**S-91 Ask-BADAN chat (`AskBadanScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** grounded Q&A over the user's own data with verifiable answers — the report's Tier-2 capability with BADAN's trust architecture (§23.3).
- **Archetypes:** Faisal, Dmitri (skeptical/on-demand), Aziza (meal-response questions).
- **Data:** `AskBadanQuery(threadId, question)` → context builder assembles engine outputs + window summaries (never raw sensor JSON) → LLM → **verifier pass** (numeric claims checked against engine values) → `GroundedAnswer(prose, charts[], grounding: GroundingFootnote, verifierReport)`; `ChatThreadRepository.history()`; `GetSuggestedFollowupsQuery(answerId)`.
- **`GroundingFootnote` component (every answer, non-dismissible):** "Data used: sleep sessions Jun 8–Jul 8 (30 nights, 2 sources) · HRV daily values (28 days) · baselines v12" — each element tappable → the exact S-56/S-58 slice cited. Power mode adds payload-summary link (per-request "what was sent" log, §23.5).
- **Verifier-failure fallback state:** when the verifier drops unverifiable sentences below coherence threshold, the answer renders as: honest notice ("I couldn't produce a fully verified answer to that") + the *deterministic* partial results that did verify (e.g., the requested chart via `GetMetricSeriesQuery` rendered directly) + rephrase suggestions + "ask a simpler version" chips. Never a hallucinated number, never a silent partial answer. Emits `coach_verifier_fallback_shown`.
- **States:** first-use guardrail banner (wellness scope, one-time acknowledge); composing (streamed tokens with "verifying…" tail phase before final render); verifier-fallback (above); offline (disabled with cached-thread reading); AI-off (screen unreachable — nav guard); rate-limited (Pro deep-analysis upsell only at genuine capability boundary, feature-context rule §14.2); sensitive-topic redirect (medical-advice attempts → guardrail phrasing, red-team suite CI §23.9).
- **Actions:** ask (text/voice); tap grounding elements; follow-up chips; per-answer 👍/👎 + "that's wrong" (correction loop: cited data shown for user verification §23.10); thread management (rename/delete — deleting thread deletes context memory of it); chart in answer → open as full S-56.
- **Subcomponents:** `MessageList`, `AnswerCard` (prose + `MiniChart[]` + `GroundingFootnote`), `VerifierFallbackCard`, `FollowupChips`, `GuardrailBanner`, `Composer` (voice + text).
- **ViewModel:** `AskBadanViewModel` — thread state machine (Idle → Sending → Streaming → Verifying → Rendered | Fallback | Failed); cancellation; token streaming into stable layout (no reflow jumps).
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Coach/AskBadanScreen.swift`, `AskBadanViewModel.swift`, `components/GroundingFootnote.swift`, `components/VerifierFallbackCard.swift`, `components/AnswerCard.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/coach/AskBadanScreen.kt`, `AskBadanViewModel.kt`, `AskBadanUiState.kt`, `components/GroundingFootnote.kt`, `components/VerifierFallbackCard.kt`.
- **Nav:** `coach/ask?seed=` (seeded from S-56 ActionsBar, S-57, insight cards); `badan://ask?seed=metric:vitals.hrv_rmssd`.
- **Analytics:** `coach_question_asked {seed_kind, thread_len_bucket, input: text|voice}`, `coach_answer_rendered {had_charts, verifier_dropped_claims}`, `coach_verifier_fallback_shown`, `coach_answer_feedback {direction}` — never question text.
- **Tests:** (1) verifier precision eval gate ≥99% on numeric-claim eval set (E-17 acceptance, CI-blocking); (2) fallback renders deterministic chart when LLM fails fixture; (3) grounding footnote links resolve to exact cited slices; (4) cycle data absent from payload unless opted in (§23.4); (5) red-team suite: dosing/diagnosis prompts produce guardrail responses; (6) thread deletion purges memory references.
- **A11y:** streamed answers announced on completion (not per-token); charts in answers have summary sentences; composer supports dictation.
- **RTL:** chat bubbles mirror; AR questions get AR answers (generation parity); bidi-safe mixed content.

**S-92 Check-in config (`CheckinConfigScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** user-owned proactive cadence: topics, frequency, tone (§23.6).
- **Data:** `GetCheckinConfigQuery()` (cadence, topics, tone matrix concise↔detailed × warm↔neutral §23.8); quiet-hours link (shared with §24 settings); topic-snooze registry (permanent-until-reenabled).
- **States:** default; all-snoozed (honest "Coach won't initiate — you can always ask").
- **Actions:** cadence picker; topic toggles; tone matrix; test-message preview.
- **Files:** `Features/Coach/CheckinConfigScreen.swift` / `features/coach/CheckinConfigScreen.kt`.
- **Nav:** `coach/checkins/config`; from S-90 strip overflow.
- **Analytics:** `checkin_config_changed {cadence, topics_count}`.
- **Tests:** (1) snoozed topic never fires (decision-engine integration); (2) tone change affects next narrative render; (3) preview renders without sending.
- **A11y/RTL:** matrix as two labeled selectors; mirrored.

**S-93 Education library (`EducationLibraryScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** indexed, searchable learning home: pillar explainers (Getting-started stories re-openable), metric glossary (every ontology entry), algorithm transparency pages (§27.5), data-quality article set — Bevel Resources parity, made navigable.
- **Data:** `GetEducationIndexQuery(section)` from content CMS bundle (`content/en/`, `content/ar/`, offline-bundled core set); `SearchEducationQuery(text)` (FTS shared grammar §35); read-state per article.
- **States:** loading; offline (bundled content full function; CMS-delta articles marked); search-no-results (glossary fuzzy suggestions).
- **Actions:** article → reader (in-app, no webviews for core content); algorithm page → per-metric method doc with version history; story explainers → story-format viewer (S-17 component reuse).
- **Subcomponents:** `LibrarySectionList`, `ArticleReader`, `AlgorithmPage` (method + changelog + "affects these metrics" links), `StoryViewer`.
- **ViewModel:** `EducationLibraryViewModel`.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Coach/EducationLibraryScreen.swift` / `features/coach/EducationLibraryScreen.kt`.
- **Nav:** `coach/library`; `badan://learn/{articleId}` (targets of every (i) footer and Resources card app-wide).
- **Analytics:** `education_article_opened {article_id, entry_point}`.
- **Tests:** (1) every registry metric id has a resolving glossary entry (CI sweep); (2) AR content parity check (no EN fallback for core set); (3) algorithm page version matches `algorithm_version` stamps in exports.

- **RTL:** reader typography per AR rules; story swipe direction mirrors.
