### 16.8 Settings stack (modal)

The Settings stack is a modal full-screen (X-close, Bevel parity — configuration is not a destination, §14.2). All settings write to `customization_profiles` (synced, exportable JSON — §19.4) except device-local items (biometric lock, local-only mode) which are explicitly marked non-syncing.

**S-100 Settings root (`SettingsRootScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** the complete configuration tree, one screen deep to everything.
- **Archetypes:** all; Sven and Tariq audit it within the first hour.
- **Data:** `GetSettingsTreeQuery()` (sections + status summaries: account state, module on/off counts, notification budget usage); `GetEntitlementQuery()` (Membership row state); `SourceConnectionRepository.healthSummary()` (Data row badge).
- **Full tree (each leaf names its screen or sheet):**
  - **Account & sync** — account state card (local-only | synced; last sync; device list) → account sheet; sign-in/create (optional, never dark-patterned — Sven guard).
  - **Membership** → S-103. **Referrals** — guest-pass flow (Bevel Rewards parity).
  - **General** — *Appearance* (theme dark/light/auto; accent palette; app-icon gallery incl. seasonal — Bevel parity plus full light theme) · *Notifications* (per-class matrix from §24.6; quiet hours incl. prayer-time-configurable windows; weekly self-audit link "BADAN sent you N this week") · *Language & region* (UI language EN/AR launch; number/date formats; week start; Hijri display option) · *Units* (global system + per-metric overrides incl. mmol/L↔mg/dL, kg↔lb, °C↔°F; export unit profile) · *Depth dial* (Casual/Balanced/Power + per-surface overrides) · *Quiet hours*.
  - **Modules** — per-module visibility switches with live preview mockups + "hiding X disables all related features and UI" warning (Bevel parity) for Nutrition/Cycle/Glucose/Meds/Symptoms/Biology/Strength/Journal; per-module settings: *Goals* (per-metric targets, multi-method value/range/direction) · *HR Zones* (multi-method %max/%HRR/LTHR/manual, per-sport, zone-change history annotates charts — exceeds Bevel's single Max-HR method §19.6) · ***Calculations*** (Bevel parity with in-line explainers: HRV method RMSSD-from-raw-beats vs platform field; HRV/RHR/SpO₂/RR sampling window entire-sleep vs deep-sleep; temperature method wrist; calories display; merge-manual-sleep toggle; every choice links its algorithm page §27.5) · *Data Loading Window* (history sync depth >1 year, Bevel parity) · *Cycle settings* (lengths, prediction on/off, sensitive-class links) · *Nutrition* (write-back toggles: macros/micros/water/caffeine/alcohol — exact Bevel switch set; regional DB preference; quality-score rubric link) · *Strength defaults* (bar type, plates, rest timer) · *Journal/water goal*.
  - **Data & Privacy** — *Data Sources* → S-60 · *Consent center* → S-101 · *Privacy dashboard* → S-102 · *Export* → S-61 · *Import* (Apple Health ZIP, Garmin/Oura/Fitbit takeouts, CSV mapper — §13.9 connectors) · *Delete* → S-104 · *App lock* (biometric) · *Analytics opt-out* (real, §36.2).
  - **Automation** — Shortcuts/intents gallery (Bevel parity: e.g., sleep-alarm + focus recipes; export intents §20.7).
  - **Resources** — What's new (release notes incl. algorithm changelog surfacing) · Getting started stories (S-17 re-entry) · Knowledge base → S-93 · Roadmap/feature requests · Report a bug (diagnostic bundle consent-first) · Rate.
- **States:** loading (tree is local — instant); degraded rows badge their problem (auth-expired source, notification permission off); local-only mode (account row swaps to "device only" state card).
- **Actions:** navigate; search settings (power: settings FTS).
- **Subcomponents:** `SettingsSection`, `StatusRow` (label + current-value summary + chevron), `ModulePreviewSwitch` (live mockup on toggle intent), `SettingsSearchBar`.
- **ViewModel:** `SettingsRootViewModel` — tree assembly + badge computation; module toggles route through confirmation with preview (never instant destructive hide).
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Settings/SettingsRootScreen.swift`, `SettingsRootViewModel.swift`, `components/ModulePreviewSwitch.swift` (+ one file per sub-sheet: `AppearanceSheet.swift`, `UnitsSheet.swift`, `CalculationsSheet.swift`, `HrZonesEditor.swift`, `NotificationsMatrixSheet.swift`…).
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/settings/SettingsRootScreen.kt`, `SettingsRootViewModel.kt`, `SettingsUiState.kt`, `sheets/` (same set, `.kt`).
- **Nav:** modal from avatar (all tabs); `badan://settings`, `badan://settings/{section}` (notifications self-audit links land at `settings/notifications`).
- **Analytics:** `settings_viewed {section}`, `module_visibility_changed {module, visible}`, `calculation_method_changed {metric_family, method}`, `unit_override_changed {metric_family}`, `depth_dial_changed {level}`.
- **Tests:** (1) hiding a module removes every related surface (S-40 card, Today modules, log tiles, All-Metrics rows) in one pass — snapshot sweep; (2) calculation-method change triggers visible recompute notice + `algorithm_version` bump on affected derived values; (3) per-metric unit override propagates to charts, exports, widgets, narratives; (4) settings JSON profile export→wipe→import restores identical tree state; (5) prayer-time quiet windows suppress all non-transactional notifications in window.
- **A11y:** every row a labeled button with value summary; module switches announce consequence text.
- **RTL:** full mirror; Arabic settings search matches Arabic labels + synonyms.

**S-101 Consent center (`ConsentCenterScreen`)** — *priority depth*
- **Purpose:** the living consent ledger (§28.3): per-data-type grants, last-read timestamps, revocation paths, sensitive-class controls.
- **Archetypes:** Sven, Tariq (first-hour audit), Mariam (cycle class), every user at permission moments.
- **Data:** `ConsentRepository.grants()` → rows per data type: `ConsentGrant(dataType, status: granted|denied|partial|expired, grantedAt, lastReadAt, readCount30d, purposeText)`; `GetOsPermissionStateQuery()` (live HealthKit/Health Connect status reconciliation — BADAN's record vs OS truth, discrepancies surfaced); sensitive-class toggles (`cycle_cloud_ai_optin` default OFF, `cycle_export_gate`, `meds_in_sharecards` default OFF); `consent_records` append-only audit log.
- **States:** loading; all-granted; partial (per-type fix paths — deep-link to OS settings where revocation must happen OS-side, with exact-path instructions per platform/version); revoked-with-data ("access revoked; 214 stored nights remain yours — delete separately if wished" — revocation never silently deletes, Law 1); reconciliation-mismatch banner (OS says denied, BADAN thought granted → honest correction).
- **Actions:** per-type row → detail (purpose, exact fields read, last-read log, revoke path); sensitive-class toggles (immediate effect + confirmation of consequence); view full consent history (append-only log render); re-request denied types (staged bundle re-prompt, never nag-loop — one re-request per value moment).
- **Subcomponents:** `ConsentGrantRow` (type icon, status chip, last-read relative time), `SensitiveClassSection` (distinct visual treatment), `ConsentHistoryList`, `OsMismatchBanner`, `RevokePathSheet` (platform-exact instructions).
- **ViewModel:** `ConsentCenterViewModel` — reconciles `ConsentRepository` vs live OS state on each appearance; writes every user action to `consent_records`; emits `PermissionRevoked` domain event (ingestion daemon reacts §32.2).
- **iOS:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Consent/ConsentCenterScreen.swift`, `ConsentCenterViewModel.swift`, `components/ConsentGrantRow.swift`, `components/SensitiveClassSection.swift`.
- **Android:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/consent/ConsentCenterScreen.kt`, `ConsentCenterViewModel.kt`, `ConsentUiState.kt`, `components/` mirrors.
- **Nav:** `settings/consent`; `badan://consent`; permission-expiring notifications (system class) deep-link to the exact row.
- **Analytics:** `consent_center_viewed`, `consent_changed {data_type_class, direction}` (class only, e.g. "vitals" — never specific grants for sensitive classes), `sensitive_toggle_changed {toggle, on}`.
- **Tests:** (1) OS revocation detected on next foreground → row + banner update, ingestion for that type halts (daemon integration); (2) cycle cloud-AI opt-in OFF by default and survives reinstall-restore; (3) consent history is append-only (mutation attempt fails at DAO layer); (4) last-read timestamps match ingestion-log fixture; (5) revoke-path instructions correct per OS version matrix (parameterized test).
- **A11y:** status chips have text equivalents; history list readable as sentences ("March 2: you granted sleep data access").
- **RTL:** mirrored; relative-time strings localized (Arabic plural rules).

**S-102 Privacy dashboard (`PrivacyDashboardScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** plain-language "what leaves this device and why" with live counters (§28.4); local-only mode switch.
- **Archetypes:** Sven (primary), all at trust moments.
- **Data:** `GetNetworkDisclosureQuery()` → per-destination rows (sync service, AI gateway, food DB, telemetry): purpose, payload class, count this week, last sent; local-only: all zeros with "nothing since {date}"; `GetAiPayloadLogQuery()` (per-request "what was sent" summaries, §23.5); `GetLocalOnlyStateQuery()`.
- **States:** cloud-mode (live counters); local-only (celebratory-calm zero state); transitioning (local-only enable walks through consequences: sync off, cloud AI off, account optional-out — staged confirmation).
- **Actions:** local-only mode switch (staged); open AI payload log; telemetry opt-out link; export disclosure as text.
- **Subcomponents:** `DestinationRow` (live counter), `AiPayloadLogList`, `LocalOnlySwitch` (staged flow), `DisclosureExportButton`.
- **ViewModel:** `PrivacyDashboardViewModel`.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Privacy/PrivacyDashboardScreen.swift` / `features/privacy/PrivacyDashboardScreen.kt` (+ VM/UiState).
- **Nav:** `settings/privacy`; `badan://privacy`.
- **Analytics:** `privacy_dashboard_viewed`, `local_only_toggled {on}` (the last event before telemetry stops when enabling).
- **Tests:** (1) local-only mode → zero network calls except user-initiated OS traffic (network fixture over 24h simulated); (2) counters match actual request log; (3) AI payload log entries render for every gateway call.
- **A11y/RTL:** counters announced with purpose; mirrored.

**S-103 Membership (`MembershipScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** honest entitlement management: Free vs Pro ✓/✗ checklist (Bevel's list format adopted), restore, manage, cancel without friction.
- **Data:** `GetEntitlementQuery()` (state, renewal date, trial countdown); `GetEntitlementMatrixQuery()` (feature rows: free tier column must show real capability, e.g. "Export: everything, always ✓ | ✓"); store-kit / billing states.
- **States:** free; trialing (day count, "reminder before charge" promise — Bevel trial-reminder parity); pro; grace/billing-issue (calm fix path); lapsed (repository intact statement front and center — Law 1).
- **Actions:** subscribe ($59.99/yr anchored vs $7.99/mo, 14-day trial §39); restore purchases; manage (routes to store); cancel-path honesty (no retention maze).
- **Subcomponents:** `EntitlementChecklist`, `PriceCards` (yearly-savings framing), `TrialPromiseCard`, `LapsedReassuranceCard`.
- **ViewModel:** `MembershipViewModel` (StoreKit 2 / Play Billing wrappers via `port-billing`).
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Membership/MembershipScreen.swift` / `features/membership/MembershipScreen.kt`.
- **Nav:** `settings/membership`; `badan://membership`; paywall sheets elsewhere link here, never interstitial (§14.2).
- **Analytics:** `paywall_viewed {source_feature}`, `trial_started`, `subscription_started {plan}`, `subscription_lapsed_viewed`.
- **Tests:** (1) lapsed state gates zero repository/export paths (architectural assert); (2) checklist matches packaging contract fixture (§39 source of truth); (3) trial reminder scheduled at day 12.
- **A11y/RTL:** price cards labeled with full terms; localized currency formatting.

**S-104 Delete & exit flows (`DeleteFlowScreen`)**
- **Purpose:** verifiable, export-first deletion (§20.9, §28): leaving well is a feature.
- **Data:** `GetDeletionScopeQuery()` (what exists: local DB size, synced copies, artifacts); `ExportEngine.enqueue()` integration (export-first offer); `DeleteAccountCommand` / `WipeLocalDataCommand` staged.
- **States:** intro (scope summary + export-first offer); export-in-progress (deletion locked until artifact ready or explicitly skipped); staged confirmation (type-to-confirm for full wipe); completed (verifiable state: "local data erased; server copies purged — confirmation id {id}"; local-only users get local-wipe verification); partial (server unreachable → queued purge with honest status).
- **Actions:** export first (recommended, pre-selected "full archive"); delete synced copies only (keep local); full wipe; cancel anywhere.
- **Subcomponents:** `ScopeSummaryCard`, `ExportFirstCard`, `StagedConfirm` (type-to-confirm), `CompletionReceipt`.
- **ViewModel:** `DeleteFlowViewModel` — orchestrates export job → purge command → receipt; never fire-and-forget.
- **iOS/Android:** `Features/Settings/DeleteFlowScreen.swift` / `features/settings/DeleteFlowScreen.kt`.
- **Nav:** `settings/delete`; reachable only from Data & Privacy (never from paywall/cancel contexts).
- **Analytics:** `deletion_started {kind}`, `deletion_export_taken`, `deletion_completed {kind}` — final events before purge.
- **Tests:** (1) full wipe leaves zero rows across all tables + keychain/keystore cleared (device audit test); (2) export-first artifact validates against schema before deletion unlocks; (3) server purge receipt verifiable via support id; (4) cancel at every stage restores normal state.
- **A11y:** staged confirmations screen-reader explicit about consequence.
- **RTL:** type-to-confirm accepts localized confirmation word.

### 16.9 Cross-cutting states (the state contract)

Every screen S-01…S-104 must satisfy this contract. CI enforces it via a screen-state conformance suite (`core-testing/conformance/ScreenStateContractTest`): each screen registers its applicable states and provides a preview/screenshot fixture per state; a screen shipping without a registered fixture for an applicable state fails the build.

| State | Trigger | Required UI | Required action affordance | Analytics | Forbidden |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Loading** | first load, no cache | skeleton mirroring final layout (shape, not spinner) | none; auto-resolves; >600 ms shows shape, >5 s shows "still working" | none (avoid noise) | full-screen spinners on root surfaces; layout jump on resolve |
| **Empty-with-path** | feature has no data ever | what this will show (mini-mockup or copy) + how to feed it (named paths) | primary CTA = the feed path (connect/log/import) | `empty_state_viewed {screen, reason}` | blank panels; guilt copy; "No data" without a path |
| **Permission-denied** | OS grant missing/revoked | value restatement + exact fix path (named OS toggle, per-version) | "Fix in Settings" deep link + manual-mode alternative | `denied_state_viewed {permission}` | re-prompt loops; feature disappearing silently |
| **No-data-today** | source connected, today absent | last-known value + staleness note + yesterday context | resync; check source health (S-60) | none | zeros presented as measurements |
| **Provisional** | baseline coverage below threshold | calibration badge + honest wobble copy + countdown ("~9 days") | "why calibration?" → education | `provisional_viewed {metric_family}` (once/day) | confident presentation of uncalibrated numbers |
| **Error** | query/engine failure | calm error card + retry + support id (correlates to local log) | retry; report (diagnostic consent-first) | `error_state_viewed {screen, error_class}` | raw exception text; dead ends |
| **Offline** | no connectivity | cached content unbannered on local surfaces; explicit banner only where function degrades (Ask, remote DBs) | queue indicator for pending writes | none | blocking any local read/log path |
| **Paywalled** | entitlement gate on depth layer | real limited version + concrete free/Pro delta copy | "See what Pro adds" → S-103 (in-context sheet) | `paywall_viewed {source_feature}` | obfuscated/scrambled numbers; interstitials; gating raw data (architecturally impossible, Law 1) |
| **Stale-sync** | >36 h since source data | gentle "data paused" banner + fix path | source health → S-60 | `stale_banner_viewed` | alarmist copy |

**Shared `StatefulContainer` component (both platforms).** One wrapper renders the contract so screens implement only their Loaded content:

```swift
// ios/BadanApp/DesignSystem/StatefulContainer.swift
struct StatefulContainer<T, Content: View>: View {
    let state: LoadState<T>                     // §3 conventions: loading, loaded(T), empty(EmptyReason), denied(PermissionKind), error(AppError)
    let skeleton: SkeletonSpec                  // shape template mirroring the Loaded layout
    var emptyOverride: ((EmptyReason) -> AnyView)? = nil   // screen-specific empty art/copy
    var deniedFixPath: OsSettingsRoute? = nil
    var onRetry: (() -> Void)? = nil
    @ViewBuilder let content: (T) -> Content
    // Renders: skeleton | content | EmptyWithPathView | DeniedView(fixPath) | ErrorCardView(retry, supportId)
    // Emits the contract analytics events; enforces 600 ms skeleton minimum-dwell to avoid flash.
}
```

```kotlin
// android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/designsystem/StatefulContainer.kt
@Composable
fun <T> StatefulContainer(
    state: LoadState<T>,                        // sealed: Loading, Loaded<T>, Empty(reason), Denied(kind), Error(appError)
    skeleton: SkeletonSpec,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    empty: (@Composable (EmptyReason) -> Unit)? = null,
    deniedFixPath: OsSettingsRoute? = null,
    onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    content: @Composable (T) -> Unit,
) { /* same contract; state transitions animated with shared motion tokens; test tag per state for conformance suite */ }
```

Rules: (1) per-card containers on dashboard screens (S-44 pattern) so one failed query never blanks a page; (2) `Provisional`, `Offline`, `Paywalled`, `StaleSync` are *decorations on Loaded* (badge/banner/gate props on content components), not `LoadState` variants — a provisional value is still a value; (3) `StatefulContainer` is the only sanctioned way to render `LoadState` — lint rule `badan-lint:no-raw-loadstate-when` blocks manual `when(state)` rendering in feature code.

## 17. Casual-user mode design

### 17.1 The casual contract
≤10 seconds/day for value; zero required input; no guilt; no jargon without inline translation; nothing alarming without confidence + context; the app never visibly "grows" unless invited. Casual is not a stripped build — it is a **rendering policy** over the full data model (§8.6, §18.5). Rania and Omar (§3.1–3.2) are the reference archetypes; the Bevel floor (§6.1) is met by Today-module curation, one-number honesty, and the morning narrative.

### 17.2 `PresentationPolicy` — the depth dial made concrete
The dial from §8.6 is a single value object consumed by every display component (§26.6). It lives in `core-model/presentation/PresentationPolicy.kt` and is the ONLY thing that differs between Casual and Power rendering.

```kotlin
// core-model/presentation/PresentationPolicy.kt
enum class DepthLevel { CASUAL, BALANCED, POWER }
enum class LabelSet { CASUAL, PRECISE }                  // terminology bridge §27.3
enum class Density { COMFORTABLE, COMPACT }
enum class BadgeStyle { ARROW_ONLY, ARROW_PLUS_NUMBER }
enum class AxisVerbosity { MINIMAL, LABELED, FULL }
enum class NotifDepth { SENTENCE, SENTENCE_PLUS_DELTA }

data class PresentationPolicy(
    val depth: DepthLevel,
    val labelSet: LabelSet,
    val density: Density,
    val annotationsDefaultOn: Boolean,      // statuses/meds/cycle layers on charts
    val tablesDefaultOpen: Boolean,         // rolling-delta tables expanded by default
    val deviationBadgeStyle: BadgeStyle,
    val axisVerbosity: AxisVerbosity,
    val sparklineAxesOnTap: Boolean,
    val maxTodayModules: Int,               // enforced by guardrail CG-01 (§19.7)
    val showConfidenceNumeric: Boolean,     // ± ranges & coverage % vs. dot indicator
    val notificationAnalyticDepth: NotifDepth,
    val hiddenScores: Set<String>,          // metric ids hidden (gentle mode, §19.4)
    val bridgeLabelsRemainingVisits: Int    // countdown for parenthetical precise labels (§17.1 vocabulary layer)
)
```

**Default values per preset** (presets defined in §19.3; the preset sets the policy, the user may then override any field):

| Field | Essential (Casual) | Athlete / Recovery / Longevity (Balanced) | Analyst (Power) |
|---|---|---|---|
| depth | CASUAL | BALANCED | POWER |
| labelSet | CASUAL | CASUAL | PRECISE |
| density | COMFORTABLE | COMFORTABLE | COMPACT |
| annotationsDefaultOn | false | true (Recovery: statuses only) | true (all layers) |
| tablesDefaultOpen | false | false | true |
| deviationBadgeStyle | ARROW_ONLY | ARROW_ONLY | ARROW_PLUS_NUMBER |
| axisVerbosity | MINIMAL | LABELED | FULL |
| sparklineAxesOnTap | false | true | true |
| maxTodayModules | 5 | 8 | 12 |
| showConfidenceNumeric | false | false | true |
| notificationAnalyticDepth | SENTENCE | SENTENCE | SENTENCE_PLUS_DELTA |
| bridgeLabelsRemainingVisits | 3 | 3 | 0 |

**Storage.** The global policy and all per-surface overrides are rows in `customization_profiles` (§19.2): global policy under `scope='global', key='presentation.policy'`; per-surface overrides (e.g., "Balanced overall but Power on Sleep", §8.6) under `scope='pillar.sleep', key='presentation.policy.override'` storing only the overridden fields as sparse JSON. Per-chart remembered toggles (annotation on/off per metric detail) live under `scope='metric.<metric_id>', key='chart.annotations'`.

**Resolution.** `core-model/presentation/PresentationPolicyResolver.kt` merges in fixed order: preset defaults → global user policy → surface override → per-chart remembered toggle. The resolved object is injected once per screen: iOS via `@Environment(\.presentationPolicy)` (key defined in `ios/BadanApp/DesignSystem/PresentationPolicyKey.swift`), Android via `CompositionLocal` `LocalPresentationPolicy` (`android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/designsystem/PresentationPolicyLocal.kt`). ViewModels never branch on depth; components read the policy (per §26.6 — one component library, two altitudes, zero forks).

### 17.3 Casual mechanisms (v1 carried, mapped to policy fields)

| Mechanism (v1 §17.2) | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Curated ceiling: Today ≤5 modules; Trends tables behind "See trends"; metric chips collapsed | `maxTodayModules=5`; `tablesDefaultOpen=false`; chips-row collapse bound to `density` |
| Vocabulary layer: casual labels with precise labels in parentheses first 3 visits | `labelSet=CASUAL` + `bridgeLabelsRemainingVisits` decremented per detail-screen visit in `customization_profiles` (`scope='metric.<id>', key='bridge.visits_left'`) |
| One-number honesty: ring carries one-word driver ("Readiness 62 — short sleep") | driver string comes from the top `InputContribution` of the score's `InputManifest` (§22.5) — never LLM-generated |
| Automatic everything: statuses auto-suggested (travel via timezone, sick via prolonged deviations + gentle confirm); sleep/workouts auto-imported; insights auto-generated | status suggesters in `core-insight/status/StatusSuggestionEngine.kt`; confirmations one tap, always optional |
| Notification floor: morning narrative + weekly digest only, everything else opt-in | `core-notify` budget preset `notif.profile='floor'` (§24.8) |
| Empty-state suppression (P5) for wearable-only users | presence-based module defaults, §16.3 |

### 17.4 Casual failure modes designed against (rules, not vibes)
- **Overwhelm on first open** → staged module reveal: modules beyond the first 3 unlock over days 2–7 (`ff_shell_staged_reveal`, schedule in `contracts/customization/presets/essential.yaml`).
- **Score anxiety** → gentle mode: `hiddenScores` hides day scores, keeps weekly trends (the orthosomnia guard); toggle surfaced in Sleep settings and after any 3 consecutive low-score days (offer, never auto-applied).
- **Paywall resentment** → free tier complete-feeling: all metrics interpreted individually; paywall gates listed in §44 only.
- **Death-by-defaults** → quarterly "tune your app" 60-second review card (skippable forever, flag `tune_review_dismissed_forever`).

### 17.5 The casual→engaged ramp — rule specs
Ramp invitations fire only at value moments (v1 §17.4), evaluated by `core-flags/ramp/RampRuleEngine.kt` against local interaction counters (table `ui_interaction_counters(counter_key, window_start, count)` in `core-db`). Each rule fires at most once per user; dismissal sets a permanent flag; acceptance mutates `customization_profiles` and logs analytics event `ramp_invitation_accepted` (properties: rule_id only — never health values).

| Rule id | Trigger condition (local counters) | Invitation surface | Accept action | Flags |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RAMP-01 | `sleep_detail_opened` ≥3 in rolling 7d | inline card on Sleep pillar: "Want the sleep-focused layout?" | apply `pillar.sleep` surface override → POWER-lite (tables open, annotations on) | `ramp_01_offered`, `ramp_01_dismissed` |
| RAMP-02 | first `meal_logged` | post-log sheet: nutrition module offer | activate Nutrition module (§19.4 module activation) | `ramp_02_offered` |
| RAMP-03 | first `export_completed` | Workbench banner: power-mode tour | launch tour; on finish offer `depth=POWER` | `ramp_03_offered` |
| RAMP-04 | `annotation_toggle_used` ≥5 in 30d | toast-anchored offer on chart | set `annotationsDefaultOn=true` globally | `ramp_04_offered` |
| RAMP-05 | `delta_table_expanded` ≥4 in 14d | offer on the surface where threshold crossed | set `tablesDefaultOpen=true` for that surface | `ramp_05_offered` |
| RAMP-06 | `metric_pinned` ≥3 total | offer custom metric collection (§19.4) | open collection creator pre-seeded with pins | `ramp_06_offered` |

Rule expressions ship as remote config through `core-flags` so thresholds are tunable without release. **Never time-based upsells of complexity** — CI lint rejects any ramp rule whose trigger references only elapsed time.

### 17.6 Acceptance criteria: same data model, two altitudes
Parity test suite `core-testing/golden/policy-parity/`:
1. Load fixture day `fixtures/day-standard-ayesha.json` (full sleep+workout+vitals).
2. Build every screen ViewModel state twice — once with resolved Essential policy, once with Analyst policy.
3. Assert **identical underlying values**: every number present in the casual state exists with equal value in the power state (power is a superset; casual never shows a value power lacks, and no value differs).
4. Assert casual state contains zero PRECISE-labelset strings and no numeric confidence fields; power state contains no casual-only simplifications of numbers (e.g., no extra rounding — rounding rules come from the metric registry, not the policy).
5. Snapshot tests on both platforms render both altitudes from the same state (iOS `PolicyParitySnapshotTests.swift`, Android Paparazzi `PolicyParityScreenshotTest.kt`).
Release gate: parity suite green is a CI-blocking check for every feature PR that touches a screen (E-05 acceptance).

## 18. Power-user mode design

### 18.1 The power contract
Every number decomposable (Anatomy everywhere); every sample inspectable (Explorer + lineage); every dataset exportable (Center + API); every algorithm documented + versioned (changelog; recompute notes); every default overridable within the curation model (sources, methods, zones, bands display, units per metric); nothing dumbed down silently. Dmitri and Priya (§3.5, §3.18) are the reference archetypes.

### 18.2 Power-surface access map
Power surfaces are reachable from Casual via explicit links — just not ambient (§8.6 invariant: the dial never changes access).

| Surface | Route / deeplink | Entry from Casual | Entry from Power | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Raw Data Explorer + lineage sheets | `badan://workbench/explorer?metric=<id>` (S-58/59) | metric detail → Anatomy → "inspect samples" | Workbench tab home | free |
| Correlation Lab (§22.7) | `badan://workbench/correlations` | insight card → "explore this association" | Workbench | Pro |
| Experiments (§22.8) | `badan://workbench/experiments` | Coach suggestion card | Workbench | Pro |
| Comparison overlays (metric-vs-metric, period-vs-period) | metric detail → compare action | explicit "Compare" action on L3 | default-visible toolbar icon | free |
| Annotation-dense charts (statuses/meds/cycle toggleable) | any chart, two-finger tap (§26.1) | discoverable via chart context menu | `annotationsDefaultOn=true` | free |
| Rolling-delta tables (Bevel parity) | every L3 metric detail | behind "See trends" | default-open (`tablesDefaultOpen`) | free |
| Algorithm pages + quantitative Score Anatomy | `badan://learn/algorithm/<algorithm_id>` | (i) affordance | Anatomy sheet footer link | free |
| Scheduled exports + personal API | `badan://settings/exports/schedules`, `/settings/api-tokens` | Export Center footer | same | Pro |
| Advanced notification rules ("notify me when HRV 7-day delta < −10%") | `badan://settings/notifications/rules` | not surfaced | notifications settings | Pro |
| Data-quality dashboards (coverage %, artifact counts per source) | `badan://workbench/quality` | source settings → "data quality" | Workbench | free |

### 18.3 Density mechanics — policy-field mapping
Power mode swaps are exactly the `PresentationPolicy` field flips of §17.2's table: compact card paddings (`density=COMPACT`), sparklines gain axes on tap (`sparklineAxesOnTap`), tables default-open, deviation badges show numbers not just arrows (`deviationBadgeStyle=ARROW_PLUS_NUMBER`), Today tiles adopt the stat-dense variant (each DS card component defines `comfortable`/`compact` variants in `ios/BadanApp/DesignSystem/` and `android/.../designsystem/`). All within the same navigation topology (Law/P10) — routes identical under both policies, verified by the parity suite (§17.6).

### 18.4 Respect protocols (mechanized)
1. **User corrections are authoritative and propagate.** Editing a sleep session runs `RecomputeAffectedCommand` → `ScoringEngine` re-derives dependent `DerivedValue`s (append-only, new `AlgorithmVersion` context per §30.1) → UI shows a "recomputed" chip sourced from the new `InputManifest.computedAt`.
2. **Disagreement affordance on every insight.** "This doesn't match how I feel" → `InsightFeedbackCommand(insightId, kind=DISAGREE)` → stored on `insights.feedback` → down-weights the template family per-user (§23.10) → feeds perceived-gap calibration (§22.5).
3. **No silent algorithm changes.** Every `AlgorithmVersion` bump ships an in-app changelog entry (content CMS, §27.5) and a per-user "your scores were re-derived" notice generated when the recompute job touches ≥1 visible score — the trust move Bevel's opaque updates miss.

### 18.5 One data model, two altitudes — resolution restated as tests
The renderer consumes the same metric records + the `PresentationPolicy` object; Casual and Power are policies, not schemas (v1 §18.5). Enforcement: (a) parity suite §17.6; (b) architecture lint in `tooling/ci/`: no file under `features/` may reference `DepthLevel` in conditional logic outside DS components (grep-based check, allowlist for the depth-dial settings screen itself); (c) QA matrix (§43) runs every feature test under both policies. Design implication carried: components are built policy-aware from the start (§26.6) — neither mode is an afterthought skin.

## 19. Personalization and customization system

### 19.1 Customization philosophy: curation, not chaos
Users customize by *selecting and arranging sanctioned modules*, never by breaking invariants (navigation topology, truthfulness, template grammar). Every customization has a visible reset. Bevel's model (Edit Home, per-tab card editing, module visibility switches with live previews, biomarker list Edit, calculation methods) is the validated backbone; BADAN extends it with presets, per-surface depth, and terminology preferences (v1 §19.1, kept verbatim as law).

### 19.2 Storage: the `customization_profiles` table
One generic key-value-with-scope table (referenced by §30.1's `CustomizationProfile` entity), SQLDelight schema in `core/core-db/src/commonMain/sqldelight/customization_profiles.sq`:

```sql
CREATE TABLE customization_profiles (
  profile_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,             -- ULID
  user_id               TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope                 TEXT NOT NULL,                -- 'global' | 'today' | 'pillar.<id>' | 'metric.<metric_id>' | 'widget.<widget_id>' | 'watch'
  key                   TEXT NOT NULL,                -- storage key from §19.4 column 2
  value_json            TEXT NOT NULL,                -- validated against per-key JSON Schema
  value_schema_version  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  preset_origin         TEXT,                         -- preset id if value untouched since preset apply; NULL once user-modified
  updated_at            INTEGER NOT NULL,             -- epoch ms; last-writer-wins per key on sync (§34)
  device_origin         TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(user_id, scope, key)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_custprof_scope ON customization_profiles(user_id, scope);
```

Per-key JSON Schemas live in `contracts/customization/keys/*.schema.json`; `core-db` DAO `CustomizationRepository` validates on write (invalid → rejected with `AppError.InvalidCustomization`). Rows sync through `sync_oplog` like all user data (E2E, §34); conflict rule is per-key last-writer-wins with the losing value retained in an undo buffer for 30 days.

### 19.3 Preset definition format
Presets are frozen contracts: `contracts/customization/presets/{essential,athlete,recovery,longevity,analyst}.yaml`, schema `contracts/customization/preset.schema.json`, loaded at runtime by `core-registry`. Fragment (essential.yaml):

```yaml
preset_id: essential
version: 2
display_name: { en: "Essential", ar: "الأساسي" }
presentation_policy:            # §17.2 defaults column 1
  depth: CASUAL
  label_set: CASUAL
  max_today_modules: 5
surfaces:
  today:
    layout.modules:             # ordered module list with size variants
      - { module: readiness_ring, size: hero }
      - { module: sleep_card, size: medium }
      - { module: one_true_sentence, size: full }
      - { module: activity_ring, size: small }
      - { module: log_shortcuts, size: row }
    staged_reveal:              # §17.4 overwhelm guard
      day2: [activity_ring]
      day5: [log_shortcuts]
  pillar.sleep:
    layout.modules: [hero, key_facts, narrative, trends_link]
notifications.profile: floor
modules.active: [sleep, recovery, activity]
```

### 19.4 The customization inventory as schema
Every v1 §19.2 control mapped to storage key + UI surface + apply/reset semantics. Reset always means "restore the value the active preset defines" (and re-stamps `preset_origin`); "Reset all" is guarded by CG-06.

| Domain | Storage key (scope) | UI surface | Apply semantics | Reset semantics |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dashboard layout (add/remove/reorder/resize per surface) | `layout.modules` (`today`, `pillar.*`) | Edit-mode long-press on surface (Bevel parity + size variants) | transactional replace of ordered list; live preview before commit | restore preset list |
| Metric pinning | `layout.pins` (`today`, `pillar.*`, `watch`) | long-press any metric anywhere | append pin (CG-01 cap applies) | clear pins |
| Card visibility | `layout.hidden_modules` (per surface) | per-module toggle w/ live preview | hide keeps data + computation running | unhide all |
| Module activation (Nutrition/Cycle/Glucose/Meds/Symptoms/Biology/Strength) | `modules.active` (`global`) | onboarding + Profile→Modules | deactivation shows "disables all related UI" warning (Bevel parity); data retained | reactivate per preset |
| Themes | `theme` (`global`) | Profile→Appearance | dark/light/auto + accent + app icon; instant | auto + default accent |
| Terminology | `presentation.policy.label_set` (`global`) | depth-dial screen | linked to depth dial; per-language | preset value |
| Chart density / annotations / bands / axes | `chart.annotations`, `chart.bands`, `chart.axes` (`metric.*`) | two-finger tap + chart context menu | per-chart override remembered | fall back to policy default |
| Units | `units.system` (`global`), `units.override` (`metric.*`) | Profile→Units | kg/lb, mmol/L↔mg/dL, °C/°F, km/mi; exports honor a chosen unit profile (§20.7) | locale default |
| Report verbosity | `reports.verbosity` (`global`) | report composer + digest settings | glance/standard/deep; applies to PDFs | standard |
| Notifications | `notif.profile`, `notif.rules` (`global`) | §24.8 matrix screen | per-type on/off, timing, quiet hours, bundling | floor defaults |
| AI tone | `ai.tone_policy` (`global`) | Coach settings (§23.5 TonePolicy JSON) | next generation uses new tone | warm+concise |
| Daily summary | `summary.delivery` (`global`) | Coach settings | time, channels (push/widget/none), content blocks | 7:30 push |
| Custom tags | dictionary table `custom_tags`, not profile rows | inline at log time | free tags on any loggable entity; usable in filters/correlations | n/a (data) |
| Custom symptoms/meds/foods/activities | dictionary tables (§21) | each logging hub | mapped-to-canonical where possible | n/a (data) |
| Custom issue categories | `conditions` table (§21.6) | Conditions hub | label + linked entities | n/a (data) |
| Goals | `goals` table (`GoalRepository`) | per-metric detail → "set goal" | value/range/direction methods | delete goal |
| Custom metric collections | `metric_collections` table | Workbench + long-press "add to collection" | named sets usable as dashboard module / report scope / export scope | delete collection |
| Custom widgets | `widget.<id>` scope, `widget.config` | platform widget gallery (§24) | per-widget metric choice + depth | preset widget set |
| Shortcuts/automations | platform-side; registry `intents.enabled` (`global`) | intents gallery | Bevel parity+ | all enabled |
| Score visibility (gentle mode) | `presentation.policy.hidden_scores` (`global`) | score context menu + Sleep settings | hides display, never disables computation (anti-orthosomnia) | all shown |
| HR zones | `zones.method`, `zones.per_sport` (`global`) | Fitness settings → zone editor | multi-method (%max/%HRR/LTHR/manual) per-sport; changes annotate charts; recompute explicit + versioned (§19.6) | %max from estimate |
| Calculation methods | `calc.<method_key>` (`global`) | Profile→Calculations (Bevel parity, inline explainers) | HRV/RHR derivation, sampling windows, temp method, merge-manual-sleep; each change triggers explicit recompute offer | recommended set |

### 19.5 Preset apply + diff-preview algorithm
`core-model/customization/PresetDiffEngine.kt`:
1. Load target preset YAML → flatten to `(scope, key, value)` set P.
2. Read user's current effective rows → set C.
3. Diff per key: `ADDED` (in P not C), `REMOVED` (module lists only — modules present in C's layout absent from P), `CHANGED` (both, values differ), `PROTECTED` (changed AND `preset_origin IS NULL`, i.e., hand-customized).
4. Classify: all preset diffs are **display-only** by construction — presets never touch dictionary/data tables, so "applying one never deletes user data or custom entities" (v1 §19.3) is structural, not policy.
5. Render grouped preview (per surface): added/removed/changed modules with thumbnails; PROTECTED keys listed separately with per-key "keep mine / take preset" toggles (default: keep mine).
6. Apply = single transaction upserting accepted keys, stamping `preset_origin`; write undo snapshot (previous rows JSON) to `customization_profiles` under `scope='global', key='preset.undo_snapshot'` (one-slot, 30-day TTL).
Presets are re-applyable and mixable per-surface (apply Athlete to `pillar.fitness` only via scope filter on step 1).

### 19.6 Customization export/import
Customization state is itself data (v1 §19.4): exportable/restorable JSON `badan-customization.v1.json` — top-level keys: `schema_version`, `exported_at`, `app_version`, `preset_lineage` (applied preset ids + versions), `profiles[]` (raw rows minus `user_id`/`device_origin`), `dictionaries_ref` (note: custom foods/symptoms travel in the data export, not here). Import validates every row against `contracts/customization/keys/*.schema.json`, ignores unknown keys with a warning list, and runs guardrail validation (§19.7) before commit. Included in the full ZIP archive export (§20.3) and restorable independently — prevents the "new phone reset my app" trust break. Per-domain law carried from v1 §19.6: terminology preferences never rename exported columns (exports use stable ids + chosen-language display columns); zone changes annotate charts and never silently redefine retroactive strain.

### 19.7 Anti-chaos guardrails as validation rules
Enforced in `CustomizationRepository.validate()` (write-time) and as import checks; rule ids stable for telemetry (`customization_rule_hit` analytics event, property: rule_id).

| Rule id | Rule | Behavior on violation |
|---|---|---|
| CG-01 | module count per surface ≤ `maxTodayModules` (policy) hard-cap 12 | overflow modules auto-move to "More" row; write succeeds with notice |
| CG-02 | layout must retain ≥1 module | reject write |
| CG-03 | safety-relevant module lint: hiding `meds_due` while ≥1 active regimen exists | warn dialog required ("meds reminders continue via notifications"); write allowed after confirm |
| CG-04 | value_json must validate against key schema; unknown key rejected | reject write with `AppError.InvalidCustomization` |
| CG-05 | per-metric unit override must be a registry-listed unit variant for that metric | reject write |
| CG-06 | "Reset all customization" requires export-first prompt (offer §19.6 export) | flow gate, not write gate |
| CG-07 | widget configs referencing sensitive-class metrics require the widget-level sensitive opt-in flag set (§24.2) | reject write until flag set |
| CG-08 | design-system enforcement: layout values reference only registered module ids from `contracts/customization/modules.yaml` | reject write (user arrangements can't produce broken layouts) |

## 20. Raw data, reports, and export system

### 20.1 Strategy and ownership boundary
Export is BADAN's flagship trust feature and top-of-funnel differentiator (report: universal ❌ across WHOOP/Oura/Bevel; Medium-High demand). Design goal: *the best-documented personal health export in consumer software.* This section specifies the **product contract** — formats, columns, scopes, templates, API surface. Engine internals (streaming writers, chunked generation, checksum pipeline, job scheduling implementation) live in §56 (`core-export` implementation); the Raw Data Explorer screens are §16.5's S-58/59. Format schemas are frozen contracts under `contracts/export/schema/v1/` and follow semver with a published changelog; old schema majors remain readable via documented migration notes (v1 §20.5 carried).

### 20.2 CSV format — exact column set
Tidy long format, one file per metric family (`sleep.csv`, `vitals.csv`, …) plus `events.csv` for EventRecords and `derived.csv` for scores/baselines. UTF-8, RFC 4180, ISO-8601 timestamps with offset. Column contract (`contracts/export/schema/v1/csv-manifest.schema.json`):

| Column | Type | Nullable | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| record_id | string (ULID) | no | stable across re-exports |
| timestamp_start | ISO-8601 w/ offset | no | measured-at |
| timestamp_end | ISO-8601 w/ offset | yes | null for instant samples |
| timezone | IANA tz string | no | tz at measurement (§30.1 Provenance) |
| recorded_at | ISO-8601 w/ offset | no | ingestion time (retro-log detectable) |
| metric_id | string | no | registry id, e.g. `vitals.hrv_rmssd` |
| metric_display | string | no | chosen-language display column (§19.6: ids stable, display localized) |
| value | decimal string | no | canonical unit unless unit profile overrides |
| unit | string | no | UCUM-style token from registry |
| value_type | enum | no | `raw` \| `derived` \| `aggregate` |
| source_app | string | yes | bundle/package id |
| source_device | string | yes | model + name |
| ingestion_path | enum | no | platform \| vendor_direct \| broker \| import \| manual |
| import_batch_id | string | yes | one-tap-undo lineage (§30.5) |
| quality_flags | string | yes | semicolon list (`artifact_suspect;low_coverage`) |
| confidence | decimal 0–1 | yes | present when metric defines it |
| algorithm_id | string | yes | derived rows only |
| algorithm_version | string | yes | derived rows only; methodology link in manifest |
| suppressed_by | string | yes | winning record_id when dedup-suppressed (only when scope includes suppressed duplicates) |

### 20.3 JSON bundle structure
`badan-export.json` (schema `contracts/export/schema/v1/json-bundle.schema.json`), top-level key tree:

```
badan-export.json
├── schema_version            "1.x.y"
├── manifest                  (§20.5 fields, embedded)
├── dictionaries
│   ├── metrics[]             registry slice for exported metric ids (names EN+chosen, units, families)
│   ├── sources[]             source_connections + devices
│   ├── statuses[]            status taxonomy
│   ├── algorithms[]          id, version, methodology_url
│   └── units[]               unit tokens + conversion factors used
├── data
│   ├── samples[]             instant records
│   ├── interval_records[]    aggregates
│   ├── sessions[]            sleep/workout, nested stages/sets
│   ├── event_records[]       typed payloads (meal|symptom|medAdherence|note|status|labResult|cycleEvent|measurement)
│   ├── derived_values[]      with input_manifest refs
│   └── baselines[]           §22.2 entities
├── customization             optional (§19.6 object, included on full archive)
└── integrity
    ├── row_counts            per array
    └── sha256                per array, canonical-JSON serialization
```

### 20.4 SQLite bundle
Single file `badan.sqlite`, indexed, raw tables mirroring §30.1 plus **views mirroring the app's own queries** (the QS crowd's dream artifact). Shipped views (DDL in `contracts/export/schema/v1/sqlite-views.sql`): `v_daily_metrics` (one row per metric×day with value, baseline center/spread, z), `v_sleep_sessions`, `v_workouts`, `v_strength_sets`, `v_meals` (+ `v_meal_items`), `v_adherence` (regimen joined), `v_symptom_episodes` (recurrence-grouped), `v_baselines`, `v_score_anatomy` (derived value × input contributions), `v_lineage` (record → source chain → dedup decision), `v_dictionary` (metric registry slice). Parquet (Phase 3) exports `v_daily_metrics` and raw tables columnar. FHIR-shaped observations remain Phase 4, wellness-labeled (v1 §20.2 carried).

### 20.5 Manifest fields (every format, every export)

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| export_id | ULID | also names the artifact |
| generated_at | ISO-8601 | — |
| app_version / platform | string | — |
| export_schema_version | semver | per-format |
| scope | object | serialized `ExportScope` (§20.7) — the export is reproducible from its manifest |
| unit_profile | object | unit choices applied |
| display_language | BCP-47 | display columns language |
| timezone_policy | string | "timestamps carry original offsets; day boundaries computed in tz-at-measurement" + notes |
| dedup_policy | object | policy description + version; whether suppressed rows included |
| per_metric_row_counts | map | truncation detectable (v1 §20.5) |
| methodology_links | map | algorithm_id → public methodology page URL |
| checksums | map | file → sha256 |
| data_quality_note | string | coverage gaps summary for the period |

### 20.6 PDF report template inventory (Report Composer)
Composer flow: compose → live preview → share/save; casual users reach curated one-tap versions of the same engine ("Share this week"). Every template carries the mandatory footer: *"Personal wellness records collected by consumer devices and self-reports; not a medical record; accuracy varies by device."* Charts print-safe: color-blind-safe, grayscale-legible. Templates are content-CMS entries (`content/report-templates/`), rendered by `core-export` PDF-data assembly + platform PDF renderers (§56).

| Template id | Tone | Sections (ordered) |
|---|---|---|
| `physician_visit` | neutral-clinical, deliberately conservative formatting | cover context (period, sources, data-quality note) · vitals summary table (RHR/HRV/BP/temp: median, range, trend) · medications & adherence (regimen table + changes timeline) · symptoms log (chronological + frequency table) · lab results table · sleep summary · appendix: methodology + device list |
| `sleep_self_study` | neutral | cover · sleep score trend · duration/efficiency/stages tables · bedtime consistency chart · correlated factors (caffeine/alcohol/late meals, association-worded) · experiment results if any · methodology |
| `training_block_review` | warm-neutral | cover · load progression (strain, muscular load) · strength progression (e1RM, volume by muscle group) · cardio (zone time, pace trends, HRR) · recovery response · PRs/records · next-block observations |
| `full_annual` | warm | cover · Year-in-Body narrative (§22.9) · per-pillar year summaries · records & turning points · biomarker year table · data coverage report |
| `custom` | per verbosity setting | user-picked sections from the full section library; saved as reusable composition (`reports.saved_compositions` profile key) |
| `share_week` (one-tap) | warm, casual labels | tri-ring week strip · one narrative paragraph · 2 highlight stats — share-card sized |

### 20.7 Scoping model — `ExportScope`
Any export = format × scope (v1 §20.3). DTO in `core-model/export/ExportScope.kt`, serialized into every manifest:

```kotlin
data class ExportScope(
    val metricSelector: MetricSelector,       // All | Pillar(id) | Collection(id) | Metrics(ids)
    val dateRange: DateRange,                 // preset (last30d, thisYear…) or custom; closed-open, tz policy per manifest
    val sourceFilter: SourceFilter,           // includeAll | include(ids) | exclude(ids)
    val includeSuppressedDuplicates: Boolean, // default false
    val payloadKinds: Set<PayloadKind>,       // RAW, DERIVED — separated in output, never merged columns
    val unitProfileId: String,                // 'canonical' | 'display' | custom profile
    val displayLanguage: String,              // BCP-47
    val sensitiveClassesIncluded: Set<SensitiveClass>, // e.g. CYCLE — each requires explicit confirm toggle (§20.10)
)
```

### 20.8 Scheduled & automated exports (Pro)
Job model in `export_jobs` table (`core-db`): `job_id, kind ('one_off'|'scheduled'), schedule_rrule (RFC 5545 RRULE, weekly/monthly presets), format, scope_json, destination ('files'|'icloud'|'drive'|'webhook'), destination_config_json (encrypted), last_run_at, last_status, next_run_at, created_at`. Runner: `core-export/ScheduledExportRunner.kt` invoked by platform background schedulers (BGProcessingTask / WorkManager, §32.3); failures notify once via `core-notify` with retry backoff 1h/6h/24h; every run appends to export history (S-63) and emits domain event `ExportCompleted` + analytics `export_completed` (properties: format, kind — no scope contents). Shortcuts/App-Intents expose "export last month as CSV" (`ExportIntent` in `ios/BadanIntents/`, app-actions on Android). Webhook destination is Phase 3, gated `ff_export_scheduled`.

### 20.9 Personal API (Phase 3)
Read-only REST (`contracts/api/personal-api-openapi.yaml`), personal access tokens, rate-limited (60 req/min), token audit log in Privacy dashboard. Local-only users get a device-local export server alternative (LAN, user-initiated) — parity for the cloudless (v1 §20.8). Scope table:

| Scope | Grants (read-only) |
|---|---|
| `read:sleep` | sleep sessions, sleep-family metrics |
| `read:vitals` | vitals family incl. HRV/RHR/BP/temp/respiratory |
| `read:activity` | activity + workouts (excl. strength set detail) |
| `read:strength` | strength sessions + sets |
| `read:nutrition` | meals, hydration, nutrition aggregates |
| `read:scores` | derived scores + baselines + anatomy manifests |
| `read:logs` | symptoms, journal, conditions (NOT meds) |
| `read:medications` | regimens + adherence (separate, deliberate) |
| `read:cycle` | sensitive class; extra confirm at token creation |
| `read:exports` | trigger/download export artifacts |

No write scopes in v1 of the API. Tokens are per-scope-set, named, expiring (max 1y), revocable individually; every request logged (token id, scope, endpoint, timestamp — no payloads).

### 20.10 Privacy & deletion interplay (carried, binding)
Deletion flow offers final export first; exports are user-initiated artifacts (BADAN doesn't retain copies post-delivery beyond transient generation); shared-report links (if used) are expiring and revocable; sensitive-class data (cycle) requires an extra confirmation toggle (`sensitiveClassesIncluded`) to include in any export or template that leaves the device. Raw Data Explorer (v1 §20.4) remains the pre-export microscope: users who can *see* raw data trust exports sight-unseen; "why is this value X" self-serves through lineage sheets (S-58/59, §16.5).

## 21. Food, exercise, symptoms, medications, and issues logging

### 21.1 Logging doctrine and the shared write path
Doctrine (v1, binding): repeat case ≤3 interactions (P8); every log editable/deletable with audit trail; retro-logging first-class (backdate picker on every flow); all flows work offline; every logged entity writes back to platform stores where supported and toggled.

**Shared write path (all domains).** `XxxCommand` (view-facing use case, `core-model/logging/commands/`) → validation → repository transaction into `event_records` (typed payload, schema-versioned per §30.1) or the domain's dedicated table → domain event on the internal bus → listeners: `DerivedValueRecalcScheduler` (invalidates affected daily aggregates), `WriteBackOutbox` (platform write-back with self-source filtering, §11.5), `RampRuleEngine` (§17.5), `AnalyticsClient` (shape-only event). Edits create a new payload version with `edited_at` + prior version retained (audit trail); deletes are tombstones that also retract write-back. Optimistic UI + 5s undo per §26.4.

### 21.2 Food logging (deepest domain)
**Pathways (v1 carried):** database search (verified-first ranking, regional DBs); barcode; photo AI (multi-item detection → per-item confidence chips → correction UI); describe (free text/voice; fast model for simple, capable model for complex); favorites/recents/meals ("my usual breakfast" one-tap); recipe builder (ingredients → per-serving math); quick-calories fallback (kcal-only, logged honestly as low-detail).

**Entities** — `core/core-model/logging/FoodItem.kt`, `Portion.kt`, `MealEntry.kt`:

```kotlin
data class FoodItem(
    val id: String,                          // ULID
    val kind: FoodItemKind,                  // CANONICAL, BRANDED, USER, RECIPE
    val name: LocalizedText,
    val brand: String?,
    val providerRef: ProviderRef?,           // provider id + provider item id + db snapshot version
    val nutrientsPer100g: NutrientVector,    // energyKcal, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sugar, addedSugar,
                                             // sodium, caffeineMg, alcoholGrams, micros: Map<MicronutrientId, Double>
    val defaultPortions: List<Portion>,
    val densityGPerMl: Double?,              // null blocks volume portions with explainer
    val verified: Boolean,
    val barcodeGtin: String?
)

data class Portion(val label: LocalizedText, val grams: Double, val isVolume: Boolean)

data class MealItem(
    val foodItemId: String,
    val portion: Portion, val quantity: Double,
    val nutrientsResolved: NutrientVector,   // snapshot at log time — provider updates never rewrite history
    val aiConfidence: Double?                // per-item, when AI-derived
)

data class MealEntry(
    val id: String,
    val at: Instant, val timezone: TimeZone,
    val mealType: MealType,                  // BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, SNACK, UNSPECIFIED
    val items: List<MealItem>,               // empty allowed only when method == QUICK_KCAL
    val quickKcal: Double?,                  // QUICK_KCAL only; quality_flags += LOW_DETAIL
    val method: LogMethod,                   // SEARCH, BARCODE, PHOTO_AI, DESCRIBE_AI, FAVORITE, RECIPE, QUICK_KCAL
    val tags: List<String>, val note: String?,
    val provenance: Provenance
)
```

**Tables:** `food_items` (local dictionary cache + user/custom/recipe items), `food_correction_aliases`, `recipes` (ingredient graph), meal entries as `event_records(event_type='meal')`. Write path: `LogMealCommand(draft: MealDraft)` → validates (quantity>0; time ≤ now+5min; items nonempty unless QUICK_KCAL) → `EventRecordRepository.insertMeal` → `MealLogged` event → recalc `nutrition.energy_in` daily aggregate, auto-tag pass, HealthKit/HC dietary write-back, RAMP-02.

**Provider-proxy contract** (`backend/services/fooddata/`, paths in `contracts/api/backend-openapi.yaml`): `GET /food/search?q&locale&limit` (verified-first ranking, regional DB routing by locale), `GET /food/barcode/{gtin}`, `GET /food/item/{provider}/{itemId}`. Proxy normalizes provider nutrient keys to registry units server-side; responses carry `db_snapshot_version` for cache invalidation; device caches hits into `food_items` for offline re-logging; p50 search <400ms; provider outage → device serves cache + user items with a "search limited" banner (no hard failure).

**AI-parse DTO** (photo + describe share one shape; §23.6 routes the model call):

```kotlin
data class FoodParseResultDto(
    val requestId: String,
    val items: List<ParsedFoodItemDto>,
    val modelId: String, val modelVersion: String, val latencyMs: Long
)
data class ParsedFoodItemDto(
    val rawSpan: String,                       // text span or photo region ref
    val candidates: List<ScoredCandidateDto>,  // top-3 foodItem candidates with match score
    val portionEstimate: PortionEstimateDto,   // grams + p10/p90 range → the ± range shown in power mode
    val confidence: Double,                    // 0..1 → chip color; < 0.70 ⇒ needsReview
    val needsReview: Boolean
)
```

**Correction-alias entity** (`food_correction_aliases` table): `alias_id, phrase_normalized ("toast"), locale, resolution_json (List<MealItem>), hit_count, last_used_at`. Every AI correction the user makes is stored as a personal alias; `FoodParsePreprocessor` checks aliases BEFORE any model call — repeat phrases short-circuit to a zero-latency, zero-cost local resolution ("my 'toast' = 2 slices whole wheat + butter"). Aliases are user data: synced, exported, editable in Nutrition settings.

**Quality honesty & auto-tags (v1 carried):** AI portions carry ± ranges; daily kcal shows an uncertainty hint in power mode (`showConfidenceNumeric`); auto-tags late-meal, high-added-sugar, keto-day, fasting-window-break computed by `core-scoring/nutrition/AutoTagger.kt` with a visible rubric page each. Micros: platform-standard vitamin/mineral set, dot-matrix visualization, "top gaps this week" insight. Hydration/caffeine/alcohol: preset-volume quick logs; caffeine cutoff-time insight hook; alcohol units wired as sleep covariate (§22.2).

**Edge cases:** retro-log across timezone change (day assignment uses tz-at-`at`, not current); barcode miss → inline "create item" flow (kind=USER, optional label-photo OCR later); describe-parse offline → draft saved locally, banner offers search instead (no queued cloud calls with stale context); volume portion with unknown density → blocked with explainer; write-back echo (our own HK dietary record re-imported) suppressed by self-source filter (E-02.4); deleting a meal retracts write-back + recomputes aggregates + auto-tags.

**Feature homes:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/FoodLog/` (`FoodLogScreen.swift`, `FoodSearchViewModel.swift`, `PhotoParseReviewScreen.swift`, `RecipeBuilderScreen.swift`), `android/.../features/foodlog/` (same trio + `FoodLogUiState.kt`); shared logic `core-model/logging/food/`.

**Tests (5):** (1) alias short-circuit: second "toast" parse makes zero network calls, resolves identically; (2) confidence chip: fixture parse with 0.62 confidence renders needsReview state and correction UI; (3) recipe math golden: 7-ingredient recipe per-serving nutrients match hand-computed fixture; (4) write-back echo excluded by dedup conformance case; (5) retro-log 11:40 PM in origin tz lands on correct day + triggers late-meal auto-tag.

## 22. Analytics and longitudinal intelligence

### 22.1 The intelligence stack as a pipeline
```
Baselines → Deviations → Trends → Patterns/Correlations → Experiments → Narratives
```
Each layer consumes the one below; every output carries evidence pointers + confidence (v1 law). Computation homes: baselines/deviations/trends in `core/core-baseline/` (which also owns the shared robust-stat kernels `core-baseline/stats/RobustStats.kt`); scores in `core/core-scoring/`; correlations/experiments/narrative generation in `core/core-insight/` (outputs are insight-shaped cards). All outputs are `DerivedValue`s or `Baseline`s — append-only, versioned (§30.1); scheduling by the compute scheduler (§32.3); registry-declared formulas per §10.17.

### 22.2 BaselineEngine
`core-baseline/BaselineEngine.kt`. **Inputs:** per-metric daily series from `DerivedValueRepository` / `SampleRepository`; status intervals (`event_records` type=status); cycle phase from the cycle engine (E-14); season derivation from date. **Method:** rolling window per metric class — 14d vitals, 28d load, 60–90d labs-adjacent (window declared per metric in `contracts/metrics/registry/*.yaml`, field `baseline_window_days`); robust statistics: median center + MAD spread (scaled ×1.4826), 10%-trimmed-mean available as registry option; minimum coverage before non-provisional (e.g., ≥10 of 14 days for vitals; per-registry `baseline_min_coverage`); backfill-seeded from history at first connect (P4, §11.7).

**Covariate context keys** (string keys on the `Baseline` entity; conditioning per v1 §22.2):
- `default` — all qualifying days, sick/travel status days EXCLUDED (the default exclusion)
- `cycle_phase:menstrual|follicular|ovulatory|luteal` — phase-conditioned bands (E-14)
- `status:sick`, `status:travel` — separately banded so "your sick-RHR" is knowable, never mixed into default
- `season:q1..q4` — seasonal-window comparison for power views (winter RHR drift guard)

**Baseline entity fields** (materialized to `baselines` table — queryable, exportable, explainable per §30.1):

```kotlin
data class Baseline(
    val metricId: String, val windowDays: Int,
    val covariateContext: String,          // key above
    val center: Double,                    // median
    val spread: Double,                    // scaled MAD
    val n: Int, val coverageRatio: Double,
    val provisional: Boolean,
    val inputRangeStart: LocalDate, val inputRangeEnd: LocalDate,
    val algorithmVersion: String, val computedAt: Instant
)
```

### 22.3 Deviation & anomaly layer
`core-baseline/DeviationEngine.kt`. **Z-score computation:** for day value x against the applicable context baseline, `z = (x − center) / spread`; context selection order: active status context → cycle-phase context (if module active and metric phase-sensitive per registry flag) → default. Artifact filters run FIRST: records with `quality_flags` containing `artifact_suspect` are excluded before z computation (a 40-minute compression-artifact HR spike must not become an "anomaly" — v1 law).

**Composite rules** (declared in `core-baseline/composite/CompositeRules.kt`, thresholds remote-tunable):
- `COMP-VITALS-01`: ≥3 of {`vitals.rhr` z ≥ +1.5, `vitals.hrv_rmssd` z ≤ −1.5, `vitals.resp_rate` z ≥ +1.5, wrist-temp deviation ≥ +0.3 °C} on the same day → composite deviation, salience `elevated` ("3 vitals off together" beats any single one).
- Persistence gate: composite must persist ≥2 consecutive days before it may notify; single-day composites fold into the daily narrative only.
- Output: `DerivedValue(metricId="recovery.composite_deviation")` with `InputManifest` listing contributing z-scores. Anomalies are *calm by design*: bundled into narrative unless severity + persistence cross thresholds → then exactly one respectful notification through `core-notify` budgets.

### 22.4 Trend layer
`core-baseline/trend/RollingDeltaCalculator.kt`. **Spec (Bevel-parity 3/7/14/30/90d, everywhere):** for each window w ∈ {3, 7, 14, 30, 90}: `delta_w = mean(days [T−w+1, T]) − mean(days [T−2w+1, T−w])`; `pct_w = delta_w / |previous-window mean|`; emitted as `DerivedValue`s `<metric>.delta_3d … .delta_90d` feeding the L3 Trends-Analysis table (§8.4). **Meaningful-change flag:** `|delta_w| ≥ 0.8 × pooled MAD` of the two windows (effect size, not just direction — the report's "distinguish meaningful long-term changes from nightly noise" requirement made explicit); windows with coverage <60% render as "insufficient data", never silently computed. Typical-range bands on all charts come straight from `baselines` rows (band = center ± 1 MAD-spread, lookup not model run); >1-year horizons use decimation-preserving-extremes tiers (§30.2).

### 22.5 Explainable scores — Score Anatomy data capture
Every score = documented model (weighted inputs → transforms → output) + per-day input snapshot stored. The snapshot is the `InputManifest`, persisted as JSON on the `derived_values` row (§30.1):

```kotlin
data class InputManifest(
    val derivedValueId: String,
    val algorithmId: String, val algorithmVersion: String,
    val inputs: List<InputContribution>,
    val computedAt: Instant
)
data class InputContribution(
    val metricId: String,
    val rawValue: Double?, val baselineCenter: Double?, val zScore: Double?,
    val covariateContext: String,
    val weight: Double, val contributionPoints: Double,   // signed points on the final score
    val qualityFlags: List<String>, val sourceRecordIds: List<String>
)
```

The Anatomy sheet renders contributions directly from this ("HRV −14% vs your phase-adjusted baseline pulled Readiness down ~9 points" = `contributionPoints = −9` on the `vitals.hrv_rmssd` row). The one-word ring driver (§17.3) is the max-|contribution| input. **Perceived-gap calibration:** "doesn't match how I feel" feedback (§18.4) stores `(scoreValue, perceivedDirection, inputPatternHash)` in `perceived_gap_events`; recurring patterns surface in Anatomy ("you often feel better than this score after short-but-deep sleep").

### 22.6 Comparisons: self-first, cohort-optional (carried)
Default: self-referenced everything. Optional cohort context (Phase 3, opt-in, aggregated anonymized bands): "your HRV is typical for your age band" — never ranked, never leaderboarded, always dismissible-permanently. Cohort bands are downloaded static tables; no user data leaves the device for comparison (E2E posture §31 intact).

### 22.7 Correlation Lab — statistical gates
`core-insight/lab/CorrelationEngine.kt` (uses `core-baseline/stats/` kernels). User picks metric pairs or accepts suggested candidates; engine computes lagged associations under hard gates:

1. **Min-n gate:** requires ≥20 paired observations after artifact/status filtering; below it, UI shows progress ("keep logging, 8 more days") — never a weak result.
2. **Method:** Spearman rank correlation (robust to outliers/nonlinearity) at lags {0, +1, +2} days.
3. **Multiple-comparison correction:** Benjamini–Hochberg FDR at q = 0.10 whenever a scan evaluates >5 pairs; suggested-candidate scans always corrected.
4. **Confounder screen:** both metrics tested against day-of-week factor; shared association → warning string ("both differ on weekends — this may explain the link").
5. **Mandatory phrasing:** strength words only, from |rho| bands — <0.2 "no clear association", 0.2–0.4 "weak", 0.4–0.6 "moderate", >0.6 "strong"; never causal (guardrail GR-CAUSAL-01, §23.8).

```kotlin
data class CorrelationResultDto(
    val metricA: String, val metricB: String, val lagDays: Int,
    val n: Int, val rho: Double, val pValue: Double, val qValue: Double?,
    val strengthWord: StrengthWord, val confounderWarnings: List<String>,
    val phrasingTemplateId: String, val computedAt: Instant
)
```
Result cards are saveable to reports (§20.6 section library) and revisitable as data grows (re-run banner when n has grown ≥25%).

### 22.8 Experiments engine — state machine
`core-insight/experiments/ExperimentEngine.kt`; definitions in `experiment_definitions` (via §30.1 `ExperimentDefinition`). Structured n-of-1 on a user-chosen variable (habit tag / med-change / bedtime shift) against 1–3 outcome metrics.

| State | Entry action | Exit condition |
|---|---|---|
| DRAFT | user defines variable + outcomes | user starts → BASELINE_CAPTURE |
| BASELINE_CAPTURE | auto-select baseline window (≥14 qualifying days pre-start, status days excluded) | window valid → ACTIVE; insufficient history → blocked with "start after N more days" |
| ACTIVE | min duration enforced (registry per variable type, default 14d); interim peeking soft-locked (progress visible, effect hidden, with explanation) | duration met → WASHOUT? (optional per design) else ANALYSIS; user abandon → ABANDONED |
| WASHOUT | optional cooldown days excluded from analysis | elapsed → ANALYSIS |
| ANALYSIS | compute effect: difference of robust means (active vs baseline) / pooled MAD; CI via bootstrap (1,000 resamples) | → CONCLUDED |
| CONCLUDED | result card: effect estimate + confidence language + "what would make this more reliable" (longer run, better logging coverage) | user may clone → DRAFT |
| ABANDONED | partial data retained, marked; no result claims | — |

This operationalizes the report's counterfactual-suggestion ambition without pseudo-science (v1 law). All result phrasing passes §23.8 guardrails; effects never phrased causally beyond "during the experiment, X averaged …".

### 22.9 Reporting cadence generators
Homes in `core-insight/cadence/`: `DailyNarrativeGenerator` (sentence→paragraph by verbosity), `WeeklyDigestGenerator` (what changed, one focus, adherence recap), `MonthlyReportGenerator` (trend confirmations, experiment results, biomarker updates), `YearInBodyGenerator` (story-format: totals, records, turning points, "your body's year in 12 charts" — retention landmark + share-card generator, template `full_annual` §20.6). Each consumes the same insight graph (§8.5 narrative spine — consistent story at all zoom levels), emits `ReportGenerated`, and renders through the AI layer (§23) or deterministic templates when AI is off.
