## 30. Data architecture and domain modeling

### 30.1 Modeling doctrine (v1 decisions, made binding)

The four v1 §30.1 decisions are frozen and restated here as testable invariants, each owned by a named module:

1. **Provenance is a struct on every record** (`core-model/Provenance.kt`), embedded (not joined) in `samples`, `interval_records`, `sessions`, `event_records`, `derived_values`. Enforced by `core-testing/conformance/ProvenancePresenceTest.kt` which reflects over all row types and fails if any persisted domain row lacks the struct.
2. **DerivedValue never overwrites.** `DerivedValueRepository.append()` is the only write path; there is no `update()`. Recomputation appends a row with a new `algorithmVersion`; `latest_derived_values` (a SQL view, physical schema in §52) serves reads. Guarded by `DerivedImmutabilityTest`.
3. **EventRecord is a closed union** — `sealed interface EventPayload` in `core-model` with exactly the types inventoried in §30.7.8; each payload carries `payloadSchemaVersion: Int`. Adding a variant requires a contracts ADR (§47) plus migration test.
4. **Baselines are materialized entities**, keyed `(metricId, windowId, covariateContext)`, so band rendering is a table lookup (`BaselineRepository.bandFor()`), never a runtime model run.
5. Full event sourcing remains rejected (v1 §30.3); the replacement pair is the **append-only ingestion log** (`ingest_log`, raw payload retention per §11.3, replayed by §51's pipeline) + immutable derived versioning above.

Ownership boundary: this section defines entities, fields, and policies. Physical `.sq` files, DAOs, and migrations live in `core/core-db` and are specified in §52; the ingestion pipeline that writes most of these rows is §51; the sync implementation moving them is §53; derived-value computation is §54.

### 30.2 Identity and key strategy (ULID)

- **Type:** `value class Ulid(val value: String)` in `core-model/ids/Ulid.kt` — 26-char Crockford base32, 48-bit ms timestamp + 80-bit randomness. Sortable (chronological index locality), offline-generatable, no coordination.
- **Random ids** for user-authored rows (event records, goals, notes): `Ulid.new(clockPort.now())`.
- **Deterministic ids** for platform/vendor/import rows: `Ulid.deterministic(ns, sourceUid, metricId, measuredAtMs)` — SHA-256 over the tuple, truncated into the ULID random field, timestamp field set from `measuredAt`. Re-syncing the same HealthKit/Health Connect record therefore produces the same primary key → idempotent upsert, the §34.3 "no conflicts possible" property.
- **Namespace registry:** `ns` values are fixed strings in `core-model/ids/IdNamespaces.kt`: `hk`, `hc`, `garmin`, `dexcom`, `broker.terra`, `import.applezip`, `import.csv`, `manual`, `derived`. Adding one is a contracts change.
- **Batch ids:** every ingestion pass stamps `Provenance.batchId` (a ULID); `ImportBatch` rows make archive imports one-tap undoable (§30.7.21).
- **Collision policy:** deterministic collision = same record by definition (upsert); random collision probability is ignored by design but `DbIntegrityJob` (§32) counts PK-conflict errors as a telemetry beacon `db_pk_conflict`.

### 30.3 Provenance — full field table

`core-model/Provenance.kt`, serialized name `prov` (embedded object in JSON export; flattened `prov_*` columns in CSV per §20.2).

| Field | Kotlin type | Required | Meaning / source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ingestPath` | `enum IngestPath { PLATFORM, VENDOR, BROKER, MANUAL, IMPORT, DERIVED }` | yes | which of the five §11.2 paths (plus DERIVED for engine outputs) |
| `sourceConnectionId` | `Ulid?` | platform/vendor/broker/import | FK → `source_connections` |
| `sourceDeviceId` | `Ulid?` | when device known | FK → `source_devices` |
| `sourceAppBundleId` | `String?` | platform paths | e.g. `com.apple.health`, writer app bundle |
| `platformRecordUid` | `String?` | platform paths | HK UUID / HC record id — dedup + deterministic id input |
| `measuredAt` | `Instant` | yes | when the body produced the value |
| `measuredEndAt` | `Instant?` | intervals/sessions | interval end |
| `recordedAt` | `Instant` | yes | when the source wrote it |
| `ingestedAt` | `Instant` | yes | when BADAN's pipeline accepted it |
| `tzId` | `String` | yes | IANA zone at measurement (`Asia/Muscat`) |
| `tzOffsetMin` | `Int` | yes | offset snapshot (survives tz-db changes) |
| `batchId` | `Ulid` | yes | ingestion/import batch |
| `adapterVersion` | `String` | yes | `port-health-ios@1.4.0` etc. |
| `pipelineVersion` | `Int` | yes | §51 normalization pipeline version stamp |
| `originalUnit` | `String?` | when converted | pre-normalization unit (Law 5; exports show both) |
| `originalValue` | `Double?` | when converted lossily | pre-conversion numeric |
| `writerNote` | `String?` | manual/import | free context ("caregiver-assisted entry") |

### 30.4 QualityFlags — enum inventory

`core-model/QualityFlags.kt`: `value class QualityFlags(val bits: Long)` bitmask; export as comma-joined snake names in the `quality_flags` column.

| Flag | Bit | Set by (module/stage) | UI consequence | Baseline/scoring consequence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GAP_FILLED` | 0 | `core-ingest/GapFiller` | amber dot | weight-reduced in baselines |
| `ARTIFACT_SUSPECTED` | 1 | `core-ingest/ArtifactClassifier` | flagged in Raw Explorer | excluded from baselines |
| `PHYSIO_BOUNDS_VIOLATION` | 2 | bounds check (§51 stage 5) | hidden from charts by default | excluded |
| `SENSOR_COMPRESSION` | 3 | CGM V-shape classifier | "possible pressure artifact" tag | excluded from variability stats (toggleable) |
| `CLOCK_SKEW_QUARANTINED` | 4 | future-timestamp guard | quarantine list (S-58) | excluded until released |
| `DST_ADJUSTED` | 5 | tz resolver | none | aggregate math uses 23/25h day rules |
| `USER_CORRECTED` | 6 | edit flows | pencil glyph | corrected value wins |
| `MANUAL_OVERRIDE` | 7 | dedup manual-wins rule | "kept your entry" note | manual value feeds baselines |
| `DUPLICATE_SUPPRESSED` | 8 | `DedupEngine` | visible only in lineage (S-59) | excluded everywhere; `suppressed_by` set |
| `IMPORT_UNVERIFIED` | 9 | archive importers | "unverified" chip on food items | normal |
| `ESTIMATED_PORTION` | 10 | food photo/describe AI | ± range chip | uncertainty propagates to kcal totals |
| `LOW_SAMPLE_COUNT` | 11 | session assembler | coverage note ("from 43 samples") | confidence penalty in scores |
| `PARTIAL_COVERAGE` | 12 | aggregate computer | "partial" badge | `DerivedValue.confidence` lowered |
| `PROVISIONAL_BASELINE` | 13 | `BaselineEngine` | calibration badge + countdown | narrative uses provisional phrasing |
| `DERIVED_FROM_PARTIAL_INPUTS` | 14 | `ScoringEngine` | Anatomy sheet note | score marked partial, never zero |
| `UNIT_CONVERTED_LOSSY` | 15 | unit normalizer | power-mode tooltip | none |

Rule: flags are append-only within a record's life; clearing a flag requires a new pipeline pass (new `pipelineVersion`), preserving auditability.

### 30.5 Sync classes

Every table carries a static sync class (column `sync_class` in the oplog, §53). Enforcement is §34.6.

| Class | Contents | Syncs? | Consent gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| `S0_LOCAL` | derived_values, baselines, caches, FTS indexes, insights (regenerable) | never | — |
| `S1_STANDARD` | samples, interval_records, sessions, standard event_records, goals, collections | E2E, on sync opt-in | sync consent |
| `S2_SENSITIVE` | cycle events, symptoms, meds/adherence, conditions, glucose, lab results | E2E, separate channel | per-class consent (§28.2) |
| `S3_CONFIG` | customization_profiles, saved filters, metric collections layout | E2E, LWW-per-key | sync consent |
| `S4_IDENTITY` | account, entitlements, consent_records (receipt copies) | server-visible (not E2E) | account creation |

### 30.6 Aggregate boundaries (transactional units)

Writes cross aggregate boundaries only via domain events (§30.8), never in one transaction — keeps SQLite transactions short and sync units coherent.

| Aggregate root | Members in same transaction | Invariant protected |
|---|---|---|
| `Session` | session row + typed payload + stage/lap child rows | a session is never visible half-assembled |
| `EventRecord(MealEntry)` | meal row + item lines + portion rows | kcal totals always match item sum |
| `MedicationRegimen` | regimen + schedule rows | schedule edits atomic; adherence events are a *separate* aggregate (append-only) |
| `DerivedValue` | derived row + its `InputManifest` | no score without its evidence snapshot |
| `ImportBatch` | batch row + status transitions (member rows committed in chunked child transactions tagged by `batchId`) | undo-ability |
| `ExperimentDefinition` | definition + window rows | window math consistent |
| `SyncOplogEntry` | oplog row + the entity row it describes | oplog never lies about local state |

### 30.7 Entity deep-dive

#### 30.7.0 Entity index (type ↔ table ↔ wire name ↔ policies at a glance)

| Entity (Kotlin type, `core-model`) | Table | Serialization | Sync | Deletion semantics | Primary writer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UserProfile` | `user_profile` | `user_profile.v1` | S3 | full-wipe only | onboarding/Settings |
| `SourceConnection` | `source_connections` | `source_connection.v1` | S3 (sans auth) | soft-revoke, never removed | S-15 wizard, §51 connectors |
| `SourceDevice` | `source_devices` | `source_device.v1` | S1 | never (provenance) | ingestion metadata |
| `MetricDefinition` | `metric_definitions` | `metric_definition.v2` | none (contracts-loaded) | versioned replace | `MetricRegistry` |
| `Sample` | `samples` | `sample.v1` | S1/S2 | suppress; hard-delete manual-origin only | `NormalizationPipeline` |
| `IntervalRecord` | `interval_records` | `interval_record.v1` | S1 (RAW tier only) | as Sample | `NormalizationPipeline` |
| `Session` (+payloads) | `sessions` | `session.v1` / `sleep_session.v2` / `workout_session.v2` | S1 | suppress; manual hard-delete | `SessionAssembler` |
| `EventRecord` (union) | `event_records` | `event_record.v1` + payload names | S1/S2 per type | hard-delete + tombstone | log flows, importers |
| `DerivedValue` | `derived_values` | `derived_value.v3` | **S0 never** | cache semantics, recomputable | `ScoringEngine` |
| `InputManifest` | `input_manifests` | `input_manifest.v1` | S0 | compaction (latest+2 versions) | `ScoringEngine` |
| `Baseline` | `baselines` | `baseline.v2` | S0 | 180d supersession compaction | `BaselineEngine` |
| `Insight` | `insights` | `insight.v2` | S0 (feedback S3) | TTL sweep | `InsightEngine` |
| `Goal` | `goals` | `goal.v1` | S1 | archive; hard-delete allowed | goal flows |
| `ExperimentDefinition` | `experiment_definitions` | `experiment.v1` | S1 | abandon state; hard-delete DRAFT only | S-34/35 |
| `MetricCollection` | `metric_collections` | `metric_collection.v1` | S3 | hard-delete (non-system) | customization |
| `MedicationRegimen` | `medication_regimens` | `medication_regimen.v2` | S2 | retire-first; guarded purge | meds hub |

Per-entity format: **Type (table · serialization name)** → purpose/writer · fields (required then `?`-optional) · lifecycle · relationships · indexing · sync class · export · deletion · audit. Physical DDL in §52; query plans in §35/§58.

#### 30.7.1 `UserProfile` (`user_profile` · `user_profile.v1`)
- **Purpose/writer:** singleton row; demographic + physiological config feeding scoring. Written by onboarding (S-13) and Settings; read by `core-scoring`, `core-baseline`.
- **Fields:** `id: Ulid`, `createdAt: Instant`, `dobMonth: YearMonth?` (month precision only — data minimization), `sexAtBirth: enum {FEMALE, MALE, UNSPECIFIED}?`, `heightCm: Double?`, `localePrimary: String`, `unitOverrides: Map<MetricFamily, UnitSystem>`, `depthMode: enum {CASUAL, BALANCED, POWER}`, `presetId: String?`, `maxHrOverride: Int?`, `zoneMethod: enum {PCT_MAX, PCT_HRR, LTHR, MANUAL}`, `accountId: String?` (null in local-only mode).
- **Lifecycle:** created-on-first-run → enriched → never deleted except with full wipe. **Relationships:** referenced implicitly by all (single-user DB). **Indexing:** none (singleton). **Sync:** S3_CONFIG (field-LWW). **Export:** `profile.json` minus `accountId`. **Deletion:** app-reset flow (S-104). **Audit:** field-change journal rows in `config_audit` (drives "settings changed → recompute" notices).

#### 30.7.2 `SourceConnection` (`source_connections` · `source_connection.v1`)
- **Purpose/writer:** one row per connected pipe (HealthKit, Health Connect, Garmin OAuth, broker link, import connector). Written by S-15 wizard and §51 connectors.
- **Fields:** `id: Ulid`, `kind: enum {PLATFORM, VENDOR, BROKER, IMPORT}`, `vendorId: String` (`hk`, `hc`, `garmin`, `dexcom`, `terra`, `applezip`…), `displayName: String`, `status: enum {CONNECTED, AUTH_EXPIRED, PAUSED_BY_USER, ERROR, REVOKED}`, `connectedAt: Instant`, `lastDeliveryAt: Instant?`, `authRef: String?` (keychain/keystore handle, never the token itself), `capabilities: Set<CapabilityId>`, `priorityRank: Int`, `hidden: Boolean`.
- **Lifecycle:** CONNECTED → (AUTH_EXPIRED ↔ CONNECTED) → REVOKED (terminal; history retained). **Relationships:** 1→N `SourceDevice`; referenced by `Provenance.sourceConnectionId`. **Indexing:** `(status)`, `(vendorId)`. **Sync:** S3_CONFIG (auth material never syncs — `authRef` is device-local). **Export:** source registry slice in every manifest (§20.5). **Deletion:** soft-revoke; rows persist so provenance chains never dangle. **Audit:** status transitions journaled → powers S-60 auth-health.

#### 30.7.3 `SourceDevice` (`source_devices` · `source_device.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id: Ulid`, `connectionId: Ulid`, `hardwareName: String` ("Apple Watch Series 10"), `model: String?`, `osVersion: String?`, `firstSeenAt: Instant`, `lastSeenAt: Instant`, `hidden: Boolean`, `dedupTier: Int` (wearable=0 > phone=1 > app-write=2 > manual=3, per §11.4).
- **Lifecycle:** discovered from record metadata; never user-created. **Indexing:** `(connectionId, lastSeenAt)`. **Sync:** S1. **Export:** device registry in manifest. **Deletion:** never (provenance). **Audit:** `lastSeenAt` drives staleness detection (fm-02).

#### 30.7.4 `MetricDefinition` (`metric_definitions` · `metric_definition.v2`)
- **Purpose/writer:** runtime cache of `contracts/metrics/registry/*.yaml`; loaded by `core-registry/MetricRegistry.kt` at startup + CMS-staged updates. UI binds to this table (E-01.3: registry row ⇒ browser row + detail screen, zero UI code).
- **Fields:** `metricId: String` (PK, `sleep.time_asleep`), `family: String`, `valueKind: enum {INSTANT, INTERVAL, SESSION, EVENT, SCORE}`, `canonicalUnit: String`, `displayUnits: List<UnitVariant>`, `namesLocalized: Map<Locale, MetricNames>` (casual + precise labels), `baselinePolicy: BaselinePolicy` (window days, robust-stat kind, phase-conditioning eligible), `chartKind: enum` (band-line, stacked-bar, ledger, diverging, event-freq, adherence, point-range per S-56), `depthVisibility: enum {ALWAYS, BALANCED_UP, POWER_ONLY}`, `derivation: DerivationSpec?` (inputs, algorithmId), `sensitiveClass: Boolean`, `registryVersion: Int`.
- **Lifecycle:** versioned replace on registry update; old versions retained for export dictionary reproducibility. **Indexing:** `(family)`, FTS over names (§35). **Sync:** not synced (each device loads contracts). **Export:** registry slice embedded per §20.2. **Audit:** `registryVersion` in every export manifest.

#### 30.7.5 `Sample` (`samples` · `sample.v1`) — the instant-value workhorse

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Ulid` | deterministic for platform rows (§30.2) |
| `metricId` | `String` | FK → registry |
| `value` | `Double` | SI-canonical unit |
| `prov` | `Provenance` | embedded |
| `flags` | `QualityFlags` | bitmask |
| `suppressedBy` | `Ulid?` | dedup pointer — winning record's id |
| `sessionId` | `Ulid?` | back-pointer when captured inside a session window |

- **Writer:** `core-ingest/NormalizationPipeline` only (manual instant entries become `Measurement` event records, not raw samples — human vs sensor authority stays typed).
- **Lifecycle:** immutable after insert except `suppressedBy` and flag appends. **Indexing:** `(metricId, measured_at)` composite (the load-bearing index), partial index `WHERE suppressed_by IS NULL` for hot reads (§35.3). **Sync:** S1/S2 by metric's sensitive flag. **Export:** tidy long CSV row (§20.2). **Deletion:** platform-revocation keeps history (dated); user hard-delete allowed for manual-origin only; import rows deleted via batch undo. **Audit:** dedup decisions in `dedup_journal` (§30.9).

#### 30.7.6 `IntervalRecord` (`interval_records` · `interval_record.v1`)
- Same shape as `Sample` plus `startAt/endAt: Instant`, `bucket: enum {RAW, MINUTE, HOUR, DAY}` (decimation tier, §30.10). Steps/energy/stand-minutes live here.
- **Indexing:** `(metricId, bucket, start_at)`; day-bucket rows power all charts ≤1Y. **Sync:** only `RAW` bucket syncs; coarser tiers recompute locally (bandwidth + §34.6 consistency). Other treatments as `Sample`.

#### 30.7.7 `Session` (`sessions` · `session.v1`, payloads `sleep_session.v2` / `workout_session.v2`)
- **Fields (common):** `id: Ulid`, `kind: enum {SLEEP, WORKOUT}`, `startAt/endAt`, `prov`, `flags`, `suppressedBy: Ulid?`, `mergedFrom: List<Ulid>` (multi-source merges keep loser ids), `payloadSchemaVersion: Int`, `payload: ByteArray` (proto/CBOR-encoded typed payload).
- **`SleepSessionPayload`:** `isPrimary: Boolean`, `stages: List<StageSpan>` (stage enum AWAKE/CORE/DEEP/REM, start, end), `latencyMin: Double?`, `efficiencyPct: Double?`, `continuityIndex: Double?`, `hrDipPct: Double?`, `overnightAggregates: Map<MetricId, Agg>` (RR, SpO₂, wrist temp), `interruptions: Int?`.
- **`WorkoutSessionPayload`:** `activityType: String` (cross-platform taxonomy id), `energyKcal: Double?`, `distanceM: Double?`, `hrSeriesRef: Ulid?` (pointer to decimated series blob), `zoneMinutes: Map<Int, Double>`, `laps: List<Lap>?`, `strength: List<ExerciseSet>?` (exerciseId, setIndex, reps, weightKg, rpe, supersetGroup), `perceivedEffort: Int?`.
- **Lifecycle:** assembled by `core-ingest/SessionAssembler` (stitching rules §51); user reclassify (nap↔primary) appends a correction, sets `USER_CORRECTED`. **Indexing:** `(kind, start_at)`, `(kind) WHERE suppressed_by IS NULL`. **Sync:** S1. **Export:** JSON nested; CSV as session summary + child files. **Deletion:** manual sessions hard-deletable; platform sessions suppress-only. **Audit:** `mergedFrom` + dedup journal make S-59 lineage renderable.

#### 30.7.8 `EventRecord` (`event_records` · `event_record.v1`) — closed union
Common envelope: `id: Ulid`, `type: EventType`, `occurredAt: Instant`, `endAt: Instant?`, `prov`, `flags`, `payloadSchemaVersion`, `payload` (typed). Typed payloads (each a `data class` in `core-model/events/`):

| Payload | Serialization | Key fields | Optional fields | Sync |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MealEntry` | `meal_entry.v2` | `items: List<MealItem>` (foodRef, portion, macros), `mealType: enum {BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER, SNACK}`, `method: enum {SEARCH, BARCODE, PHOTO_AI, DESCRIBE, QUICK_KCAL, RECIPE}` | `confidence: Double`, `tags: Set<String>` (late-meal…), `photoRef: Ulid?` | S1 |
| `SymptomEvent` | `symptom_event.v2` | `symptomId: String` (canonical dict) or `customLabel`, `severity: Int` (0–10 canonical; 3-level maps 2/5/8), `onsetAt` | `durationMin`, `ongoing: Boolean`, `bodyLocation: String?`, `triggerTags: Set<String>`, `note`, `attachmentRef` | S2 |
| `AdherenceEvent` | `adherence_event.v1` | `regimenId: Ulid`, `status: enum {TAKEN, LATE, SKIPPED}`, `scheduledSlot: LocalTime?` | `skipReason: enum {FORGOT, SIDE_EFFECT, OUT_OF_STOCK, DOCTOR_ADVICE, OTHER}?`, `note` | S2 |
| `LabResult` | `lab_result.v2` | `biomarkerId: String` (LOINC-style), `value: Double`, `unit: String`, `specimenAt: Instant` | `refLow/refHigh: Double?` (per-result override), `labName`, `fasted: Boolean?`, `sourceDoc: Ulid?` (PDF ref) | S2 |
| `StatusInterval` | `status_interval.v1` | `statusId: enum {ACTIVE, SICK, INJURED, ON_BREAK, TRAVELING, FASTING, HIGH_STRESS, MED_CHANGE, CUSTOM}`, `startAt`, `endAt?` | `customLabel`, `autoSuggested: Boolean`, `appliedRetroactively: Boolean` | S1 |
| `CycleEvent` | `cycle_event.v1` | `kind: enum {PERIOD_START, PERIOD_END, FLOW, SPOTTING, SYMPTOM_LINK}`, `flowLevel: enum?` | `modifiers: Set<enum {PREGNANT, POSTPARTUM, CONTRACEPTION}>` | S2 |
| `Measurement` | `measurement.v1` | `metricId: String` (weight, BP sys/dia pair, waist…), `value: Double`, `value2: Double?` (diastolic) | `deviceHint: String?` | S1 (S2 if metric sensitive) |
| `Note` | `note.v1` | `text: String` | `tags: Set<String>`, `attachmentRefs: List<Ulid>`, `moodValence: Int?`, `energyLevel: Int?` | S2 |

- **Indexing:** `(type, occurred_at)` + per-type partial indexes (`WHERE type='symptom'` on payload-extracted generated columns `symptom_id`, `severity` — §35.3). **Export:** per-type CSV files + unified JSON timeline. **Deletion:** user-authored ⇒ hard-delete with tombstone (§34.4); audit trail row retained without payload. **Audit:** every edit appends `event_edits` journal (before/after hash).

#### 30.7.9 `DerivedValue` (`derived_values` · `derived_value.v3`)

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `Ulid` | |
| `metricId` | `String` | scores are registry members (§10.17) |
| `periodKey` | `String` | `2026-07-09` day, `2026-W27` week — tz-resolved local period |
| `value` | `Double` | |

| `algorithmVersion` | `Int` | |

- **Writer:** `core-scoring`/`core-baseline` engines only (§54). **Lifecycle:** append-only; `latest` view = `WHERE superseded_by IS NULL`. **Indexing:** `(metricId, periodKey)`, `(metricId, periodKey) WHERE superseded_by IS NULL`. **Sync:** **S0_LOCAL — never syncs** (§34.6). **Export:** exported with `algorithm_id`+`version` columns, clearly separated from raw (§20.5). **Deletion:** wiped + recomputed freely (cache semantics with audit history). **Audit:** the version chain *is* the audit; powers fm-38 "scores re-derived" notices.

#### 30.7.10 `InputManifest` (`input_manifests` · `input_manifest.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id: Ulid`, `derivedValueId: Ulid`, `entries: List<ManifestEntry>` (`recordId: Ulid`, `recordTable: String`, `role: String` ("hrv_overnight"), `contributionWeight: Double?`, `valueAtCompute: Double`), `baselineRefs: List<Ulid>`, `covariatesApplied: Set<String>` ("cycle.luteal", "status.sick").
- Powers Score Anatomy (S-57) and export explainability. **Sync:** S0. **Indexing:** `(derivedValueId)`. **Deletion:** cascades with derived history compaction (keep manifests for latest + last 2 versions; compaction job §32.3).

#### 30.7.11 `Baseline` (`baselines` · `baseline.v2`)
- **Fields:** `id: Ulid`, `metricId`, `windowId: String` ("rolling_14d"), `covariateContext: String` ("phase:luteal", "status:none", "season:winter" — canonical sorted key), `center: Double` (median), `spread: Double` (MAD), `lowBand/highBand: Double`, `sampleCount: Int`, `coverageRatio: Double`, `provisional: Boolean`, `validFrom/validTo: Instant`, `algorithmVersion: Int`.
- **Writer:** `core-baseline/BaselineEngine`. **Lifecycle:** windowed rows; superseded rows retained 180d then compacted. **Indexing:** `(metricId, covariateContext, validTo)`. **Sync:** S0 (recomputed from synced inputs). **Export:** optional "derived" scope (with provisional flag). **Audit:** provisional→confirmed transitions journaled (drives S-12 countdown and fm-05).

#### 30.7.12 `Insight` (`insights` · `insight.v2`)
- **Fields:** `id: Ulid`, `templateId: String` (contracts-registered), `renderedText: Map<Locale, String>`, `evidenceRefs: List<Ulid>` (derived values / events), `salience: Int`, `surfacedOn: List<enum {TODAY, DIGEST, PUSH, COACH}>`, `feedback: enum {NONE, UP, DOWN, HIDDEN}?`, `verifierPassed: Boolean`, `generatedBy: enum {TEMPLATE, LLM_SMOOTHED, ON_DEVICE_LLM}`, `createdAt`, `expiresAt: Instant?`.
- **Writer:** `core-insight/InsightEngine` post-`PhrasingLinter`. **Sync:** S0 (regenerable; feedback syncs as S3 config keyed by templateId — preference, not content). **Indexing:** `(createdAt)`, `(templateId, feedback)`. **Deletion:** TTL sweep. **Audit:** verifier rejections logged to telemetry (§36.4).

#### 30.7.13 `Goal` (`goals` · `goal.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id`, `metricId`, `targetValue: Double`, `direction: enum {AT_LEAST, AT_MOST, RANGE}`, `cadence: enum {DAILY, WEEKLY}`, `startAt`, `endAt?`, `streakOptIn: Boolean`, `archived: Boolean`. **Sync:** S1. **Indexing:** `(archived, metricId)`. Adherence computed as derived values (`goal.adherence_rate`), never stored on the goal row.

#### 30.7.14 `ExperimentDefinition` (`experiment_definitions` · `experiment.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id`, `hypothesisText`, `variableKind: enum {HABIT_TAG, MED_CHANGE, BEDTIME_SHIFT, CUSTOM_TAG}`, `variableRef: String`, `baselineWindow: DateRange` (auto-selected), `interventionWindow: DateRange`, `targetMetricIds: List<String>`, `minDurationDays: Int`, `state: enum {DRAFT, RUNNING, LOCKED, COMPLETE, ABANDONED}`, `resultRef: Ulid?` (derived value). **Sync:** S1. - Named metric sets for pinning, export scopes, saved dashboards: `id`, `name`, `metricIds: List<String>`, `icon: String?`, `systemPreset: Boolean`. **Sync:** S3. Used by Export Center scope picker and S-55 filters.

- **Fields:** `id`, `medicationName: String`, `ingredientId: String?` (localized drug list), `strength: String?`, `form/route: enum?`, `scheduleKind: enum {FIXED_TIMES, INTERVAL, PRN, CYCLING, TAPER}`, `slots: List<ScheduleSlot>`, `startAt`, `endAt?`, `retired: Boolean`, `reminderPolicy: ReminderPolicy?`.
- **Lifecycle:** active → edited (new schedule rows, old journaled — regimen-change markers derive from this journal, auto-annotating charts per §21.5) → retired. **Sync:** S2. **Indexing:** `(retired)`. **Deletion:** retire-only by default; hard-delete purges linked adherence with double confirmation. **Audit:** schedule-change journal is the chart-annotation source.

#### 30.7.17 `Condition` (`conditions` · `condition.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id`, `label` (localized vocab or custom), `onsetAt?`, `status: enum {ACTIVE, RESOLVED, EPISODIC}`, `linkedMedIds`, `linkedSymptomIds`, `linkedMetricIds`, `notes`. User-declared only (§21.6 — the app never infers). **Sync:** S2. Powers per-condition dashboard (S-54) + report scope.

- **Fields:** `key: String` (PK — "today.layout", "fitness.layout", "modules.visibility", "digest.verbosity", "filters.saved.<ulid>"), `valueJson: String`, `updatedAt: Instant`, `deviceId: String`. Key-value by design → §34.3 LWW-per-key is trivially correct. **Sync:** S3. **Export:** included so a restored device looks identical.

#### 30.7.19 `ConsentRecord` (`consent_records` · `consent.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id`, `purposeId: enum {SYNC, SENSITIVE_SYNC, CLOUD_AI, SENSITIVE_AI, ANALYTICS, COHORT}`, `granted: Boolean`, `consentVersion: Int`, `decidedAt: Instant`, `surface: String` (which screen), `supersededBy: Ulid?`.
- Append-only ledger; current state = latest per purpose. **Sync:** S4 (receipt copy server-side when account exists — provable consent) + local truth. **Indexing:** `(purposeId, decidedAt)`. **Deletion:** never (legal record); account deletion exports then purges with final tombstone receipt. **Audit:** the table *is* the audit; S-101 renders it.

- **Fields:** `id`, `format: enum {CSV, JSON, SQLITE, PARQUET, PDF, ARCHIVE}`, `scope: ExportScope` (metricIds/collections, dateRange, sources, rawVsDerived, unitProfile, language, includeSuppressed, includeSensitive: per-class booleans), `schedule: CronSpec?`, `state: enum {QUEUED, RUNNING, DONE, FAILED, CANCELLED}`, `progressPct`, `outputRef: String?`, `manifestChecksum: String?`, `schemaVersion: String`, `createdAt/completedAt`.
- **Writer:** `core-export/ExportEngine` (§20; impl §52/§47 tooling). **Sync:** S0 (jobs are device-local; scheduled specs sync as S3). **Audit:** export history list (S-61) reads this table; sensitive-class inclusion requires fresh `ConsentRecord` check at run time, not schedule time.

#### 30.7.21 `ImportBatch` (`import_batches` · `import_batch.v1`)
- **Fields:** `id`, `connectorId: String` (`applezip`, `garmin_takeout`, `csv_mapper`), `fileFingerprint: String` (SHA-256 — re-import idempotency), `state: enum {PARSING, DEDUPING, COMMITTED, UNDONE, FAILED}`, `rowsRead/rowsAdded/rowsSuppressed: Int`, `startedAt/completedAt`, `errorSummary: String?`.
- **Lifecycle:** COMMITTED → UNDONE (batch undo deletes rows `WHERE prov.batch_id = ?`, restores suppressed victims, replays dependent recomputes). **Sync:** batch row S1; undo propagates as tombstones. **Audit:** import report UX (fm-09) reads counters directly.

### 30.8 Domain events emitted by this layer
Registered in `contracts/events/domain-events.yaml`; consumed per the trigger table in §32.3: `IngestBatchCompleted`, `SessionAssembled`, `DedupResolved`, `BaselinesRecomputed`, `ScoresRecomputed`, `InsightGenerated`, `RegimenChanged`, `StatusIntervalApplied`, `ImportBatchCommitted`, `ImportBatchUndone`, `ConsentChanged`, `PermissionRevoked`, `SyncConflictDetected`.

### 30.9 Dedup decision journal
`dedup_journal` rows: `id`, `ruleId: String` (from §51 rule registry), `winnerId`, `loserIds: List<Ulid>`, `familyStrategy: String`, `confidence: Double`, `reversedAt: Instant?`. Every merge reversible; S-59 lineage sheets and the §11.4 conformance suite both read this table. Sync: S1 (decisions must replicate so both devices agree on suppression).

### 30.10 Timeseries physics (decision summary)
Decimation tiers RAW→MINUTE→HOUR→DAY as `IntervalRecord.bucket`; charts pick tier by range (≤48h RAW/MINUTE, ≤90d HOUR, else DAY with extremes-preserving decimation per §22.4); pre-computed day rows are the only tier allowed on the Today critical path (§32.6 budget). Multi-year projections and vacuum/compaction jobs are specified with the physical schema in §52.

## 31. Backend architecture

### 31.1 The thin, blind backend (rationale)
Carried from v1 §31.1: computation is client-side, sync is E2E — so the backend is nine small services that collectively **cannot read health data**. This section owns responsibilities, API surfaces, blind-backend invariants, scaling and failure notes; deployment layout, IaC, and service folder trees are §47 (`backend/`), OpenAPI source of truth is `contracts/api/backend-openapi.yaml`.

### 31.2 Blind-backend invariants (testable properties, run in CI as `backend/shared/tests/test_blindness.py`)
- **BB-1:** No table in any service schema has a column typed to hold metric values; a schema linter greps migrations for banned names (`value`, `bpm`, `kcal`, `glucose`…) outside the sync blob store.
- **BB-2:** Sync payload bodies are opaque bytes; property test: server code paths never call a decoder on blob contents (taint-check via type — blobs are `EncryptedBlob`, which has no `decode()`).
- **BB-3:** Push payloads contain only `{type, ref_id, locale}` — contract test validates every producer against `contracts/events/push-payloads.schema.json`.
- **BB-4:** AI gateway logs store token counts + template ids, never prompt bodies (log-schema test).
- **BB-5:** Integration hub persists vendor payloads encrypted-at-rest with per-user data keys and deletes on delivery-ack (retention test with clock fake).
- **BB-6:** Telemetry intake rejects any event not in `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` (schema-validated at ingest; unknown event = 400 + alert).

### 31.3 Service inventory

**identity** — optional accounts, OAuth (Apple/Google/email-code), device registry, E2E public-key directory.
Endpoints: `POST /v1/auth/start`, `POST /v1/auth/verify`, `POST /v1/devices` (register deviceId + sync pubkey), `GET /v1/devices`, `DELETE /v1/devices/{id}`, `POST /v1/account/delete` (staged, returns export-first token), `GET /v1/consents`, `PUT /v1/consents/{purpose}`.
Stores: account row, device pubkeys, consent receipts (S4). NEVER sees: any health payload, recovery phrase, private keys. Scaling: trivially stateless + Postgres; failure: token issuance outage degrades to local-only (app fully functional, banner per §34).

**sync** — E2E blob store + oplog exchange (protocol in `contracts/sync/sync.proto`; client impl §53).
Endpoints: `POST /v1/sync/handshake` (device clocks + collection cursors), `POST /v1/sync/push` (batched encrypted oplog entries), `GET /v1/sync/pull?cursor=`, `POST /v1/sync/ack`, `GET /v1/sync/manifest` (per-class blob counts for hydration planning), `POST /v1/sync/purge-class` (sensitive-class revocation → server-side deletion of S2 blobs).
Stores: opaque blobs keyed `(userId, collection, seq)`, vector-clock metadata, per-class byte quotas. NEVER sees: plaintext, field names, metric ids (collection ids are opaque numbers). Scaling: append-heavy → object storage for blob bodies, Postgres for cursors; partition by userId. Failure modes: quota exhaustion (client told, oldest-class compaction advice), cursor divergence (client rebases per §34.5), regional outage (multi-region read replicas of cursors; blobs replicated).

**integrations (integration hub)** — vendor OAuth + webhook receipt + delivery queue (feeds §51's vendor connectors).
Endpoints: `POST /v1/integrations/{vendor}/connect` (OAuth dance start), `GET /v1/integrations/{vendor}/callback`, `DELETE /v1/integrations/{vendor}`, `POST /v1/webhooks/{vendor}` (vendor-facing), `GET /v1/deliveries?since=` (device pull), `POST /v1/deliveries/ack`, `GET /v1/integrations/health` (auth status per connection → S-60).
Webhook lifecycle (diagram-as-list):
1. vendor POSTs → signature verify (per-vendor HMAC/JWKS) → 2. idempotency-key check (`vendor+eventId`, 7d window) → 3. payload encrypted with the user's delivery key → persisted to `deliveries` → 4. push service sends silent trigger (`{type:"vendor_delivery", ref_id}`) → 5. device pulls `/v1/deliveries`, decrypts, ingests via §51 → 6. device POSTs ack → 7. delivery row hard-deleted (BB-5) → 8. unacked rows replay on next pull; after 7d, expired + gap flagged to device (fm-27).
Stores: OAuth tokens (encrypted, KMS), delivery queue (short-retention). NEVER sees: decrypted payloads after step 3 write path completes (encryption happens in-memory at receipt; plaintext never persisted). Scaling: per-vendor rate-limit budgets; queue depth alarms. Failure: vendor outage → replay buffer; token refresh daemon failures → auth-health flag within 15 min.

**fooddata (proxy)** — multi-provider food DB abstraction, regional routing, caching.
Endpoints: `GET /v1/food/search?q=&region=`, `GET /v1/food/item/{providerId}/{id}`, `GET /v1/food/barcode/{ean}`, `POST /v1/food/feedback` (bad-entry reports).
Stores: cache entries, provider routing config. NEVER sees: who ate what (queries pseudonymized per-session ids; no query log retention >24h). Scaling: read-through cache (Redis) with regional keyspaces. Failure: provider outage → secondary provider fallback → cached+personal-items-only mode (client behavior fm-33).

**ai-gateway** — prompt assembly guardrails, vendor routing, zero-retention enforcement, cost metering (consumed by §23 features).
Endpoints: `POST /v1/ai/complete` (templateId + minimized context), `POST /v1/ai/food-parse`, `POST /v1/ai/chart-spec` (Ask-BADAN chart gen), `GET /v1/ai/usage` (metering for entitlements), `POST /v1/ai/feedback`.
Stores: usage counters, template version pins. NEVER sees (persisted): prompt/response bodies (BB-4). Scaling: queue + token-budget per user tier; vendor failover matrix. Failure: vendor down → client falls back to templated narratives (labeled, fm-offline rules); cost runaway → per-tier circuit breakers.

**contentcms** — education articles, insight templates, registry updates, phrasing guardrails distribution.
Endpoints: `GET /v1/content/manifest?locale=&channel=` (staged rollout ring), `GET /v1/content/bundle/{id}`, `GET /v1/registry/updates?since=`, `GET /v1/phrasing/guardrails?version=`.
Stores: versioned content bundles. Failure: unreachable → clients run on last bundle (all bundles cached; no hard dependency).

**push** — APNs/FCM trigger routing.
Endpoints: `POST /v1/push/register`, `DELETE /v1/push/register/{token}`, internal `POST /internal/push/send`. Payloads reference-only (BB-3); content rendered on device by `core-notify`. Failure: token churn cleanup job; delivery-rate dashboards (§36.4).

**billing** — StoreKit2/Play Billing server verification, entitlement ledger.
Endpoints: `POST /v1/billing/verify` (receipt/purchase token), `GET /v1/entitlements`, `POST /v1/billing/webhook/{store}`. Stores: entitlement state only. NEVER: payment instruments (stores hold those). Failure: store webhook lag → client-side grace period (entitlements cached 72h).

**telemetry** — analytics intake per §36.
Endpoints: `POST /v1/telemetry/batch` (schema-validated, BB-6), `GET /v1/flags?ring=` (remote config for `core-flags`). Stores: pseudonymous events, flag configs. Failure: intake outage → client-side bounded buffer, drop-oldest.

### 31.4 Retention rules (per store)

| Store | Retention | Enforcement |
|---|---|---|
| Sync blobs | until user deletion / class purge | purge API + deletion job with completion receipt |
| Integration deliveries | delivered→deleted; max 7d unacked | BB-5 test + daily reaper |
| Vendor OAuth tokens | life of connection | revoked on disconnect, crypto-shredded |
| Food query logs | ≤24h | log pipeline TTL |
| AI gateway logs | metadata 90d, bodies never | BB-4 |
| Telemetry events | 13 months, pseudonym rotation 90d | partition drops |
| Consent receipts | account life + 3y (legal) | legal-hold flag |

### 31.5 Scaling & environment notes
FastAPI + Postgres + Redis + object storage per v1 §31.3; regions EU + GCC at launch (residency routing at the API gateway by account home region); everything behind one gateway with per-service rate classes; IaC in `backend/infra/terraform` (§47). Load profile is dominated by sync push/pull (batched, compressible) and integration webhooks (bursty at vendor batch times — 06:00 local spikes); both are queue-buffered.

Per-service quick reference:

| sync | Postgres cursors + object-store blobs | partition by userId | blob-store latency | client backoff; app unaffected (local truth) |
| integrations | queue + short-retention deliveries | per-vendor workers | vendor burst / token churn | per-source freshness honesty (S-60) |
| fooddata | Redis cache | regional cache clusters | provider outage | personal-items-only search (fm-33) |
| ai-gateway | usage counters | queue + vendor pool | vendor outage / cost spike | templated narratives, labeled |
| contentcms | versioned bundles (CDN) | CDN | bad bundle | last-good bundle retained (fm-55) |
| push | token registry | stateless | token churn | anchors already local (§34.7) |
| billing | entitlement ledger | stateless | store webhook lag | 72h entitlement grace (fm-58) |
| telemetry | event store + flag configs | ingest shards | intake outage | bounded client buffer, drop-oldest |

## 32. On-device architecture

### 32.1 Layering + concurrency model
Layers as v1 §32.1 (UI → ViewModels → shared-KMP domain → shared-KMP data → native platform adapters). Concurrency contract (`core-model/concurrency/AppScopes.kt`):

- **Structured scopes:** `AppScope` (SupervisorJob, app lifetime), `IngestScope` (child; cancelled on permission revocation of the relevant type), `ComputeScope` (child; single-flight per job key), `SyncScope`, `UiScope` per ViewModel (platform lifecycle-bound).
- **Dispatchers:** all repository/DAO calls on `Dispatchers.IO`; engines on `Dispatchers.Default` with `limitedParallelism(2)` for heavy recompute (thermal courtesy); **main-thread rules:** no SQLDelight query, no crypto, no JSON decode >1 KB on main — enforced by `MainThreadDisciplineTest` (debug-build strict-mode hooks on Android, `dispatchPrecondition` asserts in Swift bridges).
- **Flows as the spine:** repositories expose `Flow<T>` (`SampleRepository.observe(metricId, range)`); engines subscribe to domain events via `core-model/EventBus` (a `SharedFlow` with replay 0, buffer 64, `DROP_OLDEST` + telemetry beacon on drop).
- **Single-flight recompute:** `ComputeScheduler` keys jobs (`recompute:recovery:2026-07-09`); duplicate triggers coalesce (debounce 90s for ingest-driven triggers).

### 32.2 Background execution matrix

| Platform job | Identifier / name | Cadence | Constraints | Work |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| iOS BGAppRefresh | `net.badan.bg.refresh` | opportunistic (~hourly) | system-managed | HK anchored-query top-up, light score refresh |
| iOS BGProcessingTask | `net.badan.bg.recompute` | nightly, earliest 02:00 local | requiresExternalPower=false, network=false | baselines, insights, decimation tiers, manifest compaction |
| iOS BGProcessingTask | `net.badan.bg.sync` | nightly + on-demand | network=true | oplog push/pull, delivery pulls |
| iOS BGProcessingTask | `net.badan.bg.export` | when scheduled export due | power preferred | ExportEngine runs |
| iOS HKObserverQuery | per-type background delivery | event-driven | HK-managed | enqueue delta ingest |
| Android WorkManager periodic | `badan-hc-delta-poll` | 15 min (min interval) | network not required | HC changes-API diff ingest |
| Android WorkManager periodic | `badan-nightly-recompute` | 24h, flex 4h window 01:00–05:00 | batteryNotLow | as iOS recompute |
| Android WorkManager periodic | `badan-sync-cycle` | 6h | network=CONNECTED | push+pull |
| Android WorkManager unique | `badan-import-runner` | on demand | foreground service if >60s (long imports, §51) | archive import |

| Both | `badan-db-integrity` (`net.badan.bg.integrity`) | weekly | charging | PRAGMA integrity_check, snapshot rotation (fm-30) |

### 32.3 Compute-scheduling trigger table (event → jobs enqueued)

| Trigger (domain event / OS signal) | Jobs enqueued (in order) | Debounce |
|---|---|---|
| `IngestBatchCompleted` | dedup pass → session assembly → day-aggregates → `BaselinesRecomputed?` (if window touched) → `ScoresRecomputed` (affected periods) → insight eval | 90s coalesce |
| `SessionAssembled(SLEEP)` | overnight-aggregate join → recovery recompute → morning narrative build → widget timeline reload | none (user-visible latency) |
| Day rollover (tz-aware alarm) | period close → day derived values finalize → digest eval (if due) → notification planner | none |
| Settings change (calc method, zones) | full recompute of dependent metrics, staged with progress UI ("recomputing…") | explicit |
| Registry/algorithm update (CMS) | staged backfill recompute (chunked 30d slices, resumable) → "model changed" notice (fm-38) | ring-gated |
| `ImportBatchCommitted` | dedup vs live → backfill baselines → provisional re-eval | none |
| `PermissionRevoked` | cancel `IngestScope(type)` → staleness markers → module denied-state event | none |
| `ConsentChanged(SENSITIVE_SYNC=false)` | sync purge-class call → local class remains | none |
| App foreground | freshness check → opportunistic delta ingest if >15 min stale | 5 min |
| `ImportBatchUndone` | dependent derived invalidation → recompute | none |

Compute-job catalog (job keys used by `ComputeScheduler`; implementations §51/§54):

| Job key pattern | Module | Chunking / resumability | Thermal/battery policy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ingest:delta:<connectionId>` | core-ingest | per-anchor batches ≤5k records | always allowed |
| `dedup:<family>:<dayRange>` | core-ingest | per-family, per-day | always allowed |
| `assemble:sessions:<night>` | core-ingest | per-night | always allowed |
| `aggregate:day:<metricId>:<day>` | core-ingest | per metric-day | always allowed |
| `baseline:<metricId>:<covariateContext>` | core-baseline | windowed, checkpoint per window | defer if thermal serious |
| `recompute:<scoreId>:<periodKey>` | core-scoring | single-flight per key | defer if battery <15% unplugged |
| `backfill:recompute:<algoId>:<slice30d>` | core-scoring | 30d slices, resumable checkpoint row | nightly task only (fm-52) |
| `insight:eval:<day>` | core-insight | per-day | defer if thermal serious |
| `index:fts:<table>:<delta>` | core-search | delta batches | always allowed |
| `manifest:compact` / `baseline:compact` | core-db jobs | idempotent sweeps | weekly integrity window |

### 32.4 Crypto & key hierarchy

```
HW root (Secure Enclave / StrongBox)
 └─ K_device (non-exportable keypair)
     ├─ K_db          SQLCipher key, wrapped by K_device, stored keychain/keystore
     │    └─ separate cipher context for sensitive-plus DB namespace (purge-on-disable §28.7)
     ├─ K_sync_master derived from user recovery phrase: Argon2id → HKDF-SHA256
     │    ├─ K_class[S1], K_class[S2], K_class[S3]   per-sync-class content keys (HKDF info=class)
     │    └─ K_seal    per-oplog-entry XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope keys (ratcheted)
     ├─ K_delivery    per-integration delivery decryption key (registered with hub at connect)
     └─ K_export      optional user passphrase → Argon2id (export ZIP encryption)
```
Rules: recovery phrase shown once, verified by re-entry, never leaves device; losing it = new sync lineage (documented in S-16); key operations in `adapters/port-crypto` (expect/actual, §33.3); rotation: K_class rotate on sensitive-consent re-grant; algorithm agility via envelope version byte.

### 32.5 On-device AI runtime
As v1 §32.4 (Foundation Models/Core ML on iOS; LiteRT/MediaPipe + Gemma-class on Android), with the shared prompt/template layer in `core-insight`. Capability probe at startup writes `ai_capability` into `customization_profiles`; gating: devices below capability floor get templated narratives — never a worse truth, only plainer prose (Law 2).

## 33. Cross-platform mobile architecture

### 33.1 Decision (carried, binding)
KMP shared core + fully native UI (SwiftUI / Compose) per the v1 §33.1 evaluation table — rejected: dual-native (logic drift), React Native and Flutter (health-API lag, chart perf, a11y/RTL idiom cost). Rationale stands: BADAN's competitive core is *logic* (ingestion, dedup, scoring, insights, phrasing, sync — all shared once), its trust surface is *native fidelity* (HealthKit/HC day-one, widgets, watch, RTL). Divergence remains forbidden for metric math, phrasing truth, export bytes, dedup behavior (§33.6 parity suite enforces). The full monorepo tree is §47; module internals §51–§58.

### 33.2 Module dependency graph (allowed-dependencies list)
Enforced by a Gradle convention plugin (`tooling/gradle/dependency-rules.gradle.kts`); any edge not listed fails the build.

| Module | May depend on (only) |
|---|---|
| `core-model` | stdlib, kotlinx-{datetime,serialization,coroutines} |
| `core-registry` | core-model |
| `core-db` | core-model, SQLDelight runtime |
| `core-ingest` | core-model, core-registry, core-db |
| `core-baseline` | core-model, core-registry, core-db |
| `core-scoring` | core-model, core-registry (+ read-only repo interfaces from core-db) |
| `core-insight` | core-model, core-registry, core-scoring, core-phrasing |
| `core-phrasing` | core-model, core-registry |
| `core-sync` | core-model, core-db, port-crypto interface |
| `core-export` | core-model, core-registry, core-db |
| `core-search` | core-model, core-db |
| `core-notify` | core-model, core-flags |
| `core-flags` | core-model |
| `core-analytics` | core-model, core-flags |
| `core-testing` | everything (test-only) |
| `adapters/port-*` | core-model only (interfaces); `port-*-{ios,android}` also platform SDKs |
| app targets | any core via DI graph; never each other |

Forbidden edges called out explicitly: `core-scoring` ↛ `core-ingest` (scores read canonical rows, never pipeline internals); `core-phrasing` ↛ `core-db` (pure function of inputs); no `core-*` ↛ `adapters/port-*-{ios,android}` actuals.

### 33.4 Swift interop & build tooling decisions
- **SKIE** (Touchlab) on the KMP framework: sealed classes → Swift enums, `Flow` → `AsyncSequence`, suspend → async — keeps ViewModel-facing APIs idiomatic. Raw cinterop only inside `port-health-ios` where HealthKit types cross (kept out of public core API).
- Single umbrella XCFramework `BadanCore` (static, embedded once) — per-module frameworks rejected (launch-time + size cost).
- **Gradle:** version catalog `gradle/libs.versions.toml` is the only place versions live; convention plugins in `tooling/gradle/` (kmp-module, sqldelight-module, dependency-rules); configuration cache + remote build cache on CI.
- **Xcode:** XcodeGen (`ios/project.yml`) — no `.xcodeproj` merges in PRs; Tuist rejected (team familiarity, lighter tool). Swift 6 strict concurrency on.
- **CI order:** contracts validation → core tests → parity suite → platform builds (details §47/§65-adjacent tooling; this section owns only the decisions).

### 33.5 Where divergence is beneficial (unchanged from v1 §33.4)
Ambient surfaces, settings idioms, paywall presentation per store rules, haptics, Shortcuts vs App Actions. Everything else: one implementation in core.

### 33.6 Parity-suite mechanics
The cross-platform guarantee, run nightly + on core-touching PRs:
1. `tooling/fixture-gen` builds canonical fixture DBs (10 personas × multi-year data, seeded RNG).
2. Both apps embed a debug-only `ParityRunner` entry point: load fixture → run full recompute → emit `parity-report.json` (every derived value: metricId, periodKey, value to 6 decimals, algorithmVersion) + full CSV/JSON exports.
3. `tooling/ci/parity-diff` byte-compares exports and numerically compares derived values (tolerance 0 — same Kotlin code must produce identical doubles; any diff means an actual leaked into math).
4. Phrasing parity: rendered EN+AR narrative fixtures diffed as strings (fonts/layout excluded — text truth only).
5. Failure blocks release branch merge; report artifact attached to the PR.

## 34. Offline, sync, and conflict-resolution strategy

### 34.1 Doctrine (carried)
Device DB is the source of truth; cloud is a replication target; everything works offline (viewing, logging, scoring, export); sync is convergence, not gating (v1 §34.1). Wire protocol lives in `contracts/sync/sync.proto`; client implementation in `core-sync` is §53; server side §31.3. This section owns the algorithms and invariants.

### 34.2 Sync-session state machine (`core-sync/SyncSession.kt`)
States: `IDLE → HANDSHAKE → PULL → APPLY → PUSH → AWAIT_ACK → FINALIZE → IDLE`, error edges to `BACKOFF(retryN, jitter)` and `SUSPENDED(reason)` (quota, auth, circuit-breaker). Rules: PULL-before-PUSH always (apply remote first, so pushes are rebased); APPLY is transactional per collection chunk; a session interrupted anywhere resumes from cursors (all steps idempotent); `SUSPENDED(circuit_breaker)` requires user-visible support code (fm-29). Logical clocks: `(deviceId, lamport)` per oplog entry; server assigns per-collection `seq` for total order of arrival, not truth.

| Transition | Guard | Side effects |
|---|---|---|
| IDLE → HANDSHAKE | trigger (job `badan-sync-cycle` / `net.badan.bg.sync`, foreground, push nudge) + network + auth | send device clocks + cursors |
| HANDSHAKE → PULL | server cursors valid | quota status cached; manifest-generation check (divergence → §34.5 rebase) |
| PULL → APPLY | chunk received + envelope version supported | decrypt per K_class; unknown collection ⇒ reject chunk, flag fm-53 |
| APPLY → PULL | more chunks pending | per-chunk transaction commit; local cursor advance |
| APPLY → PUSH | pull drained | merge function ran; conflict copies written; `SyncConflictDetected` emitted if material |
| PUSH → AWAIT_ACK | unacked oplog batch sent (≤500 entries/batch) | — |
| AWAIT_ACK → FINALIZE | server ack | oplog entries marked acked; compaction eligibility updated |
| any → BACKOFF | transient error | exponential 2^n capped 6h + jitter; state persisted |
| any → SUSPENDED | quota/auth/breaker | S-02 surfaces reason; auth ⇒ deep-link reconnect |
| FINALIZE → IDLE | recompute triggers enqueued for changed inputs (§32.3) | freshness timestamps updated (S-02) |

### 34.3 Conflict-resolution matrix with per-case algorithms

| Case | Algorithm |
|---|---|
| Platform-imported samples on 2 devices | deterministic ids (§30.2) ⇒ upsert convergence; no conflict path exists. Property test: two devices ingest same HK fixture, sync, byte-identical `samples`. |
| Manual log edited on two devices | **LWW-per-field merge:** each oplog UPDATE carries `changedFields: Set<String>` + HLC timestamp (`lamport`,`deviceId` tiebreak). Merge = for each field take the highest-HLC write; if two devices changed the *same* field within a 24h material window and values differ materially (per-field comparators: numeric delta > unit epsilon, text inequality), keep the merged row AND write a `conflict_copies` row + emit `SyncConflictDetected` → "kept both versions of your note from Tuesday" notice. Merge function spec: `merge(base, a, b) = fieldwise argmax(hlc)`; commutative + associative (order-free convergence), proven by property test `MergeCommutativityTest`. |
| Customization profile | LWW per key (`customization_profiles.key`); no conflict copies (benign). |
| Derived values | never synced (§34.6); recomputed locally from converged inputs. |
| Deletions | tombstone rows `(entityId, deletedAtHlc, byDevice)`; grace window 30 days during which a concurrent *edit* with higher HLC resurrects (edit-beats-delete for user-authored data — deleting stale copy on device B must not destroy an edit from device A); after grace, tombstones compacted; import-batch undo emits batch-scoped tombstones that suppress resurrect (undo-beats-edit, deliberate: fm-09). |
| Regimen schedule edits | whole-`slots`-list is one LWW field (partial slot merges are semantically dangerous); conflict copy retained. |
| Dedup journal | S1-synced; on concurrent conflicting suppressions, higher-confidence rule wins, other reversed via journal (deterministic given same rule registry version). |

### 34.4 Oplog hygiene
`sync_oplog` (schema §52): append per local mutation. **Compaction:** entries acked by all registered devices AND older than 30d collapse to per-entity latest-state snapshots; tombstones survive compaction until grace expiry + all-device ack. Bounded size assertion: oplog ≤10% of DB size (`perf.db.size` sub-check). Change-volume anomaly detector (entries/hour > 50× 7-day median) trips the sync circuit breaker (fm-29).

### 34.5 Recovery flows
**New-device hydration ordering algorithm** (S-16 "restore from sync"):
1. HANDSHAKE + `GET /v1/sync/manifest` → per-class/collection sizes → progress model.
2. Pull order: `S3_CONFIG` (app looks like yours immediately) → `S1` last-45-days (Today renders real data) → **first recompute checkpoint**: baselines+scores for the visible window, provisional-flagged → `S2` last-45-days (after sensitive consent confirmed on new device) → historical S1/S2 in reverse-chronological 90-day chunks (resumable) → final full recompute + provisional flags cleared.
3. Usability gates: Today interactive after step 2's checkpoint (target <2 min on 4-year history); charts show "history still arriving" affordance for un-hydrated ranges.
**Cursor divergence / server reset:** client detects manifest-generation mismatch → re-handshake → rebase: local unacked ops replayed onto fresh pull (safe: idempotent ids + commutative merge).
**Corrupt local DB:** integrity job (§32.2) fails → restore newest local snapshot → else cloud hydration above → else platform-store re-ingest + import prompts (fm-30 ladder).

### 34.6 "Derived values never sync" — enforcement
Three locks: (1) schema — `derived_values`, `baselines`, `insights`, `input_manifests` are marked `sync_class=S0` in table metadata and `core-sync`'s `OplogWriter` has no code path for S0 tables (compile-time: its sealed `SyncableTable` enum simply lacks them); (2) CI — `core-testing/conformance/SyncClassTest.kt` asserts the S0 set matches §30.5 and that a full sync round-trip transfers zero bytes for those tables; (3) runtime — APPLY rejects any incoming collection id not in the syncable enum (defense vs version-skew peers, fm-53). Consequence honored from v1: consistency by recomputation + bandwidth savings + no way for a stale device to poison scores.

### 34.7 Offline edges (carried + sharpened)
Notification anchors scheduled locally a day ahead (`badan-notification-planner`, §32.2) so mornings fire without network; AI degrades to labeled templates; exports always local (`ExportEngine` has no network dependency — ownership principle as code); logging flows queue writes normally (they *are* the source of truth). Sync status surface is S-02.

## 35. Search, filtering, and query experience

### 35.1 Query classes and performance targets

| Query class | Example | Target (p95, on-device, 3-year DB) | Served by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 glance | Today critical path | ≤50 ms total, ≤12 queries | day-bucket aggregates + latest views |
| Q2 chart range | 1Y HRV band chart | ≤100 ms data fetch | decimation tier pick (§30.10) |
| Q3 registry browse/filter | S-55 has-data + out-of-band | ≤80 ms | `metric_daily_status` materialized table |
| Q4 full-text | "migraine" across notes/symptoms/insights | ≤50 ms search-as-you-type | FTS5 (§35.2) |
| Q5 timeline filter | meds+symptoms, last 6 months | ≤120 ms first page (50 rows) | `event_records` partial indexes |
| Q6 export scan | full-archive stream | throughput ≥50k rows/s, streamed | index-ordered cursors, no OFFSET |
| Q7 correlation fetch | paired daily series ×2, 1Y | ≤150 ms | day aggregates join |
| Q8 food remote | DB search via proxy | debounced 250 ms; personal items render <30 ms first | cached personal FTS first, network second |

Benchmarks live in `core-testing/perf/SearchLatencyBench.kt` + `QueryClassBench.kt` (assertion ids `perf.search.type`, `perf.query.q1..q7`); §58 owns the implementation.

### 35.2 FTS5 table definitions (sketch — physical DDL in §52/§58)

```sql
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search_metrics USING fts5(
  metric_id UNINDEXED, name_casual, name_precise, synonyms, family,
  tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');           -- AR/EN cross-script via synonym rows
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search_events USING fts5(
  event_id UNINDEXED, event_type UNINDEXED, title, body, tags,
  occurred_day UNINDEXED, tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search_content USING fts5(          -- education, glossary, settings screens
  content_id UNINDEXED, kind UNINDEXED, locale UNINDEXED, title, body,
  tokenize = 'unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');
```
Population: `core-search/SearchIndexer` subscribes to domain events (insert/update/delete deltas — never full rebuilds except migration); trigram fallback table for typo tolerance on short queries; Arabic normalization pass (alef/hamza folding) before tokenize; "hrv" query in AR UI hits via the synonyms column carrying both scripts (v1 §35.1 promise, made mechanical).

### 35.3 Index inventory (every index, with justification)

| Index | Table | Justification (query class) |
|---|---|---|
| `idx_samples_metric_time (metric_id, measured_at)` | samples | Q2 range scans — the load-bearing index |
| `idx_samples_active … WHERE suppressed_by IS NULL` | samples | Q1/Q2 skip suppressed without filter cost |
| `idx_intervals_metric_bucket_time (metric_id, bucket, start_at)` | interval_records | Q2 tier-pick in one seek |
| `idx_sessions_kind_time (kind, start_at)` | sessions | Q1 last-night lookup, Q5 timeline |
| `idx_events_type_time (type, occurred_at)` | event_records | Q5 filtered timeline |
| `idx_events_symptom (symptom_id, occurred_at) WHERE type='symptom'` | event_records (generated cols) | S-53 per-symptom detail |
| `idx_events_regimen (regimen_id, occurred_at) WHERE type='adherence'` | event_records | S-51 adherence strips |
| `idx_derived_metric_period (metric_id, period_key) WHERE superseded_by IS NULL` | derived_values | Q1/Q3 latest-score reads |
| `idx_baselines_lookup (metric_id, covariate_context, valid_to)` | baselines | band rendering lookup |
| `idx_oplog_pending (acked, seq)` | sync_oplog | push batching |
| `idx_insights_created (created_at DESC)` | insights | coach feed |
| `idx_labs_biomarker (biomarker_id, specimen_at) WHERE type='lab_result'` | event_records | S-48/49 lab timelines |
| `idx_dedup_winner (winner_id)` / `(loser)` via journal table | dedup_journal | S-59 lineage in one seek |
| `idx_metric_daily_status (day, metric_id)` | metric_daily_status | Q3 out-of-band/has-data filters |

Rule: no index without a named query class; new-index PRs must cite this table (reviewed by TRACK-CORE-DATA).

### 35.4 Saved-filter model + FilterSpec DTO (the one grammar)
`FilterSpec` is the single structured-query DTO used by Timeline (S-31), registry browser (S-55), Export scopes (S-61), and Ask-BADAN handoff — one grammar, four payoffs.

```kotlin
@Serializable data class FilterSpec(               // core-model/query/FilterSpec.kt
  val dateRange: DateRangeSpec?,                   // preset enum or explicit
  val pillars: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  val metricIds: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  val eventTypes: Set<EventType> = emptySet(),
  val sources: SourceFilter? = null,               // include/exclude connection ids
  val tags: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  val statusOverlap: Set<String> = emptySet(),     // status interval ids
  val hasData: Boolean? = null, val outOfBand: Boolean? = null,
  val severityMin: Int? = null, val mealTypes: Set<String> = emptySet(),
  val text: String? = null,                        // FTS clause
  val specVersion: Int = 1)
```
Saved filters persist as `customization_profiles` keys `filters.saved.<ulid>` (name + FilterSpec JSON, S3 sync). Compilation to SQL lives in `core-search/FilterCompiler.kt` (§58) with a golden-test corpus (spec → expected SQL + row set on fixture DB).

Filter-chip → FilterSpec field mapping (the v1 §35.2 grammar, made mechanical — chips are rendered from this table, localized via registry names):

| UI chip (S-31/S-55/S-61) | FilterSpec field | Value source |
|---|---|---|
| Date range | `dateRange` | presets (`7D/30D/3M/6M/1Y/custom`) |
| Pillar | `pillars` | registry families |
| Source | `sources` | `source_connections` display names |
| Tag | `tags` | tag dictionary + user customs |
| Status overlap | `statusOverlap` | `StatusInterval` taxonomy (§10.13) |
| Has data / Out of band | `hasData` / `outOfBand` | `metric_daily_status` |
| Severity | `severityMin` | symptom scale |
| Meal type | `mealTypes` | MealEntry enum |
| Search text | `text` | FTS5 clause (§35.2) |

### 35.5 NL→structured bridge contract (Ask-BADAN)
Contract: the LLM never queries the DB. Ask-BADAN's tool-call layer emits a `FilterSpec` (plus optional `ChartSpec`), validated by `FilterSpecValidator` (unknown metric ids rejected against the registry; date math resolved by engine code, not the model); the deterministic engine executes it and returns typed results the LLM may only phrase (§23.3 verifier applies). Every NL answer carries an "open as filter" handoff — the same `FilterSpec` deep-links into S-31/S-55 so trust is inspectable (v1 §35.3). Eval set: `content/eval/nl2filter/*.yaml` (≥200 utterances EN+AR → expected FilterSpec), precision gate ≥95% before flag `ff_coach_nl_filter` ships.

## 36. Observability, analytics, and experimentation

### 36.1 Event schema governance process
The taxonomy itself (every event + property) lives in `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` and is owned by §61; this section owns the governance loop:

1. **Proposal:** PR adding/changing an event in the YAML, with funnel/dashboard justification line (events without a consumer are rejected — no data hoarding).
2. **Linter gate:** `tooling/ci/analytics-lint` blocks: free-text properties, numeric properties whose name matches health-value patterns (`*_bpm`, `*_kcal`, `value`…), user identifiers, property cardinality >50 declared enum values. Only enums/shapes ever ship (v1 §36.1: `metric_detail_viewed {metric_family, period, depth_mode}` — family, never value).
3. **Codegen:** `core-analytics` event senders are generated from the YAML (typed Kotlin functions) — an unregistered event cannot compile; server intake rejects unknown events (BB-6, §31.2).
4. **Versioning:** breaking property change = new event name suffix (`_v2`); dashboards migrate explicitly; old events sunset after 2 releases.
5. **Disclosure:** the public analytics-disclosure page (v1 §36.2) is auto-generated from the same YAML at release time (`tooling/schema-dictionary-gen`) — the trust claim is mechanically true.
6. **Quarterly audit:** unused-event report (zero dashboard references) → deletion PRs.

### 36.2 Funnel definitions (exact event sequences)

| Funnel | Sequence (events from contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml) | Window |
|---|---|---|
| F1 Activation | `app_installed → onboarding_started → permission_bundle_granted{bundle:core} → backfill_completed → first_insight_viewed → session_started` (D1) | 48h |
| F2 Logging adoption | `log_hub_opened → {meal_logged \| symptom_logged \| adherence_logged \| measurement_logged} → (any second log)` | 7d |
| F3 Depth migration | `metric_detail_viewed → anatomy_viewed → raw_explorer_viewed → depth_mode_changed{to:power}` | 30d |
| F4 Export | `export_center_viewed → export_configured{format} → export_completed → export_completed` (repeat) | 30d |
| F5 Paywall | `paywall_viewed{context} → trial_started → trial_converted → renewal_completed{n:1}` | trial+1 cycle |
| F6 Notification health | `notification_sent{kind} → notification_opened` vs `notification_disabled{kind}` | rolling 7d |
| F7 Module adoption | `edit_layout_opened → module_added{module} → module_viewed ×7d` vs `module_removed` | 14d |
| F8 Digest readership | `digest_generated → digest_opened → digest_shared \| report_exported` | weekly |

Funnel health targets tie back to v1 KPIs: F1 `backfill_completed → first_insight_viewed` ≥80% (§11.7 promise).

### 36.3 Guardrail metrics with thresholds (every experiment + release ring)

| Guardrail | Threshold | Action on breach |
|---|---|---|
| Crash-free sessions | <99.5% ring / <99.0% experiment arm | auto-halt rollout (flag kill-switch) |
| D7 uninstall rate | > control +15% relative | auto-halt experiment |
| `notification_disabled` weekly rate | >5% of notified users or > control +10% | halt + notification-budget review (§24.8) |
| Sync failure rate | >2% of sessions | page TRACK-BACKEND |
| Insight verifier rejection rate | >3% of generations | freeze template/model version |
| Support-ticket rate | > 2× 28d median | release review |
| Background battery beacons | perf.bg.battery trend +30% | block next ring promotion |

### 36.4 Experiment eligibility rules
(1) Only non-truth surfaces — onboarding order, education formats, digest layout, paywall copy; **never** scores, phrasing truthfulness, safety wording, export content (v1 §36.3, now enforced: experimentable flags carry `surface: non_truth` in `core-flags` config and the flag linter rejects experiments on flags without it). (2) Local-only users excluded (no telemetry) — they receive `default` variant pinned. (3) Analytics consent required. (4) Min cohort 1,000/arm before readout; sequential-testing correction applied. (5) One concurrent experiment per surface per user (assignment service in `core-flags`, deterministic hash of pseudo-id × experiment salt). (6) Every experiment registers its guardrails (§36.3) before start — unregistered experiments cannot be activated (config schema requires the block). (7) Global 5% holdout ring receives no experiments for baseline drift measurement.

### 36.5 Quality-observability dashboards inventory

| Dashboard | Key metrics | Alert thresholds | Owning track |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sync health | push/pull latency p50/p95, failure rate, oplog depth, hydration durations, conflict-copy rate | fail >2%; hydration p95 >5 min | TRACK-BACKEND |
| Integration freshness | per-vendor webhook lag, replay-buffer depth, token-refresh failures, delivery-ack age | lag p95 >60 min/vendor; refresh fail >1% | TRACK-BACKEND |
| Ingestion & dedup quality | pipeline stage error rates, conformance-suite drift, `db_pk_conflict`, suppression-reversal rate, opt-in diagnostic samples | conformance accuracy −1pt = release block | TRACK-CORE-DATA |
| Score-distribution drift | per-score population histograms by algo version, provisional-flag duration, partial-input rate | KS-test drift alarm on version rollout | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| AI quality & cost | verifier rejection %, food-parse correction rate, token cost/user, latency p95, on-device fallback rate | rejection >3%; cost/user > budget | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| Notification health | sent/opened/disabled by kind, budget suppressions, quiet-hour violations (must be 0) | violations >0 = page | TRACK-AMBIENT |
| Widget/watch freshness | `lastRenderedAt` staleness distribution, timeline-reload failures | staleness p95 >6h (fm-49) | TRACK-AMBIENT |
| Client perf beacons | §32.6 assertion ids from field (MetricKit/Vitals) | budget +20% field regression | TRACK-QA-RELEASE |

## 38. Growth, retention, and habit formation

Carries forward v1 §38 in full; every value moment, loop, and interception idea is converted here into measurable, instrumented specifications. All analytics events named below are typed entries in `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` (no health values — feature-usage shapes only, per v1 §36.1) and are emitted through `core-analytics/AnalyticsClient`, which schema-validates payloads at build time via `tooling/ci/analytics-schema-check`.

### 38.1 Value moments as measurable specs

Each VM has a detection rule (an event sequence evaluated on-device by `core-analytics/FunnelEvaluator`, reported as a single derived funnel event), a target rate, and an owning feature + track accountable for moving it.

| VM | Definition (v1 §38.1) | Detection event sequence (within window) | Derived funnel event | Target | Owning feature / epic | Accountable track |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| VM1 | First personalized insight, session 1, backfill-powered | `onboarding_completed` → `backfill_completed {years_ingested}` → `today_viewed {has_personal_content:true}` → `insight_viewed {provisional:true}` — all in install session | `vm1_reached {session_index:1}` | ≥80% of wearable-connected installs in session 1; ≥90% by D1 | Backfill (E-02) + insight templates v1 (E-07) | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| VM2 | First "it explained me" moment | (`score_anatomy_opened` AND dwell ≥8s) OR `insight_feedback_submitted {rating:accurate}` within D7 | `vm2_reached {day_index}` | ≥40% of D7-retained users | Score Anatomy (E-04) + feedback loop (E-07) | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| VM3 | First pattern discovery | `correlation_result_viewed {significant:true, min_n_met:true}` OR `experiment_completed {conclusive:true}` by day 60 | `vm3_reached` | ≥25% of Pro trialists; ≥10% of free analysts (teaser-limited) | Correlation Lab / Experiments (E-19) | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| VM4 | First export/report used in real life | `export_completed {format, scope}` OR `report_shared {template}` within 90 days | `vm4_reached {format}` | ≥15% of MAU by month 3 of tenure | Export Center (E-09), Report Composer (E-18) | TRACK-CORE-DATA |
| VM5 | Year-in-Body | `year_in_body_viewed` → optional `share_card_created {surface:year_in_body}` | `vm5_reached {shared:bool}` | ≥50% view rate of eligible 12-month cohort; ≥20% share | Year-in-Body (E-18) | TRACK-CONTENT |

Growth-event property definitions (added to `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` under the `growth` namespace; all properties enums/shapes, never health values):

| Event | Properties (typed) | Emitted by |
|---|---|---|
| `vm1_reached` … `vm5_reached` | `session_index:int`, `day_index:int`, `shared:bool` (VM5 only) | `core-analytics/FunnelEvaluator` |
| `backfill_completed` | `years_ingested:enum(<1,1-2,3-5,5+)`, `source_count_bucket` | `core-ingest/backfill/` |
| `insight_feedback_submitted` | `rating:enum(accurate,inaccurate,useful,noisy)`, `template_pool:enum(first_week,standard)` | insight feedback UI |
| `score_anatomy_opened` | `score:enum(sleep,readiness,strain,bioage)`, `dwell_bucket` | metric detail screens |
| `referral_code_created` / `referral_code_shared` | `channel:enum(system_share,copy,qr)` | Referral feature |
| `guest_pass_redeemed` / `guest_pass_converted` | `source:enum(referral,promo,support)`, `days_to_convert_bucket` | billing service (server-emitted) |
| `paywall_viewed` / `trial_started` / `subscription_converted` / `subscription_lapsed` | `placement:enum(§39.3 list)`, `plan:enum(monthly,yearly,lifetime)` | StoreClient + billing webhooks |
| `resurrection_digest_sent` / `resurrection_digest_opened` | `lapse_bucket:enum(7-14d,15-30d,30d+)` | telemetry service + client |
