Funnel invariants: VM1→VM2 must complete inside week 1 for the retention model to hold (v1 §38.1); the P1 launch gate (§41) blocks on VM1 ≥80%. `FunnelEvaluator` state lives in `customization_profiles` table (key `vm_progress`) so it survives reinstall via sync, and is excluded from local-only-mode telemetry (users still see their own milestones; nothing is transmitted — v1 §36.3).

### 38.2 Habit loop instrumentation

All loops route notification decisions through `core-notify/NotificationDecisionEngine` (budgets, quiet hours — v1 §24.8). Rejected patterns (variable-reward, guilt streaks, FOMO) remain contractually banned via v1 §9.10; the phrasing linter (`contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml`) rejects loss-framed notification copy.

| Loop | Trigger | Surface | Instrumentation sequence | Health KPI (guardrail) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Morning glance | Anchor notification at learned wake+offset (`SmartTimingPolicy` in core-notify) | Today (L1), lock-screen widget | `notification_sent {kind:morning_anchor}` → `notification_opened` → `today_viewed {source:notification}` → session ≤60s counts as success (`glance_loop_completed`) | notification_disable rate <2%/mo for anchor class |
| Evening light (opt-in) | Wind-down window from sleep baseline | Wind-down card on Today, watch complication | `notification_sent {kind:wind_down}` → `winddown_card_viewed` → optional `mood_logged`/`journal_entry_logged` | opt-out rate; sleep-log next-morning confirm rate |
| Weekly reflection | Digest ready (Sunday evening local, `DigestScheduler` in E-18) | Weekly digest screen + email-free push | `digest_generated` → `digest_opened {week_index}` → `focus_selected {domain}` | digest open decay slope (see §38.5) |
| Logging loops (opt-in goals only) | User-selected logging goal (food/meds/symptoms) | Log hub (+), streak chip (freeze-friendly) | `log_goal_set {domain}` → daily `meal_logged`/`med_taken_logged`/`symptom_logged` → `streak_advanced {opt_in:true}` / `streak_frozen` | zero notifications for missed logs (hard rule); streak abandonment rate |
| Check-in loop (Pro, P2) | Post-anomaly or post-experiment checkpoint | Coach check-in card | `checkin_sent` → `checkin_answered {latency_bucket}` | answer rate ≥60% or engine backs off automatically |

### 38.3 Aha-moment engineering (first-week template policy)

The first-week insight templates in `content/insight-templates/first_week/*.yaml` are restricted by policy field `min_confidence: high` and `claim_class: self_evident` (e.g., "your sleep averages 47 min less on Sundays" — computable from backfill with n≥8). `core-insight/InsightEngine` enforces: sessions 1–7 draw only from the `first_week` pool; subtler claim classes (`correlational`, `covariate_conditioned`) unlock after `Baseline.maturity ≥ 0.6`. This is the engineered answer to the calibration-trust trap (v1 §44.2): provisional-but-personal beats accurate-but-generic. Measured by VM2 rate and `insight_feedback_submitted {rating}` distribution (target: ≥70% accurate/useful on first-week pool).

### 38.4 Referral & guest-pass system (data model + entitlement flow)

Bevel-parity guest passes (30-day Pro gifts), minus gimmicks. Server-side home: `backend/services/billing/` (entitlement issuance) + `backend/services/identity/` (code ownership). Client home: `ios/BadanApp/Features/Referral/`, `android/.../features/referral/`.

Tables (Postgres, billing service — never contain health data):

```
referral_codes    (code PK, owner_user_id, created_at, max_uses INT DEFAULT 5,
                   uses INT DEFAULT 0, revoked_at NULLABLE)
guest_pass_grants (id PK, code FK→referral_codes, grantee_user_id UNIQUE per code,
                   entitlement_set = 'pro_guest', starts_at, expires_at,  -- starts_at + 30d
                   converted_subscription_id NULLABLE, source ENUM(referral, promo, support))
```

Flow: owner taps Share → `referral_code_created` / `referral_code_shared {channel}` → grantee redeems in onboarding or Settings → `POST /billing/guest-pass/redeem` validates (code live, uses < max_uses, grantee has no prior grant for code, no active Pro) → billing issues a time-boxed entitlement token containing the full `ent_*` set of §39.1 with `expires_at` → client `core-flags/EntitlementService` refreshes → `guest_pass_redeemed`. Expiry follows the lapse matrix (§39.5) — no cliff, no data loss. Conversion attribution: `guest_pass_converted` when `subscription_converted` fires within 60 days of expiry; owner reward = +1 month Pro credit (applied as billing-service entitlement extension, never store-side to avoid store-policy entanglement). Abuse guards: device-attestation check on redemption (App Attest / Play Integrity via `backend/services/billing/attestation.py`), per-owner monthly cap.

Advocacy artifacts (v1 §38.4 carried): share-cards with privacy-safe defaults (E-18; `share_card_created {surface, redactions_applied}`), public roadmap + feature-request portal (contentcms-backed; `feature_request_submitted`), transparent changelogs (`changelog_viewed`).

### 38.5 Churn-signal features and interception playbook

Churn model input features are **usage-shape only** (v1 §38.5) — computed by `backend/services/telemetry/churn_features.py` from the analytics event stream; local-only users are excluded (they get static value-reminder surfaces only). Feature list (all per-user, rolling):

1. `open_gap_trend` — slope of days-between-sessions over 28d.
2. `widget_only_shift` — ratio of widget impressions to app opens rising above 5:1.
3. `notification_disable_burst` — ≥2 `notification_disabled` events in 7d.
4. `digest_open_decay` — 3 consecutive unopened digests.
5. `sync_device_gone` — connected wearable stops delivering (`SourceConnection.last_seen` > 7d) — often device abandonment, not app dissatisfaction; branch separately.
6. `paywall_bounce` — ≥3 `paywall_viewed` without `trial_started`.
7. `layout_removals` — net negative `today_card_removed` vs added in 14d.
8. `trial_shallow` — trial started but <2 Pro-feature events in first 7 trial days.

Interception playbook (never discounts-first; value reminders of what accumulated — Law 1's "safe to leave, easy to return"):

| Signal | Interception (surface, copy class) | Event | Escalation |
|---|---|---|---|
| open_gap_trend | One "your data kept working" digest: totals accumulated since last open (`resurrection_digest_sent`) | `resurrection_digest_opened` | Max 2 per lapse; then silence |
| sync_device_gone | In-app + one push: "we haven't heard from your <device_class>" with reconnect deep link | `source_reconnect_prompted` | Support article; never guilt |
| trial_shallow | In-trial checklist card surfacing unused Pro features with real examples from user's own data | `trial_feature_prompt_viewed` | Trial-end honest summary: what Pro did/didn't do for them |
| paywall_bounce | Suppress contextual paywall cards 30d (`ff_paywall_cooldown`); free tier remains complete | — | Founding-tier or annual offer only at natural moments |
| lapsed Pro | Lapse email/screen states exactly what stays (per §39.5 matrix), export link included | `lapse_summary_viewed` | Win-back only on new-capability launches |

### 38.6 Community (Phase 3, carefully)

As v1 §38.6: opt-in circles, effort-based (not score-based) challenges, no public physiology leaderboards, moderated. Implementation home E-23 (§42.23); success metric formalized: circles cohort D90 retention lift ≥ +8pp vs matched non-circle cohort **with** notification budget unchanged (guardrail: circle-class notifications draw from the same `NotificationDecisionEngine` budget pool, no separate allowance).

Instrumentation (added to the `growth` namespace when E-23 lands): `circle_created`, `circle_joined {via:enum(invite_link,qr)}`, `challenge_started {type:enum(consistency,logging,movement_minutes)}`, `challenge_completed {participation_bucket}`, `circle_left` — membership shapes only, never member physiology. Kill criteria are pre-registered (v1 §36.3 guardrail-metric discipline): if circles raise `notification_disabled` rate or uninstalls in the cohort, `ff_community_circles` ramps down before iteration continues.

## 39. Monetization and packaging strategy

Carries v1 §39 unchanged in substance (free repository + Pro intelligence; anchors $59.99/yr | $7.99/mo, 14-day full-Pro trial, regional pricing day one, founding lifetime tier; never ads/data sale/sponsored insights) and adds the entitlement architecture that makes Law 1 physically enforceable.

### 39.1 Entitlement architecture

Entitlements are the only mechanism by which paid state affects behavior. `core-flags/EntitlementService` (KMP) evaluates keys locally from a signed entitlement token; feature code never reads subscription state directly. Architectural guarantee of Law 1: entitlement checks live exclusively in interpretation/service layers (`core-insight`, `core-export` advanced paths, `core-scoring` decomposition paths, backend `ai-gateway`); `core-db` DAOs and `SampleRepository` have no entitlement dependency — raw reads physically cannot be intercepted (v1 §2.1 Law 1 engineering consequence).

| Entitlement key | Gates (feature → module) | Epic |
|---|---|---|
| `ent_ai_deep` | Ask-BADAN deep analysis, chart generation, training-plan suggestions → `backend/services/ai-gateway/` + Coach screens | E-17 |
| `ent_ai_checkins` | Proactive check-ins → `core-notify` + ai-gateway | E-17 |
| `ent_correlation_lab` | Correlation Lab full runs (free tier: teaser with one pinned example) → `core-insight/correlation/` | E-19 |
| `ent_experiments` | Experiments engine → `core-insight/experiments/` | E-19 |
| `ent_reports_advanced` | Composer templates beyond physician-basic, custom branding → `core-export/report/` | E-18 |
| `ent_export_scheduled` | Scheduled/automated exports → `core-export/scheduler/` + backend jobs | E-22 |
| `ent_api_personal` | Personal API tokens → `backend/services/*` personal-api | E-22 |
| `ent_bioage_full` | Bio Age decomposition + aging pace (free: band + definition) → `core-scoring/bioage/` | E-20 |
| `ent_cohort_context` | Cohort-optional comparisons → `core-insight/cohort/` | E-19 |
| `ent_notify_rules` | Power notification rule builder → `core-notify/rules/` | E-10/E-24 |
| `ent_sync_longhistory` | Instant long-history hydration on new device (free: progressive) → `core-sync` | E-22 |
| `ent_support_priority` | Priority support channel routing → backend contentcms/support | ops |

Entitlement sets: `pro` (all keys), `pro_guest` (all keys, time-boxed — §38.4), `founding_lifetime` (all keys, non-expiring), `free` (none). Keys are enumerated in `contracts/api/backend-openapi.yaml` (`EntitlementSetDto`) so client/server cannot drift.

| Yearly | `net.badan.pro.yearly`, $59.99, intro offer: 14-day free trial | subscription `pro`, base plan `yearly-autorenew`, offer `trial-14d` |

Both post store artifacts to the billing service (§39.4) and never toggle entitlements from unverified local state alone (except offline grace, below).

### 39.3 Paywall placement map

Free surfaces demonstrate the paid layer honestly — real limited versions, never obfuscated numbers (v1 §9.10, §39.2). Every contextual upgrade card is flag-gated for placement iteration (A/B allowed here — non-truth surface, v1 §36.3) and emits `paywall_viewed {placement, trigger}`.

| Screen (per §16 writers) | Contextual card | Flag |
|---|---|---|
| Trends tab / metric detail (analysis section) | "Run this in Correlation Lab" teaser with one real pinned correlation | `ff_paywall_correlation_teaser` |
| Coach (Ask-BADAN) | Deep-analysis prompt suggestion after 3 free concise answers | `ff_paywall_ai_deep_prompt` |
| Report Composer | Template gallery — advanced templates marked, previewable | `ff_paywall_reports_gallery` |
| Bio Age detail | Free band shown fully; decomposition section as real preview of top factor | `ff_paywall_bioage_decomp` |
| Export Center | Scheduled-export toggle row (manual export always free) | `ff_paywall_export_scheduled` |
| Onboarding end | Single trial offer screen, skippable in one tap, never repeated in-session | `ff_paywall_onboarding_offer` |
| Settings › BADAN Pro | Canonical plan screen (always reachable; the only place lifetime tier shows) | — (permanent) |

Hard rules (linter-checkable in UI review): max one paywall surface per session outside Settings; no interstitials interrupting L1/L2 reading (anti-pattern: Bevel's two interstitials in six minutes, v1 §44.1); every card names exactly which `ent_*` it unlocks.

### 39.4 Receipt validation flow

```
StoreClient (iOS JWS / Android purchaseToken)
  → POST /billing/receipts        (backend/services/billing/)
  → billing verifies: App Store Server API / Play Developer API
  → maps product → entitlement_set, writes subscriptions table
  → returns signed EntitlementToken {set, keys[], expires_at, grace_until}
  → core-flags/EntitlementService caches token in SQLCipher store,
    re-evaluates on app start + store listener events + token expiry
```

Billing-service tables (Postgres; blind to health data by construction — the billing service has no route to the sync store):

```
subscriptions      (id PK, user_id, platform ENUM(appstore, play), product_id,
                    original_transaction_id / purchase_token UNIQUE, state ENUM(active,
                    trial, grace, on_hold, lapsed, revoked, lifetime), current_period_end,
                    price_tier, region, created_at, updated_at)
entitlement_tokens (jti PK, user_id, entitlement_set, keys JSONB, issued_at,
                    expires_at, grace_until, revoked_at NULLABLE)
billing_events     (id PK, subscription_id FK, source ENUM(assn_v2, rtdn, receipt_post),
                    raw_type, mapped_transition, received_at)   -- append-only audit
```

`EntitlementToken` is a short-lived JWS (ES256, key in backend KMS): `{ sub, set, keys[], iat, exp, grace_until }`. The client treats `keys[]` as the only truth; `set` exists for display ("BADAN Pro", "Founding member"). Store-behavior test plan: sandbox/licence-tester matrices for trial→convert, trial→cancel, billing-retry→grace→lapse, upgrade monthly→yearly, refund/revocation, lifetime purchase + restore — each mapped to an expected token transition and a §39.5 matrix assertion, automated in `tooling/ci/billing-flows/`.

Offline/local-only: token valid offline until `expires_at + 30d` clock skew allowance; **local-only mode** users (no account) validate on-device only (StoreKit 2 local JWS verification / Play local acknowledgment) and receive a device-local entitlement record — accepted risk, documented in ADR (`docs/adr/`), because forcing accounts would break the local-only promise (v1 §28.5). Webhooks: App Store Server Notifications v2 + Play RTDN feed `subscriptions` state machine (active → grace → on-hold → lapsed) driving token refresh pushes via `port-push`.

### 39.5 Grace and lapse behavior (Law 1 matrix)

Grace period = store billing-retry window (16d iOS / configurable 14d Play): full Pro retained, one non-alarmist banner. Lapse matrix — exact behavior per feature:

| Capability | Active Pro | Lapsed (forever-free floor) |
|---|---|---|
| Raw data, ingestion, all logging, unlimited history | full | **unchanged — never touched** |
| Manual export CSV/JSON/PDF-basic, deletion with export | full | **unchanged** |
| Daily narrative | deep + check-ins | concise templated narrative (still personal) |
| Individual insights already generated | full | **kept readable forever** (v1 §38.5: lapsed users keep individual interpretations) |
| Score Anatomy, personal bands, basic trends | full | unchanged (free tier feature) |
| Correlation Lab / Experiments | full runs | past results read-only; new runs gated |
| Advanced report templates | full | past generated reports remain downloadable; new gens use basic template |
| Scheduled exports | active | paused with notice; manual export unaffected |
| Personal API | active tokens | tokens suspended after 30d notice; data remains manually exportable |
| Bio Age | full decomposition | band + definition remain |
| Cohort context | on | off (self-comparisons remain) |

## 40. Team structure and execution model

v1 §40 headcount and squad model carried (Phase-1 core ~12–14, Phase-2 +8; squads own user promises: Repository, Interpretation, Experience, Trust). v2 adds the execution mapping: people staff **squads**, work flows through the 12 **tracks** (conventions §3) that partition the monorepo. A track is an ownership lane with a review gate, not a team — one person may serve multiple tracks; agents (human or AI) are dispatched per track by the orchestration plan in §66.

| TRACK-CORE-DATA | Canonical store, ingestion, dedup, export | 1 KMP eng + data scientist (dedup corpus) | `core/core-model`, `core-db`, `core-ingest`, `core-registry`, `core-export`, `core-search` | contracts, port interfaces | repositories + engines for all features | dedup conformance suite + schema-migration soak green |
| TRACK-CORE-INTEL | Baselines, scoring, insights, phrasing | 1 KMP eng + 1 data scientist | `core-baseline`, `core-scoring`, `core-insight`, `core-phrasing` | core-data repos, registry, statuses | `DerivedValue`/`Insight` streams, Score Anatomy data | golden-dataset regression + phrasing linter green + validation memo for new scores |
| TRACK-IOS-SHELL | Shell, navigation, design system iOS | 1 iOS eng | `ios/BadanApp/App/`, `DesignSystem/`, `Platform/` (non-HK) | design tokens, routes contract | shell + components for feature work | snapshot tests both themes + RTL + accessibility audit |

### 40.2 Squad ↔ track mapping and decision rights

Squads (v1 §40.3 — they own user promises) draw from tracks (which own paths). The matrix keeps both true at once:

| Squad (user promise) | Primary tracks | Secondary tracks | Decision rights (final say on…) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Repository ("your data is safe, complete, portable") | TRACK-CORE-DATA, TRACK-ADAPTERS | TRACK-BACKEND (integrations, sync) | dedup policy, export schemas (with CONTRACTS), source priority UX |
| Interpretation ("numbers you can trust") | TRACK-CORE-INTEL | TRACK-CONTENT (templates), TRACK-BACKEND (ai-gateway) | score definitions, confidence policy, insight quality bars |
| Experience ("10 seconds to value, depth on demand") | TRACK-IOS-SHELL/FEATURES, TRACK-AND-SHELL/FEATURES, TRACK-AMBIENT | TRACK-CONTENT (education) | IA/navigation, screen specs, depth-dial behavior |
| Trust ("private, consented, honest") | TRACK-BACKEND, TRACK-QA-RELEASE | TRACK-CORE-DATA (consent plumbing) | consent flows, telemetry policy, lapse matrix enforcement, release go/no-go |

Escalation ladder: WP-level disputes → track review gate owner; cross-track contract disputes → ADR decided by TRACK-CONTRACTS with product lead; law conflicts → the seven laws arbitrate, lower number wins (v1 §2.1); anything touching wording/claims → wording board veto is absolute.

### 40.3 Definition of Done — the literal PR checklist

Enforced as `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` at repo root; TRACK-QA-RELEASE owns CI checks that verify the automatable items. A PR is mergeable only when every applicable box is checked or explicitly marked N/A with reason.

```markdown
## Definition of Done
- [ ] Both platforms implemented (or ticket split linked + parity ticket filed)
- [ ] Both themes (dark/light) verified — snapshot tests updated
- [ ] RTL verified (AR pseudolocale screenshot attached for new UI)
- [ ] Both depth policies rendered (casual + power altitude — Law 4)
- [ ] Denied-state and empty-state implemented per §16.9 matrix
- [ ] Offline behavior stated (works offline / queues / degrades — which?)
- [ ] Export impact assessed: new data exposed in export? schema version bumped?
- [ ] Data-dictionary entry added/updated (tooling/schema-dictionary-gen run)
- [ ] Analytics events registered in contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml (no health values)
- [ ] Feature flag registered (ff_*) with kill-switch default + cleanup ticket
- [ ] Entitlement check (if paid surface): key named, lapse behavior per §39.5
- [ ] Phrasing: user-facing strings pass phrasing linter; AR strings authored, not machine-translated
- [ ] Contracts untouched — or ADR linked + version bump + downstream regen committed
- [ ] Fixtures: new ingestion/dedup behavior has core-testing fixture coverage
- [ ] Perf budgets: no regression on §32.6 CI benchmarks
- [ ] Accessibility: labels, dynamic type, contrast on new components
- [ ] Trust collateral updated where user-visible behavior changed (v1 §7 P12)
```

## 41. Phased roadmap

v1 §41 scope per phase is carried verbatim as the deliverable list; v2 adds entry/exit criteria, ordered critical paths, parallel streams, and cut-line policy. Sequencing logic unchanged: differentiation (export, Android, local-first, meds/symptoms) ships in P1 *before* Bevel parity completes in P2 (v1 §41). The global precondition for all phases: **CONTRACT-FREEZE (M0)** — `contracts/` tagged v1.0.0 with registry schema, domain/analytics event taxonomies, export schemas, sync protocol draft, phrasing guardrails (see §66 orchestration plan).

Cross-phase policies (apply to every phase below):

- **Gate discipline:** a phase exits only when TRACK-QA-RELEASE assembles the evidence bundle (WP-24-09) and all exit criteria show green; failing items slip whole features to the next train, never half-ship (v1 §44.3).
- **Cut-line mechanics:** each phase's cut line is ordered; when schedule pressure hits, items are cut from the top of the cut list only — critical-path items are never cut, they slip the milestone with an explicit re-baseline ADR.
- **Two-week release trains** from M6 onward: cut → localization check → store submit → staged rollout (1%→10%→100%) with kill-switches (`ff_*`) armed on every new surface.
- **Parallelism rule:** streams marked parallel share no owned paths (§42 "Owns"); anything touching `contracts/` serializes through TRACK-CONTRACTS regardless of phase.
- **Bevel-floor tracking:** the parity checklist (v1 §6.1 observations) is a living CI-adjacent document; every phase review records which floor items closed.

### 41.1 Phase 0 — Foundations (months 0–3, weeks 0–13)

- **Entry criteria:** CONTRACT-FREEZE complete; monorepo scaffold merged (§47 layout); CI skeleton runs on both platforms; track staffing confirmed (§40.1).
- **Critical path (ordered):** 1) WP-01-01/02 registry schema+seeds → 2) WP-01-03 registry runtime → 3) WP-02-01 `HealthStorePort` interface → 4) WP-02-02/03 HK+HC actuals → 5) WP-03-01 normalization → 6) WP-03-02 dedup v1 → 7) WP-04-01 baseline engine → 8) WP-05-04 Today skeleton with real data.
- **Parallel streams:** design tokens + chart spike (WP-05-03); SQLDelight schema (WP-01/core-db within WP-03-01 deps); phrasing framework (WP-07-02); CI conformance harness (WP-24-01); backfill orchestrator (WP-02-04).
- **Exit criteria (measurable):** internal build shows personalized Today from ≥1yr backfilled data on both platforms (v1 exit); dedup conformance ≥40 fixtures green; baseline outputs match golden datasets within tolerance; p50 observer-delta ingestion <15 min on test devices; zero contract changes without ADR during weeks 8–13 (stability signal).
- **Cut line (slips first):** chart-library polish → presets → write-back (WP-02-05) → light theme completeness. Never cut: dedup fixtures, provenance fields, registry seeds.

### 41.2 Phase 1 — The honest daily companion (months 3–8, weeks 13–35) → public launch

- **Entry:** P0 exit signed by TRACK-QA-RELEASE; store accounts, privacy policy, and AR content pipeline live.
- **Critical path:** universal metric detail (WP-05-05) → All-Metrics browser (WP-05-07) → logging core (WP-06-01…06) → narrative v1 (WP-07-01/03/04) → trust surfaces (WP-08-01…03) → export v1 (WP-09-01…03) → notifications+widgets floor (WP-10-01…04) → onboarding + EN/AR (WP-07-05, content packs) → billing/trial scaffolding (WP-25-01…05) → launch hardening (E-24).
- **Parallel streams:** calendar/Timeline (WP-05-06); statuses + Health Monitor (TRACK-CORE-INTEL); Data Sources UI (WP-03-04); referral system (WP-25-06); education ramp v1 (TRACK-CONTENT).
- **Exit criteria:** v1's — D30 retention ≥ target for wearable-connected cohort; VM1 in-session-1 ≥80% (§38.1); crash-free ≥99.7%; plus: export round-trip test green (exported CSV/JSON re-imports losslessly via CSV mapper); phrasing-linter violations in shipped strings = 0; both stores approved incl. AR metadata.
- **Cut line:** widgets beyond core set → weekly digest polish → workout quick-add templates → referral (can trail launch by 4 wks). Never cut: export, consent center, local-only mode, denied-state matrix — these are the launch narrative ("what nobody else does," v1 §41).

### 41.3 Phase 2 — Depth & breadth (months 8–14, weeks 35–61)

- **Entry:** P1 exit; live-ops rhythm (release train every 2 wks) stable; Pro billing verified in production for one full renewal cycle.
- **Critical path:** fitness suite (E-11) and nutrition depth (E-12) in parallel → integrations wave (E-15, gated on integration-hub service WP-15-01) → Ask-BADAN grounded chat (E-17, gated on ai-gateway WP-17-01 + verifier WP-17-04) → Report Composer (E-18) → Biology pillar v1 + CGM + cycle engine (E-13/E-14, gated on covariate framework WP-04-02).
- **Parallel streams:** ambient suite (E-16); Sleep Bank + wind-down (TRACK-CORE-INTEL); import connectors (WP-15-05/06); watch apps.
- **Exit criteria:** v1's metric-coverage checklist vs §6/§10 Bevel floor = 100%; plus: broker→direct exit drill executed once (§43.4); AI numeric-claim verifier ≥99% precision on eval set (E-17 acceptance); notification-disable rate below public KPI threshold despite new surfaces.
- **Cut line:** muscle radar polish → recipes → StandBy/tiles extras → cohort teasers. Never cut: cycle-as-covariate architecture (female-physiology trap, §44), CGM wellness-framing gates.

### 41.4 Phase 3 — Intelligence & ownership apex (months 14–22, weeks 61–95)

- **Entry:** P2 exit; score-distribution drift monitors live (v1 §36.4); on-device AI runtime spike validated on min-spec devices.
- **Critical path:** Correlation Lab (WP-19-01/02) → Experiments (WP-19-03/04) → Bio Age explainable (E-20 after validation memo) → personal API + Parquet/SQLite (E-22) → on-device AI tier (E-21) → community circles v1 (E-23).
- **Parallel streams:** lab PDF import assist; advanced notification rules; additional languages wave; B2B API exploration (design only until consent plumbing review).
- **Exit criteria:** VM3 ≥25% of Pro trialists (§38.1); personal API in open beta with audit log surface; Bio Age published methodology page live; on-device private-mode parity matrix published (which AI features work fully offline).
- **Cut line:** community v1 → languages wave 2 → B2B exploration. Never cut: validation memos before Bio Age GA (pseudo-science trap).

### 41.5 Phase 4 — Horizon (22+)

As v1: FHIR regional strategy, family/caregiver sharing, voice, clinician-share evaluation, research mode, marketplace exploration — each gated by §45's preconditions and compliance gates. No milestone commitments; entry requires the §45 gate review.

## 43. Open-source and third-party build strategy

The v1 §43.1 build/buy/adopt matrix is carried unchanged as the decision record (health-store adapters: build thin on official SDKs; wearable breadth: buy broker then selectively build, Open Wearables as sovereignty fallback; dedup/normalization and scoring: **build** — the moat; SQLite+SQLDelight+SQLCipher: adopt; sync: build on proven primitives, E2E likely forces custom thin layer; charts: native Swift Charts + Vico/custom Compose under KMP chart-spec models; food data: multi-provider buy behind proxy; drug lists: regional registries display-only; AI: gateway-routed dual-vendor + on-device Tier 3; OCR: on-device first; auth: Apple/Google + passkeys; analytics: PostHog/TelemetryDeck-class; crash: Sentry; FHIR/research: adopt when phased in). v2 adds the integration engineering per dependency:

### 43.1 Per-dependency integration plan

| Dependency | Integration module home | Contract-test plan | Exit-path drill | License note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HealthKit / Health Connect | `adapters/port-health-ios/`, `port-health-android/` | port conformance suite vs `port-health` interface + device-farm smoke | n/a (official OS APIs); capability descriptors isolate deprecations | OS SDK terms; no redistribution issues |
| Broker (Terra-class) | `backend/services/integrations/broker/` | recorded webhook fixtures replayed in CI; schema drift alarms | annual broker→direct drill: migrate one vendor's users to direct connector in staging, measure gap (v1 §43.3) | commercial ToS; per-user pricing watched quarterly |
| Open Wearables (fallback) | same SPI as broker | same fixture suite must pass against self-hosted instance | standing: fallback deploy tested in the annual drill | open-source; license reviewed before any code linkage |
| SQLDelight / SQLCipher | `core/core-db/` | migration soak tests (WP-24-06); ciphered-db open benchmarks | export-everything guarantees data survival; schema documented in dictionary | Apache-2.0 / BSD-style (SQLCipher community); commercial license if needed for static linking review |
| PowerSync/ElectricSQL-class (if adopted for sync primitives) | `core/core-sync/` | protocol conformance vs `contracts/sync/sync.proto`; chaos tests (drop/dup/reorder) | protocol documented → custom thin-layer rewrite path costed in ADR | check per candidate; E2E envelope keeps vendor blind regardless |
| Swift Charts / Vico | `DesignSystem/`, `designsystem/` via KMP chart-spec models | snapshot suite renders spec fixtures both platforms | chart-spec model means renderer swap is contained | OS framework / Apache-2.0 |
| Food providers (OFF + commercial + regional) | `backend/services/fooddata/` proxy | per-provider golden queries; nutrient-field mapping tests; provenance required per item | provider removal drill: proxy serves from remaining providers; cached items retain provenance | OFF ODbL (attribution + share-alike on DB extracts — keep OFF data segregated in proxy); commercial ToS per provider |
| openFDA / regional drug registries | `backend/services/fooddata/` sibling `druglabels/` (display-only) | label-lookup fixtures; staleness alarms | display-only design = removable without data loss | public data; display-only avoids clinical-DB licensing (v1) |
| LLM vendors (dual) | `backend/services/ai-gateway/` | portable eval suite (grounding fidelity, verifier pass-rate, tone) run per vendor per release | vendor swap drill via gateway config; evals gate the swap (v1 §43.3) | commercial ToS; no training on user data — contractual requirement |
| On-device AI (Foundation Models / Gemma+LiteRT) | `Platform/OnDeviceAI/`, `platform/ondeviceai/` | WP-21 parity matrix tests per device class | template fallback always present (WP-21-01) | Gemma terms reviewed; weights not redistributed in repo |
| Vision / ML Kit OCR | `Platform/` OCR glue + `core-ingest/labs/mapper/` | lab-PDF fixture corpus with expected extractions | human-confirmation flow means OCR is assistive, removable | OS frameworks |
| Auth (Apple/Google + passkeys) | `backend/services/identity/` | OIDC conformance tests; passkey ceremony e2e | standard protocols only = provider portability (v1) | standard |
| PostHog/TelemetryDeck-class | `core/core-analytics/` sink adapter | event-schema validation against `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` | sink adapter swap; events schema is ours | MIT/commercial; self-hosted preferred |
| Sentry | `tooling/` init glue per platform | PII-scrub tests on crash payloads | drop-in alternates behind thin wrapper | BSL — acceptable for use, note for any redistribution |
| HAPI FHIR (future) | future `backend/services/fhir/` | contained to §45 gate | contained module | Apache-2.0 |

|---|---|---|---|

Kept proprietary (the moat, v1 §43.2): dedup corpus + strategies, scoring calibration, experience layer. Inbound-OSS hygiene: license allowlist in CI (`tooling/ci/license-check/`) — Apache/MIT/BSD auto-pass; ODbL/BSL/GPL-family require ADR.

Contribution policy for outbound repos: CLA-free (DCO sign-off only) to lower the barrier for the power-user community; PRs to `badan-import-connectors` require a fixture demonstrating the new format (mirrors internal WP-03-03 discipline); security reports route to a published `SECURITY.md` with the same triage SLA as internal findings; repo versions track `contracts/` version tags so external consumers can pin against app releases.

## 44. Risks, traps, and anti-patterns

All v1 §44 content carried; each trap now has an early-warning signal and a standing mitigation owner. v1 §44.1 (what NOT to copy from Bevel: paywall-first hero moments, zeros-and-skeletons cold start, logging-gated scores, iOS monoculture, export absence, collapsing tab bar, buried coach) remains the design-review blacklist, checked in every §40.4 fragmentation review.

### 44.1 Category traps with tripwires

| Trap (v1 §44.2) | Counter (carried) | Early-warning metric / review signal | Standing owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Calibration-trust | Provisional honesty + backfill | VM1 rate <80%; `insight_feedback_submitted {rating:inaccurate}` >15% in week-1 pool | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| Fragmentation | Connective-tissue systems + standing review | cross-pillar link taps per session trending down; new feature PRs without Timeline/narrative integration | design lead (shell tracks) |
| Intimidation | Depth dial + plain-word chips | casual-cohort session length collapsing after feature launches; onboarding drop at permission steps | TRACK-IOS/AND-FEATURES |
| Shallowness (overcorrection) | Contractual power floor (v1 §18) | power-segment (analyst/exporter) retention dip; §18 respect-protocol violations in review | product lead |
| Noise | Budget engine + public KPI | `notification_disabled` rate >2%/mo any class; budget overrides requested by features | TRACK-AMBIENT |
| Creepiness | Every claim shows evidence; no emotion inference | any insight template lacking evidence link fails linter; support tickets tagged "how do you know" | TRACK-CONTENT (wording board) |
| Brittleness | Adapter abstraction, replay buffers, canaries | vendor webhook error rate; auth-health dashboard ambers; delta-latency p95 drift | TRACK-BACKEND |
| Female-physiology | Covariate architecture from P2 | any baseline consumer bypassing WP-04-02 covariate API in code review | TRACK-CORE-INTEL |
| Pseudo-science | Validation memos, CIs, association language | score GA scheduled without memo (gate-report check); linter flags causal phrasing | data scientist + wording board |
| Localization-theater | Native AR authoring, RTL-native reviews | AR string churn lagging EN by >1 release; AR-native reviewer rejection rate | TRACK-CONTENT |
| Feature-factory | Seven laws arbitrate; benchmark informs | roadmap items citing "competitor shipped it" without a law-test note in the PRD | product lead |

### 44.2 Execution risks (v1 §44.3 carried, with tripwires)

| Risk (v1 §44.3) | Mitigation (carried) | Early warning | Standing owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dedup underestimation | staffed as a product: WP-03-02/03 + monthly sampling ritual | fixture-suite growth stalls while field dedup bugs rise | TRACK-CORE-DATA |
| KMP toolchain friction | senior platform owners; escape hatch: duplicated Swift core for isolated modules via ADR | iOS build-break frequency; interop workaround count in `adapters/` | TRACK-ADAPTERS |
| AI cost runaways | per-feature token budgets in WP-17-01; caching + small-model routing (fast/slow food-parse pattern) | cost/latency dashboards (§36.4) trending over budget 2 weeks | TRACK-BACKEND |
| Store-policy shifts on health data | compliance watch ritual + `ff_*` kill-switches on every sensitive surface | store review rejections; policy-changelog diffs in quarterly review | TRACK-QA-RELEASE + compliance fractional |
| Blueprint scope gravity | phase gates enforce §41 exit criteria; failing items slip whole, never half-ship | cut-line consumed >50% mid-phase; re-baseline ADRs clustering | product lead |

### 44.3 Implementation-era traps (new in v2 — multi-agent build hazards)

| Trap | Failure mode | Early warning | Standing mitigation (owner) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Contract drift between agents | Two tracks implement divergent readings of a schema | codegen diff in CI; cross-track integration sync finds mismatched DTOs | contracts are code-generated both directions; hand-written DTOs banned by lint (TRACK-CONTRACTS) |
| Schema churn | Post-freeze "small" registry/db changes cascade into rework | >2 ADRs/week touching `contracts/`; migration count growth rate | freeze discipline: batch changes into versioned windows; WP-24-06 soak on every change (TRACK-CONTRACTS) |
| KMP toolchain lock | Kotlin/Xcode/AGP version triangle blocks all tracks | toolchain upgrade PR older than 2 weeks; local build failures spike | pinned toolchain in `tooling/`, upgrade owned as scheduled packet, never ad-hoc (TRACK-QA-RELEASE) |
| Fixture rot | Conformance fixtures stop reflecting real-world device output | field-reported dedup bugs with no failing fixture | monthly dedup sampling converts field cases to fixtures (WP-03-03 living suite) (TRACK-CORE-DATA) |
| Parallel-merge conflicts on shared shells | Feature tracks editing shell/design-system files | PRs touching paths outside declared WP ownership | WP "Owns (paths)" is enforced by CODEOWNERS generated from §42 (TRACK-QA-RELEASE) |
| Mock divergence | Features built against fake ports that drift from actuals | port conformance suite failing only on device farm | fakes live in `core-testing/` and are tested against the same conformance suite as actuals (TRACK-ADAPTERS) |
| Analytics taxonomy sprawl | Agents invent events ad hoc; funnels break | events emitted but absent from `analytics-events.yaml` (runtime validator) | schema-validated client drops + alerts on unknown events (TRACK-QA-RELEASE) |

## 45. Future expansions

Each v1 §45 expansion restated with build preconditions, the architectural hooks this blueprint already reserves for it, a first-slice scope, and its compliance gate. None may start before its preconditions pass a gate review (TRACK-QA-RELEASE + compliance fractional). The gate review itself is a fixed checklist, applied identically to every expansion:

1. Preconditions verified against shipped module versions (not roadmap intent).
2. Named architectural hooks demonstrated live (compile-time or contract test, per WP-24-14).
3. First slice sized ≤ one release train, flag-gated, with a pre-registered kill criterion.
4. Compliance gate signed by the responsible fractional (counsel / wording board / security as listed).
5. Seven-laws test recorded in the expansion's ADR (v1 §46.3 discipline).

**Biological age v2 (multi-model, aging pace).** Preconditions: E-20 GA + 12 months longitudinal data across cohort; §36.4 drift monitors stable. Hooks present: `AlgoVersion` framework (WP-01-04) allows parallel model versions; Score Anatomy capture generalizes to multi-model decomposition. First slice: lifestyle-age vs blood-age split behind `ff_biology_bioage_v2` for opted-in Pro cohort. Compliance gate: updated validation memo + wording-board review of "pace of aging" phrasing.

**Health-record ingestion (FHIR).** Preconditions: §28 consent model extended with records-class consent; E-15 connector SPI stable. Hooks: `contracts/metrics` biomarker family + `LabResult` entity already model record-derived values; import idempotency (WP-03-06) handles archive overlap. First slice: HK Clinical Records (US) read into records vault with human-confirmed biomarker extraction. Compliance gate: jurisdiction review per v1 §29.2 + records-vault threat model.

**Bloodwork services compatibility.** Preconditions: E-22 export/import maturity; lab PDF import assist shipped (P3). Hooks: reference-range library with locale variants (v1 §9.8); `import_batches` provenance. First slice: two partner-lab CSV/PDF formats + reference-range harmonization report. Compliance gate: display-only framing check (no diagnostic interpretation).

**Family mode / caregiver sharing.** Preconditions: identity service multi-profile support; E-23 revocation patterns proven. Hooks: consent_records supports scoped grants; report links (E-18) are the sharing primitive. First slice: owner-driven weekly summary share to one caregiver, revocable, visibly logged (v1 §3.19). Compliance gate: elder-consent research review + minors excluded.

**Clinician-share mode.** Preconditions: E-18 Composer GA; expiring-link infrastructure in backend. Hooks: physician PDF template + audit log (WP-22-01 pattern). First slice: expiring read-only report link with professional formatting. Compliance gate: regulatory review confirming "sharing, not clinical system of record" (v1 §45).

**Advanced coaching (periodized plans, human-coach marketplace).** Preconditions: E-11 + E-17 GA; load-aware adjustment validated against ACWR grounding. Hooks: training-plan suggestion path in ai-gateway; consent-scoped report views. First slice: 4-week periodized plan generation with weekly load-aware adjustment, no marketplace. Compliance gate: wellness-framing audit; marketplace deferred to consent-plumbing review.

**Voice.** Preconditions: E-17 narrative quality stable; TTS cost model. Hooks: daily narrative is already a text artifact (composability); quick-log intents (WP-16-05) extend to voice. First slice: morning audio briefing (TTS of existing narrative) behind `ff_ambient_voice_briefing`. Compliance gate: privacy review of any speech processing path (on-device preferred).

**Multilingual wave 2+ (FR/DE/ES/JA/UR/HI/TR, dialect-aware AR).** Preconditions: TRACK-CONTENT pipeline throughput proven on EN/AR; phrasing linter per-language rule packs. Hooks: `content/` locale structure; `port-locale`; registry localized-name fields. First slice: one LTR (ES) + one new RTL/complex (UR) to stress both pipelines. Compliance gate: native-authoring policy per language (no translation-theater).

**Wearable ecosystem expansion / BLE-direct.** Preconditions: §13.1 watchlist trigger (a class ships volume without store/broker path). Hooks: connector SPI (WP-15-01); capability descriptors. First slice: one BLE-direct device class behind a flag, evaluated against maintenance cost. Compliance gate: none beyond standard; ADR required for the maintenance commitment.

**Open API & ecosystem (webhooks, integrations gallery).** Preconditions: E-22 personal API beta stable; token/audit model proven. Hooks: `contracts/api/personal-api-openapi.yaml`; local export server (WP-22-04). First slice: webhook subscriptions for daily-summary events + two reference integrations (Obsidian exporter, Home Assistant). Compliance gate: plugin-review model published before gallery opens.

**Research mode.** Preconditions: consent center extended to e-consent (IRB-grade); export pipelines reproducible (E-22). Hooks: Experiments engine protocol structure (WP-19-03) generalizes to structured self-experiments; export manifests embed methodology. First slice: opt-in data donation to one IRB-approved study with granular consent + revocation. Compliance gate: IRB partnership + regional research-data law review.

**Assistant-led data exploration (chat → durable artifacts).** Preconditions: E-17 + E-19 GA; verifier precision holding ≥99%. Hooks: saved-analysis persistence (Correlation Lab results are already durable); Composer sections as render targets. First slice: "save this analysis" from Ask-BADAN producing a re-runnable monthly report section. Compliance gate: wording-board review of auto-generated recurring claims.

## 46. Final synthesis — the execution charter

v1 §46's synthesis stands: BADAN refuses the false trade between simple-and-shallow and deep-and-hostile, resolves it architecturally, takes Bevel's validated grammar while fixing its documented failures, and answers the nine adjectives with the seven laws. v2 restates it as an operating charter for the orchestrator (human or agent) running the build described in §41–42 and dispatched per §66.

### 46.1 The ten invariants (an orchestrator must never let an agent violate these)

| # | Invariant | Enforcing artifact |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Raw data and manual logs are never gated by entitlement, lapse, or deletion flow (Law 1) | WP-25-04 static check: `core-db`/`SampleRepository` compile with zero entitlement imports; §39.5 matrix tests |
| 2 | No confident number without confidence metadata (Law 2) | `QualityFlags` required on `DerivedValue` (WP-04-06); phrasing linter blocks unhedged provisional claims |
| 3 | Zero-effort utility: every feature has a passive variant (Law 3) | §16 screen specs' empty/no-data states + DoD checklist item; Bevel anti-pattern blacklist in design review |
| 4 | One data model, two altitudes — no forked "advanced" stores (Law 4) | single `core-db` schema; depth dial renders from same queries (WP-11-06-style reuse reviews) |
| 5 | Every stored value carries full provenance (Law 5) | `Provenance` non-nullable in `core-model`; dedup journal + lineage sheets (WP-03-02/05) |
| 6 | New features integrate into Timeline/narrative/correlations or don't ship (Law 6) | fragmentation review ritual + DoD "connective tissue" scrutiny in screen specs |
| 7 | iOS/Android/EN/AR/RTL parity is a merge condition, not a follow-up (Law 7) | DoD checklist (§40.3) + parity and RTL CI suites (WP-24-01/05) |
| 8 | Contracts change only via ADR + version bump; no agent edits `contracts/` inline | CONTRACT-FREEZE process + CODEOWNERS on `contracts/**` (WP-24-07) |
| 9 | No health values in telemetry; no experiment on truth surfaces | analytics schema validation (`contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` CI) + §36.3 experiment policy |
| 10 | Wellness framing everywhere: no diagnosis/treatment claims | `contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml` linter in CI + monthly wording audit + wording board sign-off on scores |

### 46.2 First 30 days — ordered checklist

Concrete steps, in order (detailed agent-dispatch matrices in §66):

1. **Days 1–5 — Freeze contracts (M0).** Author and ratify: `contracts/metrics/registry.schema.json` (WP-01-01), `HealthStorePort` (WP-02-01), `contracts/events/domain-events.yaml` + `analytics-events.yaml`, `contracts/export/schema/v1/`, `contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml` (WP-07-02 contract half), sync protocol draft. ADR-0001 (architecture baseline) through ADR-0006 merged. Tag `contracts v1.0.0`.
2. **Days 3–8 — Scaffold the monorepo** per conventions §2 tree: Gradle KMP skeleton (`core/*` empty modules with dependency rules), XcodeGen `project.yml`, Android app shell, `backend/` FastAPI skeletons, `tooling/ci/` with build+lint on every path. CODEOWNERS generated from §42 ownership.
3. **Days 5–10 — CI foundations** (WP-24-01 start, WP-24-07): parity harness, snapshot infra (both themes + AR pseudolocale), fixture runner, analytics schema check, license allowlist, DoD PR template.
4. **Days 8–15 — Registry seeds + core-db schema:** WP-01-02 (350 seeds), WP-01-03 runtime, WP-03-01 schema with `Provenance` non-nullable. Data-dictionary generator (WP-01-06) producing docs from day one.
5. **Days 10–20 — Adapter actuals in parallel:** WP-02-02 (HK) and WP-02-03 (HC) against the frozen port, with `core-testing` fake port serving all other tracks meanwhile.
6. **Days 12–22 — Dedup v1 + fixtures:** WP-03-02 strategies, WP-03-03 first 20 fixtures (grow to 40 by M2); decision journal wired.
7. **Days 15–25 — Baseline engine + first score:** WP-04-01, WP-04-03 sleep score with golden datasets and the first validation memo.
8. **Days 18–28 — Design tokens + chart spike (WP-05-03) and shells (WP-05-01/02)** so the M2 vertical slice has a rendering target.
9. **Days 25–30 — Vertical-slice review (pre-M2):** one metric flowing HK/HC → normalize → dedup → store → baseline → band chart on both platforms; gate-report tooling (WP-24-09) drafted; §44.3 tripwires (contract drift, schema churn) armed; dispatch the M2–M3 packet wave per §66.

The charter's test for every future decision remains v1 §46.3's: run it against the seven laws — and when a decision passes all seven, it belongs in BADAN.

**بدنك. بياناتك. قصتك. — Your body. Your data. Your story.**
## 47. Repository and monorepo design

This section is the physical layout that v1 §33.2 sketched. One repo, four toolchains (Gradle, XcodeGen, pnpm, uv/pip for backend), one CI entry point. Rationale for KMP-shared-core lives in v1 §33.1; this section only implements it.

### 47.1 Canonical tree, extended

The conventions-§2 tree is authoritative. Below, `core/` and `adapters/` are expanded 1–2 levels deeper with the key files each module must contain at P0-exit. Files listed here are load-bearing names cited by other sections (§48–§52, §53+).

```
badan/
├── settings.gradle.kts                     # includes :core:*, :adapters:*, :android:*
├── gradle/libs.versions.toml               # single version catalog (see 47.2)
├── build-logic/                            # Gradle convention plugins (included build)
│   └── src/main/kotlin/
│       ├── badan.kmp-module.gradle.kts     # KMP targets: iosArm64/iosSimulatorArm64/android/jvm
```

### 47.2 Build-system decisions

| Decision | Choice | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| Gradle versioning | Single `gradle/libs.versions.toml` catalog; no version literals in module build files | One PR bumps Kotlin/AGP/SQLDelight everywhere; Renovate targets one file |
| Convention plugins | `build-logic/` included build; every `core-*` module's build file is ≤10 lines (`plugins { id("badan.kmp-module") }` + deps) | Module creation is copy-free; target/toolchain drift impossible |
| KMP targets | `iosArm64`, `iosSimulatorArm64`, `androidTarget`, `jvm` (jvm for fast unit tests + tooling reuse) | Golden-file tests run on JVM in seconds; parity suite (v1 §33.5) runs same fixtures on all targets |
| iOS project generation | **XcodeGen** (`ios/project.yml`), not Tuist: declarative YAML diffs cleanly in PRs, zero Swift build-time dependency, sufficient for our 6-target project | `.xcodeproj` is gitignored; `xcodegen generate` in bootstrap + CI |
| KMP→Swift bridge | SKIE plugin on the `:core:umbrella` framework module (sealed classes → Swift enums, Flow → AsyncSequence) | §49.2 consumes idiomatic Swift, no manual bridging layer beyond `CoreFacade` |
| JS/tooling | pnpm workspaces rooted at `tooling/` (fixture-gen, schema-dictionary-gen web output, CI scripts) | Node pinned via `.nvmrc`; pnpm lockfile checked in |
| Backend | uv-managed Python per service (`backend/services/*/pyproject.toml`), shared models generated from contracts | §48.3 codegen is the only path for wire types |
| CI | GitHub Actions, path-filtered jobs (contracts/ change → codegen+contract tests; core/ → KMP tests; ios/ → macOS lane; android/ → Linux lane) | Median PR CI < 15 min; full matrix nightly |

### 47.3 Module dependency rules (allowed-imports matrix)

Rule of thumb: data flows **model → db → engines → surfaces**; nothing imports upward; ports are leaves known only to `core-ingest`, `core-sync`, and app shells via DI. `core-testing` may import everything (test-only). All modules may import `core-model`; the matrix lists additional permitted deps.

| Module | May additionally depend on | Explicitly forbidden (common temptations) |
|---|---|---|
| core-model | — (stdlib, kotlinx-datetime/serialization only) | any other badan module |
| core-registry | — | core-db (registry is DB-free; caching handled by callers) |
| core-db | core-registry | any engine module |
| core-ingest | core-registry, core-db, adapters:port-health, port-clock, port-files | core-scoring (emits events; never calls scoring directly) |
| core-baseline | core-registry, core-db | core-scoring, core-insight |
| core-scoring | core-registry, core-db, core-baseline | core-insight, core-phrasing |
| core-insight | core-registry, core-db, core-baseline, core-scoring, core-phrasing, core-flags | core-notify (insights are consumed by notify, not vice versa) |
| core-phrasing | core-registry, port-locale | core-db (pure; evidence passed in) |
| core-sync | core-db, port-crypto, port-clock, port-files | any engine (derived values never sync, v1 §34.3) |
| core-export | core-registry, core-db, port-files, port-locale | core-sync (exports are local-always, v1 §34.5) |
| core-search | core-registry, core-db, port-locale | — |
| core-notify | core-registry, core-flags, port-clock, port-push | core-db direct (reads via injected repositories interfaces from core-db) |
| core-flags | port-files, port-clock | everything else |
| core-analytics | core-flags, port-clock | core-db, any health-data module (no health values in analytics, v1 §36.1) |

Enforcement is two-layer:
1. **Gradle graph check** — `badan.lint-arch.gradle.kts` reads `build-logic/module-graph.yaml` (the matrix above, machine-readable) and fails configuration if `project.configurations` declare an edge not in the allowlist. Runs on every build.
2. **Konsist source check** — `core-testing/.../arch/ModuleDependencyRulesTest.kt`: for each module, asserts no `import net.badan.core.<forbidden>` appears in sources; extra assertions: engines never import `net.badan.adapters.health.ios|android` (only the port), UI-facing DTO packages never import SQLDelight-generated `*Row` types. CI-blocking.

Two rules: `contracts/` additionally requires one reviewer from each *consuming* track on breaking changes (enforced by a labeler bot reading §48.5 change class); `core-model` changes require track-contracts + track-core-data double sign-off.

### 47.5 Branch and PR conventions

- **Trunk-based**: `main` protected, merge-queue enabled; no long-lived develop branch. Release branches `release/ios-1.x` / `release/android-1.x` cut at code-freeze only.
- **Branch names**: `<type>/WP-<epic>-<nn>-<slug>` — e.g. `feat/WP-03-02-dedup-conformance-fixtures`, `fix/WP-24-41-hc-availability-crash`. WP id mandatory; the CI PR-lint rejects branches without one (exception label `no-wp` for chores).
- **Commits**: Conventional Commits (`feat(core-ingest): …`); squash-merge, PR title becomes the commit.
- **PR template**: WP id + acceptance-criteria checklist copied from the packet table; "contract touched? y/n" gate; screenshot/screen-recording required for UI PRs in both themes (+ RTL if layout).
- **Required checks**: arch lint (47.3), module unit tests, contract tests if `contracts/` touched, parity suite if `core-scoring`/`core-ingest` touched, snapshot tests for UI paths.

### 47.6 Repo bootstrap sequence (day 1–3, ordered)

1. `git init badan && cd badan`; commit `CODEOWNERS`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, license, `.editorconfig`, `.gitattributes` (LFS for fixture archives).
2. Gradle skeleton: `gradle init` → replace with `settings.gradle.kts` including `build-logic`; author `gradle/libs.versions.toml` (Kotlin, AGP, SQLDelight, SKIE, kotlinx-*, Konsist, Compose BOM pinned).
3. Author `build-logic/` convention plugins (47.2); prove with empty `:core:core-model` compiling for all four targets.
4. `contracts/` skeleton: `metrics/registry.schema.json` + one seed family file `metrics/registry/sleep.yaml` (§48.7 example); `events/domain-events.yaml`, `events/analytics-events.yaml` with 3 seed entries each; `phrasing/guardrails.yaml` with v1 §23.9 banned-frames encoded.
5. `tooling/codegen/` generators (§48.3) wired as Gradle tasks; run once, commit generated `MetricIds.kt`, `AnalyticsEvents.kt`; add drift check (regenerate-and-diff) to CI.
6. `:core:core-db` with first migration `1.sqm` creating `samples`, `sources`, `sync` aggregates (§52); `DatabaseFactory` + in-memory test proving SQLDelight toolchain.
7. `adapters/port-health` interface (§51.1) + `core-testing` fakes + conformance kit skeleton.
8. iOS: `ios/project.yml` (targets §49.1) + `xcodegen generate`; `BadanApp` renders a "core says: {Ulid}" proof screen calling the KMP umbrella framework via SKIE.
9. Android: `android/app` with `badan.android-app` plugin, single `MainActivity`, same proof screen; Hilt wired (§50.3).
10. `pnpm init` workspace in `tooling/`; `backend/services/identity` FastAPI hello with generated models import proving §48.3 Python lane.
11. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with the path-filtered lanes (47.2); branch protection + merge queue on.
12. Tag `bootstrap-complete`; open the first real packets (WP tables below).

## 48. Shared contracts and schema architecture

`contracts/` is the freeze layer: every cross-boundary shape (device↔core, core↔UI analytics, client↔backend, app↔export consumer, app↔app sync) is declared here, versioned here, and generated from here. Nothing hand-writes a wire type. Rationale: v1 §30.4 (schema governance) and v1 §20.5 (export stability promise).

### 48.1 Contract artifact inventory

| Artifact | Path | Format + why | Version rule | Generated outputs (tool → path) | Verified by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Metric registry | `contracts/metrics/registry/*.yaml` + `registry.schema.json` | YAML per family (human-reviewed, localizable strings inline); JSON Schema validates in CI | Registry semver `registry_version`; per-entry `since` / `deprecated` fields | `registry-gen` (KotlinPoet) → `core-registry/.../generated/MetricIds.kt`, `SeedRegistry.kt`; JSON bundle → `content/registry/registry-vN.json` for CMS delivery | `RegistryValidatorTest` (every entry: unit convertible, family known, baseline policy legal); registry→UI binding test (E-01.3) |
| Domain events | `contracts/events/domain-events.yaml` | YAML (payload schemas inline JSON-Schema); events are in-process so no proto needed | semver; payload fields additive-only within a major | `events-gen` → `core-model/.../generated/DomainEvent.kt` (sealed interface, one data class per event) | producer/consumer pact tests in each emitting module (`DomainEventContractTest`) |
| Analytics events | `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` | YAML; every property enumerated + typed; **no free-string properties allowed by schema** (v1 §36.1) | additive-only; removal = major + telemetry-dashboard migration note | `events-gen` → `core-analytics/.../generated/AnalyticsEvents.kt` + `ios/BadanApp/Generated/AnalyticsEvents.swift` (native surfaces log via facade, but widgets log directly) + backend intake validator JSON | `EventSchemaValidator` at runtime drops off-schema events; CI test replays fixture events against intake validator |
| Export schemas | `contracts/export/schema/v1/*.schema.json` | JSON Schema (csv-manifest, json-bundle, sqlite-views DDL manifest) — consumer is the public; must be self-describing | Published semver, majors kept readable forever (v1 §20.5) | `schema-dictionary-gen` (pnpm) → `docs/data-dictionary/` site + in-app dictionary JSON | export snapshot tests in `core-export` (fixture DB → export → validate against schema, byte-stable) |
| Sync protocol | `contracts/sync/sync.proto` + `protocol.md` | protobuf: binary efficiency for encrypted-envelope framing; `protocol.md` states clock/tombstone semantics prose | proto package `badan.sync.v1`; new fields optional-only; new majors = new package | Wire → `core-sync/.../transport/`; protoc-python → `backend/services/sync/generated/` | bidirectional pact: client fixture envelopes replayed against sync service in CI (blind-payload asserted: server code cannot name any health field) |
| Backend API | `contracts/api/backend-openapi.yaml` | OpenAPI 3.1 (identity, integrations, food proxy, AI gateway, billing, telemetry) | path-versioned `/v1/`; deprecation header `Sunset` required | openapi-generator (kotlin/ktor) → `core-*/…/backendclient/`; datamodel-code-generator → `backend/shared/models/` | schemathesis fuzz vs service in CI; client compile is itself the consumer test |
| Personal API | `contracts/api/personal-api-openapi.yaml` (Phase 3) | OpenAPI 3.1, read-only, published to users (v1 §20.8) | strict semver; breaking = new major path, old maintained ≥12 months | same toolchain; public docs site render | public-contract snapshot test; token-scope matrix test |
| Phrasing guardrails | `contracts/phrasing/guardrails.yaml` | YAML rule list: banned regex frames, required qualifiers, status-conditioned suppressions (v1 §23.9) | additive rules anytime (tightening is non-breaking); *loosening* requires ADR + safety review | `phrasing-gen` → `core-phrasing/.../generated/GuardrailRules.kt`; also loaded at runtime for hotfix tightening via CMS | `PhrasingLinter` unit corpus + red-team suite in CI (adversarial templates must fail) |
| Presets | `contracts/presets/presets.yaml` | YAML: named customization presets (Casual, Balanced, Power-longevity…, v1 §19) → layout + module-visibility + depth defaults | semver; renaming a preset id is breaking | `registry-gen` → `core-flags/.../generated/PresetDefinitions.kt` | preset-application test: applying each preset to a fixture profile yields snapshot-stable layout JSON |

### 48.2 Change classes and the versioning rule

Every `contracts/` PR must declare one class in its description (bot-enforced label):

- **C0 editorial** — descriptions, docs, localized names. Patch bump. No consumer action.
- **C1 additive-compatible** — new metric entry, new optional field, new event with new name, new preset. Minor bump. Consumers regenerate; no migration.
- **C2 behavioral** — same shape, changed semantics (e.g., baseline policy window changes on an existing metric). Minor bump + mandatory `docs/adr/` entry + algorithm-version bump in the registry entry so DerivedValues re-derive (v1 §30.1).
- **C3 breaking** — field removal/rename, type change, event retirement, export column change. Major bump. Full process in 48.4.

### 48.3 Codegen pipeline

```
contracts/**            (source of truth, human-edited YAML/proto/OpenAPI)
   │  Gradle task graph: :tooling:codegen:generateAll (also pnpm-callable)
   ├─ registry-gen   (Kotlin/KotlinPoet, tooling/codegen/registry-gen/)
   │     → core-registry MetricIds.kt + SeedRegistry.kt; core-flags PresetDefinitions.kt
   │     → content/registry/registry-vN.json
   ├─ events-gen     (Kotlin, tooling/codegen/events-gen/)
   │     → core-model DomainEvent.kt; core-analytics AnalyticsEvents.kt
   │     → ios/BadanApp/Generated/AnalyticsEvents.swift
   │     → backend/services/telemetry/generated/event_schema.json
   ├─ phrasing-gen   → core-phrasing generated GuardrailRules.kt
   ├─ Wire (proto)   → core-sync transport types
   ├─ protoc+datamodel-code-generator → backend/services/sync & shared models
   ├─ openapi-generator (kotlin) → client stubs in core modules that call backend
   └─ schema-dictionary-gen (pnpm, tooling/schema-dictionary-gen/)
         → docs/data-dictionary/ static site + in-app dictionary bundle
```

Generated Kotlin/Swift is **checked in** (reviewable diffs, no generator needed for day-to-day builds); CI runs generate-and-diff to prevent drift. Generators are deterministic (sorted keys, pinned versions).

### 48.4 Breaking-change process (C3)

1. ADR in `docs/adr/ADR-NNNN-<slug>.md` (context, alternatives, migration cost) approved by track-contracts + affected-track owners (CODEOWNERS gate, 47.4).
2. Deprecation window opens: old shape marked `deprecated: "1.4.0"` with `removal_earliest` date ≥ 2 minor releases and ≥ 90 days for anything user-visible (export schemas: majors never removed, only frozen).
3. Migration note written into `contracts/CHANGELOG.md` + `docs/data-dictionary/migrations/` (export) or push-delivered client migration for sync/proto.
4. Dual-read/dual-write period where applicable (sync envelopes carry `schema_major`; clients read n and n−1).
5. Removal PR must link telemetry evidence that old-shape traffic < 0.5% (backend contracts) or ship a client floor version (sync).

### 48.5 Contract-test strategy per boundary

| Boundary | Producer | Consumer | Suite (path) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform store → core | `port-health-ios/-android` actuals | `core-ingest` | adapter conformance kit `core-testing/adapter-kit/` (§51.9) against recorded HK/HC fixtures |
| Registry → UI | `contracts/metrics` | both apps | registry-binding test: inject a synthetic metric entry, assert browser row + detail screen render with zero UI code (E-01.3) |
| Engines → app | KMP umbrella | `CoreFacade` (iOS) / Hilt graph (Android) | facade smoke tests per platform + cross-platform parity suite (same fixture DB → identical scores/exports, v1 §33.5) |
| App → analytics intake | `core-analytics` | telemetry service | replay fixture event stream through generated intake validator; unknown-property = fail |
| Client ↔ sync service | `core-sync` | `backend/services/sync` | pact envelopes both directions; blindness assertion (server test imports must not reference health field names) |
| Export → public | `core-export` | published dictionary | schema snapshot + round-trip: export fixture DB, validate every file against `contracts/export/schema/v1`, re-import into fresh DB, assert row counts |
| Templates → phrasing | `content/` insight templates | `core-phrasing` | `PhrasingLinter` run over full template corpus in CI; any C-banned frame fails |

### 48.6 Worked example 1 — metric registry entry

`contracts/metrics/registry/vitals.yaml` (excerpt, one full entry):

```yaml
registry_version: 1.3.0
family: vitals
entries:
  - id: vitals.hrv_rmssd
    kind: sample                    # sample|interval|session|event|score
    names:
      en: { casual: "Heart rate variability", precise: "HRV (rMSSD)" }
      ar: { casual: "تفاوت معدل ضربات القلب", precise: "HRV (rMSSD)" }
    unit:
      canonical: ms
      display: [ms]
      precision: 1
    source_classes: [device, platform, derived]
    derivation:
      methods:
        - id: rmssd_raw_beats       # BADAN derivation from beat series
          algorithm: alg.hrv_rmssd  # versioned in AlgorithmVersion table
          default: true
        - id: platform_field        # HK SDNN-adjacent field / HC RMSSD record
      user_selectable: true          # Bevel-parity calc setting, v1 §6.2
    baseline_policy:
      window_days: 60
      stat: median_mad
      covariates: [cycle_phase, travel, activity_status]
      provisional_min_nights: 14
    quality:
      physiologic_bounds: { min: 5, max: 300 }
      artifact_rules: [sleep_window_coverage_min_20]
    depth:
      casual_visible: true
      casual_render: band_status_chip
      power_render: band_chart_trends_table
    sensitivity_class: standard      # standard|sensitive|sensitive_plus (v1 §28.7)
    since: 1.0.0
```

## 49. iOS implementation architecture

Implements v1 §32 (on-device architecture) and §33 (KMP consumption) for iOS. Screens themselves are §16A property; this section owns the shell, glue, and platform services.

### 49.1 Target list (`ios/project.yml`)

| Target | Type | Contents | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|
| BadanApp | app | SwiftUI app, Features/, DesignSystem/, Platform/ | Core.xcframework (KMP umbrella via SKIE) |
| BadanWidgets | widget-ext | WidgetKit timeline providers, Live Activities (v1 §24.2–24.3) | Core (read-only slice) + shared `BadanKit` |
| BadanWatch | watchOS app | glance pages, complications, set-logger (v1 §24.4) | BadanKit + WatchConnectivity |
| BadanIntents | app-intents ext | App Intents / Shortcuts (49.10) | BadanKit |
| BadanKit | framework | shared Swift: `CoreFacade`, formatters, DesignSystem tokens, deep-link parser | Core.xcframework |
| BadanAppTests | unit | ViewModel + facade tests (swift-testing) | BadanApp |
| BadanSnapshotTests | unit | swift-snapshot-testing: themes × RTL × 3 type sizes (v1 §33.5) | BadanApp |
| BadanUITests | ui | XCUITest critical flows: log food, view metric, export, permission dance | — |

App Group `group.net.badan.shared` shares the SQLCipher DB + flag cache between app/widgets/intents; watch has its own store hydrated via connectivity + its own HK reads.

### 49.2 KMP consumption layer

- `:core:umbrella` Gradle module exports all core modules as one `Core.xcframework`; SKIE generates Swift-idiomatic API (sealed → enum, suspend → async, Flow → AsyncSequence).
- Swift never touches KMP types outside `BadanKit`. `CoreFacade` (in `BadanKit/Core/CoreFacade.swift`) is the single doorway, split into role facades:

```swift
public final class CoreFacade: Sendable {
    public let today: TodayFacade          // GetTodayOverviewQuery, narrative stream
    public let metrics: MetricsFacade      // registry browse, detail series, trends tables
    public let logging: LoggingFacade      // LogMealCommand, LogSymptomCommand…
    public let ingest: IngestFacade        // pipeline enqueue, backfill progress
    public let export: ExportFacade
    public let sync: SyncFacade
    public static func start(config: CoreConfig) async throws -> CoreFacade  // boots DB, registry, engines
}
```

- Mapping rule: facades emit Swift value types (`TodayOverview`, `MetricDetailModel`) mapped from KMP DTOs in `BadanKit/Core/Mapping/*.swift`; SwiftUI views never see a KMP class name (keeps SKIE churn out of feature code).

### 49.3 Dependency injection — environment-based factory container

No DI framework. One `@Observable` container, injected via SwiftUI Environment:

```swift
@Observable @MainActor final class AppDependencies {
    let core: CoreFacade
    let router: AppRouter
    let healthKit: HealthKitAdapterController   // Platform/HealthKit/
    let notifications: NotificationScheduler
    let flags: FlagsProxy
    let analytics: AnalyticsProxy
    // factory methods per feature:
    func metricDetailViewModel(route: MetricDetailRoute) -> MetricDetailViewModel { … }
}
// BadanApp.swift:  RootView().environment(\.deps, AppDependencies.live)
```

Tests swap `AppDependencies.preview` / `.test(coreFixture:)` built on `core-testing` fixture DBs. Rationale: 6 targets, one graph root, compile-time safety without macro/codegen cost; factories keep ViewModel init signatures honest.

### 49.4 Feature-folder anatomy — worked example

```
ios/BadanApp/Features/MetricDetail/
├── MetricDetailScreen.swift          # View; consumes MetricDetailViewModel.state (LoadState<MetricDetailModel>)
├── MetricDetailViewModel.swift       # @Observable; pulls MetricsFacade.detail(id:period:); owns period paging
├── MetricDetailRoute.swift           # Codable route: metricId, initialPeriod (49.5)
├── components/
│   ├── StatusHeader.swift            # value + "Above normal 74.0–82.2" chip (v1 §6.1 template)
│   ├── MetricSwitcherChips.swift
│   ├── BandChartSection.swift        # wraps DesignSystem/BandChart with personal-range bands
│   ├── PeriodControl.swift           # 30D/3M/6M/1Y + calendar + paging chevrons
│   ├── TrendsAnalysisTable.swift     # 3/7/14/30/90d rolling deltas
│   ├── ResourcesSection.swift        # education cards (content CMS)
│   └── DefinitionFooter.swift        # (i) physiology footer + algorithm-doc link
├── MetricDetailPreviewFixtures.swift # #Preview data from core-testing golden slices
└── (tests live in BadanAppTests/Features/MetricDetail/: MetricDetailViewModelTests.swift,
     and BadanSnapshotTests/MetricDetailSnapshotTests.swift)
```

Every feature folder follows this shape (`XxxScreen`, `XxxViewModel`, `XxxRoute`, `components/`, preview fixtures); the §16A screen specs map 1:1 onto these folders.

### 49.5 Navigation

- `AppRouter` (in `App/AppRouter.swift`): one `NavigationPath` per tab + modal stack; routes are small `Codable` structs (`MetricDetailRoute`, `TimelineRoute`…), registered in a `RouteRegistry` mapping route → screen factory (via `AppDependencies`).
- Path serialization: `NavigationPath.CodableRepresentation` persisted to app-group defaults on background; restored on cold start (<400 ms budget respected by lazy VM creation).
- Deep links: `badan://metric/vitals.hrv_rmssd?period=m3`, `badan://log/water`, `badan://export/history` parsed by `BadanKit/DeepLink/DeepLinkParser.swift` (shared with widgets/intents); every notification and widget deep-link has an integrity test (E-10 acceptance).

### 49.6 Background task registration (exact identifiers)

Registered in `Platform/Background/BackgroundTaskRegistrar.swift`; all listed in Info.plist `BGTaskSchedulerPermittedIdentifiers`:

| Identifier | Type | Work | Budget rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `net.badan.bg.refresh` | BGAppRefreshTask | anchored-query top-ups, narrative refresh | ≤30 s; reschedules itself |
| `net.badan.bg.nightly-recompute` | BGProcessingTask (requiresExternalPower preferred) | baselines, insight scan, decimation tiers (v1 §32.3) | chunked + resumable via `RecomputePlanner` checkpoints |
| `net.badan.bg.import-continue` | BGProcessingTask | resume archive import batches | streams, never whole-archive in memory (v1 §32.6) |
| `net.badan.bg.sync-push` | BGAppRefreshTask | flush sync oplog | skips on metered constraints per user setting |
| `net.badan.bg.export-scheduled` | BGProcessingTask | Pro scheduled exports (v1 §20.7) | local generation always |

HealthKit background deliveries wake the app independently of BGTask (49.7); the two paths converge on `IngestScheduler`.

### 49.7 HealthKit adapter implementation notes (`adapters/port-health-ios` + `Platform/HealthKit/`)

- **Observer setup:** on permission grant per type bundle, register `HKObserverQuery` + `enableBackgroundDelivery` (`.hourly` for aggregates, `.immediate` for sleep/workouts). Completion handlers must call the HK completion within the window — `HkObserverBridge.kt` hands off to a detached ingest job and completes immediately.
- **Anchored reads:** `HKAnchoredObjectQuery` per type; anchors persisted in `sync.sq/read_anchors` keyed `(store='hk', type_id)`; anchor reset protocol on permission re-grant or OS-major change (re-probe, v1 §37.3 case 16).
- **Delivery → pipeline handoff:** `HealthKitStore.observe()` emits `StoreChangeEvent(typeIds, reason)`; `IngestScheduler` debounces 90 s, batches types, and runs `NormalizationPipeline` off-main; deleted-object anchors map to tombstone suppressions.
- **Workouts:** `HkWorkoutReader.kt` expands `HKWorkout` → session + HR series + segments/laps where present; energy/distance statistics read via `statisticsForType`.
- **Backfill:** `BackfillCoordinator` walks history newest-first in 30-day windows (recent-data-first usability, v1 §34.4), progress events → onboarding UI.
- **Self-source filtering:** all BADAN writes stamp `HKMetadataKeySyncIdentifier` prefix `net.badan.` and readers drop own-source samples (v1 §11.5).

### 49.8 Widget timeline providers (`ios/BadanWidgets/`)

| Provider | Widget(s) | Timeline policy |
|---|---|---|
| `TodayRingsProvider` | small single-ring, medium tri-ring+sentence | `.after(next hour)`; reload pushed via `WidgetCenter` on `ScoresRecomputed` |
| `SentenceProvider` | small One True Sentence, Lock Screen inline | after morning recompute; stale >12 h shows dated chip, never wrong-day text |
| `HealthMonitorProvider` | medium mini-grid | hourly |
| `MedsDueProvider` | small meds count (interactive take-action via AppIntent) | at each dose time |
| `WaterQuickLogProvider` | small interactive | static; button = `LogWaterIntent` |
| `SleepLastNightProvider` / `GlucoseStripProvider` | mediums (opt-in, sensitive redaction rules v1 §24.2) | post-wake / 15-min while CGM live |

Widgets read a pre-rendered `WidgetSnapshot.json` in the app group (written by the app/BG tasks) — no engine boot inside the extension memory cap.

### 49.9 Watch connectivity

- `Platform/Watch/WatchSessionRelay.swift` (phone) ↔ `BadanWatch/Connectivity/PhoneLink.swift`: `updateApplicationContext` carries the readiness snapshot + meds-due list; `transferUserInfo` queues quick-logs (water/mood/symptom/med-taken) from wrist → phone → `LoggingFacade` (offline-safe, replayed on reachability).
- Workouts: watch app uses `HKWorkoutSession`/live metrics natively (no custom polling, v1 §24.4); resulting HK samples flow through the normal adapter — no side channel.

### 49.10 App Intents (`ios/BadanIntents/`)

`LogWaterIntent`, `LogCaffeineIntent`, `LogMoodIntent`, `LogMealDescriptionIntent` (free-text → describe pipeline), `GetTodaySummaryIntent` (returns sentence + rings snippet for Siri/Shortcuts), `StartWindDownIntent`, `ExportLastMonthIntent` (v1 §20.7), `SetActivityStatusIntent`. All route through `BadanKit` facades; each has a donation policy and a deep-link fallback.

### 49.11 Build configurations

| Config | Bundle id suffix | Flags |
|---|---|---|
| Debug | `.debug` | `BADAN_ENV=dev`, local backend, flag overrides panel on, analytics → console, SQLCipher plaintext-key fallback OFF (always encrypted, dev key) |
| TestFlight | `.beta` | staging backend, analytics sampled, `ff_*` beta defaults, extra diagnostics consent screen |
| Release | — | prod endpoints, on-device flag cache, symbol upload, App Store privacy manifest checked in CI |

### 49.12 iOS test harnesses

1. **Unit (swift-testing):** ViewModels against `AppDependencies.test` with fixture facades; navigation route round-trip (Codable) tests.
2. **Snapshot:** every screen light/dark × LTR/RTL × [S, L, AX3] type sizes; CI perceptual-diff gate.
3. **XCUITest critical flows:** onboarding permission dance (partial-grant matrix, v1 §12.6), log-food-in-10s, metric detail template walk, export-and-share, paywall.
4. **HK adapter harness:** simulator `HKHealthStore` seeded by `tooling/fixture-gen` (writes canonical fixture samples via a debug seeding app); conformance kit (§51.9) runs against it nightly.
5. **Perf:** XCTest metrics for cold-start <400 ms cached and 1-year chart render <100 ms (v1 §32.6 budgets), enforced in CI on a pinned device class.
