Reading: IOS-FEATURES × AND-FEATURES is ✅ — two agents can build the same screen on two platforms simultaneously against the same query interface, and the parity suite (§62.3.2) referees. FEATURES × SHELL is ⚠ only at registration points (DI/nav/strings) — eliminated by the 66.5 patterns. CORE-INTEL × FEATURES is C: features consume `XxxQuery` interfaces; contract = fake-backed query fixtures in core-testing.

### 66.3 Wave plan

**Wave 0 — Contracts + scaffold (serial, ~2 agents, ~1 week).** Agent W0-A (TRACK-CONTRACTS): freeze list artifacts. Agent W0-B (TRACK-QA-RELEASE): repo scaffold (`settings.gradle.kts`, version catalog, `ios/project.yml`, module skeletons compiling empty, PR pipeline stage 1–3). Exit = IC-1.

**Wave 1 — Data spine + design systems (parallel, ~6 agents, 2–3 weeks).** CORE-DATA: core-model + core-db + core-registry + repositories over fixtures. ADAPTERS: port fakes (in core-testing) + HK/HC read-core actuals started. IOS-SHELL and AND-SHELL: tokens, component libraries, app scaffolds, router codegen. BACKEND: identity + sync skeleton + contentcms stub. QA: core-testing harness, fixture-gen v1, affected-detection. Exit = IC-2.

**Wave 2 — Engines + shells + walking skeleton (parallel, ~8 agents, 3–4 weeks).** CORE-DATA: ingest pipeline + DedupEngine + sync engine + export engine v1 + flags/analytics clients. CORE-INTEL: baseline → scoring (sleep first) → insight/phrasing v1 → notify engine. Shells: navigation complete, policy-aware components, `LoadState`/`UiState` scaffolds, settings shell. ADAPTERS: HK/HC observe/backfill + write-back. BACKEND: integration hub v1, push, telemetry, billing stubs. CONTENT: phrasing templates + sleep education seed. The **sleep-pillar walking skeleton** (66.8 files 30–40) assembles mid-wave. Exit = IC-3 (engines) then IC-4 (skeleton).

**Wave 3 — Feature fan-out (fully parallel, ~20 agents).** Twenty feature packets, each owning one folder per platform, all consuming frozen queries/components:

| # | Feature packet | Owned folder(s) | Blueprint refs |
|---|---|---|---|
| FP-01 | Today iOS (S-20/21/22) | `ios/…/Features/Today/` | §16.3 |
| FP-02 | Today Android | `android/…/features/today/` | §16.3 |
| FP-03 | Sleep pillar iOS (S-41, deepen skeleton) | `ios/…/Features/Sleep/` | §16.5 |
| FP-04 | Sleep pillar Android | `android/…/features/sleep/` | §16.5 |
| FP-05 | Recovery + Strain pillars iOS (S-42/43) | `ios/…/Features/Recovery/`, `Features/Strain/` | §16.5 |
| FP-06 | Recovery + Strain Android | `android/…/features/recovery/`, `features/strain/` | §16.5 |
| FP-07 | Universal metric detail + Anatomy iOS (S-56/57) | `ios/…/Features/MetricDetail/` | §8.4, §22.5 |
| FP-08 | Metric detail + Anatomy Android | `android/…/features/metricdetail/` | §8.4 |
| FP-09 | All-metrics browser + Health Monitor iOS (S-55, S-20 grid) | `ios/…/Features/Browser/` | §16.5 |
| FP-10 | Browser + Health Monitor Android | `android/…/features/browser/` | §16.5 |
| FP-11 | Journey/Timeline + calendar iOS (S-30–33) | `ios/…/Features/Journey/` | §16.4 |
| FP-12 | Journey/Timeline Android | `android/…/features/journey/` | §16.4 |
| FP-13 | Log hub + food logging iOS (S-70–75) | `ios/…/Features/Log/` | §16.6, §21.2 |
| FP-14 | Log hub + food Android | `android/…/features/log/` | §16.6 |
| FP-15 | Meds + symptoms + measurements iOS (S-50–54, S-78–81) | `ios/…/Features/Care/` | §21.4–21.6 |
| FP-16 | Meds + symptoms + measurements Android | `android/…/features/care/` | §21.4–21.6 |
| FP-17 | Data sources + Export Center + Raw Explorer, both platforms (S-58–61) | `ios/…/Features/DataOwnership/`, `android/…/features/dataownership/` | §20 |
| FP-18 | Settings + consent + privacy dashboard + paywall, both platforms (S-100–104) | `ios/…/Features/Settings/`, `android/…/features/settings/` | §16.8, §28 |
| FP-19 | Coach surfaces + onboarding (S-10–17, S-90–93), both platforms | `ios/…/Features/Coach/`+`Onboarding/`, android mirrors | §16.2, §16.7 |
| FP-20 | Ambient v1: iOS widgets + Android Glance + watch/wear glances | `ios/BadanWidgets/ BadanWatch/`, `android/widgets/ wear/` | §24 |

FP-17–19 span both platforms because their logic is settings/flow-heavy and screen-light; they still own disjoint folders. Exit = IC-5.

**Wave 4 — Integration + hardening (~6 agents, 2–3 weeks).** Parity suite green across all features; perf budget passes on zoo floor devices; RTL + accessibility audits (every FP folder); notification budgets tuned live; beta rings R1→R2; release QA checklist (§62.6); store submission dry run. Exit = IC-6 → launch train.

**Agent staffing per wave (indicative):**

| Wave | Agents | Track distribution | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 2 | CONTRACTS ×1, QA-RELEASE ×1 | ~1 wk |
| 1 | 6 | CORE-DATA ×2, ADAPTERS ×1, IOS-SHELL ×1, AND-SHELL ×1, BACKEND+QA ×1 | 2–3 wks |
| 2 | 8 | CORE-DATA ×2, CORE-INTEL ×2, ADAPTERS ×1, shells ×2, BACKEND ×1 (CONTENT part-time) | 3–4 wks |
| 3 | ~20 | one agent per FP packet; CONTENT ×2 riding alongside (strings/education); CORE tracks on interface support duty only | 3–5 wks |
| 4 | 6 | QA-RELEASE ×2, one per platform pair ×2, CORE fix squad ×2 | 2–3 wks |

During Wave 3, CORE and SHELL tracks freeze their public APIs and operate a same-day interface-request queue: a feature agent files a request issue naming the query/component needed and its §16 spec line; the owning track ships it behind the existing module boundary or rejects with an alternative. Requests, not edits — this is the mechanism that keeps the ✅ cells of the 66.2 matrix true.

### 66.4 Six worked example agent work packets

**WP-04-01 — `core-baseline` engine (TRACK-CORE-INTEL, Wave 2)**
- **Objective:** implement `BaselineEngine`: rolling robust statistics (median/MAD windows per registry `baseline policy`), covariate contexts (cycle phase, statuses, travel), materialized `Baseline` rows, pause-on-gap semantics (v1 §37.1.2).
- **Owned paths:** `core/core-baseline/**`.
- **Read-only:** `core/core-model/`, `core/core-registry/`, `contracts/metrics/registry/*`, `core/core-testing/` harness, v1 §22.2, §10.13, §37.1.
- **Inputs/specs:** registry baseline-policy fields; `DerivedValueRepository`/`BaselineRepository` interfaces (frozen IC-2); fixture series in `core-testing/fixtures/baselines/` (provided by QA with golden expectations authored alongside this WP).
- **Step plan:** (1) window iterator over decimated series via `SampleRepository`; (2) robust estimators + configurable window per policy; (3) covariate-context keying (`Baseline(metric × window × context)`); (4) gap detection → pause flag; (5) provisional-confidence output for <21-day windows; (6) golden tests incl. luteal-vs-follicular fixture; (7) emit `ScoresRecomputed`-precursor domain event `BaselinesRecomputed` per `domain-events.yaml`.
- **Forbidden:** touching `core-scoring` (consumes you); adding registry fields (contracts change → ADR); any UI/string work; network access of any kind.
- **Acceptance criteria:** `RobustStatsGoldenTest`, `CovariateContextTest`, `GapPauseTest` green; property test: single artifact-flagged outlier never shifts a 30-day median band by >1%; API surface reviewed by CORE-INTEL lead.
- **Verification:** `./gradlew :core:core-baseline:allTests` and `./gradlew :core:core-baseline:apiCheck`.
- **Merge risks:** low — new module. Watch: `domain-events.yaml` event addition (contracts PR, serialize with TRACK-CONTRACTS); core-testing fixture folder additions (owned subfolder `fixtures/baselines/`, no conflicts by convention).

**WP-02-01 — HealthKit adapter read-core (TRACK-ADAPTERS, Waves 1–2)**
- **Objective:** `port-health-ios` actual of `HealthStorePort`: typed reads for §12.1–12.3 core set, `HKObserverQuery`+background delivery, anchored delta queries, capability descriptor generation, multi-year backfill with resumable progress.
- **Owned paths:** `adapters/port-health-ios/**`.
- **Read-only:** `adapters/port-health/` (interface — frozen), `core/core-model/`, v1 §12, §32.2, §37.3.
- **Inputs/specs:** `HealthStorePort` + `CapabilityDescriptor` signatures; type-mapping table from §12 (HK type ↔ metric id); recorded HK fixture responses in `core-testing/fixtures/healthkit/`.
- **Step plan:** (1) type map HK↔registry ids with unit conversions at the boundary (canonical units only leave the adapter); (2) anchored query per type with persisted anchors; (3) observer + background delivery registration; (4) backfill iterator (chunked by month, resumable cursor, progress callback for S-12); (5) provenance stamping (device, source app, HK metadata); (6) capability probe (denied/notDetermined per type → descriptor); (7) contract tests vs recorded fixtures + device smoke on zoo.
- **Forbidden:** dedup logic (core-ingest owns it — adapter emits raw canonical records); writing outside `adapters/port-health-ios/`; interpreting values; requesting permissions itself (shell drives consent flows).
- **Acceptance criteria:** contract-test suite (same suite runs against the fake and the HC adapter — one behavior spec); backfill of a 3-year fixture store streams without exceeding the §32.6 import memory ceiling; observer-to-row latency <15 min p50 on device smoke (E-02.1).
- **Verification:** `./gradlew :adapters:port-health-ios:iosSimulatorArm64Test`; device smoke via `tooling/ci/devicezoo/run-smoke.sh hk-read`.
- **Merge risks:** low (exclusive module). Watch: capability-descriptor schema changes (contracts boundary with CORE-DATA).

**WP-05-21 — Today screen iOS (TRACK-IOS-FEATURES, Wave 3, FP-01)**
- **Objective:** S-20/S-21/S-22 per the §16.3 spec: hero rings, One True Sentence, curated modules, edit-layout, calendar sheet, all §16.9 states.
- **Owned paths:** `ios/BadanApp/Features/Today/**` (`TodayScreen.swift`, `TodayViewModel.swift`, `EditTodayScreen.swift`, `CalendarSheet.swift`, `components/`, `Today.strings` catalog slice, `TodayDI.swift` registration file).
- **Read-only:** `DesignSystem/` (BadanCard, BandChart, ring components), `App/` (router, DI registry), `core` queries (`GetTodayOverviewQuery`, `GetCalendarMonthQuery`), `core-flags`, generated analytics constructors.
- **Inputs/specs:** §16.3 screen spec (the §16A writer's detail), §8.2 daily contract, §61 Today events, `ff_today_edit_layout`/`ff_today_presets`, fake-backed query fixtures from core-testing.
- **Step plan:** (1) `TodayViewModel` (@Observable) mapping query flow → `LoadState<TodayViewData>`; (2) module list rendering from `CustomizationProfile`; (3) hero + narrative card with "why →" route; (4) edit mode (drag/remove/add gallery/preset switch); (5) calendar sheet; (6) states: first-run provisional, no-wearable variant, all-denied, stale-banner; (7) analytics (`today_viewed`, `ring_tapped`, `today_edited`, `calendar_opened`); (8) snapshot matrix + XCUITest flow (open→edit→add module→verify persistence).
- **Forbidden:** editing `AppRouter.swift`/central DI (register via `TodayDI.swift` picked up by the registration list); new components in `DesignSystem/` (request via shell track); direct repository access (queries only); string literals outside the Today strings slice; new analytics events (contract change).
- **Acceptance criteria:** all §16.3 states snapshot-tested both themes × RTL × 3 sizes; casual preset renders ≤5 modules without scroll on SE 3; events fire per spec in UI test; zero writes outside owned folder (CI ownership check).
- **Verification:** `xcodebuild test -scheme BadanApp -only-testing:TodayFeatureTests`; `tooling/scripts/ownership-check --wp WP-05-21`.
- **Merge risks:** ⚠ shell registration list if codegen not yet in place (mitigation 66.5); route additions go to `routes.yaml` via contracts PR.

**WP-06-24 — Meds logging Android (TRACK-AND-FEATURES, Wave 3, FP-16 slice)**
- **Objective:** S-50/S-51 meds hub + S-79 take/skip flow: regimen list, adherence week-strip (non-punitive), skip-with-reason, take-all, reminder deep-links, regimen-change chart markers emission.
- **Owned paths:** `android/app/src/main/kotlin/net/badan/app/features/care/meds/**` (`MedsHubScreen.kt`, `MedsHubViewModel.kt`, `MedsHubUiState.kt`, `MedActionSheet.kt`, `MedDetailScreen.kt`, `medsStrings.xml` slice, `MedsDiModule.kt`).
- **Read-only:** designsystem, navigation registry (generated), `LogMedActionCommand`/`GetMedicationHubQuery` interfaces, `medication_regimens`/`adherence_events` shapes (via repositories only), v1 §21.5, §3.12 (Huda), §24.6 care-task class.
- **Step plan:** (1) `MedsHubUiState` sealed interface (Loading/Loaded/Empty/Denied/Error); (2) hub list + adherence strip (no red X's — skipped renders neutral with reason chip); (3) `MedActionSheet` one-tap take-all + skip-with-reason chips; (4) detail screen with adherence chart + linked annotations; (5) notification deep-link entry (`badan://log/meds/due`, from routes.yaml); (6) large-type preset audit (Huda: tap targets ≥48dp); (7) analytics `med_action_logged`; (8) Paparazzi matrix + Compose UI test (due list → take-all → adherence updates).
- **Forbidden:** scheduling notifications (core-notify decides; feature only renders and deep-links); adherence math in the ViewModel (query provides derived rates); dosing-advice copy of any kind (linter enforces, but do not attempt); editing NavGraph central file.
- **Acceptance criteria:** skip-with-reason persists and renders in ≤2 taps from notification; UI test proves take-all writes N `AdherenceEvent`s via command fake; a11y scanner passes at 200% font; RTL snapshot clean.
- **Verification:** `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*Meds*"` + `:app:verifyPaparazziDebug` + connected test on Pixel 6a.
- **Merge risks:** ⚠ shared `features/care/` package with symptoms agent — split by subpackage (`care/meds/` vs `care/symptoms/`), strings in separate slices; DI via per-feature module file.

**WP-09-21 — Export CSV writer (TRACK-CORE-DATA, Wave 2)**
- **Objective:** `ExportEngine` CSV path: per-table writers streaming from repositories, manifest builder, dedup-policy stamping, suppressed-duplicate inclusion with flags, RFC 4180 + UTF-8 + ISO-8601-offset compliance, schema v1 conformance.
- **Owned paths:** `core/core-export/**`.
- **Read-only:** `contracts/export/schema/v1/`, repositories, `core-model`, v1 §20.2–20.5, §64.3.
- **Step plan:** (1) column-mapping layer generated from the export schema (internal refactors can't silently change columns); (2) streaming row writers (never whole-table in memory, §32.6); (3) `manifest.json` builder (schema_version, algorithm_versions, dedup policy id, record counts, sha256 per file); (4) scope filters (metrics/date/source); (5) suppressed-duplicate rows with `suppressed_by` column in raw exports; (6) `SchemaSnapshotTest` + round-trip test (export→CSV-mapper import→counts match, feeds §62.6 item 7); (7) locale hardening: numbers always `.`-decimal regardless of UI locale, RTL text safely quoted.
- **Forbidden:** UI; changing export schemas (contracts); network; PDF logic (separate WP).
- **Acceptance criteria:** byte-stable output across platforms (parity suite includes export bytes); 1M-row samples table exports on-device under memory ceiling; dictionary generator consumes the same mapping layer without drift.
- **Verification:** `./gradlew :core:core-export:allTests` + parity export stage.
- **Merge risks:** low; boundary with WP-09-20 (dictionary generator) is the shared mapping layer — land mapping layer first, serialize the two PRs.

**WP-03-02 — Dedup conformance fixtures (TRACK-QA-RELEASE, Waves 1–2)**
- **Objective:** author the §62.3.1 fixture catalog: ≥40 real-world overlap cases with expected outcomes + runner integration; the executable spec `DedupEngine` is built against.
- **Owned paths:** `core/core-testing/fixtures/dedup/**`, runner glue in `core/core-testing/src/**/dedup/`.
- **Read-only:** `core-model` types, dedup family strategy spec (v1 §11.4, §30.6, §37.2), `DedupEngine` API signature (not internals).
- **Step plan:** (1) `catalog.yaml` index schema; (2) author case families: steps phone+watch (5 cases incl. tz-offset skew), sleep multi-source (6 incl. ring-vs-watch disagreement + nap misclassification), workout dupes (6 incl. Garmin+HK same session different durations), import-over-live (6 incl. partial-overlap batches), manual-vs-device (4), meds double-log (3), CGM artifact overlap (4), cross-tz travel (4), DST nights (2); (3) expected outputs with rule ids from the strategy spec; (4) tolerance metadata where exactness is wrong (minute-bucketed steps); (5) runner diff format showing the decision journal on failure; (6) CI-blocking wiring + coverage report mapping cases → §37.2 items.
- **Forbidden:** modifying `DedupEngine` to make fixtures pass (fixtures are the spec — engine PRs conform to fixtures, disagreements resolved via CORE-DATA review); inventing physiologically impossible data (each case cites its real-world origin in meta.yaml).
- **Acceptance criteria:** ≥40 cases, every §37.2 case ≥3 fixtures; catalog validates against its schema; failure output names rule id + records; suite runs <60 s.
- **Verification:** `./gradlew :core:core-testing:dedupConformance` and `tooling/scripts/coverage-map --suite dedup`.
- **Merge risks:** minimal (owned folder); API-signature drift with the engine WP — pin the signature at IC-2.

### 66.5 Merge-conflict heat map and mitigations

| Contended file | Why hot | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, `settings.gradle.kts` | every module addition touches them | All module registrations land in Wave 0/1 as empty skeletons; later dependency bumps only via TRACK-QA PRs; features never edit |
| `ios/project.yml` (XcodeGen) | new files/targets | Per-feature target definitions via `project.yml` includes (`ios/targets/<feature>.yml`); features own their include file |
| DI containers (`App/DI/`, `di/DiModules.kt`) | every feature registers | Registration pattern: one `<Feature>DI.swift` / `<Feature>DiModule.kt` per feature folder; central list generated by `tooling/scripts/di-gen` scanning annotations — no hand-edited central file |
| Navigation registries (`AppRouter.swift`, `navigation/NavGraph.kt`) | every screen adds routes | Routes declared in `contracts/events/routes.yaml`; both routers **generated**; features add a yaml stanza (append-only file, trivial merges) |
| String catalogs (`Localizable.xcstrings`, `strings.xml`) | every feature adds copy | Per-feature string slices (`Today.strings`, `medsStrings.xml`) merged at build; CONTENT track owns AR translation passes over slices |
| `contracts/events/analytics-events.yaml` | every feature adds events | Events for all P1 features authored **up front** in WP-08-20 (this section already enumerates them); later additions are append-only stanzas + contracts review |
| SQLDelight migration numbers | parallel schema work | `MIGRATIONS.lock` reservation (§64.1) |
| `core/core-testing/fixtures/` | every suite adds fixtures | One subfolder per suite/owner; `catalog.yaml` per suite is append-only |
| `flags.yaml` | every feature adds a flag | Append-only stanzas, key-sorted; flaggen validates duplicates |
| Design-system components | features want new components | Features may not add; request queue to shell tracks; temporary feature-local components allowed in `components/` subfolder, promoted later |

**IC-4 demo script** (recorded, becomes the regression reference): (1) fresh install on iPhone 15 Pro and Pixel 8, real accounts with ≥30 nights of wearable history; (2) grant sleep+vitals bundle; (3) backfill runs with live progress; (4) sleep score renders with provisional badge and correct personal band; (5) open S-56 for `sleep.time_asleep`, switch period 30D→3M, read definition footer; (6) export CSV, open `sleep_sessions.csv` in Numbers/Sheets, verify columns match dictionary; (7) run parity diff on both devices' export bytes — zero diffs. Elapsed target <15 min per platform including backfill of one year.

### 66.7 Review gates — lead orchestrator PR checklist per track

Every PR (danger-enforced where automatable): owned-paths only (`ownership-check`) · linked WP id · tests added/updated in same PR · no new banned-pattern strings (guardrail lint) · no central-file edits (66.5 list).

Track-specific additions:

| Track | Extra checklist items |
|---|---|
| CONTRACTS | ADR present for breaking change; all consumer tracks tagged; codegen outputs regenerated in same PR |
| CORE-DATA | Migration lock reserved; soak fixture updated; repository API changes flagged to consumers; export impact stated |
| CORE-INTEL | Golden files updated with justification; algorithm_version bumped per §64.5 class; phrasing linter run on any copy; no experimentable flags on truth paths |
| ADAPTERS | Contract suite passes on fake AND actual; capability descriptor updated; §12 matrix row cited for any type mapping |
| IOS/AND-SHELL | Component API documented; snapshot baselines for new components; token usage only (no literals) |
| IOS/AND-FEATURES | §16.9 states implemented + snapshot-tested; analytics events match §61; flags wrap incomplete work; RTL + 3 type sizes; parity counterpart WP linked |
| BACKEND | OpenAPI diff reviewed; RED metrics on new endpoints; secrets via manager; retention/privacy note for any new stored field |
| AMBIENT | Deep-links resolve via routes.yaml; widget redaction honored; battery note |
| CONTENT | Phrasing linter pass; EN+AR pair present; template family registered before enabling |
| QA-RELEASE | Pipeline changes tested on a fork run; fixture catalogs append-only; runbook links valid |
